Abu Abdillah {a.s} said to me (Muhammad ibn Muslim): "Indeed, if you give the adhan
and the iqamah, two rows of angels will pray behind you. But if you give only the
iqamah without the adhan, then one row of angels will pray behind you."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.303 • Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.97 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.52 • Rawdat Al- Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.559 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.381 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.381 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.383 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.116 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.24

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّصْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ يَحْيَى
بْنِ عِمْرَانَ الْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «الْمُؤَذَّنْ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ مَدَّ صَوْتِهِ
وَ يَشَهَدُ لَهُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ سَمِعَهُ».
قال الشيخ رحمه الله : (ولا يجوز الاذان لشئ من الصلوات قبل دخول وقتها) إلى قوله : (ولا بأس للانسان أن يؤذن وهو
على غير وضوء).
english_text:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya’qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from
al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya ibn ‘Imran al-Halabi from Muhammad ibn Marwan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "The mu’adhdhin (caller to prayer) is forgiven for the extent
of his voice, and everything that hears him bears witness for him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "It is not permissible to give
the adhan for any of the prayers before their time has entered," up to his statement:
"And there is no harm if a person gives the adhan while not in a state of ritual purity
(wuduʾ)."
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.307 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.52 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.561 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.374

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ عَلِيَّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ - عَنِ
الْأَذَانِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَلا وَ إِذَا كَانَ وَحْدَهُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from al-Nadr from Yahya al-Halabi from ‘Imran ibn Ali, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about giving the adhan before Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is in congregation, then no [it is not permissible]; but if he is alone,
then there is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.306 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.53 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.601 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.615 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.390 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.448 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.117

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ لَنَا مُؤَذَّناً يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَقَالَ «أَمَا إِنَّ
ذَلِكَ يَنْفَعُ الْجِيرَانَ لِقِيَامِهِمْ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَ أَمَّا السِّنَّةُ فَإِنَّهُ يُنَادَى مَعَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ وَ لا يَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ
إِلاَّ الرَّكْعَتَانِ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from al-Nadr from Ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: "We have a mu’adhdhin who gives the adhan during the night."
Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, that benefits the neighbors by prompting them to rise for
prayer. But as for the sunnah, it is that the call (adhan) is made at the rising of the dawn
(tulu’ al-fajr), and there should be nothing between the adhan and the iqamah except
the two [Sunnah] rak’ahs."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.53 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.615 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.390

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ النَّدَاءِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ وَ أَمَا ٱلسُنَّةُ مَعَ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَ
إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَيَنْفَعُ الْجِيرَانَ يَعْنِي قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : (ولا بأس أن يؤذن الانسان وهو على غير وضوء ولا يقيم إلا وهو على وضوء).
english_text:
Narrated from him from Fadalah from Ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about calling (the adhan) before the rising of Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm, but the sunnah is to call at the time of Fajr. And
indeed, that (calling before Fajr) benefits the neighbors", meaning, before the Fajr.
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
The Shaykh, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: "There is no harm if a person gives
the adhan while not in a state of ritual purity (without wuduʾ), but he should not give
the iqamah except while in a state of wuduʾ."
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.53 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.616 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.391

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُؤَذِّنَ وَ أَنْتَ
عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوء طَهُورٍ وَ لاَ تُقِيمُ إِلَّ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى وُضُوءِ».
english_text:
Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no harm in giving the adhan while you are not in a state
of purity (wuduʾ), but do not give the iqamah except while you are in a state of wuduʾ."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.53 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.594 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.392

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَعَثَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ
يُؤَذِّنَ الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءِ وَ لاَ يُقِيمُ إِلَّ وَ هُوَ عَلَى وُضُوءِ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Muhammad al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no harm if a man gives the adhan while not in a state of
wuduʾ, but he should not give the iqamah unless he is in a state of wuduʾ."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.304 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.53 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.592 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.391

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
سَعَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بِي مُوسَى الْخَشَابِ عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ كَلُوبِ بْنِ فَيْهَسِ عَنْ
إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ عَلِياً عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ ٱَلْغَلاَمُ
قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ وَ لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ وَ هُوَ جُنْبٌ وَ لا يُقِيمُ حَتَّى يَفْتَسِلَ».
قال الشيخ رحمه الله : (وان عرض للمؤذن حاجة يحتاج الى كلام ليس من الاذان فليتكلم به ولا يجوز أن يتكلم في الاقامة
english_text:
Narrated by Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from
Ghiyath ibn Kallub ibn Fayhas from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (narrates) from his father (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}), that (Imam) Ali {a.s},
peace be upon him, used to say: "There is no harm if a boy gives the adhan before
reaching puberty, and there is no harm if the mu’adhdhin gives the adhan while in a
state of janabah (major ritual impurity), but he should not give the iqamah until he has
performed ghusl."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "If a need arises for the
mu’adhdhin such that he must speak words not part of the adhan, then he may speak.
But it is not permissible to speak during the iqamah when one has the choice."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.289 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.53 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.595

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ
أَيَتَكَلَّمُ الرَّجُلُ فِي الْأَذَانِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» قُلْتُ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ قَالَ (لاَ)).
english_text:
Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn Uthman from ‘Amr ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "May a man speak during the adhan?"
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
I asked: "What about during the iqamah?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.304 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.54 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.54 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.300 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.593 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.394 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.396

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْذِّنِ أَ يَتَكَلَّمُ وَ هُوَ يُؤَذَّنُ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ جِينَ يَفْرُغُ
مِنْ أَذَانِهِ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from al-Hasan from Zur’ah from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the mu’adhdhin, may he speak while giving the adhan?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm after he finishes his adhan."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.54 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.595 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.394

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وعنه عن أحمد عن الحسين بن سعيد عن فضالة بن أيوب عن الحسين بن عثمان عن عمرو بن أبي نصر قال
قلت: لابي عبد اللّه عليه السلام أيتكلم الرجل في الاذان؟ قال : لا بأس.
english_text:
Narrated from him from Ahmad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Husayn ibn
Uthman from ‘Amr ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "May a man speak during the adhan?"
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ
أَبِي هَارُونَ الْمَكْفُوفِ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ : «يَا أَبَا هَارُونَ ٱلْإِقَامَةُ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ فَإِذَا أَقَمْتَ فَلاَ تَتَكَلَّمْ وَ لا تُومِ بِيَدِكَ».
english_text:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya’qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from
Muhammad ibn Isma’il from Salih ibn ‘Uqba from Abu Harun al-Makfuf, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "O Abu Harun, the iqamah is part of the prayer, so when you have
given the iqamah, do not speak and do not gesture with your hand."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.305 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.54 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.593 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.396

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
فَأَمًا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي أَذَانِهِ أَوْ فِي إقَامَتِهِ فَقَالَ (لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abdullah ibn Muskan from
Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who speaks during his adhan or during his
iqamah.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.54 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.596 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.395

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى سَعَدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ أَيَتَكَلَّمُ بَعْدَ مَا يُقِيمُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Narrated by Sa’d from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman, who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man, may he speak after he has given the iqamah for
prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.54 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.596 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.395

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ
الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ يُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ وَ بَعْدَ مَا يُقِيمُ إِنْ شَاءَ».
فهذه الاخبار محمولة على حال الضرورة دون الاختيار ويكون ذلك الكلام ايضا لشئ يتعلق بالصلاة مثل تقديم إمام
وتسوية صف وما يجري مجراهما ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Narrated from him from Ja’far ibn Bashir from al-Hasan ibn Shihab, who said:
I (al-Hasan ibn Shihab) heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "There is no harm if a man speaks
while he is giving the iqamah, or after he has given the iqamah, if he wishes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So these narrations are to be understood as applying to situations of necessity rather
than choice, and such speech should also be related to matters concerning the
prayer, like appointing an imam, straightening the rows, or matters similar to them.
What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.55 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.301 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.601 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.597 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.395 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.118

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ
اللّه عَ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ فَإِذَا قَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاةُ فَقَدْ حَرُمَ الْكَلاَمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ
الْمَسْجِدِ إلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونُوا قَدِ اِجْتَمَعُوا مِنْ شَتَّى وَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ إِمَامٌ فَلا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَقُولَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضِ تَقَدَّمْ يَا فُلانُ».
english_text:
Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn Uthman from Ibn Muskan from Ibn Abi
‘Umayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who speaks during the iqamah.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, but when the mu’adhdhin says ‘Qad qamat al-salah’ (the prayer
has been established), then speech becomes forbidden for the people in the mosque,
except if they have gathered from different places and have no imam; then there is no
harm if some of them say to one another, ‘Go ahead, so-and-so (and lead the prayer).’"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.55 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.595 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.395 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.160

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا أَقَامَ ٱلْمُؤَذِّنُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَدْ حَرُمَ
اَلْكَلاَمُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ ٱَلْقَوْمُ لَيْسَ يُعْرَفُ لَهُمْ إِمَامٌ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from al-Hasan from Zur’ah from Sama’ah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When the mu’adhdhin gives the iqamah for the prayer, then
speaking becomes prohibited, except if the people do not have a known imam."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.55 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.302 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.596 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.394

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ: «لا تَتَكَلَّمْ إِذَا أَقَمْتَ
الصَّلاةَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا تَكَلَّمْت أعدت القام
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ولا بأس أن يؤذن الانسان جالسا إذا كان ضعيفا في جسمه أو كان راكبا ولمثل ذلك من الاسباب ،
ولا تجوز الاقامة إلا وهو قائم متوجه الى القبلة مع الاختيار).
english_text:
Narrated from him from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not speak once you have given the iqamah for the prayer, for
if you speak, you must repeat the iqamah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "There is no harm if a person
gives the adhan while sitting, if he is physically weak or riding, or due to similar
reasons. However, the iqamah is not permissible except while standing and facing the
qiblah, when one has the ability to do so."
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.55 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.596 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.394

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ : «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ
تُوَّذِّنَ رَاكِباً أَوْ مَاشِياً أَوْ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوء وَ لاَ تُقِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ رَاكِبٌ أَوْ جَالِسٌ إِلاَّ مِنْ عِلْةٍ أَوْ تَكُونَ فِي أَرْضِ مَلَصَّةِ».
english_text:
Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn Uthman from Sama’ah from Abu Basir, who
said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no harm in giving the adhan while riding, walking, or
without wuduʾ. But do not give the iqamah while riding or sitting, except due to an
ailment or if you are in a slippery land."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.56 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.597 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.403

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ لِلْمُسَافِرِ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ وَ هُوَ رَاكِبٌ وَ يُقِيمُ
وَ هُوَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ قَائِمٌ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from al-Nadr from Ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no harm for a traveller to give the adhan while riding,
and to give the iqamah while standing on the ground."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.56 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.597 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.402

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ يُؤَذِّنُ الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ قَاعِدٌ قَالَ
«نَعَمْ وَ لاَ يُقِيمُ إِلاَّ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from Hammad from Rib’i from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "May a man give the adhan while sitting?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, but he should not give the iqamah except while standing."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.56 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.302 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.598 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.402

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ صَالِحِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يُؤَذِّنْ الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ وَ لاَ يُقِيمُ إِلاّ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ»
وَقَالَ «تُؤَذِّنُ وَ أَنْتَ رَاكِبٌ وَ لاَ تُقِيمُ إِلاَّ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى ٱلأَرْضِ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from Ahmad ibn Muhammad:
The Righteous servant (Abd Salih {a.s}), peace be upon him, said: "A man may give the
adhan while sitting, but he should not give the iqamah except while standing."
And Imam {a.s} said: "You may give the adhan while riding, but do not give the iqamah
except while on the ground."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.56 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.302 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.598 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.402

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي أَوْ
عَلَى ظَهْرِ دَابَّتِهِ وَ عَلَى غَيْرِ طَهُورٍ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ التَّشَهُدُ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Narrated from him from Fadalah from al-’Alaʾ from Muhammad from one of the two
(Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who gives the adhan while walking, or on the back of his
animal, or without being in a state of ritual purity.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the tashahhud (the part of the adhan with ‘Ashhadu...’) is said while
facing the qiblah, then there is no harm."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.285 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.56 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.598 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.403

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ
سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا يُقِيمُ أَحَدُكُمُ الصَّلاةَ وَ هُوَ مَاشٍ وَ لا رَاكِبٌ وَ لاَ مُصْطَجِعْ
إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَرِيضاً وَ لَيَتَمَكَّنْ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ كَمَا يَتَمَكِّنُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا أَخَذَ فِي الإِقَامَةِ فَهُوَ فِي صَلاةٍ».
english_text:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya’qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from
Muhammad ibn Isma’il from Salih ibn ‘Uqba from Sulayman ibn Salih:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "None of you should give the iqamah for prayer while walking, or
riding, or lying down, unless he is ill. And let him be firmly settled during the iqamah
just as he is firmly settled during the prayer, for when he begins the iqamah, he is
already in a state of prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.306 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.56 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.594 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.404

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ النسباني عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أُوَّذِّنُ وَ أَنَا رَاكِبٌ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقُلْتُ فَأُقِيمُ وَ أَنَا رَاكِبٌ فَقَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ فَأُقِيمُ وَ أَنَا مَاشِ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ مَاشِ إِلَى الصَّلاةِ» قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي «إِذَا أَقَمْتَ فَأْقِمْ مُتَرَسِّلاً فَإِنَّكَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ» فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَقَدْ سَألْثُكَ
أُقِيمُ وَ أَنَا مَاشِ فَقُلْتَ لِي نَعَمْ أَفَيَجُوزُ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ فِي الصِّلاةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مِنْ بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَكَبَّرْتَ وَ
أَنْتَ مَعَ إِمَامِ عَادِلِ ثُمَّ مَشَيْتَ إِلَى الصَّلاةِ أَجْزَأَكَ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Narrated by Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Buzay’ from Salih ibn ‘Uqba from Yunus al-
Nisbani from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: "May I give the adhan while I am riding?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: "Then may I give the iqamah while I am riding?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
I asked: "May I give the iqamah while I am walking?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, walking toward the prayer."
Then Imam {a.s} said to me: "When you give the iqamah, give it calmly (with composure),
for indeed you are in the prayer."
I said to Him {a.s}: "But I asked you whether I may give the iqamah while walking, and
you said yes. So is it permissible for me to walk while in prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, if you enter from the door of the mosque and you have said the
takbir while following a just imam, and then you walk toward the prayer, that suffices
for you."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.57 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.598

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدِ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الأذَانِ جَالِسا قَالَ «لاَ يُؤَذِّنُ جَالِساً إِلاَّ رَاكِبٌ أَوْ مَرِيضٌ».
فهذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب لانا قد بينا جواز الاذان جالسا من غير علة وهذا محمول على الفضل والندب.
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (وليس على النساء أذان ولا اقامة بل يتشهدن الشهادتين ، ولو أذن واقمن على الاخفات لم يكن
مأزورات بل كن ماجورات).
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid
from Humran, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s} about giving the adhan while sitting.
Imam {a.s} said: "No one gives the adhan while sitting except one who is riding or ill."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
So this narration is to be understood as recommending (indicating preference),
because we have already established the permissibility of giving the adhan while
sitting without any excuse. Therefore, this report is to be taken as referring to what is
more virtuous and preferred (mustahabb and mandub).
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "There is no adhan or iqamah
required of women; rather, they should recite the two testimonies (shahadatayn).
However, if they do give the adhan and iqamah in a subdued voice (without raising it),
they are not blameworthy, rather, they will be rewarded for it."
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.57 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.302 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.599 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.404

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ
عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ أَعَلَيْهَا أَذَانْ وَ إقَامَةً فَقَالَ «لا)».
english_text:
Narrated by Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said: al-Husayn ibn Sa’id narrated to us
from Fadalah ibn Ayyub and Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a woman, is adhan and iqamah obligatory upon her?
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.305 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.57 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.613 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.406

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَدَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ النِّسَاءُ عَلَيْهِنَّ
أَذَانٌ فَقَالَ «إِذَا شَهِدَتِ الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَحَسْبُهَا».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘eed from Ibn Abi Umayr from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Are women required to perform the
Adhan?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If she proclaims the two testimonies, that is sufficient for her.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.57 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.614 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.405

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ - عَنِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ تُؤَذَّنُ لِلصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «حَسَنْ إِنْ فَعَلَتْ
وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ أَجْزَأَهَا أَنْ تُكَبَّرَ وَ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه (ومن أذن فليقف على آخر كل فصل من اذانه ويرفع صوته ولا يخفض به نفسه دون اسماعه نفسه
اياه) إلى آخر الباب.
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr and Fadhala, from Abdullah who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a woman giving the Adhan for prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “It is good if she does so, and if she does not do it, it suffices for her to
say ‘Allahu Akbar’ and to bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT} and that
Muhammad {saws} is the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} send blessings upon him
and his family.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “And whoever performs the Adhan
should pause at the end of each section of his Adhan, and he should raise his voice
and not lower it below the level where he can hear himself” until the end of chapter.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.58 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.614 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.405

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ :
«الْأَذَانُ جَزْمٌ بِإِفْصَاحِ الْأَلِفِ وَ الْهَاءِ وَ الْإِقَامَةُ حَدْرٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah who
said:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Adhan is to be pronounced clearly, with
articulation of the Alif’ and the ‘ha’, and the Iqamah is to be recited quickly in a flowing
manner.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.58 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.576 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.408 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.429

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثِمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ نَجِيحِ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «التَّكْبِيرُ جَزْمٌ فِي الْأَذَانِ مَعَ الْإِفْصَاحِ بِالْهَاءِ وَ الْأَلِفِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Khalid ibn Najeeh:
(Imam) Al-Sadiq {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Takbir is to be pronounced firmly
in the Adhan with clear articulation of the ‘ha’ and the Alif’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.283 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.58 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.576 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.408

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَذَّنْتَ فَلا تُخْفِيَنَ صَوْتَكَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْجُرُكَ مَدَّ صَوْتِكَ فِيهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad from Hariz
from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you perform the Adhan, do not lower your voice, for Allah
{SWT} rewards you for extending your voice in it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.58 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.563 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.410

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«كَانَ طُولُ حَائِطِ مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَامَةً فَكَانَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ لِبِلاَلِ «إِذَا دَخَلَ الْوَقْتُ
يَا بِلالُ اُغْلُ قَوْقَ الْجِدَارِ وَ اِرْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ بِالْأَذَانِ فَإِنَّ اللْهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ قَدْ وَكِّلَ بِالْأَذَانِ رِيحاً تَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَ إِنَّ
اَلْمَلائِكَةَ إِذَا سَمِعُوا الْأَذَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ قَالُوا هَذِهِ أَصْوَاتُ أَمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِتَوْجِيدِ اللَّهِ عَزّ وَ
جَلَّ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِأُمَّةٍ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا مِنْ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةِ» ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl from Ibn Mahbub from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The height of the wall of Mosque of the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, was the height of a man, so He {saws}, peace be
upon him, used to say to Bilal;
‘When the time (for prayer) enters, O Bilal, climb up on top of the wall and raise your
voice with the Adhan, for indeed Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has assigned a
wind for the Adhan that carries it up to the heavens. And indeed, when the angels hear
the Adhan from the people of the earth, they say:
‘These are the voices of the nation of Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, proclaiming the oneness of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, and they
seek forgiveness for the nation of Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, until they complete that prayer.’”
source: Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.307 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.58 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.561

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN (CALL TO PRAYER) AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ : أَنَّهُ شَكَا إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
سُقْمَهُ وَ أَنَّهُ لا يُولَدُ لَهُ فَأَمَرَهُ بِأَنْ يَرْفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالْأَذَانِ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ فَأَذْهَبَ آللَّهُ عَنِّي سُقْمِي وَ كَثِرَ وُلْدِي.
قال محمد ابن راشد وكنت دائم العلة ما انفك منها في نفسي وجماعة خدمي فلما سمعت ذلك من هشام عملت به فاذهب
اللّه عني وعن عيالي العلل.
٧ - باب عدد فصول الاذان والاقامة ووصفهما
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Muhammad ibn Rashid who said: Hisham ibn Ibrahim narrated to me:
He (Hisham ibn Ibrahim) complained to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon
him, about his illness and that he had no children.
So He {a.s} instructed him to raise his voice with the Adhan in his house.
He (Hisham ibn Ibrahim) said: ‘I did so, and Allah {SWT} removed my illness and
increased my children.’
AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Rashid said: “I used to be constantly afflicted with illness, never free
from it, in myself and among a group of my servants. So when I heard that from
Hisham, I acted upon it, and Allah {SWT} removed the illnesses from me and my family.”
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “The Adhan and the Iqamah
consist of thirty-five sections: the Adhan is eighteen sections, and the Iqamah is
seventeen sections” up to his statement “When he finishes the Adhan”.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.412 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.2 1 p.373

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH,
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ
الْجُعْفِيّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «الْأَذَانُ وَ الْإِقَامَةُ خَمْسَةٌ وَ ثَلاَثُونَ حَرْفًا فَعَدَّ ذَلِكَ بِيَدِهِ وَاجِداً
وَاجِداً الْأَذَانَ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ حَرْفاً وَ الْإِقَامَةَ سَبْعَةً عَشَرَ حَرْفاً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from Yunus from Aban ibn
Uthman from Isma‘il al-Ju‘fi who said:
I heard (Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “The Adhan and the Iqamah are
thirty-five phrases.”
Then He {a.s} counted them with His {a.s} hand, one by one: “The Adhan is eighteen
phrases, and the Iqamah is seventeen phrases.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.302 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.59 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.305 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.573 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.413 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.110

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْأَذَانِ فَقَالَ « تَقُولُ
- آَللَّهُ أَكْرَءُ آَللَّهُ أَكْرَءُ أَشَدُ أَه لاَ الَهَ الاَّ آَلَّهُ أَشَئُ أَه لاَالَهَ الأَ آَلَهُ أَشهَدُ أَنّ مُحَتّدا مَلمل اللَّه أَهُ أَن ا
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the Adhan.
Imam {a.s} said: “You say, ‘Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah,
Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadur Rasulullah, Ashhadu anna
Muhammadur Rasulullah, Hayya alas-salah, Hayya alas-salah, Hayya alal-falah,
Hayya alal-falah, Hayya ala khayril-amal, Hayya ala khayril-amal, Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, La ilaha illallah La ilaha illallah.’”
(Allah {SWT} is the Greatest, Allah {SWT} is the Greatest. I bear witness that there is no god
but Allah {SWT}, I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}. I bear witness that
Muhammad {saws} is the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, I bear witness that Muhammad {saws} is
the Messenger of Allah {SWT}. Come to prayer, come to prayer. Come to success, come
to success. Come to the best of deeds, come to the best of deeds. Allah {SWT} is the
Greatest, Allah {SWT} is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah {SWT}, there is no god but
Allah {SWT}.)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.59 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.305 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.577 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.414

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيَّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ إِبْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ
عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: « لَمَّا أَسْرِيَ بِرَسُولِ اللهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَبَلَغَ الْبَيْتَ الْمَعْمُورَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ
فَأَذَّنَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ أَقَامَ فَتَقَدَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ صَفَّ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ النَّبِيُّونَ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ
اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ » قَالَ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ كَيْفَ أَذَّنَ فَقَالَ « اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ - أَشَهَدُ أَنْ لا
إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللهُ أَشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمّداً رَسُولُ اللّهِ أَشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللّهِ حَيٍّ عَلَى الصَّلَاَةِ حَيِّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَيَّ عَلَى
الْفَلاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاحِ حَيٍّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَ اللَّهُ»
« وَ الْإِقَامَةُ مِثلُهَا إِلا أَنَّ فِيهَا قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاَةُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ بَيْنَ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ ٱلْعَمَلِ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ وَ
بَيْنَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِلالا فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُؤَذِّنُ بِهَا حَتَّى قَبَضَ اللَّهُ - رَسُولَهُ
صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn al-Sindi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah
and al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar:
(Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “When the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, was taken on the night journey and reached
the Bayt al-Ma‘mur, the time of prayer came, so Jibra’il {a.s}, peace be upon him, gave
the Adhan and the Iqamah. Then the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, stepped forward, and the angels and the prophets lined up behind the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.”
He (ibn Yasar) said: “So we (Zurarah and al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar) said to Him {a.s}, “How
did He {saws} give the Adhan?”
Imam {a.s} said: “‘Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an
la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah, Ashhadu anna
Muhammadan Rasulullah; Hayya ‘ala al-salah, Hayya ‘ala al-salah; Hayya ‘ala al-
falah, Hayya ‘ala al-falah; Hayya ‘ala khayr al-‘amal, Hayya ‘ala khayr al-‘amal; Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha illallah, La ilaha illallah.’
And the Iqamah is like it, except that in it is: ‘Qad qamatis-salah, qad qamatis-salah’
placed between ‘Hayya ‘ala khayr al-‘amal, Hayya ‘ala khayr al-‘amal’ and ‘Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar.’
So the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, instructed Bilal
with it, and he (Bilal) continued to call it until Allah {SWT} took the soul of His Messenger,
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.60 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.305 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.416

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
وَ كُلَيْبِ الْأَسَدِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : أَنَّهُ حَكَى لَهُمَا الْأَذَانَ فَقَالَ - « آَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ آللَّهُ
أَكْبَرُ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ - حَيَّ
عَلَى الصَّلَاَةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَيَّ عَلَى ٱلْفَلاَحِ حَيَّ عَلَى ٱلْفَلاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ اللَّهُ
أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّهُ وَ الْإِقَامَةُ كَذَلِكَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Fadhala from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and from Kulayb al-Asadi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} recited the Adhan to both of them (Abu Bakr al-Hadrami and Kulayb
al-Asadi), and Imam {a.s} said:
“Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah,
Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah, Ashhadu anna
Muhammadan Rasulullah; Hayya ‘ala al-salah, Hayya ‘ala al-salah; Hayya ‘ala al-
falah, Hayya ‘ala al-falah; Hayya ‘ala khayr al-‘amal, Hayya ‘ala khayr al-‘amal; Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha illallah, La ilaha illallah. And the Iqamah is likewise.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.289 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.60 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.306 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.416 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.40

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنِ الْمُعَلَّى بْنِ خُنَيْسِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يُؤْذِّنُ فَقَالَ « اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ
اللهُ أَشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللّهِ أشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاَةِ حَيَّ عَلَى اَلْفَلاَحِ
حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ» حَتَى قَرَغَ مِنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ وَ قَالَ فِي آخِرِهِ « ٱَللَّهُ أكْبَرُ ٱَللَهُ أكْبَرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ».
فأما الحديثان الاولان وان تضمنا ذكر الله اكبر مرتين في أول الاذان فيجوز أن يكون إنما اقتصر على ذلك لانه قصد الى
افهامه السائل كيفية التلفظ به وكان المعلوم له ان ذلك لا يجزي الاقتصار عليه دون الاربع مرات، والذي يكشف عما ذكرناه
من أنه لا يجوز الاقتصار على مرتين مع الاختيار ما رواه:
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadhala from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from al-Mu‘alla ibn
Khunays who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} performing the Adhan, and Imam {a.s} said:
“Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah,
Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah, Ashhadu anna
Muhammadan Rasulullah; Hayya ‘ala al-salah, Hayya ‘ala al-salah; Hayya ‘ala al-
falah, Hayya ‘ala al-falah”, until He {a.s} completed the Adhan.
Imam {a.s} said at the end of it: “Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha illallah, La ilaha
illallah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
As for the first two narrations, although they include the mention of ‘Allahu Akbar’
twice at the beginning of the Adhan, it is possible that the reason for this limitation was
merely to teach the questioner the way to pronounce it. And it was already known to
him that such limitation does not suffice without completing it to four times. What
clarifies what we have mentioned, that it is not permissible to suffice with only two
times when one has the choice, is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.61 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.420

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يَا زُرَارَةُ تَفْتَتِحُ الأَذَانَ بِأَرْبَعِ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ وَ تَخْتِمُهُ بِتَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ وَ تَهْلِيلَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from
Zurarah:
(Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “O Zurarah, you begin the Adhan with
four Takbirs and you end it with two Takbirs and two declarations of ‘La ilaha illallah’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.303 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.61 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.307 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.573 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.413

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الأَذَانُ مَثنَى
مَثْنَى وَ اَلْإِقَامَةُ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadhala from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Adhan is in pairs, two by two, and the Iqamah is single, one
by one.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.61

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْإِقَامَةُ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَإِنَّهُ مَرَّتَانِ».
فمحمول على حال التقية أو عند العجلة دون حال الاختيار، والذي يكشف عما ذكرناه.
english_text:
And what was narrated by Sa‘d from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Safwan ibn
Yahya from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Iqamah is once, once, except for the statement ‘Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar’, for it is said twice.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So it is to be interpreted as referring to a situation of ‘taqiyyah’ (dissimulation) or in
times of haste, not in a state of choice and full deliberation. And what clarifies what
we have mentioned is the following.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.61 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.307 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.580 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.425

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ الْحَذَّاءِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُكَبِّرُ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً فِي الْأَذَانِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لِمَ تُكَبِّرُ وَاحِدَةً
وَاجِدَةً فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ إِذَا كُنْتَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً».
english_text:
What was narrated by Sa‘d ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadhala
ibn Ayyub from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Abu ‘Ubaydah al-Hadhdha’ who said:
I (al-Hadhdha’) saw (Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, saying the Takbir one by
one in the Adhan, so I said to Him {a.s}: “Why are you saying the Takbir one by one?”
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in it if you are in a hurry.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.62 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.307 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.579 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.425

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنْ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ الْجَمَّالِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
«الْأَذَانُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَ الْإِقَامَةُ مَثْنَى مَثَنَى».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Ibn Abi Najran from Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: “The Adhan is in pairs, two by two, and the Iqamah is in
pairs, two by two.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.303 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.62 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.307 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.573 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.414

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ مَوْلَى الْحَكَمِ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ سَمِعْثُهُ يَقُولُ: «لَأَنْ أَقِيمَ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى أَحَبٌ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُوَذِّنَ وَ أَقِيمَ وَاحِداً وَاحِداً».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadhala from Husayn ibn Uthman from Ibn Muskan from Yazid, the client of al-Hakam,
from someone who narrated to him from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, he said:
I heard Him {a.s} say: “For me to perform the Iqamah in pairs, two by two, is more
beloved to me than to perform the Adhan and the Iqamah each as single statements,
one by one.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.62 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.308 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.580 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.423

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةً عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةً عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «الْأَذَانُ يُقْصَرُ فِي
السَّفَرِ كَمَا تُقْصَرُ الصَّلاَةُ الْأَذَانُ وَاحِداً وَاحِداً وَ الْإِقَامَةُ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah from Burayd ibn Mu‘awiyah:
(Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Adhan is shortened during travel
just as the prayer is shortened, the Adhan is single, one by one, and the Iqamah is
single, one by one.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.62 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.308 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.579 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.424

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ نُعْمَانَ الرَّازِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
«يُجْزِيكَ عَنِ الْإِقَامَةِ طَاقٌ طَاقٌ فِي السَّفَرِ».
english_text:
Sa‘d from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja‘far ibn Bashir from Nu‘man al-Razi who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: “It suffices you in place of the Iqamah during travel to say
each phrase once, once.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.62 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.308 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.580 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.425

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ
يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «النَّدَاءُ وَ التَّثِوِيبُ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from al-Husayn from
Hammad ibn Isa from Shu‘ayb ibn Ya‘qub from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The call (Adhan) and the repetition (Tathwib) in the Iqamah are
from the Sunnah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.62

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ هُوَ أَيْضا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبِي يُنَادِي فِي بَيْتِهِ « بِالصَّلاَةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ» وَ لَوْ رَدَّدْتَ ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِهِ بَأْسٌ».
وما أشبه هذين الحديثين مما يتضمن ذكر هذه الالفاظ فانها محمولة على التقية لاجماع الطائفة على ترك العمل بها ، ويدل
عليه ايضا ما رواه :
english_text:
And what was also narrated by him from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from al-Husayn from Fadhala from al-‘Ala’
from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
(Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “My father {a.s} used to call out in His
{a.s} house; ‘Al-salatu khayrun min al-nawm’ (Prayer is better than sleep), and if you
repeat that, there is no harm in it.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al- Abidin {a.s}
commentary:
And what resembles these two narrations, which include the mention of these
phrases, is to be interpreted as being due to ‘taqiyyah’ (dissimulation), because of the
consensus of the Shia community on abandoning practice upon them (‘Al-salatu
khayrun min al-nawm’). This is also supported by what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.63 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.308 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.601 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.581 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.427 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.168

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ - عَنِ
اَلتَثوِيبِ الَّذِي يَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ فَقَالَ «مَا نَعْرِفُهُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadhala and Hammad ibn Isa from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the ‘tathwib’ (‘Al-salatu khayrun min al-nawm’) that
occurs between the Adhan and the Iqamah.
Imam {a.s} said: “We do not recognize it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.303 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.63 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.308 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.601 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.575 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.425 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.167

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ
زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «يَا زُرَارَةُ تَفْتَتِحُ ٱلْأَذَانَ بِأَرْبَعِ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ وَ تَخْتِمُهُ بِتَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ وَ تَهْلِيلَتَيْنِ
وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ زِدْتَ عَلَى التَّثَوِيبِ - حَيٍّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ مَكَانَ الصَّلاَةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ».
فلو كان ذكر الصلاة خير من النوم من السنة لما سوغ له تكرار اللفظ والعدول عما هو السنة الى تكرار اللفظ ، وتكرار اللفظ
إنما يجوز إذا اريد به تنبيه انسان على الصلاة أو انتظار آخر أو ما أشبه ذلك يبين ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Najran from Hammad ibn
Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who said:
(Imam) Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: “O Zurarah, you begin the Adhan
with four Takbirs and you end it with two Takbirs and two declarations of ‘La ilaha
illallah ‘. And if you wish, you may add in place of ‘tathwib’, after ‘Hayya ‘ala al-falah’,
the phrase ‘Al-salatu khayrun min al-nawm’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
So if the mention of ‘al-salatu khayrun min al-nawm’ were from the Sunnah, He {a.s}
would not have been permitted to repeat the phrase or to deviate from what is the
Sunnah by repeating it. Repeating the phrase is only allowed when the intention is to
alert someone to prayer, or to wait for another person, or for something similar. This is
clarified by what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.63 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.309 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.580

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لَوْ أَنَّ مُؤَذِّناً أَعَادَ فِي الشَّهَادَةِ وَ فِي حَيٍّ عَلَى الصَّلاةِ أَوْ حَيْ عَلَى ٱلْفَلاَحِ
الْمَرَّتَيْنِ وَ الثَّلَاث وَ أَكْتَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِذَا كَانَ إِمَاماً يُرِيدُ جَمَاعَةَ الْقَوْمِ لِيَجْمَعَهُمْ لَمْ يَكُنُ بِهِ بَأْسِّ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (فإذا فرغ من اذانه على ما شرحناه فليجلس بعده جلسة خفيفة) الى قوله : (فإذا أراد أن يقيم).
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Ali
ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “If a mu’adhdhin were to repeat the testimony or ‘Hayya ‘ala al-
salah’ or ‘Hayya ‘ala al-falah’ two times, three times, or more than that, if he is an
imam who wishes to gather the people together for congregational prayer, then there
is no harm in it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “When he finishes his Adhan
as we have explained, he should sit after it for a short while” up to his statement: “Then
when he wants to perform the Iqamah”.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.308 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.63 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.309 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.582 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.428

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«لاَ بُدَّ مِنْ قُعُودِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Ibn Abi Umayr from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah from al-Hasan ibn Shihab:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “There must be a sitting between the Adhan and the Iqamah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.64 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.585 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.397 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.181

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ الْجَعْفَرِيّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «أُفْرُقُ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ وَ ٱلْإِقَامَةِ بِجُلُوسِ أَوْ بِرَكْعَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Sulayman ibn Ja‘far al-Ja‘fari who said:
I heard Him {a.s} say: “Separate between the Adhan and the Iqamah with a sitting or with
two units of prayer.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.64 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.585 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.397 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.181

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ قَالَ: «ٱلْقُعُودُ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ كُلِّهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنُ قَبْلَ ٱلْإِقَامَةِ صَلاَةً
يُصَلَّيهَا».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad:
He (Imam al-Ridha {a.s}) said: “The sitting between the Adhan and the Iqamah is for all
the prayers, if there is no prayer being performed before the Iqamah.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.306 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.64 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.181

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ بَعْضٍ
أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ قَعْدَةٌ إِلَّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَ فَإِنَّ بَيْنَهُمَا نَفَساً».
وقد روي أنه يجلس بينهما في المغرب وقد أوردناه فيما بعد في الزيادات. .
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf from Sayf
ibn Umayrah from one of our companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Between every two Adhans (between the Adhan and the
Iqamah) there is a sitting, except for Maghrib, for between them is only a brief pause.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And it has been narrated that he sits between them in Maghrib as well, and we have
mentioned it later in the section on additions (‘al-ziyadaat’).
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.64 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.309 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.586 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.398 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.181

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ
جَغْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ رَفَعَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ: «يَقُولُ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا قَرَغَ مِنَ ٱلأَذَانِ وَ جَلَسَ - اَللّهُمّ اِجْعَلْ قَلْبِي بَارَاً وَ
رِزَقِي دَارَاً وَ اِجْعَلْ لِي عِنْدَ قَبْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَرَاراً وَ مُسْتَقَرّاً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn ‘Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from
al-Husayn ibn Rashid from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqtin, who raised it to them:
(Imam {a.s}) said: “When a man finishes the Adhan and sits, he says: ‘O Allah {SWT}, make
my heart righteous, and my sustenance flowing, and grant me a place and a
settlement near the grave of the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family.’”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.64

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ الْجَرِيرِيِّ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ قَالَ قَالَ: «مَنْ جَلَسَ فِيمَا بَيْنَ أَذَانِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ كَانَ كَالْمُتَشَحَطِ بِدَمِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (وإذا أراد أن يقيم فليقل الى آخر الباب) قد مضى بيانه بما فيه كفاية إن شاء اللّٰه وما ذكره من
ترتيل الاذان وحدر الاقامة قد مضى أيضا ما يدل عليه، ويؤكده أيضا ما رواه :
english_text:
Sa‘d ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from Sa‘dan ibn
Muslim from Ishaq al-Jariri:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Whoever sits between the Adhan of Maghrib and the Iqamah, it
is as if he were covered in his own blood in the path of Allah {SWT}.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “And when he wants to
perform the Iqamah, he should say…” until the end of the chapter. Its explanation has
already been given with sufficient detail, Allah {SWT} willing. And what he mentioned
regarding the measured recitation of the Adhan and the swift recitation of the Iqamah
has also already been supported by evidence. This is further confirmed by what was
narrated:
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.1 p.50 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.64 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.309 • Miftah Al- Falah, Vol.1 p.235 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.585 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.399 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.149

Chapter Title: THE NUMBER OF PHRASES IN THE ADHAN AND IQAMAH, AND THEIR DESCRIPTION
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ السَّرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْأَذَانُ تَرْتِيلْ
وَ الإقَامَةُ حَدْرٌ».
٨ - باب كيفية الصلاة وصفتها وشرح الاحدى وخمسين ركعة وترتيبها والقراءة فيها
والتسبيح في ركوعها وسجودها والقنوت فيها والمفروض من ذلك والمسنون
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Hasan ibn al-Sarri:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Adhan is to be recited with measured recitation (‘tartil’),
and the Iqamah is to be recited quickly in a flowing manner (‘hadr’).”
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND
PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY
AND
RECOMMENDED THEREIN
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “When the sun passes the
meridian) up to his statement: (Then you perform the two prostrations of gratitude”.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.306 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.576 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.429

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : «إِذَا
دَخَلْتَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَاحْمَدِ اللهَ وَ أَثْنِ عَلَيْهِ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ فَإِذَا اِفْتَتَحْتَ الصَّلاَةَ فَكَبَّرْتَ فَلا
تُجَاوِزْ أُذْنَيْكَ وَ لا تَرْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ بِالدُّعَاءِ فِي الْمَكْثُوبَةِ تُجَاوِزُ بِهِمَا رَأْسَكَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadhala from Husayn from Sama‘ah from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you enter the mosque, praise Allah {SWT} and extol Him
{SWT}, and send blessings upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
Then when you begin the prayer and pronounce the Takbir, do not raise your hands
beyond your ears, and do not raise your hands in supplication during the obligatory
prayer so that they go above your head.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.643

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-
arabic_text:
وَ عَثَهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ جينَ اِفْتَتَحَ
الصَّلَاةَ يَزْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ أَسْفَلَ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ قَلِيلاً.
english_text:
And from him, from Hammad ibn Isa from Fadhala from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} when He {a.s} began the prayer, He {a.s} would raise his hands
slightly below his face.
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.643 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.26

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ ٱلْجَمَالِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ إِذَا كَبَّرَ فِي الصّلاَةِ
يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى تَكَادَ تَبْلُغُ أَذْنَيْهِ.
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Najran from Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, when Imam {a.s} said the Takbir in prayer, He {a.s} would raise his
hands until they nearly reached his ears.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.644 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.26 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.213

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يُصَلِّي يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ جِيَالَ وَجْهِهِ جِينَ اِسْتَفْتَحَ.
english_text:
And from him, from Fadhala from Ibn Sinan who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} praying, He {a.s} would raise his hands in front of his face when
He {a.s} began the prayer.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.644 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.26

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى «فَصَلّ لِرَبَّكَ وَ إنحَر» قَالَ
«هُوَ رَفَعُ يَدَيْكَ حِذَاءَ وَجْهِكَ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr from Ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: ‘So pray to
your Lord and sacrifice”’ (Surah Kawthar 108:2).
Imam {a.s} said: “It is the raising of your hands in front of your face.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.644 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.27 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.30

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنْ أَذْنَى مَا يُجْزِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ مِنَ التَّكْبِيرِ قَالَ «تَكْبِيرَةٌ وَاحِدَةً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from
Abu Basir who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the minimum that suffices in prayer from the Takbir.
Imam {a.s} said: “One Takbir.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.641 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.10

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا اِفْتَتَحْتَ الصَّلاةَ فَكَبِّرْ إنْ شِئْتَ وَاحِدَةً وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ ثَلاَثاً وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ خَمْساً وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ سَبْعاً فَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ مُجْزٍ
عَثكَ غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ إِمَاماً لَمْ تَجْهَزْ إِلاَّ بِتَكْبِيرَةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad from al-Husayn from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you begin the prayer, you may say the Takbir once if you
wish, or three times if you wish, or five times if you wish, or seven times if you wish, all
of that suffices for you. However, if you are an imam, you should not recite aloud
except with one Takbir.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.641 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.21 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.34

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ
اِفْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ جِيَالَ وَجْهِهِ وَ اِسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ بِبَطْنِ كَفِّيْهِ.
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Mansur ibn Hazim who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} begin the prayer, He {a.s} raised his hands in front of his face and
directed the palms of his hands toward the Qiblah.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.644 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.27

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ زَيْدِ الشَّحَامِ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ زَيْدِ الشَّحَامِ قَالَ:
قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الاِفْتِتَاحُ فَقَالَ «تَكْبِيرَةْ تُجْزِيكَ» قُلْتُ فَالسَّبْعُ قَالَ «ذَلِكَ ٱلْفَضْلُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadhala from al-Husayn from Zayd al-Shahham, and Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu
Ayyub from Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Is the opening (of the prayer) with one Takbir?”
Imam {a.s} said: “One Takbir suffices for you.”
I asked: “And the seven (Takbirs)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “That is extra merit.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.641 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.9

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَدّيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «التَكْبِيرَةُ
الْوَاجِدَةُ فِي اِفْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ تُجْزِي وَ الثَّلَاثُ أَفْضَلُ وَ السَّبْعُ أَفْضَلُ كُلِّهِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The single Takbir at the opening of the prayer
suffices, and three is better, and seven is the best of all.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.66 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.641 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.10

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ حَفْص عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ آللَّهِ
صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ
وَ آلِهِ فَلَمْ يُجِرِ الْحُسَيْنُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَلَمْ يُجِرِ الْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ التَكْبِيرَ
وَلَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُكَبَّرُ وَ يُعَالِجُ الْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ التَكْبِيرَ فَلَمْ يُجِزْ حَتّى أَكْمَلَ سَبْعَ
تَكْبِيرَاتٍ فَأَحَارَ الْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ التَّكْبِيرَ فِي السَّابِعَةِ» فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «فَصَارَتْ سُنَّةً».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr and Fadhala from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Hafs:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, was in prayer, and beside Him {saws} was al-Husayn ibn Ali {a.s}, peace be
upon him.
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said the Takbir,
but al-Husayn {a.s} did not follow with the Takbir. Then the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may
Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said the Takbir again, but al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be
upon him, still did not say the Takbir. The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless
him and his family, continued to say the Takbir and was helping al-Husayn {a.s}, peace
be upon him, to say the Takbir, but He {a.s} did not do so, until the Messenger of Allah
{SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, completed seven Takbirs, and then al-
Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon him, followed with the Takbir on the seventh.”
Then Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “(Thus) So it became a Sunnah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Abu Abdillah Imam Husayn ibn Ali Sayyid al-Shuhada {a.s}
references: ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.67 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.4 p.73 • Al- Arba’un Hadithan (Lil-Shahid Al-Awwal), Vol.1 p.37 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.851 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.20 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 3 p.307 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 4 p.194 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 7 p.42 • Awalim Al- Uloom, Vol.1 7 p.70

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِفْتَتَحْتَ الصَّلَاةَ فَارْفَع كَفِّيْكَ ثُمَّ أُبْسُطُهُمَا بَسْطاً ثُمَّ كَبَّرْ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ
أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنَّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذَثْبِي إِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ ثُمَّ كَبِّزْ
نَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قُلْ - لَبَيْكَ وَ سَعْدَيْكَ وَ الْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَ الشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ وَ ٱلْمَهْدِيُّ مَنْ هَدَيْتَ لاَ مَلْجَأْ مِنْكَ إِلاَّ
إِلَيْكَ سُبْحَانَكَ وَ حَنَانَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَ تَعَالَيْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّ الْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ كَبِّرْ تَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ - «وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ
لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ» عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً «وَ مَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ» ثُمَّ تَعَوِّذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ
الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ثُمَّ اِقْرَأُ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman
from al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you begin the prayer, raise your hands, then spread them
open fully, then say Takbir three times, then say:
‘O Allah {SWT}, You are the True King. There is no god but You {AZJ}. Glory be to You {AZJ}.
Indeed, I have wronged myself, so forgive me my sin. Surely, no one forgives sins
except You {AZJ}.’
Then say Takbir two times, then say:
‘Here I am, at Your {AZJ} service, and all goodness is in Your {AZJ} hands, and evil is not
attributed to You {AZJ}. The rightly guided is he whom You {AZJ} guide. There is no refuge
from You {AZJ} except in You {AZJ}. Glory be to You {AZJ} and to Your {AZJ} mercy. You {AZJ} are
Blessed and Exalted. Glory be to You {AZJ}, Lord {AZJ} of the House.’
Then say Takbir two times, then say:
‘I have turned my face to the One {AZJ} who created the heavens and the earth,’ the
Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, in pure devotion, submitting (to Him {AZJ}),
‘and I am not of the polytheists.’
Then seek refuge with Allah {SWT} from the accursed Shaytan, then recite the Opening
Chapter of the Book (Surah al-Fatiha).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.67

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
سَعدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ وَ عَبْدِ الرِّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ
حَمَّادٍ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يُجْزِيكَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مِنَ ٱلْكَلاَمِ
