وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ قَالَ: أَمَرَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ
الْمُعَوَّذَتَيْنٍ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ.
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} instructed me to recite ‘al-Mu‘awwidhatayn’ (‘Surat al-Falaq’ and
‘Surat al-Nas’) in the obligatory prayer.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.96 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.662 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.115

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ ٱلْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ عَنْ صَابِرٍ مَوْلَى بَسَامِ قَالَ: أَمْنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلَاَمُ
فِي صَلاَةٍ الْمَغْرِبِ فَقَرَأْ ٱلْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ.
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Sabir, the freed slave of
Bassam, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} led us in the Maghrib prayer, and He {a.s} recited ‘al-Mu‘awwidhatayn’
(‘Surat al-Falaq’ and ‘Surat al-Nas’).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.96

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْخَالِقِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ خَالٍ سَهْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ
رَبِّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قَرَأْتُ فِي صَلاةِ الْفَجْرِ بِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ «قُلْ يَا أَيْهَا الكَافِرُونَ» وَ
قَدْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Isma‘il ibn Abd al-Khaliq, from Abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn Abi
Talhah, the maternal uncle of Sahl ibn Abd Rabbih:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “I recited in the Fajr prayer: ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Al-
Ikhlas) and ‘Qul ya ayyuha al-kafirun’ (Surah Al-Kafirun), and the Messenger of Allah
{SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, also did that.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.96 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.670 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.81

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ ٱلْمُكَارِي وَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ وَ أَبِي إسْحَاقَ تَعْلَبَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أُصَلِّي رٍ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» فَقَالَ »نَعَمْ قَدْ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي كِلْتَا
الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بٍ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلَهَا وَ لا بَعْدَهَا - بِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» أَتَمَّ مِنْهَا».
english_text:
And from him, from Abu Sa‘id al-Mukari and Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah and Abu Ishaq
Tha‘labah, from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I pray using : ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’
(Surah Al-Ikhlas)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes. The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family,
prayed in both rak‘ahs with ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’, and He {saws} did not pray before it
or after it with anything more complete than it.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.96 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.660 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.49 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.26

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ ٱلْجَمَالِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: « «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ»
تُجْزِي فِي خَمْسِينَ صَلاَةً».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Safwan al-Jammal, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: “‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ suffices for fifty prayers.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.96 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.660 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.48

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُزْوَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَا تَقْرَأْ فِي
الْمَكْتُوبَةً بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْعَزَائِمِ فَإِنَّ السُّجُودَ زِيَادَةٌ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from one of the two (Imams)
(peace be upon them), who said:
(Imam {a.s} said) “Do not recite anything from the ‘Azaʾim’ (chapters containing
obligatory prostration) in the obligatory prayer, for prostration is an addition in the
obligatory prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.318 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.96 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.685 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.105

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا صَلَّى يَقْرَأَ فِي الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ ٱَلظُهْرِ سِرّاً وَ يُسَبَّحُ فِي
الْأَخِيرَتَيْنٍ مِنْ صَلاتِهِ الظُهْرِ عَلَى نَحْوٍ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ الْعِشَاءِ وَ كَانَ يَقْرَأْ فِي الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاةِ الْعَصْرِ سِرَأَ وَ يُسَبِّحُ
فِي اَلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ عَلَى نَحْوٍ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ أَوْلُ صَلاَةِ أَحَدِكُمُ الرُّكُوعُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Yusuf ibn ‘Aqil, from Muhammad ibn
Qays, from Abu Ja‘far {a.s} (peace be upon him), who said:
(imam {a.s} said) “Commander of the Faithful, (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon
him, when He {a.s} prayed, would recite silently in the first two rak‘ahs of his Dhuhr
prayer, and He {a.s} would perform ‘tasbih’ (glorification) in the last two rak‘ahs of his
Dhuhr prayer, similar to what He {a.s} did in the Isha prayer. And He {a.s} would recite
silently in the first two rak‘ahs of his ‘Asr prayer, and He {a.s} would perform ‘tasbih’ in
the last two rak‘ahs similar to what He {a.s} did in the Isha prayer.
And He {a.s} used to say: ‘The beginning of the prayer of one of you is the bowing.’”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.97 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.125

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ وَ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ
أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا يُكْتَبُ مِنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ وَ الدُّعَاءِ إِلا مَا أَسْمَعَ نَفْسَهُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from
‘Umar ibn Udhaynah and Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon
him, who said:
“Nothing of recitation or supplication is recorded except what he makes himself
hear.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.313 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.97 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.689 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.96 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.134

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ هَلْ يَقْرَأُ الرَّجُلُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ ثَوْبُهُ عَلَى فِيهِ قَالَ «فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ إِذَا أَسْمَعَ أُذْنَيْهِ
اَلْهَمْهَمَةَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri’ab,
from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “May a man recite in his prayer while his garment is over his
mouth?”
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no problem with that, as long as he makes his ears hear the
murmur (of his recitation).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.97 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.229 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.320 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.398 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.393 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.423 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.423 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.97

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱَلسّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَصْلُحْ لَهُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي صَلَاَتِهِ وَ يُحَرِّكَ لِسَانَهُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فِي لَهَوَاتِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُسْمِعَ نَفْسَهُ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ
أن لا يُحَرِّكَ لِسَانَهُ يَتَوَهَمُ تَوَهُماً».
فليس بمناف للرواية الاولة لان هذا محمول على من كان مع قوم لا يقتدي بهم ويخاف من اسماع نفسه القراءة ، يدل على
ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja‘far
(peace be upon them both), who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man, is it permissible for him to recite in his prayer and move
his tongue with the recitation only within his throat without making himself hear it?
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm if he does not move his tongue and simply imagines
(the recitation) as imagination.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
So this is not in conflict with the earlier narration, because this is to be understood as
applying to one who is among people who do not follow him (in prayer) and who fears
letting them hear his recitation. What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.238 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.97 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.690 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.97 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.128

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «يُجْزِيكَ مِنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ مَعَهُمْ مِثْلُ حَدِيثِ النَّفْسِ».
فأما ما ذكره الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه من التخيير بين القراءة والتسبيح في الركعتين الاخيرتين ، يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from someone
who mentioned it:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “It suffices you, when praying with them, to recite like the
whispering of the soul (inner speech).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
As for what was mentioned by Shaykh (al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him,
regarding the option (of choice) between recitation and ‘tasbih’ in the last two rak‘ahs,
this is supported by what was narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.315 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.399 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.97 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.36 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.321 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.430 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.690 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1207 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.128 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.364

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ:
قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مَا يُجْزِي مِنَ القَوْلِ فِي الرّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ قَالَ «أَنْ تَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ
لِلَّهِ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَ تُكَبِّرَ وَ تَرْكَعَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa,
from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What suffices in terms of recitation in the
last two rak‘ahs?”
Imam {a.s} said: “That you say: ‘Subhan Allah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah,
wa-Allahu akbar’, then you say the ‘takbir’ and bow.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.319 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.98 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.321 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.89 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.775 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.109 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.89

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ
الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ مِنَ الظُهْرِ قَالَ «تُسَبِّحُ وَ تُحَمِّدُ اللَّهَ وَ تَسْتَغْفِرُ لِذَنْبِكَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ فَإِنَّهَا تَحْمِيدٌ
وَ دُعَاءً».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Halabi, from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the last two rak‘ahs of Dhuhr.
Imam {a.s} said: “You glorify (‘tusabbih’), praise Allah {SWT} (‘tuhammid’), and seek
forgiveness for your sins. And if you wish, recite the Opening of the Book (‘Surat al-
Fatihah’), for it is praise and supplication.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.98 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.776 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.107 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.90

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ مَا أَصْنَعُ فِيهِمَا فَقَالَ «إِنْ شِئْتَ فَاقْرَأُ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ - وَ إِنْ
شِئْتَ فَاذْكُرِ اللّهَ فَهُوَ سَوَاء» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَأَيْ ذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ فَقَالَ «هُمَا وَ اللّهِ سَوَاءُ إِنْ شِئْتَ سَبَّحتَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ
قَرَأْتَ».
فأما ما ذكره الشيخ رحمه اللّه من التخيير بين القراءة والتسبيح في الركعتين الاخيرتين ، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Sa‘d, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Ali ibn
Hanzalah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the last two rak‘ahs, what should I do in them?
Imam {a.s} said: “If you wish, recite the Opening of the Book (‘Surat al-Fatihah’), and if
you wish, remember Allah {SWT}, it is the same.”
I asked: “Which of the two is better?”
Imam {a.s} said: “By Allah {SWT}, they are the same. If you wish, you may glorify (‘tasbih’),
and if you wish, you may recite.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
As for what was mentioned by Shaykh (al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him,
regarding the option between recitation (‘qira’ah’) and glorification (‘tasbih’) in the last
two rak‘ahs, this is supported by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.98 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.776 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.108

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
رَوَى ذِلِكَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلاَّنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أَيْمَا أَفْضَلُ
الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ أَو التَّسْبِيحُ فَقَالَ «الْقِرَاءَةُ أَفْضَلُ».
يدل على ما ذكرناه ما رواه :
english_text:
This was narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn ‘Allan, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Which is better in the last two rak‘ahs,
recitation or ‘tasbih’?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Recitation is better.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary: What supports what we have mentioned is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.98 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.322 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.90 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.777 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.125

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كُنْتَ إِمَاماً فَاقْرَأْ فِي
الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ وَحْدَكَ فَيَسَعَكَ فَعَلْتَ أَوْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “If you are an imam (of prayer), then recite the Opening of the
Book (‘Surat al-Fatihah’) in the last two rak‘ahs. And if you are alone, then it is
permissible whether you do so or not.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.99 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.322 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.91 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.776 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.126

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
فَأَمًا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيِّ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ لا تَقْرَأْ فِيهِمَا فَقُلِ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ سُبْحَانَ
اللَّهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ».
فانما نهاه أن يقرأ معتقدا بأن غيرها لا يجزيه دون أن يقرأها على وجه الاختيار أو طلب الفضل وليس ذلك بمناقض لما
ذكرناه. فأما ما ذكره الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه من التشهد الاخير فقد قدمنا التشهد الاول ونذكر الآن التشهد الثاني ثم نبين أقل ما
يجوز الاقتصار عليه في التشهد إن شاء اللّٰه
english_text:
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
As for what was narrated by Sa‘d, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn
Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman, from ‘Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “If you stand for the last two rak‘ahs, do not recite in them.
Rather, say: ‘al-hamdu lillah’, ‘subhan Allah’, and ‘Allahu akbar’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The prohibition mentioned is only directed at someone who recites while believing that
nothing else suffices, not someone who recites out of preference or in pursuit of
greater merit. So this does not contradict what we have previously stated.
As for what Shaykh (al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, mentioned regarding
the final ‘tashahhud’, we have already presented the first ‘tashahhud’, and we shall
now mention the second ‘tashahhud’ and then explain the minimum that suffices for
‘tashahhud’, if Allah {SWT} wills.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.99 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.322 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.89 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.777 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.124 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.90

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَنْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا جَلَسْتَ
فِي الرّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ وَ خَيْرُ الْأَسْمَاءِ لِلْهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
وَ أَشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ أَرْسَلَهُ بِالْحَقُّ بَشِيراً وَ نَذِيراً بَيْنَ يَدَي السَّاعَةِ أُشهَدُ أَنَّكَ نِعْمَ الرَّبُّ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً
نِعْمَ الرَّسُولُ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمِّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ تَقَبَلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أَمَّتِهِ وَ اِرْفَع دَرَجَتَهُ ثُمَّ تَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ
ثَلاَثاً ثُمَّ تَقُومُ فَإِذَا جَلَسْتَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ قُلْتَ بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ وَ خَيْرُ الْأَسْمَاءِ لِلّهِ أَشَهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ
اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ أَرْسَلَهُ بِالْحَقَّ بَشِيراً وَ نَذِيراً بَيْنَ يَدَي السَّاعَةِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ
نِعْمَ الرَّبُّ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً نِعْمَ الرَّسُولُ التَّحِيَّاثُ لِلَّهِ وَ الصَّلَوَاتُ الطَّاهِرَاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ الزَّاكِيَاتُ اَلْغَادِيَاتُ الرَّائِحَاتُ
السَّابِغَاتُ النَّاعِمَاتُ لِلَّهِ مَا طَابَ وَزَكَا وَطَهُرَ وَ خَلَصَ وَ صَفَا فَلِلَّهِ وَ أَشهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَ
أَشهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ أَرْسَلَهُ بِالْحَقُّ بَشِيراً وَ نَذِيراً بَيْنَ يَدَي السَّاعَةِ أَشهَدُ أَنَّ رَبِّي نِعْمَ الرَّبُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً
نِعْمَ الرَّسُولُ وَ أَشهَدُ «أَنَّ الشَاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لا رَيْبَ فِيها وَ أَنَّ اللهَ يَنْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ» «اَلْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ الَّذِي هَدانَا لِهَذا وَ
مَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْ لا أَنْ هَدْانَا اللهُ» «الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ» اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ بَارِك عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ سَلَّمْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ تَرَحِّمْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ وَ تَرَحِّمْتَ
عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ «اِغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ لِإِخْوَانِنَا
اَلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونًا بِالْإِيِمَانِ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلاّا لِلْذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنا إِنَّكَ رَؤُفّ رَجِيمٌ» اَللَّهُمّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أُمْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالْجَنَّةِ وَ عَافِنِي مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ «وَ
لِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَنْتِيَ مُؤْمِناً وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِناتِ وَ لَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلا تَبَاراً» ثُمَّ قُلِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ وَ رَحْمَةُ
اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلامُ عَلَى أَنْبِيَاءِ اللَّهِ وَ رُسُلِهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَلَى جَبْرَئِيلَ وَ مِيكَائِيلَ وَ الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ السِّلاَمُ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ لاَ نَبِيْ بَعْدَهُ وَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ ثُمَّ تُسَلَّمُ».
وأدنى ما يجزي من التشهد الشهادتان يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zur‘ah, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you sit in the second rak‘ah, say:
‘Bismi Allah wa billah wa alhamdu lillah wa khayru al-asmai lillah ashhadu an la ilaha
illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh
arsalahu bil-haqqi bashiran wa nadhiran bayna yadayi al-sa'ah ashhadu annaka ni'ma
al-rabb wa anna Muhammadan ni'ma al-rasul Allahumma salli ala Muhammad wa Aali
Muhammad wa taqabbal shafaatahu fi ummatih wa irfa darajatah’
(In the Name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, and all praise is due to Allah {SWT}, and the
best of names belong to Allah {SWT}. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT},
alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad {saws} is His servant and
His messenger. He {SWT} sent him with the truth as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner
before the Hour. I bear witness that You {SWT} are the best Lord {SWT}, and that
Muhammad {saws} is the best messenger. O Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad
{saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}, and accept his intercession for his nation, and
raise his rank.)
Then you praise Allah {SWT} twice or three times, then rise.
And when you sit in the fourth (rak‘ah), you say:
‘Bismi Allah wa billah wa alhamdu lillah wa khayru al-asmai lillah ashhadu an la ilaha
illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh
arsalahu bil-haqqi bashiran wa nadhiran bayna yadayi al-sa'ah ashhadu annaka ni'ma
al-rabb wa anna Muhammadan ni'ma al-rasul al-tahiyyatu lillah wa al-salawatu al-
tahiratu al-tayyibatu al-zakiyatu al-ghadiyatu al-raihat al-sabi ghat al-na'imatu lillah
ma taba wa zaka wa tahura wa khalasa wa safa falillah wa ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah
wahdahu la sharika lah. Wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh
arsalahu bil-haqqi bashiran wa nadhiran bayna yadayi al-sa'ah ashhadu anna rabbi
ni'ma al-rabb wa anna Muhammadan ni'ma al-rasul wa ashhadu anna al-sa'ata
atiyatun la rayba fiha wa anna Allah yab'athu man fi al-qubur’”
(In the Name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, and all praise is due to Allah {SWT}, and the
best of names belong to Allah {SWT}. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT},
alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad {saws} is His servant and
His messenger. He {SWT} sent him with the truth as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner
before the Hour. I bear witness that You {SWT} are the best Lord {SWT}, and that
Muhammad {saws} is the best messenger. All greetings are for Allah {SWT}, and the pure,
good, blessed, ascending and descending, complete and delightful prayers are for
Allah {SWT} whatever is good, pure, purified, sincere, and clear belongs to Allah {SWT} and
is for Allah {SWT}. And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone, without
any partner. And I bear witness that Muhammad {saws} is His servant and His
messenger. He {SWT} sent him with the truth as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner
before the Hour. I bear witness that my Lord {SWT} is the best Lord {SWT}, and that
Muhammad {saws} is the best messenger. And I bear witness “that the Hour is surely
coming there is no doubt about it and that Allah {SWT} will resurrect those who are in the
graves.”
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
All praise is due to Allah {SWT} who has guided us to this, and we would not have been
guided had Allah {SWT} not guided us. All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord of the
worlds."
“O Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws},
and bless Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}, and send peace upon
Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}, and have mercy on Muhammad
{saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}, just as You {AZJ} sent blessings and bestowed
favor and mercy upon Ibrahim {a.s} and upon the family of Ibrahim {a.s}, indeed, You {AZJ}
are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
O Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}
and Forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and place not in our hearts
any resentment toward those who believe, our Lord {AZJ}, indeed You are Kind and
Merciful. O Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}, and grant me Paradise by Your {SWT} grace and protect me from the
Fire. O Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad
{saws} and forgive the believing men and believing women; And those who enter my
house as believers, and the believing men and the believing women, and increase not
the wrongdoers except in destruction."‘
Then say:
‘Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah {SWT} and His blessings.’
‘Peace be upon the Prophets of Allah {SWT} and His messengers.’
‘Peace be upon Jibra’il {a.s} and Mika’il {a.s} and the close angels.’
‘Peace be upon Muhammad ibn Abdillah {saws}, the Seal of the Prophets, there is no
prophet after him.’
‘And peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT}.’
Then you give the salam (salutation to conclude the prayer).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And the minimum that suffices for ‘tashahhud’ is the two testimonies (‘al-
shahadatan’). This is supported by what was narrated:

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
سَعدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ
زُرَارَةً قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَا يُجْزِي مِنَ الْقَوْلِ فِي التَّشَهْدِ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ٱلْأَوْلَتَيْنِ قَالَ « تَقُولُ أَشهَدُ
أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ » قُلْتُ فَمَا يُجْزِي مِنْ تَشَهُدِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «الشَهَادَتَانِ».
english_text:
Sa‘d ibn Abdillah, from al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz ibn
Abdillah, from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What suffices to be said in the ‘tashahhud’
of the first two rak‘ahs?”
Imam {a.s} said: “You say: ‘Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah, wahdahu la sharika lah’.”
I said: “And what suffices in the ‘tashahhud’ of the last two rak‘ahs?”
Imam {a.s} said: “The two testimonies.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.100 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.767 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.396

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْحَجَالِ عَنْ تَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ سَوْرَةَ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ أَدْنَى مَا يُجَزِي مِنَ التَّشَهْمِ قَالَ «الشَّهَادَتَانِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-Hajjal, from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun, from
Yahya ibn Talhah, from Sawrah ibn Kulayb, who said:
I asked Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the minimum that suffices for
‘tashahhud’.
Imam {a.s} said: “The two testimonies (‘al-shahadatan’).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.101 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.766 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.398

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ حَبِيبِ الْخَثِعَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا
جَلَسَ الرَّجُلُ لِلتَّشَهْدِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ أَجْزَأَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Sa‘d ibn Bakr, from Habib al-Khath‘ami:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “If a man sits for the ‘tashahhud’ and praises
Allah {SWT}, it suffices him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.101 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.319 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.341 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.767 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.399

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ التَّشَهُدُ آلَّذِي فِي الثَّانِيَةِ
يُجْزِي أَنْ أَقُولَهُ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, the ‘tashahhud’
which is said in the second rak‘ah, is it sufficient if I say it in the fourth [rak‘ah] as well?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.101 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.342 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.768 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.397

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ
عِيسَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ بَكْرٍ بْنِ حَبِيبِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ التَّشَهُدِ فَقَالَ « لَوْ كَانَ كَمَا
يَقُولُونَ وَاجِباً عَلَى النَّاسِ هَلَكُوا إِنَّمَا كَانَ ٱلْقَوْمُ يَقُولُونَ أَيْسَرَ مَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِذَا حَمِدْتَ اللَّهَ أَجْزَأَكَ».
فليس بدافع ان يكون الشهادتان واجبتين وإنما يدل على ان ما زاد عليهما ليس بواجب لان الزيادة على الشهادتين أيضا
تسمى تشهدا، والذي يبين ما ذكرناه
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn
Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Uthman ibn ‘Isa, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Bakr ibn Habib,
who said:
I asked Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the ‘tashahhud’.
Imam {a.s} said: “If it were as they say, obligatory upon the people, they would have
perished. Rather, the people used to say the simplest of what they knew. If you praise
Allah {SWT}, it suffices you.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
So this does not negate the possibility that the two testimonies (‘al-shahadatan’) are
obligatory; rather, it indicates that what is beyond them is not obligatory, because
anything added to the two testimonies is also referred to as ‘tashahhud’.
And what clarifies what we have mentioned is:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.101 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.342 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.765 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.399

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ التَّشَهْدُ فِي الصَّلاةِ قَالَ «مَرَّتَيْنِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ كَيْفَ مَرَّتَيْنِ قَالَ «إِذَا اِسْتَوَيْتَ جَالِساً فَقُلْ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ
لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَشَهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ ثُمَّ تَنصَرِفُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ قَوْلُ الْعَبْدِ التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ
وَ الصَّلَوَاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلَّهِ قَالَ «هَذَا اللَّطْفُ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ يَلْطُفُ الْعَبْدَ رَبُّهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim,
who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “The ‘tashahhud’ in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Twice.”
I said: “And how is it said twice?”
Imam {a.s} said: “When you sit upright, say: ‘Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah, wahdahu la
sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa rasuluh,’ then you exit
(complete the prayer).”
I said: “What about the statement of the servant: ‘al-tahiyyatu lillah wa al-salawatu al-
tayyibat lillah’?”
Imam {a.s} said: “That is a graceful form of supplication, a kindness from the servant by
which his Lord shows him grace.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.101 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.342 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.768 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.397

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَجَالِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شَعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«التَشَهُدُ فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ شَفْعٌ».
english_text:
And from him, from Abu Muhammad al-Hajjal, from Ali, from ‘Ubayd, from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The ‘tashahhud’ in the book of (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon
him, is in two parts.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.102 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.768 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.398

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنْ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَيِّ
شَيْءٍ أَقُولُ فِي التَّشَهْدِ وَ الْقُنُوتِ قَالَ «قُلْ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا عَلِمْتَ فَإِنَّهُ لَوْ كَانَ مُوَقَّتاً لَهَلَكَ النَّاسُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Bakr ibn Habib, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What should I say in the ‘tashahhud’ and
in the ‘qunut’?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Say the best of what you know, for if it had been fixed (with strict
wording), the people would have perished.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.102 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.765 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.399

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي آخِرٍ تَشَهْدِهِ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ حَتَّى أَسْمَعَنَا فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قُلْتُ كَذَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ
بُسْمِعَ تَشَهْدَهُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-‘Abbas, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Hammad, from Abu
Basir, who said:
I prayed behind Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and when He {a.s} reached the final ‘tashahhud’, He
{a.s} raised his voice until we could hear him.
When He {a.s} finished the prayer, I said to him: “Is it appropriate for the imam (of prayer)
to make his ‘tashahhud’ audible to those behind him?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.102 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1265 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.401

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ ٱلْحَجَالِ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلْإمَامِ أَنْ يُسْمِعَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ كُلَّمَا يَقُولُ وَ لا يَنْبَغِي لِمَنْ خَلْفَ ٱلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُسْمِعَهُ شَيْئاً مِمَّا يَقُولُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abu Muhammad al-Hajjal, from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman,
from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “It is appropriate for the imam (of prayer) to make audible to
those behind him everything that he says, and it is not appropriate for those behind the
imam (of prayer) to make anything they say audible to him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.102 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.49 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1262 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.401 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.396 • Al-Fusul Al- Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.123 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.202

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ ٱلْبَخْتَرِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي
لِلْإمَامٍ أَنْ يُسْمِعَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ التَّشَهُدَ وَ لا يُسْمِعُونَهُ شَيْئاً».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “It is appropriate for the imam (of prayer) to make the
‘tashahhud’ audible to those behind him, and they should not make anything audible
to him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.102 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1264 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.400

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِالتَّشَهْدِ وَ الْقَوْلِ فِي الرُكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ وَ الْقُنُوتِ
قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ جَهَرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَجْهَرْ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (وإذا سلم رفع يديه حيال وجهه) الى قوله : (فإذا سقط القرص).
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-‘Ubaydi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from al-Husayn, from his father
Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Madi {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man, whether it is
proper for him to recite aloud the ‘tashahhud’ and the statements in ‘ruku’, ‘sujud’,
and ‘qunut’.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he wishes, he may recite aloud, and if he wishes, he may not recite
aloud.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "And when he gives the salam,
he should raise his hands to the level of his face..." until his statement: "...when the
sun disc sets."
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.102 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.290

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَنْتَقِلَ إِذَا سَلَمَ حَتَّى يُتِمَّ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ الصَّلاةَ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَؤُمُّ فِي
الصَّلَاةٍ هَلْ يَتْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُعَقَّبَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ بَعْدَ التَّسْلِيمِ فَقَالَ «يُسَبِّحُ وَ يَذْهَبُ مَنْ شَاءَ لِحَاجَتِهِ وَ لا يُعَقِّبُ رَجُلْ
بتَعْقِيبِ الْإِمَامِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-
Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “It is not appropriate for the imam (of prayer) to move (from his
place) after the taslim until those behind him complete their prayer.”
He (al-Halabi) said: “I asked Him {a.s} about the man who leads others in prayer, should
he engage in ta‘qib with his companions after the taslim?”
Imam {a.s} said: “He should recite tasbih, and whoever wishes may go to attend to his
need, and no man should remain seated for the sake of the Imam’s ta‘qib.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.341 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.103 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1265

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَمّ قَوْماً
فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَقْعُدَ بَعْدَ التَّسْلِيمِ وَ لا يَخْرُجَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعِ حَتَّى يُتِمَّ الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ اَلَّذِينَ سُبِقُوا صَلاَتَهُمْ ذَلِكَ عَلَى
كُلَّ إِمَامٍ وَاجِبٌ إِذَا عَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيهِمْ مَسْبُوقاً وَ إِنْ عَلِمَ أَنْ لَيْسَ فِيهِمْ مَسْبُوقاً بِالصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَذْهَبْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Any man who leads a group (in prayer) is required to remain
seated after the taslim and not leave that spot until those behind him who had missed
part of their prayer have completed it. This is obligatory upon every imam (of prayer)
when he knows that among them is someone who has missed part of the prayer. But
if he knows that there is no one among them who has missed part of the prayer, then
he may go wherever he wishes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.341 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.103 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1265 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.434

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى صَلَاَةً فَرِيضَةً وَ عَقَّبَ إِلَى أُخْرَى فَهُوَ ضَيْفُ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ حَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
أَنْ يُكْرِمَ ضَيْفَهُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Mansur
ibn Yunus, from the one who narrated it from him:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Whoever performs an obligatory prayer and remains in ta‘qib
until the (time of) the next (prayer), then he is the guest of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Exalted, and it is a right upon Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, to honor His {SWT} guest.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.1 p.51 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.341 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.103 • Awali Al- La’ali, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.783 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.430 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.322

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الدُّعَاءُ بَعْدَ
الْفَرِيضَةً أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ تَنَفّلاً)).
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Supplication after the obligatory prayer is
better than performing voluntary prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.342 • Da’a’im Al-Islam, Vol.1 p.166 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.328 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.103 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.285 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.332 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.64 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.437 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.324 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.5 p.32

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَلْبَثَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُكَلَّمَ أَحَداً حَتَّى يَرَى أَنّ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ
قَدْ أَتَمُّوا الصَّلاةَ ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ هُوَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from Sama‘ah, who said:
(it was said) “It is appropriate for the Imam to remain (seated) before speaking to
anyone until he sees that those behind him have completed their prayer, then he may
depart.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.104 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1266 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.434

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ عَنْ شِهَابِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ وَ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ كِلَيْهِمَا عَنِ ٱلْوَلِيدِ بْنِ صَبِيحِ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «التَّعْقِيبُ أَبْلَغُ فِي طَلَبِ الرِّزْقِ مِنَ الضَّرْبِ فِي الْبِلاَدِ».
يعني بالتعقيب الدعاء بعقب الصلاة.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from Aban from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih and Abdullah ibn Sinan, both from
al-Walid ibn Sabih:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Ta‘qib is more effective in seeking sustenance than traveling
through the lands (in search of it).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: What is meant by ‘ta‘qib’: supplication after the prayer.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.104 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.332 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.64 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.429 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.315

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «آلدُّعَاءُ دُبُرَ ٱلْمَكْتُوبَةِ
أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ دُبُرَ التَّطَوْعِ كَفَضْلِ ٱلْمَكْتُوبَةِ عَلَى التَّطَوْعِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two
(Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them:
(Imam {a.s} said) “Supplication after the obligatory prayer is better than supplication
after the recommended prayer, just as the obligatory prayer is superior to the
recommended one.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Usul Al-Sittah Ashar (T. Dar Al-Hadith), Vol.1 p.357 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.104 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.285 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.64 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.786 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.436 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.324 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.5 p.31

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا الْكَاتِبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «مَا عَالَجَ النَّاسُ شَيْئا أَشَدَّ مِنَ التَّعْقِيبِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from al-Rabi‘ ibn Zakariyya
al-Katib from Abdullah ibn Muhammad:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “People have not practiced anything more demanding than
ta‘qib.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.104 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.784 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.429

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلَيْنِ اِفْتَتَحَا الصَّلاَةَ فِي
سَاعَةٍ وَاجِدَةٍ فَتَلا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ فَكَانَتْ تِلاوَتُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ وَ دَعَا هَذَا أَكْثَرَ فَكَانَ دُعَاؤُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ تِلاَوَتِهِ ثُمَّ
انْصَرَفَا فِي سَاعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ أَيْهُمَا أَفْضَلُ قَالَ «كُلِّ فِيهِ فَضْلْ كُلّ حَسَنْ» قُلْتُ إِنَّي قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كُلاْ حَسَنْ وَ أَنّْ كُلا
فِيهِ فَضْلٌ فَقَالَ «الدُعَاءُ أَفْضَلُ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ «وَ قَالَ رَبْكُمُ أدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ
يُسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ داخِرِينَ» هِيَ وَ اللَّهِ الْعِبَادَةُ هِيَ وَ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ هِيَ وَ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ أَلَيْسَتْ
هِيَ الْعِبَادَةَ هِيَ وَ اللهِ الْعِبَادَةُ هِيَ وَ اللّهِ الْعِبَادَةُ أَلَيْسَتْ هِيَ أَشَدَّهُنَّ هِيَ وَ اللّهِ أَشَدَّهُنَّ هِيَ وَ اللّهِ أَشَدَّهُنَّ».
english_text:
And from him, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Two men began the prayer at the same time. One of them
recited the Qur’an, and his recitation was more than his supplication. The other
supplicated more, and his supplication was more than his recitation. Then they both
concluded (their prayers) at the same time. Which of them is superior?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Each has merit. Each is good.”
I asked: “I know that each is good and that each has merit, but..”
Imam {a.s} said: “Supplication is superior. Have you not heard the saying of Allah {SWT},
Mighty and Exalted: ‘And your Lord said: Call upon Me, I will respond to you. Surely
those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell in humiliation’? (Surah Ghafir
40:60). By Allah {SWT}, it is worship! By Allah {SWT}, it is superior! By Allah {SWT}, it is superior!
Is it not worship? By Allah {SWT}, it is worship! By Allah {SWT}, it is worship! Is it not the most
intense of them? By Allah {SWT}, it is the most intense of them. By Allah {SWT}, it is the most
intense of them.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.104 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.30 • ‘Uddat Al-Da’i, Vol.1 p.41 • Al- Wafi, Vol.9 p.1471 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.438 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.4 p.765 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.223 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.9 0 p.298 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.5 p.33

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «مَنْ سَبَّحَ تَسْبِيحَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ عَلَيْهَا
السَّلَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَثُنِي رِجْلَيْهِ مِنْ صَلاةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ وَ يَبْدَأْ بالتَّكْبِيرِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Whoever recites the Tasbih of Fatimah al-Zahra {s.a}, peace be
upon her, before folding his legs after the obligatory prayer will be forgiven. And he
should begin with the takbir.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.342 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.164 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.105 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.281 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.165 • Kashf Al-Ghummah, Vol.1 p.471 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.787 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.439 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.332 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 1 p.289

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ
عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللّهَ فِي دُبُرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ تَسْبِيحَ فَاطِمَةَ
عَلَيْهَا السِّلاَمُ الْمِائَةَ وَ أَنْبَعَهَا بِلاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from a group of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Yahya
ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from Ibn Abi Najran from a man:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Whoever glorifies Allah {SWT} after the obligatory prayer with the
Tasbih of Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her, one hundred times, and follows it with ‘La
ilaha illallah ‘ (There is no god but Allah {SWT}), Allah {SWT} will forgive him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.342 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.105 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.787 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.440

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ أُبِي
هَارُونَ الْمَكْفُوفِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يَا أَبَا هَارُونَ إِنَّا نَأْمُرُ صِبْيَانَنَا بِتَسْبِيحِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا ٱلسَّلاَمُ
كَمَا نَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالصَّلَاَةِ فَالْزَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَلْزَمْهُ عَبْدٌ فَشَقِيَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il
ibn Bazi‘, from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah, from Abu Harun al-Makfuf:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “O Abu Harun, we instruct our children to (recite) the Tasbih of
Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her, just as we instruct them to perform the prayer. So
adhere to it, for no servant adheres to it and becomes wretched.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.343 • Al-Amali (Lil-Saduq), Vol.1 p.579 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.105 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.788 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.441 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.328 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 1 p.289

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَ قَالَ: «مَا عُبِدَ اللّهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ ٱلتَّحْمِيدِ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِ
فَاطِمَةً عَلَيْهَا ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَ لَوْ كَانَ شَيْءَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ لَنَحَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السِّلامُ».
english_text:
And through this same chain of transmission, from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: “Allah {SWT} has not been worshipped with anything of praise better
than the Tasbih of Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her, and had there been anything better
than it, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace and blessings be upon him and his family,
would have gifted it to (Sayyida) Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.343 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.105 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.788 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.443 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 3 p.64 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 1 p.288

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدِ الْقَمَّاطِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: «تَسْبِيحُ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ فِي كُلِّ
يَوْمٍ دُبُرَ كُلَّ صَلَاَةٍ أُحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ صَلاَةِ أَلْفِ رَكْعَةٍ فِي كُلَّ يَوْمِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: “The Tasbih of Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her, every day
after every prayer is more beloved to me than performing a thousand rak‘ahs of prayer
each day.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.343 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.163 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.105 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.281 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.135 • Kashf Al-Ghummah, Vol.1 p.471 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.65 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.788 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.443 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 1 p.291

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ
مَعَ أَبِي عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَسَأَلَهُ أَبِي عَنْ تَسْبِيحِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ فَقَالَ » اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ » حَتَّى
أخصَى أزبَعاً وَثَلاثِينَ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ قَالَ » الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ» حَتَّى بَلَغَ سَبْعاً وَ سِتَّينَ ثُمَّ قَالَ » سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ » حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِائَةً
يُخْصِيهَا بِيَدِهِ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from a group of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Amr ibn Uthman
from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, who said:
I entered with my father upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and my father asked Him {a.s} about the
Tasbih of Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her.
Imam {a.s} said: ‘Allahu Akbar’ - Until He {a.s} counted thirty-four times.
Then Imam {a.s} said: ‘Alhamdulillah’ - Until He {a.s} reached sixty-eight.
Then Imam {a.s} said: ‘Subhanallah’ - Until He {a.s} completed one hundred.
He {a.s} would count them with his hand all together as one sequence.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.342 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.105 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.789 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.444 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.333

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ إِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ ع قَالَ: «تَبْدَأُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ أَرْبَعاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ ثُمَّ التَّحْمِيدِ ثَلاثاً وَ ثَلَاَثِينَ ثُمَّ التَّسْبِيحِ ثَلاَثاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from
Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “You begin with the takbir thirty-four times, then the tahmid
thirty-three times, then the tasbih thirty-three times.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.342 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.106 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.135 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.789 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.444

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: قُلْ بَعْدَ التَّسْلِيمِ « اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ «لا إِنهَ إِلا اللَّهُ» وَحْدَهُ «لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ» «لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ» «يُخيِي وَ يُمِيتُ»
وَ هُوَ حَيّ لاَ يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ ٱلْخَيْرُ »وَ هُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ» لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَا ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ صَدَقَ وَعْدَهُ وَ نَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَ هَزَمَ
اَلْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ اِهْدِنِي لِمَا أُخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd and al-Hasan ibn Sa‘id from Zur‘ah from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Say after the tasleem (concluding the prayer),
‘Allah {SWT} is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone, with no partner. To Him
belongs the dominion and to Him {SWT} belongs all praise. He {SWT} gives life and causes
death, and He {SWT} is the Living who does not die. In His {SWT} hand is all good, and He
has power over all things. There is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone. He {SWT} fulfilled His {SWT}
promise, and aided His {SWT} servant, and defeated the confederates alone. O Allah {SWT},
guide me to the truth concerning that in which there is disagreement, by Your {SWT}
permission. Indeed, You {SWT} guide whom You {SWT} will to the straight path."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.106 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.796 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.472 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.48

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ ٱلْجَمَالِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ إِذَا صَلَّى فَفَرَغَ مِنْ
صَلاَتِهِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ جَمِيعاً فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ.
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, when He {a.s} completed his prayer, raise both his hands above
his head.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.325 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.106 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.839 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.452

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ نَهِيكٍ عَنْ سَلاَّمِ الْمَكِّيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «أَتّى رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ شَيْبَةُ ٱلْهُذَيْلِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّي شَيْخٌ
قَدْ كَبِرَ سِنِّي وَ ضَعْفَتْ قُوَّتِي عَنْ عَمَلٍ كُنْتُ قَدْ عَوَّدْتُهُ نَفْسِي مِنْ صَلاَةٍ وَ صِيَامٍ وَ حَجِّ وَ جِهَادٍ فَعَلَّمْنِي يَا رَسُولَ
اللّهِ كَلَاماً يَنْفَعُنِي اللهُ بِهِ وَ خَفّف عَلَيَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ فَقَالَ «أَعِدْ» فَأَعَادَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى
اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «مَا حَوْلَكَ شَجَرَةْ وَ لا مَدَرَةٌ إِلاّ وَ قَدْ بَكَتْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ فَإِذَا صَلِّيْتَ الصُّبْحَ فَقُلْ عَشرَ مَرَّاتٍ سُبْحَانَ
اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ لا حَوْلَ وَ لا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيَّ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُعَافِيكَ بِذَلِكَ مِنَ الْعَمَى وَ الْجُنُونِ وَ الْجُذَامِ
وَ الْفَقْرِ وَ الْهَرَمِ» فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ هَذَا لِلدُّنْيَا فَمَا لِلآخِرَةِ فَقَالَ «تَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ اِهْدِنِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
وَ أَفِض عَلَي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَ أُنشُرْ عَلَيْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيْ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ » قَالَ فَقَبَضَ عَلَيْهِنَّ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ مَضَى
فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسِ شَدَّ مَا قَبَضَ عَلَيْهَا خَالُكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «أَمَا إِنَّهُ إِنْ وَافَى بِهَا يَوْمَ
اَلْقِيَامَةِ لَمْ يَدَعْهَا مُتَعَمِّداً فَتَحَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَبْوَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ» ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Mu‘awiyah ibn Shurayh from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb from ‘Amr ibn Nahik from Sallam
al-Makki:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “A man came to the Prophet, peace and
blessings be upon him and his family, whose name was Shaybah al-Hudhali, and he
said: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, I am an old man; my age has advanced, and my
strength has weakened from the acts I had trained myself upon, prayer, fasting, Hajj,
and jihad. So teach me, O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, some words by which Allah {SWT} will
benefit me and lighten (the burden) upon me, O Messenger of Allah {SWT}.”
He {saws} replied: “Repeat (what you said).”
So he repeated it three times.
Then the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said
to him: “There is not a tree or a clod of earth around you except that it has wept out of
mercy for you. So when you have prayed the morning prayer, say ten times:
‘Subhana Allah al-azim wa bihamdih, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah al-Aliyy al-
‘Azim’ (Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Almighty, and with His {SWT} praise. There is no power
and no strength except with Allah {SWT}, the Most High, the Most Great.)
Indeed, with this Allah {SWT} will protect you from blindness, insanity, leprosy, poverty,
and decrepitude.”
The man said: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, that is for this world, so what about the
Hereafter?”
He {saws} said: “Say after every prayer: ‘O Allah {SWT}, guide me from Yourself {SWT}, pour
upon me from Your {AZJ} bounty, spread upon me from Your {AZJ} mercy, and send down
upon me from Your {AZJ} blessings.’”
He (the narrator) said: So He {saws} grasped them in his hand and walked on. A man said
to Ibn ‘Abbas: "How tightly your uncle clung to them!"
He said: Then the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
“Indeed, if he meets (his Lord {AZJ}) on the Day of Resurrection having preserved them
and not having deliberately abandoned them, Allah {SWT} will open for him eight gates
from the gates of Paradise, and he will enter through whichever of them he wishes.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.106 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.796

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَوْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «أذْكُرُوا اللهَ ذِكْراً كَثِيراً»
مَا ذَا الذِّكْرُ الْكَثِيرُ قَالَ »أَنْ يُسَبِّحَ فِي دُبُرِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً».
english_text:
And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Exalted:
‘Remember Allah {SWT} with much remembrance’ (Surah Ahzab 33:41), what is meant
by “much remembrance”?
Imam {a.s} said: “That one says tasbih (subhanAllah) thirty times after the obligatory
prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.107 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.797 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.454 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.4 p.287 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.10 p.403

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ : «إِنَّ
رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ ذَاتَ يَوْمِ «أَ رَأَيْثُمْ لَوْ جَمَعْتُمْ مَا عِنْدَكُمْ مِنَ الثَّيَابِ وَ الْآنِيَةِ ثُمَّ
وَضَعْتُمْ بَعْضَهُ عَلَى بَعْضِ تَرَوْنَهُ يَبْلُغُ السَّمَاءَ» قَالُوا لا يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ فَقَالَ «يَقُولُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ
سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاّ اللَهُ وَ اللَهُ أكْبَرُ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً وَ هُنَّ يَدْفَعْنَ ٱلْهَدْمَ وَ الْغَرَقَ وَ ٱلْحَرَقَ وَ التَّرَدِيّ
فِي اَلْبِئْرِ وَ أَكْلَ السَّبُعِ وَ مِيتَةَ السَّوْءِ وَ الْبَلِيَّةَ اَلَّتِي نَزَلَتْ عَلَى الْعَبْدِ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ» ».
english_text:
And from him, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abu Ayyub, who said Abu Basir narrated to me:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace and blessings be
upon him and his family, said to his companions one day:
‘Do you think that if you gathered together all the clothing and vessels you possess,
then placed them one on top of another, do you think it would reach the sky?’
They said: ‘No, O Messenger of Allah {SWT}.’
He {saws} said: ‘One of you says, when he finishes his prayer: ‘SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu
lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wa Allahu Akbar’, thirty times. These repel destruction,
drowning, burning, falling into a well, being devoured by a beast, a bad death, and the
calamity that descends upon the servant on that day.’”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.107 • Al-Arba’un Hadithan (Lil-Shahid Al-Awwal), Vol.1 p.49 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.797 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.453

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«أَقَلّ مَا يُجْزِيكَ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ أَنْ تَقُولَ اللّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ كُلَ خَيْرِ أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ
كُلِّ شَرِّ أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ عَافِيَتَكَ فِي أَمُورِي كُلِّهَا وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْي الدُّنْيَا وَ عَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The least that suffices you from supplication
after the obligatory prayer is to say: ‘O Allah {SWT}, I ask You for every good which Your
knowledge encompasses, and I seek refuge in You from every evil which Your
knowledge encompasses. O Allah {SWT}, I ask You for well-being in all my affairs, and I
seek refuge in You from disgrace in this world and punishment in the Hereafter.’”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.343 • Da’a’im Al-Islam, Vol.1 p.170 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.107 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.793 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.469 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.5 p.84

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ :
«لا تَنْسَوُا الْمُوجِبَتَيْنِ » أَوْ قَالَ «عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُوجِبَتَيْنِ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاةِ» قُلْتُ وَ مَا ٱلْمُوجِبَتَانِ قَالَ «تَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ
اَلْجَنَّةَ وَ تَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ النَّارِ ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who
said:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: “Do not forget the two obligations,” or Imam {a.s} said: “It is upon you
to observe the two obligations after every prayer.”
I asked: “And what are the two obligations?”
Imam {a.s} said: “You ask Allah {SWT} for Paradise and you seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from
the Fire.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.343 • Ma’ani Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.183 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.108 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.794 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.464 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.26

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّد بنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ
الْوَاسِطِيّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «لا تَدَعْ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةِ - أُعِيدُ نَفْسِي وَ مَا رَزَقَنِي رَبِّي
بِاللهِ اَلْوَاجِدِ الصَّمَدِ حَتَّى تَخْتِمَهَا وَ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي وَ مَا رَزَقَنِي رَبَّي «بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ» حَتَّى تَخْتِمَهَا وَ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي وَ مَا
رَزَقَنِي رَبِّي «بِرَبّ النَّاسِ» حَتَّى تَخْتِمَهَا ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn al-
Hakam from Aban from Muhammad al-Wasiti, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: “Do not leave, after every prayer, to say:
‘I seek protection for myself and what my Lord has provided me with, by Allah {SWT}, the
One, the Self-Sufficient’, until you complete it,
And: ‘I seek protection for myself and what my Lord has provided me with, by the Lord
of al-Falaq’, until you complete it,
And: ‘I seek protection for myself and what my Lord has provided me with, by the Lord
of mankind’, until you complete it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.343 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.346 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.108 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.792 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.469 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.51

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنْ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَحَبَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَ قَدْ تَخَلَّصَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا
يَتَخَلَّصُ الذَّهَبُ الَّذِي لا كَدَرَ فِيهِ وَ لا يَطْلُبَهُ أَحَدٌ بِمَظْلِمَةِ فَلْيَقُلْ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاَةٍ نِسْبَةَ آلرَّبّ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى
اِثْنَتَي عَشرَةَ مَرَّةً، ثُمَّ يَنْسُطُ يَدَيْهِ فَيَقُولُ « اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسألُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُونِ الْمَخْزُونِ الطُهْرِ الطَّاهِرِ الْمُبَارَكِ وَ
أَسْأَلْكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ الْقَدِيمِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ يَا وَاهِبَ الْعَطَايَا يَا مُطَلِقَ الْأُسَارَى
يَا فَكَاكَ الرِّقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تُفْتِقَ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ النَّارِ وَ تُخْرِجَنِي مِنَ
اَلدُّنْيَا آمِناً وَتُدْخِلَنِي الْجَنَّةَ سَالِماً وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ دُعَائِي أَوْلَهُ فَلاَحاً وَ أَوْسَطَهُ نَجَاحاً وَ آخِرَهُ صَلاحاً «إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلاَمُ
الْغُيُوبِ» » ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «هَذَا مِنَ الْمَحْبِيَّاتِ مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي - رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
وَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُعَلَّمَهُ الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُسَيْنَ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ».
english_text:
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
And it has been narrated from the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, that
Imam {a.s} said: “Whoever wishes to depart from this world having been cleansed of
sins as pure gold is cleansed of impurities, and with no one seeking from him a right
due to injustice, let him say after every prayer the ‘(Surah al-Ikhlas)’ twelve times. Then
he should spread his hands and say:
‘O Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by Your hidden, treasured, pure, immaculate, and blessed
Name. And I ask You {AZJ} by Your great Name and Your ancient authority, that You {AZJ}
send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}. O Giver of
gifts, O Liberator of captives, O Deliverer of necks from the Fire, I ask You {AZJ} to send
