Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيّ بْنِ أَبِي عُثَمَانَ وَ أَبُو عُثِمَانَ اِسْمُهُ عَبْدُ ٱلْوَاحِدِ بْنُ
حَبِيبٍ قَالَ زَعَمَ لَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ الثُمَالِيَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ الدُّهْنِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ:
«صَلاَةُ اَللَّيْلِ تُحَسِّنُ الْوَجْهَ وَ تُذْهِبُ الْهَمَّ وَ تَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ahmad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi ‘Uthman, and Abu
‘Uthman’s name is Abdulwahid ibn Habib. He said Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah al-Thumali claimed to us,
from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar al-Duhni:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The night prayer improves the face, removes worry, and clears
the eyesight.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.121 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.106 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.151 • Al- Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.3 p.229

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الدَّيْلَمِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلاَمُ : «يَا
سُلَيْمَانُ لاَ تَدَغْ قِيَامَ اللَّيْلِ فَإِنَّ ٱلْمَغْبُونَ مَنْ حُرِمَ قِيَامَ اللَّيْلِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami, from his father. He said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, said: “O Sulayman, do not abandon the night prayer, for the one who
is truly deprived is the one who is deprived of the night prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.122 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.107 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.160 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.127 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.146

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الْكِنْدِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّه عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكْذِبُ الْكَذِبَةَ فَيُحْرَمُ بِهَا صَلَاةَ اللَّيْلِ فَإِذَا حُرِمَ صَلَاةَ اللَّيْلِ حُرِمَ بِهَا الرِّزْقَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn al-
Hasan al-Kindi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Indeed, a man may utter a lie, and because of it he is deprived
of the night prayer; and when he is deprived of the night prayer, he is deprived thereby
of sustenance.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.42 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.362 • Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.142 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.122 • Sulwat Al-Hazin, Vol.1 p.118 • Irshad Al-Qulub, Vol.1 p.93 • A’lam Al-Din, Vol.1 p.263 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.107 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.160 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.6 9 p.260

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى فُضَيْلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ ٱلْبُيُوتَ الَّتِي يُصَلِّى فِيهَا بِتِلاَوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ ثُضِيءُ
الأَهْلٍ السَّمَاءِ كَمَا تُضِيءُ نُجُومُ السَّمَاءِ لِأَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ».
english_text:
And Fudayl ibn Yasar narrated:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Indeed, the houses in which the Qur’an is recited and prayer is
performed shine for the inhabitants of the heavens just as the stars of the sky shine for
the inhabitants of the earth.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.473 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.42 • Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.120 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.122 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.321 • A’lam Al-Din, Vol.1 p.262 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.103 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.294 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.158 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.153

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ النَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ [صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خ ل] لأَبِي ذَرَّ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ لَهُ: «يَا أَبَا ذَرِّ اِحْفَظْ وَصِيَّةَ
نَبِيِّكَ مَنْ خُتِمَ لَهُ بِقِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ» فِي حَدِيثٍ طَوِيلِ.
english_text:
And the Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said to Abu Dharr in his will
to him: “O Abu Dharr, preserve the will of your Prophet {saws}; Whoever’s end comes
while he was engaged in the night prayer, then Paradise is for him.” (This was
mentioned in a lengthy narration.)
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.474 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.122 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.154

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُمَرَ الْيَمَانِيَّ
عَمَّنْ حَدَّتَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ «إِنَّ الْحَسَناتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّثَاتِ» قَالَ «صَلاَةُ
الْمُؤْمِنِ بِاللَّيْلِ تَذْهَبُ بِمَا عَمِلَ مِنْ ذَنْبِ بِالنَّهَارِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa,
from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamani, from someone who narrated to him:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic:
‘Indeed, good deeds remove bad deeds”’ (Surah Hud 11:114)
Imam {a.s} said: “The believer’s prayer at night removes what he has committed of sins
during the day.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.266 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.473 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.42 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.122 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.101 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.146 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.139 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.126 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.148

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا قُمْتَ بِاللَّيْلِ مِنْ مَنَامِكَ فَقُلِ - الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ آلَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوجِي لِأَحْمَدَهُ وَ أَعْبُدَهُ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتَ صَوْتَ الدُّيُوكِ
فَقُلْ - سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسُ رَبُّنَا وَ رَبُ ٱلْمَلائِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ سَبَقَتْ رَحْمَتُكَ غَضَبَكَ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لا شَرِيكَ لَكَ عَمِلْتُ
سُوءاً وَ «ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي» وَ اِرْحَمْنِي إنّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ فَإِذَا قُمْتَ فَانظُرْ فِي آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ وَ قُلٍ
اَللَّهُمّ إِنَّهُ لا يُوَارِي عَنْكَ لَيْلْ سَاجٍ وَ لا سَمَاءُ ذَاتُ أَبْرَاجٍ وَ لا أَرْضّ ذَاتُ مِهَادٍ وَ لا «ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُها فَوْقَ بَعْضِ» وَ
لاَ بَخرٌ لُجَّيْ تُذلِجُ بَيْنَ يَدَي الْمُذلِجِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ تَعْلَمُ «خَائِئَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَ مَا تَخْفِي الصُدُورُ» غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ وَ نَامَتِ
الْعُيُونُ وَ أَنْتَ «اَلْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ» لا تَأْخُذُكَ «سِنَةُ وَ لا نَوْمٌ» «سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» وَ إِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ «وَ اَلْحَمْدُ
لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» ثُمَّ اِقْرَأْ الْخَمْسَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ « إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السِّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ» إلَى قَوْلِهِ «إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ
الْمِيعَادَ» ثُمَّ اِسْتَكْ وَ تَوَضَّأُ فَإِذَا وَضَعْتَ يَدَكَ فِي الْمَاءِ فَقُلْ - بِسْمِ اللّهِ وَ بِاللّهِ اللَّهُمْ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَ
اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ «الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» فَإِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى صَلاَتِكَ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللّهِ وَ بِاللهِ
وَ إِلَى اللهِ وَ مِنَ اللّهِ وَ مَا شَاءَ اللهُ وَ لا حَوْلَ وَ لا قُوْةَ إِلاّ بِاللّهِ اللّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنْ زُوَّارِكَ وَ عُمَّارٍ مَسَاجِدِكَ وَ اِفْتَحْ
لِي يَا رَبَّ بَابَ تَوْبَتِكَ وَ أَغْلِقَ عَنِّي بَابَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ كُلِّ مَعْصِيَةِ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي جَعَلَنِي مِمَّنْ يُنَاجِيهِ اللَّهُمَّ أَقْبِلْ
عَلَيّ بِوَجْهِكَ جَلَ ثَنَاوُكَ ثُمَّ اِفْتَتِحِ الصَّلاَةَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ثم يقوم الى مصلاه) الى قوله : (ويستحب ان يقنت بهذا الدعاء).
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “When you rise at night from your sleep, say:
‘Praise be to Allah {SWT} who returned my soul to me so that I may praise Him {AZJ} and
worship Him {AZJ}.’
And when you hear the sound of the roosters, say: ‘Holy, Holy, is our Lord {AZJ} and the
Lord {AZJ} of the angels and the Spirit. Your {AZJ} mercy has preceded Your {AZJ} wrath. There
is no god but You {AZJ}, alone with no partner. I have done evil and wronged myself, so
forgive me and have mercy on me. Indeed, none forgives sins except You {AZJ}.’
Then when you stand up, look at the horizons of the sky and say: ‘O Allah {SWT}, there is
no night in prostration that is hidden from You {AZJ}, nor a sky with towers, nor an earth
with bedding, nor ‘layers of darkness, some above others’, nor a deep sea in which
travellers travel during the night from among Your {AZJ} creation. You {AZJ} know ‘the
betrayal of the eyes and what the breasts conceal’. The stars have disappeared, and
the eyes have slept, and yet You {AZJ} are ‘the Ever-Living, the Sustainer’, neither
slumber nor sleep overtakes You {AZJ}.
Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds. And the God {AZJ} of the Messengers,
and praise be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds.”
Then recite the five verses from Surah Aal Imran: ‘Indeed, in the creation of the
heavens and the earth…’ until His {AZJ} saying: ‘Indeed, You do not break the promise.”’
Then use the siwak (toothstick) and perform wudu (ablution).
IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
When you place your hand in the water, say: ‘In the name of Allah {SWT} and by Allah {SWT}.
O Allah {SWT}, make me among those who repent often and make me among those who
purify themselves.’
When you finish, say: ‘Praise be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds.’
When you stand for your prayer, say: ‘In the name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, and
to Allah {SWT}, and from Allah {SWT}, and whatever Allah {SWT} wills. There is no power and
no strength except through Allah {SWT}. O Allah {SWT}, make me among Your {AZJ} visitors
and among the frequenters of Your {AZJ} mosques. O Lord {AZJ}, open for me the door of
Your {AZJ} repentance, and close from me the door of Your {AZJ} disobedience and every
act of disobedience. Praise be to Allah {SWT}, who made me among those who converse
with Him {AZJ}. O Allah {SWT}, turn Your {AZJ} face toward me, Exalted is Your {AZJ} praise!’
Then begin the prayer with the takbir.
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “Then he stands at his prayer
place” until his statement: “And it is recommended that he perform qunoot with this
supplication.”
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.445 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.122 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.343 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.34

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بن مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ
رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَقْرَأَ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةِ خَمْسَ عَشَرَةَ آيَةً وَ يَكُونُ رُكُوعُهُ مِثلَ قِيَامِهِ وَ سُجُودُهُ مِثلَ
رُكُوعِهِ وَ رَفَعُ رَأْسِهِ مِنَ الرُكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ سَوَاءً».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, used to recite fifteen verses in every rak‘ah, and His {saws} bowing (ruku‘) would
be equal in length to His {saws} standing, and His {saws} prostration would be equal to His
{saws} bowing, and His {saws} raising of His {saws} head from bowing and from prostration
were all equal.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.123 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.343 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.332

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَسْعُودِ الطَّائِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى
اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يَقْرَأْ فِي آخِرِ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ «هَلْ أَتى عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ» » - قَالَ عَلِيّ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ وَ قَالَ الْحَارِثُ
سَمعْثُهُ هَ هُهَ تَقُوأُ - « «قُاْ هُهَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُلْثُ ٱلْقُآن هَ «قُا نَا أَنَّهَا الْكَافُه:» تَعْداُ أُلُعَهُ هَ كَاءَ رَسُواُ اللَّه
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Mas‘ud al-Ta’i:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, used to recite in the final rak‘ah of the night prayer: ‘Has there come upon
man…’ (Surah al-Insan 76:1).”
Ali ibn al-Nu‘man said, and al-Harith said: I heard Him {a.s} while He {a.s} was saying:
‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’ is one-third of the Qur’an, and ‘Surah Al-Kafirun’ equals one-fourth
of it.
And the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, used to
combine ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’ in the witr prayer in order to encompass the entire Qur’an.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.124 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.669

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنْ قَرَأ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةِ مِنْهَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مَرَّةً وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ»
ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً اِنْفَتَلَ وَ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ذَنْبٌ إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ».
english_text:
And it has been narrated:
“That whoever recites in the first two rak‘ahs of the night prayer, ‘Al-Hamdulillah’ once
in each rak‘ah, and ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’ thirty times, then he finishes his prayer, there will
remain no sin between him and Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, except that it will be
forgiven for him.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.485 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.124 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.668 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.129 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.796

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْبَرْقِيّ وَ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلْعَبْدِ إِذَا صَلَّى أَنْ يُرَتَّلَ فِي قِرَاءَتِهِ فَإِذَا مَرَّ بِآيَةٍ فِيهَا ذِكْرُ الْجَنَّةِ وَ ذِكْرُ النَّارِ
سَأَلَ اللَّهَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ تَعَوِّذَ بِاللّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ إِذَا مَرَّ بٍ «يَا أَيْهَا النّاسُ» وَ «يا أَيُهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» يَقُولُ لَبَّيْكَ رَبَّنَا».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn al-Barqi and Abu Ahmad, from
some of our companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “It is proper for the servant, when he prays, to recite with
measured tone (tartil). And when he passes by a verse that mentions Paradise or the
Fire, he should ask Allah {SWT} for Paradise and seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from the Fire.
And when he passes by ‘O people’ and ‘O you who believe’, he should say: ‘Labbayk,
our Lord {AZJ}.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.124 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.698 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.68 • Al- Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.3 p.312

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنْ عَمِّهِ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ سَالِمِ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَقُومُ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ فَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَقَالَ «يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّجُلِ إِذَا صَلَّى فِي اللَّيْلِ أنْ
يُسْمِعَ أَهْلَهُ لِكَيْ يَقُومَ ٱلْقَائِمُ وَ يَتَحَرَّكَ ٱلْمُتَحَرِّك».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from some of our companions, from Ali ibn Asbat, from his uncle Ya‘qub ibn Salim:
He asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who rises at the end of the night and raises his
voice with the Qur’an.
Imam {a.s} said: “It is proper for a man, when he prays at night, to make his voice heard
by his family, so that the one who is already awake may rise and the one stirring may
become active.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.124 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.691 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.77 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.79

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَجَالِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْوَلِيدِ الْكِنْدِيّ عَنْ
إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ أَوْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِنِّي أَقُومُ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ وَ أَخَافُ الصُّبْحَ
قَالَ «اِقْرَأِ الْحَمْدَ وَ اِعْجَلِ اِعْجَلْ».
هذا الخبر محمول على من يغلب على ظنه انه يمكنه الفراغ من صلاة الليل قبل أن يطلع الفجر فاما مع الخوف من ذلك
فالاولى أن يقدم الوتر ثم يقضي الثماني ركعات بعد ذلك ، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hajjal, from
Abdullah ibn al-Walid al-Kindi, from Isma‘il ibn Jabir or Abdullah ibn Sinan. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I rise at the end of the night and I fear that dawn will come.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Recite al-Hamd and hurry, hurry.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
This report is to be understood as applying to the one who strongly believes he will be
able to complete the night prayer before the arrival of dawn. But if there is fear that he
may not be able to do so, then it is preferable to perform the witr prayer first, and then
make up the eight rak‘ahs afterward. What indicates this, which has been narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.449 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.124 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.337 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.257 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.130 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.123

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بَنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ
الْقَاسِم بْنِ بُرَيْدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَقُومُ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ وَ هُوَ
يَخْشَى أَنْ يَفْجَأَهُ الصُّبْحُ أَيَبْدَأُ بِالْوَثْرِ أَوْ يُصَلِّي الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا حَتّى يَكُونَ ٱلْوَثْرُ آخِرَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «بَلْ يَبْدَأْ
بالْوَثْرِ» وَ قَالَ «أَنَا كُنْتُ فَاعِلاً ذَلِكَ».
وإذا صلى أربع ركعات من صلاة الليل ثم أدركه الصبح جاز له أن يتم صلاة الليل ثم يصلي
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn ‘Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar,
from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from al-Qasim ibn Burayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja‘far. said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who rises at the end of the night and fears that dawn might
surprise him, should he begin with the witr prayer or perform the prayer in its proper
sequence so that the witr would be the last of it?
Imam {a.s} said: “Rather, he should begin with the witr.”
And he (narrator) said: “I used to do that myself.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
And if he has prayed four rak‘ahs of the night prayer and then dawn reaches him, it is
permissible for him to complete te night prayer and then perform Fajr prayer.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.449 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.125 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.337 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.257

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي الْفَضْلِ النَّحْوِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلنُّعْمَانِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ : «إِذَا كُثْتَ صَلَّيْتَ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنْ صَلاةِ اللَّيْلِ
قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ فَأْتِمَّ الصَّلاةَ طَلَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَطْلُعْ».
والافضل أن يعدل عن اتمام صلاة الليل الى صلاة الغداة ثم يصلي تمامها بعد الفراغ من صلاة الفجر، يدل على ذلك ما
رواه :
english_text:
What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from Ali ibn al-
Hakam, from Abu al-Fadl al-Nahwi, from Abu Ja‘far al-Ahwal Muhammad ibn al-Nu‘man. He said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, said: “If you have prayed four rak‘ahs of the night prayer before the
rising of dawn, then complete the prayer, whether dawn has risen or not.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And it is better that he shifts from completing the night prayer to performing the
morning (Fajr) prayer, then completes the remainder of the night prayer after finishing
the Fajr prayer. What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.125 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.339 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.260 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.218 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.154

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْبَزَّازِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَقُومُ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ بِقَلِيلٍ
فَأَصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ أَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ يَنْفَجِرَ الْفَجْرُ - أَبْدَأُ بِالْوَثْرِ أَوْ أَتِمُ الرَّكَعَاتِ قَالَ «لا بَلْ أَوْتِزْ وَ أَخَرِ الرَّكَعَاتِ
حَتَّى تَقْضِيَهَا فِي صَدْرِ النَّهَارِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ya‘qub al-Bazzaz. He said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “I rise shortly before Fajr and pray four rak‘ahs, then I fear that dawn
will break, should I begin with the witr or complete the rak‘ahs?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, rather perform the witr and delay the rak‘ahs until you make them
up in the early part of the day.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.125 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.339 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.260 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.218

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمّدٍ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيَ عَنِ ٱلْمَرْزُبَانِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
الأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَقُومُ وَ قَدْ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَإِنْ أَنَا بَدَأْتُ بِالْفَجْرِ صَلِّيْتُهَا فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِهَا وَ إِنْ بَدَأْتُ فِي
صَلَاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَ الْوَثْرِ صَلَّيْتُ الْفَجْرَ فِي وَقْتِ هَوْلاءِ فَقَالَ «ابْدَأُ بِصَلَاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَ ٱلْوَثْرِ وَ لا تَجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَادَةً».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from al-
Marzuban ibn ‘Imran, from ‘Umar ibn Yazid. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I rise and the dawn has already appeared. If I begin with the
Fajr prayer, I perform it at its earliest time; but if I begin with the night prayer and the
witr, I end up praying Fajr at the time these people do (later).”
So Imam {a.s} said: “Begin with the night prayer and the witr, but do not make that a
habit.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.126 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.335 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.262

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَقُومُ وَ قَدْ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ وَ لَمْ أُصَلِّ صَلاَةَ اللِّيْلِ فَقَالَ «صَلِّ صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ وَ أَوْتِزْ وَ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَي
الْفَجْرِ».
فانما وردت هذه الاخبار رخصة في جواز تأخير صلاة الغداة عن أول الوقت الى آخره، ويجوز ذلك إذا كان تأخيره إنما
يكون للاشتغال بشئ من العبادات والافضل ما ذكرناه أن يصلي الغداة في أول وقتها ثم يقضي صلاة الليل ، والذي يكشف
أيضا عما ذكرناه:
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from ‘Ammar ibn al-Mubarak, from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir,
from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I rise and the dawn has already appeared, and I have not yet
performed the night prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Perform the night prayer, and perform the witr, and perform the two
rak‘ahs of Fajr.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
These reports were only narrated as a concession permitting the delay of the morning
(Fajr) prayer from its earliest time to its latest, and that is allowed if the delay is due to
being engaged in some form of worship. However, the preferred course is what we
have mentioned: to perform the Fajr prayer at its earliest time, then make up the night
prayer afterward. And what further clarifies what we have stated is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.126 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.335 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.262

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أُوتِرُ
بَعَدَ مَا يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ قَالَ »لا».
english_text:
What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Hammad, from Isma‘il ibn Jabir. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Shall I perform the witr after the dawn has risen?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.126 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.336 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.259

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصِّفَارُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ
عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلَاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَ ٱلْوَثْرِ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «صَلَّهَا بَعْدَ اَلْفَجْرِ
حَتَى تَكُونَ فِي وَقْتٍ تُصَلِّي ٱلْغَدَاةَ فِي آخِرٍ وَقْتِهَا وَ لا تَعَمَّدْ ذَلِكَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةِ» وَ قَالَ «أَوْتِزْ أَيْضاً بَعْدَ فَرَاغِكَ مِنْهَا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from ‘Amr ibn Uthman and Muhammad ibn
‘Umar ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, from ‘Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}. He said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the night prayer and the witr after the rising of dawn.
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray it after Fajr, so long as it is still within the time when you can pray
the morning prayer at its latest time. But do not make that your habit every night.”
And Imam {a.s} said: “Also perform the witr after you finish it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.126 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.336 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.261

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي
الْوَثْرٍ فَقَالَ «كَانَ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَ أَبِي بَابٌ فَكَانَ أَبِي إِذَا صَلَّى يَقْرَأَ فِي الْوَثْرِ - بٍ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ» فِي تَلاَثَتِهِنَّ وَ
كَانَ يَقْرَأ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْهَا قَالَ «كَذَلِكَ اللَّهُ رَبِّي أَوْ كَذَاكَ اللَّهُ رَبِّي» ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj. He said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the recitation in the witr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “There was a door between me and my father {a.s}, and when my father
{a.s} would pray, He {a.s} would recite ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’ in the three rak‘ahs of the witr. And
when He {a.s} finished reciting it, He {a.s} would say:
‘Thus, Allah {SWT} is my Lord {AZJ},’ or ‘That is how Allah {SWT} is my Lord {AZJ}.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.126 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.669 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.131 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.796 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.226

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
يَقُولُ: « «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ ٱلْقُرْآنِ وَ كَانَ يُجِبُ أَنْ يَجَمَعَهَا فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ لِيَكُونَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from al-Halabi, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughirah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “My father {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to say: ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’
is equal to one-third of the Qur’an, and He {a.s} used to love to combine it in the witr so
that the entire Qur’an would be encompassed.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.127 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.669 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.131 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.796 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.226

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الْعَبْدَ الصَالِحَ عَنِ ٱلْقِرَاءَةِ فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ وَ قُلْتُ إِنَّ بَعْضاً رَوَى - «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ
أَحَدٌ» فِي الثَّلاَثِ وَ بَعْضاً رَوَى فِي الْأُولَيَيْنِ - الْمُعَوِّدَّتَيْنِ وَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ» فَقَالَ «اِعْمَلْ بِالْمُعَوِّدَتَيْنِ
وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ».
والتسليم في الركعتين من الثلاث ركعات لا يجوز تركه يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
And from him, from Ya‘qub ibn Yaqtin. He said:
I asked the Righteous Servant (Abd al-Salih {a.s}) about the recitation in the witr prayer.
I asked: “Some have narrated ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’ in all three rak‘ahs, and some have
narrated the ‘Mu‘awwidhatayn’ (Surah al-Falaq and Surah al-Nas) in the first two, and
‘Surah Al Ikhlas’ in the third.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Act upon the ‘Mu‘awwidhatayn’ and ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
And the taslim (salutation) in the two rak‘ahs of the three rak‘ahs (of the witr set) is not
to be omitted. What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.127 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.668 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.115 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.132 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.809 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.226

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«الْوَثْرُ ثَلاَثُ رَكَعَاتِ يُفْصَلُ بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ يُقْرَأْ فِيهِنَّ جَمِيعا - «بقل هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ»».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Uthman ibn ‘Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The witr is three rak‘ahs, separated from one another, and
‘Surah Al Ikhlas’ is recited in all of them.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.127 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.348 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.796

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ شُعَيْبِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْوَثْرُ ثَلاَثُ رَكَعَاتٍ ثِنْتَيْنٍ مَفْصُولَةً
و وَاحِدَةٍ».
english_text:
And from him, from Hammad ibn Shu‘ayb, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The witr is three rak‘ahs, two separated and one (by itself).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.127 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.348 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.93 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.64

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ التَّسْلِيمُ فِي
رَكْعَتَي الْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ «تُوقِظُ الرَّاقِدَ وَ تُكَلَّمُ بِالْحَاجَةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, regarding the taslim (salutation) in the two rak‘ahs of witr.
Imam {a.s} said: “You may wake the one who is sleeping and speak regarding a need.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.127 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.348 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.94 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.64

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدِ حَفْصِ بْنِ سَالِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ - عَنِ
التَّسْلِيم فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكَ حَاجَةٌ فَاخْرُجْ وَ اِقْضِهَا ثُمَّ عُدْ قَارْكَعْ رَكْعَة».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Walad Hafs ibn Salim. He said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the taslim (salutation) in the two rak‘ahs of the witr.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes. And if you have a need, then go out and take care of it, then return
and perform one rak‘ah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.449 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.127 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.348 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.93 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.62 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.210

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَارِ قَالَ قَالَ لِي: «اِقْرَأْ فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ فِي ثَلاَثَتِهِنَّ - بِ «قُلْ هُوَ
الله أَحَد» وَسَلَّمْ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ تُوقِظُ الرَّاقِدَ وَ تَأْمُرُ بالصَّلاةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Hammad ibn Isa and Fadalah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar. He said:
Imam {a.s} said to me: “Recite in the witr, in all three rak‘ahs, ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’, and
perform taslim in the two rak‘ahs. Wake the one who is asleep and command (them)
to pray.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.128

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْوَثْرِ
ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفَ فَيَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Abu Walad:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “There is no harm if a man prays the two rak‘ahs of the witr, then
departs to fulfill his need.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.128 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.64

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْبَرْقِي عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ عَمَّنُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَفْصِلُ الْوَثْرَ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّي رُبَّمَا عَطِشتْ أَفَأَشْرَبُ اَلْمَاءَ فَقَالَ
«نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Sa‘d, from Abu Ja‘far, from al-Barqi, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl al-Nawfali, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, or
someone else, from someone who narrated to him, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}. He said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “Shall I separate the witr (into parts)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
I said to Him {a.s}: “Sometimes I become thirsty, may I drink water (in between)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.128 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.95

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ
بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ : فِيمَنِ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ مِنَ الْوَثْرِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ أَوْ يَخْرُجَ مِنَ
الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمّ يَعْودَ فَيُوتِرَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ تَصْنَعُ مَا تَشَاءُ وَ تَتَكَلَّمُ وَ تُحْدِثُ وُضُوءَكَ ثُمَّ تُتِمْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ الْغَدَاةَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘, from
Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, from ‘Umar ibn Yazid:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding someone who leaves after the second rak‘ah of
the witr, whether it is permissible for him to speak or leave the mosque and then return
to complete the witr.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, you may do as you wish, you may speak, perform wudu again, and
then complete it before you pray the morning (Fajr) prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.128 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.94 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.65

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْبَرْقِيّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ الْأَشعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ اَلْوَثْرِ أَفَصْلٌ أَمْ وَصْلٌ قَالَ «فَصْلٌ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Barqi, from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d al-Ash‘ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha,
peace be upon him. He said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the witr, should it be separated or connected?
Imam {a.s} said: “Separated.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.128 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.348 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.94 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.65

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ وَ غَيْرِهِ
عَنْ بَعْضِ مَشِيخَتِهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَفْصِلُ فِي الْوَثْرِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي رُبِّمَا عَطِشتُ
فَأُشرَبُ الْمَاءَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ إِنْكِح».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ja‘far, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl al-Nawfali,
from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah and others, from some of his teachers. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Shall I separate (the rak‘ahs) in the witr?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
I asked: “Sometimes I become thirsty, so I drink water.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, and (even) marry (if you wish).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.128 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.95 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.65

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ التَّسْلِيمِ فِي رَكْعَتَي الْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ شِئْتَ سَلِّمْتَ وَ إنْ شِئْتَ لَمْ تُسَلَّمْ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from
Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb. He said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the taslim (salutation) in the two rak‘ahs of the witr.
Imam {a.s} said: “If you wish, you may say the taslim, and if you wish, you may omit it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.129 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.129 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.348 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.349 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.95 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.95 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.66 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.66

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وعنه عن النضر عن محمد بن أبي حمزة عن معاوية بن عمار قال قلت لابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : اسلم في
ركعتي الوتر؟ فقال: إن شئت سلمت وإن شئت لم تسلم.
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Shall I say the taslim in the two rak‘ahs of the witr?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If you wish, you may say the taslim, and if you wish, you may omit it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ كُرْدَوَيْهِ الْهَمْدَانِيَّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلْعَبْدَ الصَّالِحَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ ٱلْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ «صِلْهُ».
فان هذه الروايات ليست منافية لما ذكرناه لانها تضمنت التخيير في التسليم ومن يقول بصلتها فانه لا يجوز التسليم فيها
على وجه، وإذا كان فيها الاختيار فنحن نحمله على التسليم المخصوص وهو ان عندنا ان من قال السلام علينا وعلى عباد
اللّه الصالحين في التشهد فقد انقطعت صلاته ، فان قال بعد ذلك السلام عليكم ورحمة اللّٰه جاز، وإن لم يقل جاز أيضا ،
فكان التخيير إنما تناول هذا الضرب من التسليم ، ولو كان فيها صريح بالنهي عن التسليم لم يجب العمل بها لان ما أثبتناه
في وجوب التسليم من الاخبار اكثر، ولا يجوز العدول عن الاكثر الى الاقل الا لدليل يمنع منه، ويجوز أن تكون هذه
الاخبار خرجت على طريق التقية لانها موافقة لمذاهب العامة وما يخرج على هذا الوجه لا يجب العمل به ، ويحتمل أن
يكون أراد بالتسليم ما يستباح بالتسليم من الكلام وغيره، واجري عليه هذه التسمية لانه سبب في اباحته وهذا الكلام
مما الانسان مخير فيه إن شاء تكلم وإن شاء ابتدأ في الوتر من غير كلام ، والذي يكشف عما ذكرناه أخيرا ما رواه:
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Kurdawayh al-Hamdani. He said:
I asked the Righteous Servant (Abd al Salih {a.s}), peace be upon him, about the witr.
Imam {a.s} said: “Connect it.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
For these narrations are not contradictory to what we have mentioned, because they
contain the element of choice regarding the taslim (salutation). And for the one who
connects the rak‘ahs (without separating them), then it is not permissible for him to
perform the taslim in that form. And when there is choice involved, we interpret it to
refer to the specific form of taslim, according to us, whoever says ‘Peace be upon us
and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT} ‘ in the tashahhud, his prayer is cut off;
and if after that he says ‘Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah {SWT} ‘, it is
permissible, and if he does not say it, that is also permissible.
Thus, the choice pertains to this type of taslim. And if there were a clear prohibition of
taslim in those reports, it would not be obligatory to act upon them, because the
narrations establishing the obligation of taslim are more numerous, and it is not
permissible to abandon the greater number for the lesser unless there is a clear proof
requiring it.
It is also possible that these reports were issued by way of taqiyya (precautionary
dissimulation), because they conform with the views of the general public (non-Shia
jurists), and whatever is issued in such a manner is not obligatory to act upon. It is also
possible that by "taslim" was meant the permission to speak and other such acts that
become allowed through taslim, and that it was referred to as “taslim” because it
serves as the cause for that permission.
This type of statement is something in which the person is given a choice, if he wishes,
he may speak, and if he wishes, he may begin the witr without speaking. And what
further clarifies what we have just mentioned is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.129 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.349 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.96

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مَوْلَى لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «رَكْعَتَا الْوَثْرِ إِنْ شَاءَ
تَكَلَّمَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ بَيْنَ الثَّالِثَةِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَفْصِلْ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ويستحب أن يدعو الانسان في الوتر بهذا الدعاء) وذكر الدعاء الى اخره الى قوله : (ثم يصلي
اكمة الفح) فله نشتغا بتخديح أسانه التعاء لا الاشتفال بفه أمل ممن أولى أن يقف عل السعاء نفسه فل أخذ
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Mansur, from a servant of Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him. He said:
Imam {a.s} said: “The two rak‘ahs of the witr, if he wishes, he may speak between them
and the third rak‘ah, and if he wishes, he may not separate them.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And it is recommended that
a person supplicate in the witr with this supplication’ and he mentioned the
supplication to its end, up to his statement: ‘then he performs the two rak‘ahs of Fajr.’
We did not occupy ourselves with tracing the chains of transmission of the
supplication, as attending to other matters was more appropriate. And whoever
wishes to see the supplication itself, let him refer to the book.
As for what has been narrated encouraging supplication in the witr:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.130 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.95 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.65

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «فِي قَوْلِ
اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «وَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ» فِي الْوَثْرِ فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً».
english_text:
What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar. He said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic: ‘And
in the hours before dawn they would seek forgiveness’ (Surah Dhariyat 51:18), this
refers to the witr, at the end of the night, seventy times.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.130 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.758 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.280 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.121

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَمّا أَقُولُ فِي وَثَرِي فَقَالَ
«مَا قَضَى اللهُ عَلَى لِسَانِكَ وَ قَدَرَهُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Isma‘il ibn al-Fadl. He said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about what I should say in my witr. He said: “Whatever Allah
{SWT} causes to be spoken on your tongue and has decreed.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.130 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.758 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.278

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ: «اِسْتَغْفِرِ اللّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ
سَبْعينَ مَرَّةً».
english_text:
And from him, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}. He said:
Imam {a.s} said to me: “Seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, in the witr
seventy times.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.450 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.130 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.757 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.279 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.280

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ «اَلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ» فَقَالَ
«اِسْتَغْفَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي وَثْرِهِ سَبْعِينَ مَرّةً».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Sama‘ah, from Abu Basir who said:
I said to him: “(about) Those who seek forgiveness at dawn” (Surah Aal ‘Imran 3:17) &
(Surah Dhariyat 51:18).
He said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, blessings of Allah {SWT} be upon him and his
family, sought forgiveness in his Witr prayer seventy times.”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.130 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.758 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.281 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.602 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.121

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ فِي الْوَثْرِ هَلْ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مُوَقَّتْ يُتَّبَعُ وَ يُقَالُ فَقَالَ «لا أَثْنِ عَلَى اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ صَلَّ عَلَى
اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ الْعَظِيمِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «كُلُّ ذَنْبٍ عَظِيمٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-
Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding the Qunoot in Witr, is there anything fixed in it
that should be followed and said?
Imam {a.s} said: “No. Praise Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, and send blessings upon
the Prophet, blessings of Allah {SWT} be upon him and his family, and seek forgiveness
for your great sins.”
Then Imam {a.s} said: “Every sin is great.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.450 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.130 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.758 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.277 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.99

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «اَلْقُنُوتُ فِي الْوَثْرِ الاِسْتِغْفَارُ وَ فِي الْفَرِيضَةِ الدُّعَاءُ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from Aban, from Abd al-
Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Qunoot in Witr is seeking forgiveness, and in the obligatory
prayer it is supplication.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.450 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.491 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.131 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.755 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.276

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «تَدْعُو فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ
عَلَى اَلْعَدُوِّ وَ إِنْ شِنْتَ سَمَّيْتَهُمْ وَ تَسْتَغْفِرُ وَ تَرْفَعُ يَدَيْكَ فِي الْوَثْرِ جِيَالَ وَجْهِكَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ تَحْتَ ثَوْبِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “In the Witr, you supplicate against the enemy, and if you wish,
you may mention them by name. And you seek forgiveness, and you raise your hands
in the Witr in front of your face, and if you wish, under your garment.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.489 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.131 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.758

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ وَ عَبْدِ ٱلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ وَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ
بَعْضٍ أَصْحَابِنًا عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يُجْزِيكَ مِنَ ٱلْقُنُوتِ خَمْسُ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ فِي تَرَسُّلٍ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Hadid, and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, and al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from
Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from some of our companions:
Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said: “Five Tasbihs with calm recitation suffice you for
Qunoot.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.131 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.756 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.274

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانُ بْنُ عُثَمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ: أَنّهُ قَالَ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ أُسَمِّي الْأَئِمَةَ عَلَيهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ
فَقَالَ «أَجْمِلْهُمْ».
english_text:
And Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Al-Halabi:
He (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: "I mention the names of the
Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, in the prayer."
Imam {a.s} said: "Summarize them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.493 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.131 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.886

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ
مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللْهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ : عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى الْقُنُوتَ فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ أَوْ غَيْرِ الْوَثْرِ قَالَ
«لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْء» وَ قَالَ «إِنْ ذَكَرَهُ وَ قَدْ أَهْوَى إلَى الرُّكُوعِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ فَلْيَرْجِعْ قَائِماً وَ
لَيَقْنُثْ ثُمَّ يَرْكَعُ وَ إِنْ وَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ فَلْيَمْضٍ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn
Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding the man who forgets the
Qunoot in the Witr prayer or in other than the Witr.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is nothing upon him."
And Imam {a.s} said: "If he remembers it while he has already moved toward the bowing
(ruku‘) before placing his hands on his knees, then let him return to a standing position
and recite the Qunoot, then bow. But if he has placed his hands on his knees, then let
him continue in his prayer, and there is nothing upon him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.131 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.936 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.286 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.415

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ قَالَ حَدَثَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا قَالَ:
كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ عَنْ آخِرِ رَكْعَةِ ٱلْوَثْرِ قَالَ » هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ حَسَنَاتُهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِثْكَ وَ
شكْرُهُ ضَعِيفٌ وَ ذَتْبُهُ عَظِيمٌ وَ لَيْسَ لِذَلِكَ إِلاَّ رِفْقُكَ وَ رَحْمَثُكَ فَإِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِي كِتَابِكَ ٱلْمُنْزَلِ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «كَانُوا قَلِيلاً مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ وَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ» طَالَ هُجُوعِي وَ قَلَ قِيَامِي
وَ هَذَا السَّحَرُ وَ أَنَا أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِذُنُوبِي اِسْتِغْفَارَ مَنْ لا يَجِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ ضَرّاً وَ لا نَفْعاً وَ لا مَوْتاً وَ لاَ حَيَاةً وَ لاَ نُشُوراً ثُمَّ
يَخِرُّ سَاجِداً».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ثم ليصل ركعتي الفجر) الى قوله : (وليضطجع).
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Abdul-Aziz, who said:
One of our companions narrated to me, saying:
Abu al-Hasan al Awwal (the First) {a.s}, peace be upon him, when He {a.s} raised his head
from the final rak‘ah of the Witr prayer, used to say:
"This is the position of one whose good deeds are a blessing from You, and whose
gratitude is weak, and whose sin is great, and there is no refuge for that except in Your
{AZJ} gentleness and Your {AZJ} mercy. For indeed, You {AZJ} said in Your {AZJ} revealed Book,
which was sent down upon Your {AZJ} sent Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family: ‘They used to sleep but little of the night, and in the hours before dawn they
would seek forgiveness’ (Surah Dhariyat 51:17–18). My sleep has been long, and my
standing (in prayer) has been little, and now is the time before dawn, and I am seeking
Your {AZJ} forgiveness for my sins, seeking forgiveness like one who finds no harm or
benefit for his own self, nor death, nor life, nor resurrection."
Then He {a.s} would fall into prostration.
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "Then let him perform the two
rak‘ahs of the Fajr (supererogatory) prayer" until his statement: "And let him lie down."
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.325 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.132 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.763 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.281 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.122 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 2 p.413

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَدَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ الرَّكْعَتَانِ اللَّتَانِ قَبْلَ ٱلْغَدَاةِ أَيْنَ مَوْضِعُهُمَا فَقَالَ «قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ فَإِذَا طَلَعَ ٱلْفَجْرُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ
وَقْتُ اَلْغَدَاةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah
from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him: "The two rak‘ahs that are before the dawn (al-
ghadah) prayer, what is their time?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Before the rising of the dawn. So when the dawn rises, then the time of
the dawn prayer has entered."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.448 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.132 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.314 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.265

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ فِي كِتَابِ رَجُلٍ إلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ الرّكْعَتَانِ اللَّتَانِ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ مِنْ صَلَاَةِ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَمْ مِنْ صَلَاَةِ النَّهَارِ وَ فِي أَيِّ وَقْتِ أَصَلِّيهِمَا فَكَتَبَ
بِخَطَّهِ «أُحْشُوهُمَا فِي صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ حَشواً».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
I (Ali ibn Mahziyar) read in the letter of a man to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him,
asking: "The two rak‘ahs before the Fajr prayer, are they from the night prayer or from
the day prayer? And at what time should I perform them?"
So He {a.s} wrote in his own handwriting: "Insert them into the night prayer as an
insertion."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.450 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.132 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.315 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.265 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.119 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 3 p.339 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 3 p.383

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ
فَقَالَ «أُحْشُوا بِهِمَا صَلاَةَ اَللّيْلِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked (Imam) al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the two rak‘ahs of Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "Insert them into the night prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.132 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.315 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.263

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
رَكْعَتَا اَلْفَجْرٍ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Hasan from Zur‘ah from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked (Imam {a.s}): "Are the two rak‘ahs of Fajr from the night prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.132 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.315 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.264

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ
الْفَجْرٍ أَوْ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ صَلَاَةِ اللَّيْلِ ثَلاثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً صَلاَةُ ٱَللَّيْلِ أَثُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَايِسَ لَوْ
كَانَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَكُنْتَ تَتَطَوَّعُ إِذَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْكَ وَقْتُ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَابْدَأْ بِالْفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the two rak‘ahs of Fajr, are they before the Fajr or after the Fajr?
Imam {a.s} said: "Before the Fajr, for they are from the night prayer. Thirteen rak‘ahs is
the night prayer. Do you want to compare? If there was something due upon you from
the month of Ramadan, would you perform voluntary prayers after the time of the
obligatory prayer has entered? Begin with the obligatory prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.133 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.316 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.264 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.77

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ ٱلْفَجْرِ
قَالَ «تَرْكَعُهُمَا حِينَ تَثْرُكُ الْغَدَاةَ إِنَّهُمَا قَبْلَ الْغَدَاةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Hisham, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the two rak‘ahs before Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "You perform them when you are about to leave off the dawn prayer;
indeed, they are before the dawn prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.133 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.266

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمْرَةَ بْنِ بِيضٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
- عَ: أَمًا مَقْت دَكْوَةَ ٱلْفَنْ فَقَالَ «سُلُكُ الاَّما الْتَاق »
english_text:
And from him, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Muhammad ibn Hamzah ibn Bayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim,
who said:
I asked Abu Ja‘far {a.s} about the beginning time of the two rak‘ahs of Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "The last sixth of the night."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.133 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.316 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.265 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.124

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ
أُصَلِّيهِمَا قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ أَوْ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «أُحْشُ بِهِمَا صَلاَةَ اللِّيْلِ وَ صَلِّهِمَا قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ».
english_text:
Sa‘d from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: "The two rak‘ahs of Fajr, should I
perform them before Fajr or after Fajr?"
He (narrator) said: “Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: "Insert them into the night prayer, and perform
them before Fajr."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.133 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.315 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.265

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ فَقُلْتُ مَتَى أُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «حِينَ يَعْتَرِضُ ٱلْفَجْرُ وَ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي تَسَمِّيهِ الْعَرَبُ الصّدِيعَ».
فأما ما روي من أن وقتهما مع الفجر أو بعد الفجر مثل ما رواه:
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and said: "When should I perform the two
rak‘ahs of Fajr?"
Imam {a.s} said: "When the dawn appears across the horizon, and that is what the Arabs
call 'al-Sadi‘ (the splitter of the night).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
As for what has been narrated that their time is with the Fajr or after the Fajr, such as
what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.133 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.268 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.5 6 p.18

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
«صَلِّ رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ وَ بَعْدَهُ وَ عِنْدَهُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abu Ja‘far {a.s} say: "Perform the two rak‘ahs of Fajr before the Fajr, and after it,
and at its time."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.133 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.318 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.268 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.311 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.154

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي يَغْفُورٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَغْفُورٍ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ - عَنْ رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ مَتَى أُصَلّبهِمَا فَقَالَ «قَبْلَ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَ مَعَهُ وَ بَعْدَهُ».
english_text:
And it has been narrated from Safwan from al-‘Alaa from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, and from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr
from Muhammad ibn Humran from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the two rak‘ahs of Fajr, when should I perform them?
Imam {a.s} said: "Before the Fajr, and with it, and after it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.134 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.318 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.268

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «صَلّهِمَا مَعَ
الْفَجْرِ وَقَبْلَهُ وَ بَعْدَهُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: "Perform them with the Fajr, and before it, and after it."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.134 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.318 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.269

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ ابْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ سَالِمِ ٱلْبَزَّازِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «صَلَّهِمَا بَعْدَ ٱلْفَجْرِ
وَاِقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا فِي الْأُولَى «قُلْ يَا أَيْهَا الكَافِرُونَ» وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ»».
english_text:
And with this chain of transmission, from Ibn Muskan from Ya‘qub ibn Salim al-Bazzaz, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Perform them after the Fajr, and recite in
the first one ‘Surah Al-Kafirun’ and in the second one ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.134 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.317 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.267 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.66

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَكْعَتَيٍ
الْفَجْر قَالَ «صَلَّهِمَا قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ وَ مَعَ الْفَجْرِ وَ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the two rak‘ahs of Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "Perform them before the Fajr, and with the Fajr, and after the Fajr."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.134 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.318 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.268

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «صَلَّهِمَا بَعْدَ
مَا يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ».
فليس بين هذه الاحاديث وبين ما قدمناه قبلها تناقض لان التخيير والامر بالصلاة بعد الفجر ومع الفجر في هذه الاخبار
إنما توجه الى من لم يدرك أن يحشوهما في صلاة الليل ، وليس في شئ منها انه لا يجوز قبل الفجر، بل في كثير منها انه
يصلي قبل وبعد ومع ، ويحتمل أيضا أن يكون المراد بقوله مع الفجر وبعد الفجر الفجر الاول وهو الذي يطلع صعدا دون
أن يكون المراد به الفجر الثانى الذى ينتشر فى افق السماء. والذى يكشف عما ذكرناه ما رواه :
english_text:
And from him, from Safwan and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdur-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Perform them after the Fajr has risen."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
There is no contradiction between these narrations and those that we presented
earlier, because the allowance and the command to perform the prayer after Fajr and
with Fajr in these reports is directed to the one who was not able to include them within
the night prayer. And none of these reports state that it is not permissible to perform
them before Fajr; rather, in many of them, it is stated that one may perform them
before, after, and with it. It is also possible that what is meant by “with Fajr” and “after
Fajr” is the first dawn (al-fajr al-awwal), which rises vertically, and not the second
dawn (al-fajr al-thani), which spreads across the horizon of the sky. What clarifies
what we have mentioned is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.134 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.318 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.267

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, EXPLANATION OF THE FIFTY-ONE RAK‘AHS; THE ORDER, RECITATION, TASBIH IN BOWING AND PROSTRATION, QUNUT, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED THEREIN
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«صَلّ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ أَنْ يَكُونَ الضَّوْءُ حِذَاءَ رَأْسِكَ فَإِنْ كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَابْدَأُ بِالْفَجْرِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from someone who
informed him:
He, peace be upon him, said: "Perform the two rak‘ahs while the light is still between
you and being level with your head. If it is after that, then begin with the Fajr prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
