references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.149 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.350 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.927 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.960 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.315 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.200 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.140

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
فأما ما رواه الحسين بن سعيد عن صفوان عن منصور عن أبي بصير عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : إذا
يقن الرجل أنه ترك ركعة من الصلاة وقد سجد سجدتين وترك الركوع استأنف الصلاة.
فالوجه في هذا الخبر ان نحمله على صلاة لا يجوز فيها السهو مثل الغداة والمغرب وما اشبههما، أو على الركعتين الاولتين
من الرباعيات لئلا تتنافى الاخبار، ويحتمل أن يكون أراد بقوله استأنف الصلاة يعني الركعة التي فاتته ، وليس في الخبر
أنه يستأنف الصلاة من اولها، والذي يكشف عما ذكرناه :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan from Mansur from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "If a man is certain that he left out a rak’ah from the prayer, and
he had already performed two prostrations but omitted the bowing, then he must
begin the prayer anew."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The interpretation of this report is that it should be understood as referring to prayers
in which forgetfulness is not excused, such as the Fajr (dawn) and Maghrib (sunset)
prayers, and the like, or to the first two rak’ahs of the four-unit (ruba’iyyah) prayers, so
that the various narrations do not contradict one another.
It is also possible that what is meant by his saying ‘he must begin the prayer anew’ is
that he must begin the rak’ah that he missed, and the report does not state that he
must begin the entire prayer from the start. And what clarifies what we have mentioned
is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ حَكَمِ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَنْسَى مِنْ صَلاتِهِ رَكْعَةً أَوْ سَجْدَةً أَوْ شَيْئاً مِنْهَا ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «يَقْضِي
ذَلِكَ بِعَيْنِهِ» فَقُلْتُ أَ يُعِيدُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ «لا».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : (فان شك في الركوع وهو قائم ركع ، وان كان قد دخل في حالة اخرى من السجود وغيره مضى
الانه انا كلف الكمت الاوات
english_text:
What was narrated by Sa’d from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman
from Hakam ibn Hukaym, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who forgets a rak’ah, or a prostration, or
something from his prayer, and then remembers afterward.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him make up exactly that which he missed."
So I asked: "Should he repeat the entire prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "If one doubts whether he
performed the bowing while he is still standing, then let him bow. But if he has already
entered another position, such as prostration or otherwise, then let him continue with
his prayer and there is nothing upon him."
This also applies if he is in the last two rak’ahs (of a four-unit prayer), because if the
doubt occurs in the first two rak’ahs, he must restart the prayer, as he has not
completed their number with certainty, and there is a saying that any forgetfulness
that occurs in the first two rak’ahs obligates repeating the prayer.
What supports the first category (that he continues if the doubt occurs in the last two)
from what has preceded is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.150 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.357 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.927 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.314 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.200 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.264

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يَشُكْ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فَلاَ يَدْرِي أَرَكَعَ
أَمْ لاَ قَالَ «فَلْيَرْكَعْ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Hammad from ‘Imran al-Halabi, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: "A man doubts while he is standing and does not know whether he
has bowed or not."
Imam {a.s} said: "Then let him bow."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.150 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.357 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.948 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.315 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.160

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فَلَاَ يَدْرِي أَرَكَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ «يَرْكَعُ وَ يَسْجُدُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan, and Fadalah from Husayn from Ibn Muskan
from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who doubts while he is standing and does not
know whether he has bowed or not.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him bow and prostrate."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.348 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.150 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.357 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.947 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.316

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text: فَضَالَةُ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ : فِي الرَّجُلِ لا يَدْرِي أَرَكَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ «يَزْكَعُ)».
english_text:
Fadalah from Husayn from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir and al-Halabi:
(Imam {a.s} was asked) concerning a man who does not know whether he has bowed or
not.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him bow."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.150 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.357 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.948 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.316

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
أَسْتَتِمُ قَائِماً فَلاَ أَدْرِي رَكَعْتُ أَمْ لا قَالَ «بَلَى قَدْ رَكَعْتَ فَامْضٍ فِي صَلاَتِكَ فَإِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ».
فليس بمناف لما ذكرناه لانه إنما أراد عليه السلام إذا استتم قائما من الركعة الرابعة فلا يدري أركع في الثالثة أم لا فحينئذ
يجب عليه المضي في صلاته لانه صار من القسم الثاني الذي قدمناه ، وهو انه إذا شك في الركوع وقد دخل في حالة
اخرى يمضي في صلاته، ويؤكد ما ذكرنا :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Aban from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "I complete my standing but do not know whether I have
bowed or not."
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, you have bowed, so continue with your prayer, for that is only from
Shaytan."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
This is not in contradiction to what we have previously mentioned, because what He
{a.s}, peace be upon him, intended was the case where a person has completed
standing in the fourth rak’ah and does not know whether he bowed in the third or not,
then, in such a situation, he must continue with his prayer. This falls under the second
category we previously explained, namely: if one doubts about the bowing after having
entered into another position, he continues with his prayer.
What confirms what we have said is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.151 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.357 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.951 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.317 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.160

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ أَشُكْ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدٌ
فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَرَكَعْتُ أَمْ لاَ قَالَ «إِمْضٍ».
english_text:
What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "I am in prostration and I doubt, did I bow or not?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Continue (with your prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.151 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.151 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.358 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.358 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.950 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.317

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وعنه عن صفوان عن حماد بن عثمان قال قلت لابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : أشك وانا ساجد فلا أدري ركعت أم
لافقال: قد ركعت امضه.
english_text:
And from him, from Safwan from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "I experience doubt while I am in prostration, and I do not
know whether I have performed the rak‘ah or not."
Imam {a.s} said: "You have performed the rak‘ah, continue on."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ بَعْدَ مَا سَجَدَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ «يَمْضِي فِي صَلاتِهِ».
english_text:
Sa’d from Abu Ja’far from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from al-’Alaʾ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn
Muslim from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who, after prostrating, doubts whether he had bowed.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him continue with his prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.151 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.358 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.950 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.318

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ أَهْوَى إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَرَكَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ «قَدْ رَكَعَ».
قال الشيخ رحمه الله : (وإن ترك سجدتين من ركعة واحدة اعاد على كل حال ، فان نسي واحدة منهما ثم ذكرها في الركعة
الثانية قا الكم أسا نفسه مسحدهاثه قاه فاستأنف القداءة أمالت
english_text:
Him from Abu Ja’far from Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "A man moves down toward prostration and does not know
whether he bowed or not."
Imam {a.s} said: "He has bowed."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said:
"And if someone omits two prostrations from one rak’ah, he must repeat (the prayer)
in all cases. But if he forgets one of them and then remembers it in the second rak’ah
before bowing, he should lower himself, perform that prostration, then stand up and
resume the recitation, or the glorification (tasbih) if he is in the last two rak’ahs, as we
have previously explained. And if he does not remember it until after bowing in the
second rak’ah, then he must make it up after the salam and perform two prostrations
of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw)."
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.151 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.951 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.318 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.159

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا تُعَادُ الصَّلاَةُ إِلاّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ الطَّهُورِ وَ الْوَقْتِ وَ الْقِبْلَةِ وَ الرُّكُوعِ
وَ السُّجُودِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «ٱلْقِرَاءَةُ سُنَّةٌ وَ التَّشَهُدُ سُنَّةٌ فَلاَ تَنْقُضُ السُّنَّةُ الْفَرِيضَةَ».
فأما ما يدل على انه إذا سها عن واحدة وذكرها قبل الركوع يجب أن يرسل نفسه ويسجد ما رواه :
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Abu Ja’far {a.s} that Imam {a.s} said:
"Prayer is not repeated except for five things: purification, time, direction of the Qiblah,
bowing, and prostration."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Recitation is Sunnah, and tashahhud is Sunnah, so the Sunnah
does not invalidate the obligation."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
As for what indicates that if one forgets a single prostration and remembers it before
bowing, he must lower himself and perform that prostration, it is what was narrated:
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.339 • Al-Khisal, Vol.1 p.284 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.152 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.44 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.919 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.470 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.91 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.401 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.234 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.136

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّنْ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ سَجْدَةً
وَاجِدَةً فَذَكَرَهَا وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا مَا لَمْ يَرْكَعْ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ رَكَعَ فَلْيَمْضٍ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَ إِذَا
اِنْصَرَفَ قَضَاهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ سَهْوٌ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about someone who forgets to perform one prostration and
remembers it while standing.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him perform the prostration when he remembers it, as long as he
has not yet bowed. But if he has already bowed, then let him continue with his prayer,
and when he finishes, he should make it up, and there is no prostration of
forgetfulness (sajdat al-sahw) upon him."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.152 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.358 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.929 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.365

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَهَا فَلَمْ يَذْرِ سَجْدَةً سَجَدَ أَمِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُ أُخْرَى وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ اِنْقِضَاءِ الصَّلاَةِ
سَجْدَتَا السَّهْوِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-
Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} was asked about a man who was forgetful and did not know whether
he had performed one prostration or two.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him perform another prostration, and after the completion of the
prayer, there is no obligation upon him to perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness
(sajdata al-sahw)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.349 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.152 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.361 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.947 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.368 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.161

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ
أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ فَلَمْ يَدْرٍ سَجَدَ سَجْدَةً أَمْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُ
حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِنَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from
Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who doubts and does not know whether he has
prostrated once or twice.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him prostrate until he is certain."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.349 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.152 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.361 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.947 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.368

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ ٱلْخَزَازِ عَنِ ٱلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحِ عَنْ زَيْدِ ٱلشَّحَامِ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : فِي رَجُلِ شُبِّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ وَاجِدَةً سَجَدَ أَو اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ «فَلْيَسْجُدْ أُخْرَى».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman al-Khazzaz, from al-Mufaddal ibn
Salih, from Zayd al-Shahham:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man over whom it
became unclear, and he did not know whether he had performed one prostration or
two.
Imam {a.s} said: "Then let him perform another prostration."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.349 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.152 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.361 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.948 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.368

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ :
فِي رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ سَجْدَةَ الثَّانِيَةِ حَتَّى قَامَ فَذَكَرَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ قَالَ «فَلْيَسْجُدْ مَا لَمْ يَرْكَعْ فَإِذَا
رَفَعَ فَذَكَرَ بَعْدَ رُكُوعِهِ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ فَلْيَمْضٍ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ حَتَّى يُسَلِّمَ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُهَا فَإِنَّهَا قَضَاءُ» وَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِنْ شَكَّ فِي الرُّكُوعِ بَعْدَ مَا سَجَدَ فَلْيَمْضٍ وَ إِنْ شَكَّ فِي السُّجُودِ بَعْدَ مَا قَامَ فَلْيَمْضٍ كُلُّ
شَيْءٍ شَكَّ فِيهِ مِمَّا قَدْ جَاوَزَهُ وَ دَخَلَ فِي غَيْرِهِ فَلْيَمْضِ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Jabir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who forgot to
perform the second prostration until he stood up, then while standing he remembered
that he had not prostrated.
Imam {a.s} said: "Then let him perform the prostration, as long as he has not yet bowed
(for ruku’). But if he rises and then remembers after his ruku’ that he did not prostrate,
then let him proceed with his prayer until he completes it with the salam, then he
should perform the prostration, for it is a makeup (qadahʾ)."
And he (narrator) said:
“Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If he doubts regarding the ruku’ after
having prostrated, then let him proceed. And if he doubts regarding the prostration
after having stood up, then let him proceed. Everything in which there is doubt, after it
has passed and one has entered into something else, then let him continue with it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.153

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ رَجُلٌ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ فَشَكَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ جَالِساً فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَسَجَدَ أَمْ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ قَالَ
«يَسْجُدُ» قُلْتُ فَرَجُلٌ نَهَضَ مِنْ سُجُودِهِ فَشَكَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ قَائِماً فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَسَجَدَ أَمْ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abdur Rahman
ibn Abi Abdullah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man raised his head from prostration
and doubted before he became fully seated, not knowing whether he had prostrated
or not.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should prostrate."
I asked: “And a man who rose from his prostration and doubted before he became fully
standing, not knowing whether he had prostrated or not.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should prostrate."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.153 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.361 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.950 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.369 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.160

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيّ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكْثُرُ عَلَيْهِ الْوَهْمُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَيَشُكْ فِي الرُّكُوعِ فَلاَ يَدْرِي أَرَكَعَ أَمْ لا وَ
يَشُكْ فِي السَّجُودِ فَلا يَذْرِي أَسَجَدَ أَمْ لا فَقَالَ «لا يَسْجُدُ وَ لا يَرْكَعُ وَ يَمْضِي فِي صَلاَتِهِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِنَ يَقِيناً»
وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى سَجْدَةً فَذَكَرَهَا بَعْدَ مَا قَامَ وَ رَكَعَ قَالَ «يَمْضِي فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَسْجُدُ حَتَّى يُسَلَّمَ فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ
سَجَدَ مِثلَ مَا فَاتَهُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَهُ».
وهذا الحكم في السهو عن السجود إنما هو يخص الركعتين الاخيرتين لان الركعتين الاولتين متى شك فيهما في السجود
اعاد ، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah,
from Ammar al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding the man upon whom frequent doubt occurs in
prayer, so he doubts in the bowing and does not know whether he bowed or not, and
he doubts in the prostration and does not know whether he prostrated or not.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should neither prostrate nor bow, and he should continue in his
prayer until he is certain with certainty."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding the man who forgets a prostration and remembers
it after he has stood and bowed.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should continue in his prayer and not prostrate until he completes
it with the salam. Then when he has given the salam, he should perform a prostration
like that which he missed."
I asked: “What if he does not remember except after that?”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should make up what he missed whenever he remembers it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And this ruling regarding forgetfulness in prostration specifically pertains to the last
two rak‘ahs, because if one doubts in the prostration during the first two rak‘ahs, he
must repeat. This is indicated by what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.153

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي
الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ وَ هُوَ رَاكِعْ أَنَّهُ تَرَكَ سَجْدَةً فِي الْأُولَى قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَقُولُ «إِذَا
تَرَكْتَ السَّجْدَةَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى فَلَمْ تَدْرِ وَاجِدَةً أَو اِثْنَتَيْنِ اِسْتَقْبَلْتَ حَتَّى يَصِحَ لَكَ ثِنْتَانٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ فِي الثَّالِئَةِ
وَ الرَّابِعَةِ فَتَرَكْتَ سَجْدَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ تَكُونَ قَدْ حَفِظْتَ الرُّكُوعَ أَعَدْتَ السُّجُودَ».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر
english_text:
WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who performs two rak‘ahs of
prayer, then remembers in the second rak‘ah while in the state of bowing that he had
left out a prostration in the first.
He (Imam al-Ridha {a.s}) said: “Abul Hasan (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}), used to say:
"If you left out a prostration in the first rak‘ah and did not know whether it was one or
two, then you must start over until two prostrations are certain for you. But if it is in the
third or fourth rak‘ah and you left a prostration after having already preserved the
bowing (ruku‘), then you repeat the prostration."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary: And this report does not contradict.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.154

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُعَلّى بْنِ خُتَيْسِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
الْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي الرَّجْلِ يَنْسَى السَّجْدَةَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ («إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا قَبْلَ رُكُوعِهِ سَجَدَهَا وَ بَنَى عَلَى
صَلاَتِهِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَي السَّهْوِ بَعْدَ اِنْصِرَافِهِ وَ إِنْ ذَكَرَهَا بَعْدَ رُكُوعِهِ أَعَادَ الصَّلاَةَ وَ نِسْيَانُ السِّجْدَةِ فِي الْأَوِّلَتَيْنِ
وَ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ سَوَاء».
فليس هذا الخبر منافيا للخبر الاول لان قوله عليه السلام : ونسيان السجدة في الاولتين والاخيرتين سواء انما أراد به في
ترك السجدتين معا الا ترى أن ما تضمن الخبر إنما تضمن حكم من ترك السجدتين معا لانه قال إذا ذكرها بعد الركوع اعاد
الصلاة فلو لا أن المراد بذكر السجدة الثنتين معا لما وجب اعادة الصلاة حسب ما قدمناه ، والذي رواه:
english_text:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn Isma'il, from a man, from Mu‘alla ibn Khunays:
I asked Abul Hasan al-Madi {a.s} about a man who forgets a prostration in his prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he remembers it before his bowing, he should perform it and
continue with his prayer, then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay
al-sahw) after completing the prayer. But if he remembers it after his bowing, he must
repeat the prayer. Forgetting a prostration in the first two rak‘ahs and the last two
rak‘ahs is the same."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
So this report is not contradictory to the first report, because His {a.s} saying, “And
forgetting the prostration in the first two and the last two (rak‘ahs) is the same,” He {a.s}
only intended by it the case of leaving both prostrations together. Do you not see that
what the report contained was only the ruling of someone who left both prostrations
together? For Imam {a.s} said: “If he remembers it after the bowing, he must repeat the
prayer.” So were it not that what is meant by remembering the prostration is both of
them together, it would not have been obligatory to repeat prayer, as explained:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.154 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.359 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.932 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.366 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.147

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الَّذِي
يَنْسَى السَّجْدَةَ الثَّانِيَةَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ أَوْ شَكَ فِيهَا فَقَالَ «إِذَا خِفْتَ أَنْ لا تَكُونَ وَضَعْتَ وَجْهَكَ إِلا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً
فَإِذَا سَلَّمْتَ سَجَدْتَ سَجْدَةً وَاحِدَةً وَ تَضَعُ وَجْهَكَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ سَهْوٌ».
فليس ايضا بمناف لما ذكرناه لان قوله الذي ينسى السجدة الاخيرة من الركعة الثانية يحتمل أن يكون أراد من الركعة
الثانية من الركعتين الاخيرتين ، وليس في ظاهر الخبر من الركعة الثانية من الاولتين أو الاخيرتين بل هو محتمل لهما
معا، وإذا احتمل ذلك حملناه على الركعة الثانية من الركعتين الاخيرتين، وقد سلمت الاحاديث كلها بحمد اللّٰه ومنه ، فاما
الذى يدل على وجوب سجدتي السهو على من ترك سجدة ولم يذكرها إلا بعد الركوع حسب ما ذكره رحمه اللّٰه :
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Mansur,
who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about one who forgets the second prostration of the second rak‘ah or
doubts about it.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you fear that you may have only placed your face once (in
prostration), then when you finish the prayer with the salam, perform one prostration,
and place your face once. And there is no (obligation of) prostration for forgetfulness
(sahw) upon you."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
So this too is not contradictory to what we have mentioned, because His {a.s}
statement, "the one who forgets the last prostration of the second rak‘ah," may mean
the second rak‘ah of the last two rak‘ahs.
And there is nothing in the apparent wording of the report to indicate whether it refers
to the second rak‘ah of the first two or the last two; rather, it is possible to interpret it
as referring to either. Therefore, since it is open to both possibilities, we interpret it as
referring to the second rak‘ah of the last two rak‘ahs. And thus all the narrations are in
harmony, all praise and bounty be to Allah {SWT}.
As for that which indicates the obligation of performing the two prostrations of
forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) upon one who has left a prostration and did not
remember it until after the bowing, as he (al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him,
has mentioned (following narration):
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.155 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.360 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.930 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.366

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ
السَّمْطِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «تَسْجُدُ سَجَدَتَي السَّهْوِ فِي كُلِّ زِيَادَةٍ تَدْخَلُ عَلَيْكَ أَوْ نُقْصَانٍ وَ مَنْ
تَرَكَ سَجْدَةً فَقَدْ نَقَصَ».
وليس تنقض هذه الرواية التي قدمناها وهي رواية أبي بصير عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام حين ذكر حكم من نسي السجدة
ولم يذكرها إلا بعد الركوع قال : يقضيها بعد الصلاة وليس عليه سهولان قوله عليه السلام وليس عليه سهو إنما أراد أن لا
يكون حكمه حكم السهاة بل يكون حكم القاطعين لانه إذا ذكر ما كان فاته وقضاه لم يبق عليه شئ يشك فيه فخرج عن
حد السهو. فأما ما تضمن رواية الحلبي من انه إذا شك في سجدة أو ثنتين يضيف إليه سجدة وليس عليه سجدتا السهو.
فانه مقصود على من هذا حكمه ، وإنما أوجبنا سجدتي السهو لمن علم بعد الركوع انه ترك سجدة فانه يقضيها بعد التسليم
ويسجد سجدتي السهو.
english_text:
What was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from
Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Sufyan ibn al-Simt:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "You perform the two prostrations of
forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) for every addition or deficiency that occurs to you.
And whoever leaves out a prostration has certainly committed a deficiency."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And this narration does not contradict the report we previously presented, which is the
narration of Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, when he mentioned
the ruling of one who forgot a prostration and did not remember it until after the
bowing.
Imam {a.s} said: "He makes it up after the prayer, and there is no prostration for
forgetfulness upon him."
His saying, peace be upon him, ‘and there is no prostration for forgetfulness upon
him,’ only means that his ruling is not the ruling of those who are forgetful (sahin), but
rather the ruling of those who interrupt the act, because when he remembers what he
missed and makes it up, nothing remains for him to be in doubt about, thus he exits
the state of forgetfulness.
As for what is contained in the narration of al-Halabi, that if one doubts whether it was
one prostration or two, he should add a prostration, and there is no prostration for
forgetfulness upon him, this applies to one for whom this is the ruling.
And we have only made the two prostrations of forgetfulness obligatory upon one who
realizes after the bowing that he left out a prostration, for such a person makes it up
after the taslim and then performs the two prostrations of forgetfulness.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.155 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.992

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنِ إِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا نَسِيّ
الرَّجُلُ سَجْدَةً وَ أَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ تَرَكَهَا فَلْيَسْجُدْهَا بَعْدَ مَا يَقْعُدُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ شَاكًا فَلْيُسَلَّمْ ثُمَّ لَيَسْجُدْهَا وَ
لَيَتَشَهَدْ تَشَهُداً خَفِيفاً وَ لا يُسَمِّيهَا نَقْرَةً فَإِنَّ النَّقْرَةَ نَقْرَةُ ٱلْغُرَابِ».
ومن سجد بعد ما شك ثم ذكر انه كان قد سجد السجدتين مضى في صلاته ، والركوع متى ركع ثم ذكر انه كان قد ركع
قبل ذلك استأنف الصلاة ، روى ذلك :
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets a prostration and is certain
that he has left it out, then let him perform it after he sits, before he gives the salam.
And if he is in doubt, then let him give the salam and then perform the prostration, and
let him recite a light tashahhud, and let him not call it a 'pecking,' for the 'pecking' is
the pecking of a crow."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And whoever prostrates after having doubted, and then remembers that he had indeed
performed both prostrations, he continues with his prayer. But as for the bowing
(ruku‘), whenever one bows and then remembers that he had already bowed before
that, he must begin the prayer anew. This was narrated by:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.156 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.360 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.930 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.370

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأْلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلِ صَلَّى فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ سَجَدَةً قَالَ «لا يُعِيدُ صَلاَةً مِنْ سَجْدَةٍ وَ يُعِيدُهَا مِنْ رَكْعَةٍ».
english_text:
Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja‘far, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Mansur ibn Hazim,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who prayed and then remembered that he had added an
extra prostration.
Imam {a.s} said: "He does not repeat the prayer because of a (mistaken) prostration, but
he does repeat it because of a (mistaken) rak‘ah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.346 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.156 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.933 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.319 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.162

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ
زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلِ شَكّ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَ سَجَدَ ثِنْتَيْنِ أَمْ وَاحِدَةً فَسَجَدَ أُخْرَى ثُمَّ
اِسْتَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ زَادَ سَجْدَةً فَقَالَ «لا وَ اللَّهِ لا تُفْسِدُ الصَلاَةَ زِيَادَةُ سَجْدَةٍ» وَ قَالَ «لا يُعِيدُ صَلاَتَهُ مِنْ سَجْدَةٍ وَ
بُعيدُها مِنْ رَكَعَةٍ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : (فان ترك التسبيح في الركوع والسجود ناسيا لم يكن عليه اعادة الصلاة). يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Sa‘d, from Abu Ja‘far, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan
ibn Muslim, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who doubted and did not
know whether he had prostrated twice or once, so he performed another prostration,
and then became certain that he had added a prostration.
Imam {a.s} said: "No, by Allah {SWT}, an extra prostration does not invalidate the prayer."
And Imam {a.s} said: "He does not repeat his prayer because of a prostration, but he
does repeat it because of a rak‘ah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘If one forgets the tasbih in
bowing and prostration, there is no obligation to repeat the prayer.’
This is supported by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.156 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.933 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.319 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.162

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ سُئِلَ - عَنْ رَجْلٍ رَكَعَ وَ لَمْ يُسَبِّحْ نَاسِياً قَالَ «تَمَّثْ صَلاَتُهُ» ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah al-Qaddah, from Ja‘far, from
his father (Imam al Sadiq {a.s}), peace be upon them:
(Imam al Sadiq {a.s} said): “(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, was asked about a man
who bowed but did not recite the tasbih due to forgetfulness.
He (Imam Ali {a.s}) said: "His prayer is complete."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.157 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.157 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.928 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.320

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وعنه عن عبد اللّٰه القداح عن جعفر عن أبيه عليه السلام ان عليا عليه السلام سئل عن رجل ركع ولم يسبح
ناسيا قال : تمت صلاته.
english_text:
And from him, from Abdullah al-Qaddah, from Ja‘far, from his father (Imam al Sadiq {a.s}), peace be upon
him):
(Imam al Sadiq {a.s} said): “(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, was asked about a man
who bowed but did not recite the tasbih due to forgetfulness.
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ تَسْبِيحَةً فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَ
سُجُودِهِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ».
فأما الذي يدل على أنه إذا تركه متعمدا فلا صلاة له ما رواه :
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot the tasbih
in his bowing and prostration.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in that."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
As for that which indicates that if one deliberately leaves it out, then his prayer is
invalid, it is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.157 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.928 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.320

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ ٱلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي
بَكْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيّ قَالَ قَالَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «تَدْرِي أَيّ شَيء حَدُ الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُجُودِ» فَقُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ «سَبِّحْ
فِي الرُّكُوعِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَ فِي السُّجُودِ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى وَ بِحَمْدِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ
فَمَنْ نَقَصَ وَاحِدَةً نَقَصَ ثُلُثَ صَلاَتِهِ وَ مَنْ نَقَصَ ثِنْتَيْنِ نَقَصَ ثُلْثَيْ صَلاَتِهِ وَ مَنْ لاَ يُسَبَّحْ فَلاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (فان ترك التشهد ناسيا قضاه ولم يعد الصلاة).
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam,
from Uthman ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: "Do you know what defines the bowing and the prostration?"
I (al-Hadrami) said: “No.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Say in the bowing three times: ‘Subhana rabbiyal-‘azim wa bihamdih’,
and in the prostration: ‘Subhana rabbiyal-a‘la wa bihamdih’ three times. Whoever
leaves out one (recitation) has left out one-third of his prayer, and whoever leaves out
two has left out two-thirds of his prayer, and whoever does not recite the tasbih at all,
he has no prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘If one forgets the tashahhud,
he makes it up and does not repeat the prayer.’
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.329 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.157 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.707 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.301

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ -
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ لا يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَهُمَا حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فِي الثَّالِئَةِ قَالَ «فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ ثُمَّ لَيُسَلَّمْ وَ
يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَي السَّهْوِ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-‘Ala’, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who performs the two
rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer but does not sit between them until he bows in the
third (rak‘ah).
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the two
prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.157 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.158 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.159 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.362 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.363 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.940 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.402

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَفْرُغُ مِنْ
صَلَاَتِهِ وَ قَدْ نَسِيَ التَشَهُدَ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ فَقَالَ «إنْ كَانَ قَرِيباً رَجَعَ إِلَى مَكَانِهِ فَتَشَهَدَ وَ إِلاَّ طَلَبَ مَكَاناً نَظِيفاً
فَتَشَهَدَ فِيهِ» وَ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا النَّشَهُدُ سُنَّةً فِي الصَّلاَةِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah and Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two (Imams
{a.s}), peace be upon them:
(Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding a man who finishes his prayer and has forgotten the
tashahhud until he departs.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he is near (to the place of prayer), let him return to his place and
recite the tashahhud; otherwise, let him find a clean place and recite the tashahhud
there."
And Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, the tashahhud is a sunnah (recommended act) within the
prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.157 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.940 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.401 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.152

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلِ
نَسِيَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ ذَكَرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ فَلْيَجْلِس وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَلْيُتِمَّ
الصَّلَاَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ فَلْيُسَلَّمْ وَ لَيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَي السَّهُوِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who forgot to sit after the
first two rak‘ahs.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he remembers before he bows, let him sit; but if he does not
remember until after he bows, then let him complete the prayer, and when he finishes,
let him give the salam and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-
sahw)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.158 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.362 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.941 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.402

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ [الْحُسَيْنِ خ ل] بَنِ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَن الرَّجُل يُصَلِّي رَكْعَنَي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فَلا يَجْلِسُ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ قَالَ «يُتِمُّ صَلاَتَهُ وَ يَسْجُدُ سَجَدَتَي السَّهُوِ
وَ هُوَ جَالِسْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-‘Ala’, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who performs the two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer but
does not sit until he bows in the third (rak‘ah).
Imam {a.s} said: "He should complete his prayer and perform the two prostrations of
forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.158

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وعنه عن فضالة عن العلا عن ابن أبي يعفور قال سألت أبا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : عن الرجل يصلي الركعتين
من المكتوبة فلا يجلس فيهما حتى يركع فقال : يتم صلاته ثم يسلم ويسجد سجدتي السهو وهو جالس قبل
أن يتكلم.
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who performs the two
rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer and does not sit in them until he bows (in the third
rak‘ah).
Imam {a.s} said: "He should complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the
two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he
speaks."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَتَشَهَدَ قَالَ
«يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيْنِ يَتَشَهَدُ فِيهِمَا».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Sama‘ah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who forgets to recite the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform two prostrations (sajdatay al-sahw) in which he
recites the tashahhud."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.158 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.941 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.403

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ
مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيَّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْهُو فِي الصَّلاةِ فَيَنْسَى التَّشَهْدَ فَقَالَ
«يَرْجِعُ فَيَتَشَهَدُ» قُلْتُ أَيَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَي السّهْوِ فَقَالَ «لا لَيْسَ فِي هَذَا سَجْدَنَا السَّهْوِ».
فأما متى لم يذكر إلا بعد الركوع فانه يلزمه سجدتا السهو حسب ما ذكرناه، ويؤيده أيضا وضوحا ما رواه:
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Sa‘d, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad
ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who errs in prayer and
forgets the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should return and recite the tashahhud."
I asked: “Should he perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, there are no prostrations of forgetfulness in this case."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And as for when he does not remember until after the bowing, then the two
prostrations of forgetfulness become obligatory for him, according to what we have
mentioned, and this is also clearly supported by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.158 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.363 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.942 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.406

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الحسين بن سعيد عن صفوان بن يحيى عن الحسين بن أبي العلا قال سألت أبا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : عن الرجل
يصلي ركعتين من المكتوبة فلا يجلس حتى يركع الثالثة فقال : يتم صلاته ثم يسلم ويسجد سجدتي السهو
وهو جالس قبل أن يتكلم.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-‘Ala, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who performs two rak‘ahs
of the obligatory prayer and does not sit until he bows in the third (rak‘ah).
Imam {a.s} said: "He should complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the
two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he
speaks."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثِمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَغْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمَكْثُوبَةِ فَلَاَ يَجْلِسُ فِيهِمَا فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ
فِي الثَّالِثَةٍ فَلْيَجْلِس وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ».
english_text:
Sa'd, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn
Abi Ya‘fur, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who performs two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer and
does not sit in them.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he remembers while he is standing in the third (rak‘ah), let him sit.
But if he does not remember until he bows, then let him complete his prayer, and then
perform two prostrations (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.351 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.159 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.941

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مِنْ تَمَامِ الصِّوْمِ إِعْطَاءُ الزَّكَاةِ
كَالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلِّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنْ تَمَامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَ مَنْ صَامَ وَ لَمْ يُؤْدِّهَا فَلاَ صَوْمَ لَهُ إِذَا تَرَكَهَا مُتَعَمَّداً وَ
مَنْ صَلَّى وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ تَرَكَ ذَلِكَ مُتَعَمَّداً فَلَاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بَدَأْ بِهَا قَبْلَ
الصَّلاةٍ فَقَالَ «قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّى وَ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلّى»».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (والسلام في الصلاة سنة وليس بفرض يفسد بتركه الصلاة). يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Basir, from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Part of the completion of fasting is the
giving of zakat, just as sending blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, is part of the completion of prayer. And whoever fasts but does not give
it (zakat), his fast is not accepted if he deliberately leaves it. And whoever prays but
does not send blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
and deliberately leaves that out, then he has no prayer. Indeed, Allah {SWT} the Exalted
began with it before the prayer, as He {SWT} said: ‘Indeed successful is the one who
purifies himself, and remembers the name of his Lord and then prays.’" (Surah A'la
87:14 -15)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And the salam in prayer is a
sunnah and not an obligation whose omission invalidates the prayer.’
This is supported by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.159 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.108 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.343 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.358 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.769 • Al-Wafi, Vol.10 p.273 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.407 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.637

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا نَسِيَ الرَّجُلُ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ فَإِذَا وَلَى وَجْهَهُ عَنِ ٱلْقِبْلَةِ وَ قَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اللّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ فَقَدْ فَرَغَ
مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Sama‘ah, from
Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “If a man forgets to say the salam, then
when he turns his face away from the qiblah and says ‘al-salamu ‘alayna wa ‘ala
‘ibadillah al-salihin’, he has completed his prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.159 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.945 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.423

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا نَسِيَ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ
خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ أَجْزَأَهُ تَسْلِيمُ الْإِمَامِ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (والتوجه بسبع تكبيرات) الى قوله : (والقنوت سنة مؤكدة) .فقد مضى شرح جميع ذلك مستوفى
١٠٧١ ٥٠ ٢٠
فما تقدم قال الشيخ حمهالله . (والقنوت سنة مكيدة لا ينفتكه مع الاختار ومن نسه فله يفعله قا الكوء
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If one forgets to say the salam behind the
imam, the salam of the imam suffices for him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And the ‘tawajjuh’ with seven
takbirat…’ up to his statement: ‘And the ‘qunut’ is a strongly emphasized sunnah.’
Indeed, a complete explanation of all that has already been provided earlier.
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘The ‘qunut’ is a strongly
emphasized sunnah that should not be abandoned when one has the choice. And
whoever forgets it and does not perform it before bowing should make it up after the
bowing. If he does not remember it until he bows in the third rak‘ah, then he should
make it up after finishing the prayer.’
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.160 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.945 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.424

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنْ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ وَ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ قَالاَ: سَأَلْنَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَنْسَى الْقُنُوتَ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ قَالَ «يَقْنُتُ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Zurarah ibn
A‘yan, who said:
We asked Abu Ja‘far {a.s} about a man who forgets the ‘qunut’ until he bows.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform the ‘qunut’ after the bowing, and if he does not
remember, then there is nothing upon him."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.160 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.935 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.287

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ - عَنِ ٱلْقُنُوتِ يَنْسَاهُ الرَّجُلُ
فَقَالَ «يَقْنُتُ بَعْدَ مَا يَرْكَعُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَنَّى يَنْصَرِفَ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the ‘qunut’, if a man forgets it.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform the ‘qunut’ after he bows, and if he does not
remember until after he finishes the prayer, then there is nothing upon him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.160 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.935 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.288

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
الرَّجُلُ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقْنُتْ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ قَالَ فَقَالَ «يَقْنُتُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man remembers that he did not
perform the ‘qunut’ until after he bowed.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Then he should perform the ‘qunut’ when he raises his head."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.160 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.936 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.288

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ ٱلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ يُذْكَرُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ قَالَ
«فِي اَلرَّجْلِ إِذَا سَهَا فِي الْقُنُوتِ قَنَتَ بَعْدَ مَا يَنْصَرِفُ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Basir, who said:
I heard it mentioned in the presence of Abu Abdillah {a.s}.
Imam {a.s} said: "Regarding a man who forgets the ‘qunut’, he should perform the
‘qunut’ after he finishes (the prayer), while he is seated."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.160 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.345 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.936

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ يَسَعَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sahl ibn Yasa‘, from his
father, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who forgets the ‘qunut’ in the
obligatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no redoing (the prayer) upon him."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.161

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرِّجُلِ يَنْسَى الْقُنُوتَ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ أ
يَقْنُتُ قَالَ «لا».
فيجوز أن يكون عليه السلام إنما أراد لا إعادة عليه وجوبا لان القنوت أصله ليس بواجب فكيف يكون إعادته واجبا ، وإنما
هو مستحب مسنون فكذلك قضاؤه إنما يكون مسنونا مندوبا دون أن يكون واجبا ويجوز أن يكون عليه السلام إنما أراد لا
إعادة عليه إذا كانت الحال حال التقية الذي يبين هذا ويوضحه ما رواه:
english_text:
WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
And what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who forgets the ‘qunut’ until he bows, should he perform
the ‘qunut’?
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
So it is permissible that what He {a.s}, peace be upon him, meant was that there is no
obligatory redoing upon him, because the ‘qunut’ is originally not obligatory, so how
could its making up be obligatory? Rather, it is a recommended sunnah; thus, making
it up is also a recommended and encouraged act, not an obligation.
And it is also possible that what He {a.s}, peace be upon him, intended was that there is
no redoing upon him in a situation of ‘taqiyyah’ (precautionary dissimulation).
What clarifies and explains this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.161 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.345 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.937 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.288

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْهُ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الْقُنُوتِ فِي الْفَجْرِ إِنْ شِئْتَ
فَاقْنُتْ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَلاَ تَقْنُتْ وَ قَالَ »هُوَ إِذَا كَانَ تَقِيَّةً فَلا تَقْنُتْ وَ أَنَا أَتَقَلَّدُ هَذَا».
وقد استوفينا القنوت وما يتعلق باحكامه فيما مضى مستوفى وفيه غنى ان شاء اللّٰه تعالى. قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : بعد أن
ذكر اشياء قد مضى شرحها وما يتعلق بها مثل دعاء القنوت وتسبيح الزهراء عليها السلام وفضل ذلك والجهر في بعض
الصلوات والاخفات في بعضها (ومن تعمد الاخفات فيما يجب فيه الاجهار والاجهار فيما يجب فيه الاخفات أعاد).
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from him, who said:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said to me regarding the ‘qunut’ in the Fajr prayer:
"If you wish, then perform the ‘qunut’, and if you wish, then do not perform it."
And Imam {a.s} said: "When there is ‘taqiyyah’ (precautionary dissimulation), then do
not perform the ‘qunut’, and I personally adopt this."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
And we have already thoroughly covered the ‘qunut’ and the rulings related to it in
detail previously, and that suffices, if Allah {SWT} willing.
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said after mentioning matters
whose explanation has already been provided, such as the supplication of ‘qunut’, the
‘tasbih’ of (Sayyidah) al-Zahra’ {s.a}, peace be upon her, its merit, the audible recitation
(‘jahr’) in some prayers, and the silent recitation (‘ikhfat’) in others.
Whoever deliberately recites silently where audible recitation is obligatory, or audibly
where silent recitation is obligatory, must repeat (the prayer).
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.161 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.345

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
رَوَى حَرِيزٌ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ جَهَرَ فِيمَا لا يَنْبَغِي الْإِجْهَارُ فِيهِ أَوْ أَخْفَى فِيمَا لا
يَنْبَغِي الْإِخْفَاءُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ «أَيَّ ذَلِكَ فَعَلَ مُتَعَمِّداً فَقَدْ نَقَضَ صَلاَتَهُ وَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْإِعَادَةُ وَ إِنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ نَاسِياً أُوْ سَاهِياً
أَوْ لا يَدْرِي فَلا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ».
english_text:
Hariz narrated from Zurarah:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who recites aloud in
what should not be recited aloud, or recites silently in what should not be recited
silently.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whichever of these he does deliberately, he has invalidated his prayer
and must repeat it. But if he did it forgetfully, out of inattentiveness, or not knowing,
then there is nothing upon him, and his prayer is complete."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.162 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.694 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.86 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.94 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.77 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.234 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.7 p.537

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي مِنَ الْفَرِيضَةِ مَا يُجْهَرُ فِيهِ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لا يَجْهَرَ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ جَهَرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ».
فهذا الخبر موافق للعامة لانهم الذين بخيرون في ذلك، والذي نعمل عليه ما قدمناه. قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : (والامام يجهر
اف صلاة الحممة) ال قمله . لمص فاتته صلاة الليل ) فستنك تلكف الماه ان شاء الله تعال قال الشيخ يحيه الله
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his
brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who is praying one of the obligatory prayers in which the
recitation is normally to be done aloud, is it required of him not to recite aloud?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he wishes, he may recite aloud, and if he wishes, he may refrain from
doing so."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
So this report is in agreement with the view of the general public (‘al-‘ammah’), for they
are the ones who give a choice in this matter, whereas the ruling we act upon is what
we have already presented.
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘The imam recites aloud in the
Friday prayer…’ up to his statement: ‘And whoever misses the night prayer…’, we shall
mention that in its appropriate chapters, Allah {SWT} willing.
WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘Whoever misses the night
prayer should make it up at the beginning of the day; and if he is unable to do that, he
should make it up on the second night before performing it, at the end of the night. And
if he makes it up after the night prayer (‘ishaʾ al-akhirah’) before sleeping, that suffices
for him. Likewise, whoever forgets the recommended day prayers (‘nawafil al-nahar’)
or is too preoccupied to perform them, may make them up at night. And if he misses
making them up at night, he should make them up the next day during the daytime.’
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.237 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.205 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.162 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.694 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.85 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.235 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.7 p.536

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَارِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ : «اِقْضِ مَا فَاتَكَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اَلنَّهَارِ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ مَا فَاتَكَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ بِاللَّيْلِ» قُلْتُ أَقْضِي وَثَرَيْنِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ اِقْضٍ وَثْراً أَبَداً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, by Ali ibn Ibrahim, by his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Make up what you have missed of the day prayer during the day,
and what you have missed of the night prayer during the night."
I said: “Should I make up two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, always make up ‘witr’."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.451 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.162 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.168 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1031 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.276

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ الْجُعِفِيّ قَالَ قَالَ
أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَفْضَلُ قَضَاءِ النَّوَافِلِ قَضَاءُ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ صَلاَةُ ٱلنَّهَارِ بِالنَّهَارِ» قُلْتُ فَيَكُونُ وَثَرَانِ
فِي لَيْلَةٍ قَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ وَ لِمَ تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَوتِرَ وَثْرَيْنِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ «أَحَدُهُمَا قَضَاء».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from
Aban, from Isma’il al-Ju’fi, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s} said: "The best way to make up the recommended prayers (‘nawafil’) is
to make up the night prayer during the night, and the day prayer during the day."
I said: “So there would be two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
I said: “Then why do you command me to perform two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "One of them is a make-up."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.452 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.163 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.163 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1032 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.276 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.124

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text: وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: سُبِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who
said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} was asked about a man who misses a day prayer, when should he
make it up?
Imam {a.s} said: "Whenever he wishes, if he wishes, after Maghrib, and if he wishes, after
‘Ishaʾ."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.452 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.163 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.241

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَلاءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ تَفُوثُهُ صَلاَةُ النَّهَارِ قَالَ «يَقْضِيهَا إِنْ شَاءَ بَعْدَ الْمَعْرِبِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from
al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who misses a day prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He may make it up, if he wishes, after Maghrib, and if he wishes, after
Isha."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.163

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ :
«إِنْ قَوِيتَ فَاقْضٍ صَلاَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ بِاللَيْلِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Shu’ayb, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "If you have the strength, then make up the day prayer during the
night."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.163 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1028 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.277

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ : «إِنْ فَانَكَ شَيْءَ مِنْ تَطَوْعِ النَّهَارِ
وَ اللّيْلِ فَاقْضِهِ عِنْدَ زَوَالِ الشَمْسِ وَ بَعْدَ الظُهرِ عِنْدَ ٱلْعَصْرِ وَ بَعْدَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَ بَعْدَ الْعَتَمَةِ وَ مِنْ آخِرِ السَّحَرِ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Hammad, from Shu’ayb, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "If you miss anything from the recommended prayers of the day
or night, then make it up at the time of the sun’s zenith, after Dhuhr, at ‘Asr, after
Maghrib, after ‘Atamah (‘Ishaʾ), and at the end of the night before dawn (sahar)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.163 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1028 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.277

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وعنه عن الحسن عن فضالة عن أبان عن إسماعيل الجعفي قال قال أبو جعفر عليه السلام : أ
النملفا صلات لللا ملللل مصلاة لللللك تلة لات قل ٧٠ق.١
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Isma‘il al-Ju‘fi, who said:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: "The best way to make up the recommended prayers (‘nawafil’) is
to perform the night prayer during the night and the day prayer during the day."
I said: “Will there be two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
I said: “Then why do you command me to perform two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "One of them is a make-up."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنُهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: «إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ كَانَ إِذَا فَاتَهُ شَيْءُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَضَاهُ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ إِنْ فَاتَهُ شَيْءُ مِنَ ٱلْيَوْمِ قَضَاهُ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَوْ فِي الْجُمْعَةِ
أَوْ فِي الشَّهْرِ وَ كَانَ إِذَا اِجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْأَشيَاءُ قَضَاهَا فِي شَعْبَانَ حَتَّى يَكْمُلَ لَهُ عَمَلُ السَّنَةِ كُلَّهَا كَامِلَةً».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Indeed, (Imam) Ali ibn al-Husayn {a.s}, whenever He {a.s} missed
something from the night (prayers), He {a.s} would make it up during the day.
And if He {a.s} missed something from the day, He {a.s} would make it up the next day, or
on Friday, or within the month. And when many such things accumulated upon Him,
He {a.s} would make them up during Sha’ban, so that the complete year’s deeds would
be complete for him."
source: Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.164 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1029 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.276

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَضَاءِ صَلاةِ ٱَللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ
«اِقْضِهَا فِي وَقْتِهَا الَذِي صَلَّيْتَ فِيهِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ يَكُونُ وَثْرَانٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ قَالَ «لَيْسَ هَوَ وَثْرَانٍ فِي لَيْلَةِ أَحَدُهُمَا لِمَا
فَاتَكَ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s} about making up the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’).
Imam {a.s} said: "Make it up at the same time in which you used to perform it."
I asked: “Will there be two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not considered two ‘witrs’ in one night, one of them is for what you
missed."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.164 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1033 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.277

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنِ إبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ ٱلْعَبْدَ يَقُومُ فَيَقْضِي
النَّافِلَةَ فَيُعَجّبُ الرَّبُ مَلاَئِكَتَهُ مِنْهُ فَيَقُولُ «مَلاَئِكَتِي عَبْدِي يَقْضِي مَا لَمْ أَفْتَرِضْهُ عَلَيْهِ» ».
فأما كيفية القضاء فانه يقضيها على حسب ما فاتته ، والذي يدل على ذلك :
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "Indeed, the servant stands and makes up the ‘nafilah’
(recommended prayer), and the Lord {AZJ} causes His {SWT} angels to marvel at him. He
(AZJ) says: 'My angels, My servant is making up what I {AZJ} did not make obligatory upon
him.'"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Hadith-E-Qudsi
commentary:
As for the manner of making up the missed (prayers), it is to be done in the same form
as it was missed. What indicates this is:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.488 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.164 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1025 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.72 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.75

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيْ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنِ ٱلنَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ - عَنْ قَضَاءِ ٱلْوَثْرِ بَعْدَ الظُهْرِ فَقَالَ «إِقْضِهِ وَثراً أَبَداً كَمَا فَاتَكَ» قُلْتُ وَثْرَانِ
فِي لَيْلَةٍ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ أَلَيْسَ إِنَّمَا أَحَدُهُمَا قَضَاءُ».
english_text:
What was narrated by Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan, from al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, and Fadalah
