from Aban, both from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about making up ‘witr’ after Dhuhr.
Imam {a.s} said: "Make it up as ‘witr’, always, just as you missed it."
I asked: “Two ‘witr’ prayers in one night?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, is not one of them a make-up?"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.453 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.164 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1033 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.273

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ ٱلنَّعْمَانِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ
بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَضَاءِ الْوَثْرِ قَالَ «اقْضِهِ وَثراً أَبَداً».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Ali ibn al-Nu’man, and Muhammad ibn Sinan, and Fadalah from al-
Husayn, all from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding the making up of ‘witr’.
Imam {a.s} said: "Always make it up as ‘witr’."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.164 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.292 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.273

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ
الْوَثْرٍ يَفُوتُ الرَّجُلَ قَالَ «يَقْضِي وَثَراً أَبَداً».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah, from Abu
Ja’far {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about ‘witr’ that a man misses.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should always make it up as ‘witr’."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.165 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1034 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَفُوتُهُ ٱَلْوَثْرُ
قَالَ «يَقْضِيهِ وَثْراً أَبَداً».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, who said:
I asked Aba Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who misses the ‘witr’ prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should always make it up as ‘witr’."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.165 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1034 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ أُصْبِحُ عَنِ ٱلْوَثْرِ إِلَى
اَللِّيْلِ كَيْفَ أَقْضِي قَالَ «مِثلاً بِمِثلٍ».
فأما ما روي من انه يقضيها شفعا إذا قضاه بعد الظهر، مثل ما روى :
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked (Imam {a.s}): “I reach the night without having performed the ‘witr’, how should
I make it up?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Like for like."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
As for what has been narrated that it should be made up as ‘shaf’ (even-numbered)
when it is made up after Dhuhr, such as what was narrated:
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.499 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.165 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1034 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «تَقْضِيهِ مِنَ النَّهَارِ مَا لَمْ تَزُلِ الشَّمْسُ وَثْراً فَإِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَمَثنَى مَثنَى».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from al-
Fudayl, who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s} say: "You make it up during the day as ‘witr’ as long as the sun
has not passed its zenith (before Dhuhr). But once the sun has passed its zenith, then
it is (made up) as pairs, two by two."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.165 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1035 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«الْوَثْرُ ثَلاَثُ رَكَّعَاتٍ إِلَى زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ فَإِذَا زَالَتْ فَأَرْبَعُ رَكَعَاتٍ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn Uthman, from Sama’ah, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "‘Witr’ is (prayed as) three rak’ahs until the sun passes its zenith
(zawal), but once it has passed, then it is (prayed as) four rak’ahs."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.165 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1035 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.275

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ كُرْدَوَيْهِ ٱلْهَمْدَانِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ عَنْ قَضَاءِ ٱلْوَثْرِ
فَقَالَ «مَا كَانَ بَعْدَ ٱلزَّوَالِ فَهُوَ شَفْعٌ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ».
فيحتمل أن يكون المراد بهذه الاحاديث من يريد قضاها جالسا مع تمكنه من القيام لانه والحال هذه ينبغي أن يصلي مكان
كل ركعة ركعتين الذي يبين عما ذكرناه
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Kurdaywayh al-Hamdani, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about making up the ‘witr’ prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whatever is after the sun’s zenith (‘zawal’) is to be prayed as ‘shaf’,
two rak’ahs by two rak’ahs."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
So it is possible that what is meant by these narrations is someone who wishes to
make up the ‘witr’ prayer while sitting, despite having the ability to stand. In such a
case, it is appropriate that he prays two rak’ahs in place of each one.
What clarifies and supports what we have mentioned is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.165 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1035 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.275

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بَحْرٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلِ يَكْسَلُ أَوْ يَضُعُفُ فَيُصَلِّي التَّطَوعَ جَالِساً قَالَ «يُضّعَفُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بِرَكْعَةِ».
english_text:
From al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Abdullah ibn Bahr, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who feels lazy or weak and prays the
recommended (‘nafl’) prayer while sitting.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should double, two rak’ahs in place of one."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.166 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.113 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.493 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.35

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ إِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادِ ٱلصِّيْقَلِ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلَاَمُ
: «إِذَا صَلِّى الرَّجُلُ جَالِساً وَ هُوَ يَسْتَطِيعُ اَلْقِيَامَ فَلْيُضَعَفْ».
والذي يبين ان ذلك إنما يلزم من هذه صفته ما رواه:
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Hasan ibn Ziyad al-Sayqal, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said to me: "If a man prays while sitting and he is able to stand, then
let him double (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And what clarifies that this is specifically required of one who is in such a condition is
what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.166 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.293 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.493

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَفُوتُهُ الْوَثْرُ مِنَ اللِّيْلِ قَالَ «يَقْضِيهِ وَثْراً مَتَى مَا ذَكَرَ وَ إِنْ زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ».
فجاء هذا الخبر صريحا بانه يقضيه وترا وإن كان بعد الظهر فلولا ان المراد بتلك الاخبار ما ذكرنا لكانت متناقضة ، ويحتمل
أن تكون هذه الاخبار مختصة بمن يتهاون بالصلاة ويتعمد تركها على الدوام عقوبة له ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from Ali ibn
Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who misses the ‘witr’ prayer
at night.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should make it up as ‘witr’ whenever he remembers, even if the sun
has passed its zenith."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
So this report has come explicitly stating that ‘witr’ is to be made up as ‘witr’, even if it
is after Dhuhr. Were it not that the intended meaning of those other reports is as we
have explained, they would be contradictory.
It is also possible that those other reports are specific to the one who is negligent in
prayer and deliberately abandons it regularly, as a form of punishment for him.
What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.166 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1035 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.272

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَاتَكَ وَثرُكَ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ فَمَتَى مَا
قَضَيْتَهُ مِنَ الْغَدِ قَبْلَ الزَّوَالِ قَضَيْتَهُ وَثْراً وَ مَتَى مَا قَضَيْتَهُ لَيْلاً قَضَيْتَهُ وَثْراً وَ مَتَى مَا قَضَيْتَهُ نَهَاراً بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ
اليَوْم قَضَّيْتَهُ شَفْعاً تُضِيفُ إِلَيْهِ أُخْرَى حَتَّى تَكُونَ شَفْعا» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ لِمَ جُعِلَ الشَّفْعَ قَالَ «عُقُوبَةً لِتَضْبِيعِهِ
الْوَثْرَ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : (ولا يقضي نافلة في وقت فريضة) يدل على ذلك :
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
(It was said) "If you miss your ‘witr’ from the night, then whenever you make it up the
next day before the sun’s zenith, you make it up as ‘witr’. And whenever you make it
up at night, you make it up as ‘witr’.
But whenever you make it up during the day after that (after that day), you make it up
as ‘shaf’, you add to it another rak’ah so that it becomes even."
I asked: “Why is it made ‘shaf’?”
Imam {a.s} said: "As a punishment for neglecting the ‘witr’."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘One does not make up a
recommended (‘nafilah’) prayer during the time of an obligatory (‘faridah’) prayer.’
What indicates this is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.166 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1035 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي الْأُولَى ثُمَّ يَتَنَّفَّلُ فَيُدْرِكُهُ وَقْتُ العَضْرِ مِنَ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ مِنْ نَافِلَتِهِ فَيْنِطِئُ بِالْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ
بَقْضِي نَافِلَتَهُ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَصْرِ أَوْ يُوَخِّرُهَا حَتَّى يُصَلَّيَهَا فِي وَقْتٍ آخَرَ قَالَ «يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَ يَقْضِي نَافِلَتَهُ فِي يَوْمِ
آخَرَ».
english_text:
What was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Sa’d ibn Isma’il, from his father Isma’il ibn ‘Isa,
who said:
I asked (Imam) al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who prays the Dhuhr
prayer, then begins his ‘nafilah’, and the time for ‘Asr comes upon him before he
finishes his ‘nafilah’. So he delays the ‘Asr prayer and then makes up his ‘nafilah’ after
‘Asr, or delays the ‘nafilah’ until he performs it in another time.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform the ‘Asr prayer and make up his ‘nafilah’ on another
day."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.167 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.275 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.291 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.359 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.244

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ ٱلْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتْ
صَلاَةٍ مَفْرُوضَةٍ فَلاَ تَطَوُّعَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah, from Abi Bakr:
(Imam) Ja’far ibn Muhammad {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When the time of an
obligatory prayer enters, there is no (valid) supererogatory (‘tatawwu’) prayer (to be
performed)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.167 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.340 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.292 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.228

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الطَّاطَرِيّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ عَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قَالَ لِي
رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مَا لِي لاَ أَرَاكَ تَطَوَّعُ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ كَمَا يَصْنَعُ النَّاسُ» قَالَ «فَقُلْتُ إِنَّا إِذَا
أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَتَطَوْعَ كَانَ تَطَوْعُنَا فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَإِذَا دَخَلَتِ الْفَرِيضَةُ فَلاَ تَطَوْعَ».
english_text:
Al-Tatari, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from al-’Alaʾ ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
(Imam) Abu Ja’far {a.s} said: “A man from the people of Madinah said to me, ‘O Aba
Ja’far, why do I not see you performing supererogatory (‘tatawwu’) prayers between
the adhan and the iqamah as the people do?’”
He (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) said: "So I replied, 'When we want to perform supererogatory
prayers, we do so outside the time of the obligatory prayer. Once the time of the
obligatory prayer enters, there is no supererogatory prayer (to be performed).'"
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.167 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.247 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.252 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.227

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ نَجِيَّةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ تُذْرِكُنِي الصَّلاَةُ
أَوْ يَدْخُلُ وَقْتُهَا فَأَبْدَأُ بِالنَّافِلَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «لا وَ لَكِنْ إِبْدَأُ بِالْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ إِقْضِ النَّافِلَةَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Miskin, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, from Najiyyah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}: "The time of the prayer reaches me or enters while I have not yet
prayed, should I begin with the ‘nafilah’ (supererogatory prayer)?"
Abu Ja’far {a.s} said: "No. Rather, begin with the obligatory prayer (‘al-maktubah’), and
make up the ‘nafilah’ afterward."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.167 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.227

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أُدَيْمِ بْنِ ٱلْحُرّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «لا
يَتَنَفَّلُ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ فَرِيضَةِ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ «إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ فَرِيضَةٍ فَابْدَأْ بِهَا».
قال الشيخ رحمه الله : (والمسافر إذا خاف أن يغلبه النوم لما لحقه من التعب فلا يقوم في آخر الليل فليقدم صلاة ليلته
أملما بص المشاء الآخرة) القوله.لم ضو ا ا
بالقائما)
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Udim ibn al-Hurr, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "A man should not perform supererogatory (‘nafilah’)
prayer once the time of an obligatory (‘faridah’) prayer has entered."
And Imam {a.s} said: "When the time of an obligatory prayer enters, begin with it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And the traveler, if he fears
that sleep will overcome him due to the exhaustion he has experienced and he will not
be able to rise at the end of the night, then let him perform the prayer of his night (‘salat
al-layl’) at its beginning, after the Isha prayer…’, up to his statement: ‘And whoever is
too weak to perform the night prayer standing…’
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.167 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.228

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ - عَنْ
صَلَآةٍ اللَّيْلِ وَ الْوَثْرِ فِي أَوّلِ اللَّيْلِ فِي السَّفَرِ إِذَا تَخَوَّفْتُ الْبَرْدَ أَوْ كَانَثْ عِلَةً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ أَنَا أَفْعَلُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about performing the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) and ‘witr’ at
the beginning of the night while traveling, if I fear the cold or there is an illness.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm, I do it myself."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.441 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.228 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.331 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.251

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الطَّاطَرِيُّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَخَافُ الْجَنَابَةَ فِي السَّفَرِ أَوِ
الْبَرْدَ أَيُعَجّلُ صَلَاةَ اللَّيْلِ وَ الْوَثْرِ فِي أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Al-Tatari, from Ali ibn Ribat, from Ya’qub ibn Salim, from Abdullah, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who fears becoming in a state of janabah during travel, or
fears the cold, should he hasten to perform the night prayer and ‘witr’ at the beginning
of the night?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.478 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.331 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.252

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ أُصَلَّيهَا
أَوّلَ اللَّيْلٍ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إنَّي لَأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا أَعْجَلَنِي الْجَمَالُ صَلِّيْثُهَا فِي الْمَحْمِلِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Humran, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the night prayer, may I perform it at the beginning of the night?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, I do that myself. When the camel driver hastens me, I perform it
in the howdah (riding carriage)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.252

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «إِذَا خَشِيتَ أَنْ
لاَ تَقُومَ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ كَانَتْ بِكَ عِلْةُ أَوْ أَصَابَكَ بَرْدٌ فَصَلَ صَلاَتَكَ وَ أَوْتِرْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Shu’ayb, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "If you fear that you will not be able to rise at the end of the night,
or if you have an illness, or are afflicted by cold, then perform your prayer and your
‘witr’ at the beginning of the night."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.252

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
صَفْوَانُ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ لَيْثِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ - عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي الصِّيْفِ فِي اللِّيَالِي الْقِصَارِ
أُصَلِّي فِي أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Layth, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about prayer during the summer, in the short nights, may I pray
at the beginning of the night?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.333

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْأَحْمَرِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ فِي أَوْلِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ «نِعْمَ مَا رَأَيْتَ وَ نِعْمَ
مَا صَنَعْتَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّابَ يُكْثِرُ النَّوْمَ فَأَنَا آمُرُكَ بِهِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Muskan, from Ya’qub al-Ahmar, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about performing the night prayer at the beginning of the night.
Imam {a.s} said: "Excellent is what you have seen, and excellent is what you have done."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, the youth sleeps a lot, so I command you to do this."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سَعِيدِ قَالَ: سَألْتُ أُبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةٍ
اللَّيْلِ وَ الْوَثْرِ فِي السِّفَرِ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللِّيْلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فِي آخِرِهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ومن ضعف عن الصلاة قائما فليصلها جالسا) الى قوله : (ويجوز للعليل).
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Ali ibn Sa’id, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about performing the night prayer and ‘witr’ during travel at
the beginning of the night if one is unable to pray at its end.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And whoever is too weak to
perform the prayer standing, let him pray it sitting…’ up to his statement: ‘And it is
permissible for the sick person…’
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.169 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.333

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَمَّنْ حَدَّتَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «يُصَلِّي
الْمَرِيض قَاعِداً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ صَلَّى مُسْتَلْقِياً يُكَبَّرُ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ الرُّكُوعَ غَمَّضَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُسَبَّحُ ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ عَيْنَيْهِ
فَيَكُونُ فَتْحُ عَيْنَيْهِ رَفْعَ رَأْسِهِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ غَمَّضَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُسَبَّحُ فَإِذَا سَبَّحَ فَتَحَ عَيْنَيْهِ فَيَكُونُ
فَتْحُ عَيْنَيْهِ رَفْعَ رَأْسِهِ مِنَ السُّجُودِ ثُمَّ يَتَشَهَّدُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from someone who narrated
to him:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "The sick person should pray while sitting, and if he is unable, he
should pray lying on his back. He should pronounce the ‘takbir’, then recite. When he
wants to perform ‘ruku’, he should close his eyes, then say the ‘tasbih’; then he opens
his eyes, and the opening of his eyes will count as raising his head from ‘ruku’. When
he wants to prostrate, he closes his eyes, then recites the ‘tasbih’, and when he has
done so, he opens his eyes, the opening of his eyes will count as raising his head from
‘sujud’. Then he recites the ‘tashahhud’ and concludes the prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.169 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1039

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ
«آلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ قِياماً وَقُعُوداً» قَالَ «الصَّجِيحُ يُصَلِّي قَائِمًا وَقُعُودا الْمَرِيضُ يُصَلِّي جَالِساً »وَ عَلىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ»
أَلَّذِي يَكُونُ أَضْعَفَ مِنَ الْمَرِيضِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي جَالِساً».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Hamzah:
Abu Ja’far {a.s} (was asked) regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic:
‘Those who remember Allah {SWT} standing, and sitting’ (Surah Al ‘Imran 3:191).
Imam {a.s} said: "The healthy one prays standing, and sitting refers to the sick person
who prays while seated. ‘And on their sides’ refers to the one who is weaker than the
sick person who prays sitting."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.1 p.211 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.411 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.169 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.176 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1040 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.1 p.408 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.481 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.726 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.729 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.6 6 p.349

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ عَنِ إِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ مَا حَدُ ٱلْمَرِيضِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي
قَاعِداً فَقَالَ »إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُوعَكُ وَ يَحْرَجُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ أُعْلَمُ بِنَفْسِهِ وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا قَوِيَ فَلْيَقُمْ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj:
That he asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “What is the condition of the sick person who should
pray sitting?”
Imam {a.s} said: "A man may feel pain and discomfort, but he knows himself best.
However, when he regains strength, then let him stand."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.410 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.169 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.82 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1040 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.495

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَتَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَتُصَلِّي النَّوَافِلَ وَ أَنْتَ
قَاعِدٌ فَقَالَ «مَا أُصَلَّيهَا إِلاَّ وَ أَنَا قَاعِدٌ مُنْذُ حَمَلْتُ هَذَا اللَّخْمَ وَ بَلَغْتُ هَذَا السَنّ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}: “Do you pray the supererogatory prayers while seated?”
Imam {a.s} said: "I have not performed them except while sitting since I carried this flesh
and reached this age."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.410 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.169 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.112 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.491 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 6 p.294 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 9 p.223

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ آللّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يُصَلِّي وَ هُوَ قَاعِدٌ فَيَقْرَأ السُورَةَ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْتِمَهَا قَامَ فَرَكَعَ بِآخِرِهَا
قَالَ «صَلاّتُهُ صَلاَةُ ٱَلْقَائِمِ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn ‘Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from
Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man prays while sitting and recites a surah, then when he wishes
to conclude it, he stands and bows (‘rak’ah’) at its end.”
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is considered the prayer of one who stands."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.411 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.170 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.112 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.498

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثِمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
يُصَلِّي وَ هَوَ جَالِسٌ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ وَ أَنْتَ جَالِسُ وَ يُكْتَبَ لَكَ بِصَلاَةِ الْقَائِمِ فَاقْرَأْ وَ أَنْتَ جَالِسْ فَإِذَا
كُنْتَ فِي آخِرِ السُّورَةِ فَقُمْ فَأْتِمَّهَا وَ اِرْكَعْ فَتِلْكَ تُحْسَبُ لَكَ بِصَلاَةِ الْقَائِمِ».
وقد بينا ان من صلى النوافل جالسا مع التمكن من القيام يصلي ركعتين بركعة وهو الافضل ، فان جعل ركعة مكان ركعة
الم يكن عليه حرج.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who prays while sitting.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you want to pray while sitting and have it counted for you as the
prayer of one who stands, then recite while sitting. When you reach the end of the
surah, stand up, complete it, and bow. That will be counted for you as the prayer of
one who stands."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
And we have explained that whoever performs the supererogatory prayers (‘nawafil’)
while sitting, despite having the ability to stand, should pray two rak’ahs in place of
one, and this is better. But if he performs one rak’ah in place of one, there is no blame
upon him.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.170 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.112 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.498

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ
سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّا
نَتَحَدَّثُ نَقُولُ مَنْ صَلَّى وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ كَانَتْ صَلاَتُهُ رَكَعَتَيْنِ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَ سَجْدَتَيْنٍ بِسَجْدَةٍ فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ
هُوَ هَكَذَا هِيَ تَامَّةً لَكُمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah,
from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “We commonly say that whoever prays while sitting without an
excuse, his prayer counts as two rak’ahs for one, and two prostrations for one.”
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not like that, it is complete for you."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.410 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.170 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.111 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.492

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَغدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ أَوْ سُئِلَ أَيُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ مُتَرَبِّعاً وَ مَبْسُوطَ الرِّجْلَيْنِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Sa’d, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Mu’awiyah ibn
Maysarah:
That he (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say, or He {a.s} was asked: “Whether a man
may pray while sitting cross-legged (‘mutarabbi’an’) or with his legs stretched out.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.170 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.111

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ بْنِ أَغْيَنَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبِي إِذَا صَلَّى جَالِساً تَرَبَّعَ فَإِذَا رَكَّعَ ثَنَى رِجْلَيْهِ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : (ويجزي للعليل والمستعجل ان يصليا في الركعتين الاولتين من فرايضهما بسورة الحمد وحدها)
فرضة كا ذلك ق
ح4 فلا محه لاعليته ثمقا حمهالله . لمصن فضة فلقضه
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, from Humran ibn
A’yan, from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
(Imam {a.s} said) "My father, when He {a.s} prayed sitting, would sit cross-legged
(‘tarrabba’a’), and when He {a.s} bowed, he would fold his legs."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And it suffices for the sick
person and the one in haste to recite only Surat al-Hamd in the first two rak’ahs of their
obligatory prayers’ up to his statement: ‘And whoever forgets an obligatory prayer’, all
of this has already been explained previously, so there is no need to repeat it.
Then he said, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him: ‘Whoever forgets an obligatory prayer,
let him make it up whenever he remembers it, unless it is at the end time of a second
prayer, in which case making up the missed one would cause him to miss the second;
in that case, he should not delay the second.’
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.171 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.114 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.502

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الطَّاطَرِيّ عَنِ اِبْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ نُعْمَانَ ٱلرَّازِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَاتَهُ شَيْءٌ مِنَ
الصَّلَوَاتِ فَذَكَرَ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا قَالَ «فَلْيُصَلّ جينَ ذَكَرَهُ».
english_text:
Al-Tatari, from Ibn Ziyad, from Hammad, from Nu’man al-Razi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who missed some prayers and then remembered
them at sunrise or at sunset.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him pray as soon as he remembers."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.171 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.354 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.240 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.244

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى بِغَيْرِ طَهُورِ أَوْ نَسِيَ
صَلَوَاتُ لَمْ يُصَلَّهَا أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا قَالَ «يُصَلَّيهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا فِي أَيَّةٍ سَاعَةٍ ذَكَرَهَا لَيْلاً أَوْ نَهَاراً».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Ziyad, from Zurarah and others, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, who said:
He {a.s} was asked about a man who prayed without ‘taharah’ (ritual purity), or who
forgot prayers and did not perform them, or who slept through them.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform them whenever he remembers them, at whatever
hour he remembers, whether night or day."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.171 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.354

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدِ الْمُكَارِي عَنْ أَبِي
بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتُ تُصَلَّيهِنَّ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتِ صَلاَةُ ٱَلْكُسُوفِ وَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى
الْمَيَّتِ وَصَلاَةُ الْإِحْرَامِ وَ الصَّلاَةُ اَلَّتِي تَفُوتُ وَ صَلَاَةُ الطَّوَافِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ إِلَى
اللّيْلِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Yunus, from Hashim ibn Abi
Sa’id al-Makkari, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There are five prayers which you may perform at any time:
the prayer of the eclipse (‘salat al-kusuf’), the funeral prayer (‘salat al-mayyit’), the
prayer of ‘ihram’, a missed prayer that was not performed (‘salat allati tafut’), and the
circumambulation prayer (‘salat al-tawaf’).
All of these may be performed from Fajr until sunrise, and after ‘Asr until night."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.287 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.171 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.353 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.241 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.70

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ وَ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ
صَفَوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتُ لاَ تُثْرَكُ عَلَى
كُلِّ حَالٍ إِذَا طُفْتَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تُحْرِمَ وَ صَلاَةُ الْكُسُوفِ وَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ فَصَلِّ إِذَا ذَكَزْتَ وَ الْجِنَازَةُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isma’il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan and Ahmad ibn Idris, from
Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, all from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "There are five prayers that are never to be abandoned
under any circumstance: when you perform ‘tawaf’ of the House (Ka’bah), when you
intend to enter into ‘ihram’, the prayer of the eclipse (‘salat al-kusuf’), when you forget
a prayer, then pray it when you remember, and the funeral prayer (‘salat al-janazah’)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.287 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.172 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.353 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.241 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.70

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ الظُهْرَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ ٱلْعَصْرِ قَالَ «يَبْدَأُ بِالظُهْرِ وَ كَذَلِكَ الصَّلَوَاتُ تَبْدَأُ بِالَتِي نَسِيتَ إِلَّ أَنْ
تَخَافَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاةِ فَتَبْدَأ بِالَّتِي أَنْتَ فِي وَقْتِهَا ثُمَّ تَقْضِي الَّتِي نَسِيتَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn
Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who forgets the Dhuhr prayer until the time of ‘Asr enters.
Imam {a.s} said: "He begins with Dhuhr, and likewise with the (other) prayers, begin with
the one you forgot, unless you fear that the time of the current prayer will end. In that
case, begin with the one whose time you are in, and then make up the one you forgot."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.292 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.172 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.268 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1012 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.290

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ
سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلِّى بِغَيْرِ طَهُورِ أَوْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً لَمْ يُصَلَّهَا أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ «يَقْضِيهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ
ذَكَرَهَا مِنْ لَيْلِ أَوْ نَهَارٍ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاَةِ وَ لَمْ يُتِمَّ مَا قَدْ فَاتَهُ فَلْيَمْضِ مَا لَمْ يَتَخَوَّف أَنْ يَذْهَبَ وَقْتُ هَذِهِ
الصَّلَاَةِ الْتِي قَدْ حَضَرَتْ وَ هَذِهِ أَحَقُّ بِوَقْتِهَا فَلْيُصَلَّهَا فَإِذَا قَضَاهَا فَلْيُصَلِّ مَا فَانَهُ فِيمَا قَدْ مَضَى وَ لاَ يَتَطَوَّعْ
بِرَكْعَةٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ الْفَرِيضَةَ كُلَّهَا».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah,
from Abu Ja’far {a.s}:
He {a.s} was asked about a man who prayed without ritual purification (‘tahur’), or forgot
a prayer and did not perform it, or slept through it.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should make it up whenever he remembers it, at whatever hour he
remembers, by night or by day. But if the time of another prayer enters and he has not
yet completed the missed one, then let him continue, as long as he does not fear that
the time for the present prayer will expire. If he fears that, then this current prayer takes
precedence, so let him pray it. Then, once he has prayed it, he should make up the
missed prayer afterwards. And he must not perform any supererogatory (‘nafl’) rak’ah
until he has made up all of the obligatory (‘faridah’) prayers."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.292 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.172 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.266 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.159 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.286 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1011 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.256

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَانَثكَ صَلاَةً
فَذَكَرْتَهَا فِي وَقْتِ أُخْرَى فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ إِذَا صَلِّيْتَ آَلَّتِي فَاتَثكَ كُثْتَ مِنَ الْأُخْرَى فِي وَقْتِ فَابْدَأُ بِالَتِي فَاتَثَكَ
فَإِنَّ اللهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ »وَ أَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ لِذِكْرِي » وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ إِذَا صَلِّيْتَ الْتِي فَاتَثكَ فَاتَثكَ اَلَّتِي بَعْدَهَا
فَابْدَأُ بِالَّتِي أَنْتَ فِي وَقْتِهَا وَ اِقْضِ الْأُخْرَى».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ولا بأس أن يقضي الانسان نوافله بعد صلاة الغداة الى أن تطلع الشمس أو بعد صلاة بعد العصر
الى أن يتغير ضوء الشمس بالاصفرار).
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah, from ‘Ubayd, from Zurarah:
Abu Ja’far {a.s} said: "If you miss a prayer and then remember it during the time of
another prayer, and you know that if you perform the one you missed first, you will still
be within the time for the current prayer, then begin with the one you missed.
For Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘And establish the prayer for My
remembrance’ (Surah Taha 20:14).
But if you know that by praying the one you missed first, you will miss the current one,
then begin with the one whose time you are in, and make up the other afterwards."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “There is no harm in a person
making up his ‘nawafil’ (supererogatory prayers) after the morning prayer (‘salat al-
ghadah’) until the sun rises, or after the afternoon prayer (‘salat al-’asr’) until the
sunlight begins to turn yellow.”
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.293 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.172 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.268 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1011 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.3 p.302 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.287 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.758 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.290 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.375

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ الْعَدَوِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْنِ الشَّامِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَضَاءِ صَلاةٍ
اللَّيْلِ وَ الْوَثْرِ تَفُوتُ الرَّجُلَ أَ يَقْضِيهَا بَعْدَ صَلَاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn
Buzay’ al-’Adawi, from Abu al-Hasan Abdullah ibn ‘Awn al-Shami, who said Abdullah ibn Abi Ya’fur narrated
to me:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding making up the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) and
‘witr’ that a man misses, may he make it up after the morning prayer and after ‘Asr?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in that."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.173 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.289 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.357 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.242

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ فَرَجِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ
إلَى الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ أَسْأَلْهُ عَنْ مَسَائِلَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ «وَ صَلِّ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ مَا شِئْتَ وَ صَلِّ بَعْدَ الْغَدَاةِ مِنْ
اَلنَّوَافِلِ مَا شِنْتَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Musa ibn Ja’far ibn Abi Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Maymun, from
Muhammad ibn Faraj, who said:
I wrote to the Righteous Servant (al Abd al-Salih {a.s}) asking Him {a.s} about certain
issues.
Imam {a.s} wrote back to me: "Pray as many ‘nafilah’ (supererogatory) prayers as you
wish after ‘Asr, and pray as many ‘nafilah’ prayers as you wish after the morning (‘al-
ghadah’) prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.173 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.275 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.289 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.356 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.235

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ الزَّيَّاتِ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوْلَ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنْ قَضَاءِ صَلَاَةِ اللَّيْلِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ إِلَى اللِّيْلِ فَهُوَ مِنْ سِرَّ
آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ الْمَخْزُونِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn ‘Umar al-Zayyat, from Jamil ibn
Darraj, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him, about making up the
night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) after Fajr until the sun rises.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, and also after ‘Asr until night. This is from the concealed secrets
of the family of Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.173 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.357 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.243 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.273

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ هَارُونَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ قَضَاءِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَصْرِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا هِيَ النَّوَافِلُ فَاقْصِهَا مَتَى مَا شِئْتَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah, from Sulayman ibn Harun, who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about making up prayers after ‘Asr.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, they are merely ‘nawafil’ (supererogatory prayers), so make them
up whenever you wish."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.173 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.358

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ وَ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اِقْضِ صَلاَةَ النَّهَارِ أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلِ أَوْ نَهَارِ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ سَوَاء».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub and al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-’Alaʾ:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Make up the daytime prayer at whatever hour you wish, by night
or by day, all of it is the same."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.173 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.168 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.290 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.358 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.243 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.277 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.71

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «صَلاَةُ ٱَلنَّهَارِ يَجُوزُ قَضَاؤُهَا أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلِ أَوْ نَهَارِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Ya’fur, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "The daytime prayer may be made up at whatever hour
you wish, whether by night or by day."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.174 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.358 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.243

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ وَ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ فِي بَعْضِ أَسَانِيدِهِمَا قَالَ: سُنِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْقَضَاءِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ قَاقْضِهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ سِرِّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ
السَّلامٌ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ولا يجوز ابتداء النوافل ولا قضاء شئ منها عند طلوع الشمس ولا عند غروبها).
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr and Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr in one of their chains of
transmission, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} was asked about making up prayers (‘qadah’) before sunrise and after
‘Asr.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, make it up, for this is from the secret knowledge of the Family of
Muhammad {saws}, peace be upon them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: “It is not permissible to begin
supererogatory prayers (‘nawafil’) nor to make up any of them at the time of sunrise or
at the time of sunset.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.174 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.357 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.244

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
الطّاطَرِي عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ وَ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ
بَيْنَ قَرْنَي شَيْطَانٍ وَ تَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ » وَ قَالَ «لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تُصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبُ» ».
english_text:
Al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Ali ibn Ribat, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn al-
Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no prayer after Fajr until the sun rises. Indeed, the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
‘The sun rises between the horns of Satan and sets between the horns of Satan.’
And Imam {a.s} said: “There is no prayer after ‘Asr until Maghrib is performed.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.174 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.348 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.234

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُكَيْنٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا صَلاةَ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَصْرِ حَتَّى
الْمَغْرِبٍ وَلَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ».
هذه الاخبار وما أشبهها محمولة على ابتداء النوافل في هذه الاوقات دون القضاء والاخبار الاولة محمولة على القضاء
دون الابتداء، ولا تنافي بينهما ، والذي يدل على ما ذكرناه من التفصيل ما رواه:
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sukayn, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no prayer after ‘Asr until Maghrib, and no prayer after
Fajr until the sun rises."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
These narrations and those similar to them are to be understood as referring to the
‘initiation’ of supererogatory (‘nafilah’) prayers during these times, not the making up
(‘qadha’) of missed prayers. And the earlier narrations are to be understood as
referring specifically to ‘qadha’, not initiation. Thus, there is no contradiction between
them. What supports this explanation and the distinction we have mentioned is what
has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.174 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.349 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.235

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ بِلالِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ فِي قَضَاءِ ٱلنَّافِلَةِ
مِنْ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى أَنْ تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ فَكَتَبَ «لا يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ إِلاّ لِلْمُقْتَضِي
فَأَمًا لِغَيْرِهِ فَلا».
وقد روي رخصة في الصلاة عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Bilal, who said:
I wrote to Him {a.s} regarding making up supererogatory prayers (‘nafilah’) from the rising
of Fajr until sunrise, and from after ‘Asr until sunset.
He {a.s} wrote back: "That is not permissible except for one who is making up missed
prayers (‘al-muqtadi’); as for anyone else, it is not."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary:
And it has been narrated that there is a concession (‘rukhsah’) permitting prayer at the
time of sunrise and at the time of sunset.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.175 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.291 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.349 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.235

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
رَوَى أَبُو جَعْفَرِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ قَالَ رَوَى لِي جَمَاعَةٌ مِنْ مَشَايِخِنَا عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ ٱلْأَسَدِيِّ رَضِيَ
اللهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّهُ وَرَدَ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ جَوَابٍ مَسَائِلِهِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ الْعَمْرِيِّ قَدَّسَ اللهُ رُوحَهُ «وَ أَمَّا مَا سَأَلْتَ
عَنْهُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا فَلَئِنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ اَلنَّاسُ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَي شَيْطَانٍ وَ
تَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَي شَيْطَانٍ فَمَا أَرْغِمَ أَنفُ الشِّيْطَانِ بِشَيْءٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ فَصَلَّهَا وَ أَرْغِمِ الشِّيْطَانَ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : (ومن أحب ان يقوم في آخر الليل) الى قوله : (ومن قام في آخر ليله).
english_text:
Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali narrated: A group of our elders narrated to me (narrator)
from Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Ja’far al-Asadi, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him,
that among the responses received to his questions from Muhammad ibn Uthman al-
’Amri, may Allah {SWT} sanctify his soul, regarding the questions he had sent, was:
"As for what you asked about, prayer at the time of sunrise and at the time of sunset,
even if people say that the sun rises between the horns of Satan and sets between the
horns of Satan, then there is nothing by which the nose of Satan is more forcefully
rubbed in humiliation than prayer. So perform the prayer and humiliate Satan."
source: Imam al-Hujjah al Qaim Muhammad ibn Hasan al-Mahdi {a.s}
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And whoever wishes to rise
at the end of the night…’ up to his statement: ‘And whoever stands at the end of his
night…’, all of this refers to the encouragement and merit of performing the night
prayer (‘salat al-layl’) in its preferred time, particularly in the latter part of the night.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.175 • Al-Ghaybah (Lil-Tusi), Vol.1 p.296

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
رَوَى عَامِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُذَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدِ يَقْرَأُ آخِرَ الْكَهْفِ جِينَ يَنَامُ إِلاَّ
اِسْتَيْقَظَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الَّتِي يُرِيدُ».
english_text:
‘Amir ibn Abdillah ibn Juda’ah narrated:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no servant who recites the end of Surat al-Kahf when
he goes to sleep except that he will wake up at the hour he desires."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.471 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.175 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.283 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.229 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.610

Chapter Title: THE DETAILED EXPLANATION OF PRAYER, INCLUDING THE OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED, AND WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND NOT PERMISSIBLE.
arabic_text:
وَرُوِيَ عَنِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ قَرَأْ هَذِهِ آلْآيَةَ عِنْدَ مَنَامِهِ «قُلْ إِنّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُمْ يُوحى إلَيَّ
أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِنَهُ وَاجِدٌ فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوا لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلا صالِحاً وَ لا يُشرِك بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَداً» سَطَعَ لَهُ نُورْ إِلَى
الْمَسْجِدِ اَلْحَرَامِ حَشوُ ذَلِكَ النُّورِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ».
وأما ما ذكره رحمه اللّه بعد ذلك الى آخر الباب فقد مضى شرحه مستوفى والمنة لله.
١٠ - باب احكام السهو في الصلاة وما يجب منه اعادة الصلاة
english_text:
And it has been narrated from the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
that He {saws} said: "Whoever recites this verse at the time of sleep:
‘Say: I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God {AZJ} is One
God {AZJ}. So whoever hopes to meet his Lord {AZJ}, let him do righteous work and not
associate anyone in the worship of his Lord {AZJ}’ (Surah Kahf 18:110).
(Thus) a light will shine for him extending to the Sacred Mosque (‘al-Masjid al-Haram’),
and within that light will be angels seeking forgiveness for him until morning."
WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary:
As for what he, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, mentioned after that until the end of
the chapter, its explanation has already been fully presented, and all praise is due to
Allah {SWT}.
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: ‘And every instance of
forgetfulness that befalls a person during the first two units of his obligatory prayer
requires him to repeat the prayer.’ What indicates this is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.175 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.282

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ رَجُلِ
شَكٍّ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى قَالَ «يَسْتَأْنِفٌ».
english_text:
What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from ‘Asim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who
said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s} about a man who has doubt in the first rak’ah.
Imam {a.s} said: "He must start over."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.176 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.363 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.973 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.190

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ إِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ مُصْعَبِ
قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَأَعِدْ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad bin Sinan, from Ibn Maskan and Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from
Ibn Maskan, from Anbasah bin Mus'ab, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: "If you are doubtful regarding the first
two rak‘ahs, then repeat (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.350 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.176 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.363 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.971 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.190

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ ٱلْقَرَوِيَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ ٱلْجُعْفِيّ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلامُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالا: «إِذَا لَمْ تَدْرِ أَوَاجِدَةً صَلِّيْتَ أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ فَاسْتَقْبِل».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad al-Qarawi, from Aban, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi and Ibn Abi Ya'fur:
Abu Ja'far {a.s} and Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon them both, they said:
"If you do not know whether you prayed one rak‘ah or two, then start over."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.176 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.363 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.973 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.191

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ ٱلْفُضَيْلُ عَنِ ٱلسَّهْوِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي ٱلْأُولَيَيْنِ فَأَعِدْ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Musa bin Bakr, who said:
Al-Fudayl asked Him {a.s} about forgetfulness (in prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are doubtful about first two (rak‘ahs), then repeat (the prayer)."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.176

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ: «إِذَا سَهَا الرَّجُلُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَ الْعَصْرِ وَ لَمْ يَدْرِ وَاحِدَةً
صَلَّى أُمْ ثِئْتَيْنِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ الصَّلاَةَ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: "If a man is forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs of the Dhuhr and ‘Asr prayers
and does not know whether he prayed one or two, then it is obligatory upon him to
repeat the prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.350 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.176 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.364 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.971 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.191

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text: فَضَالَةُ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لاَ يَدْرِي أَرَكْعَةً صَلَّى أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ قَالَ «يُعِيدُ».
english_text:
Fadalah, from Rifa‘ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether
he prayed one rak‘ah or two.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should repeat (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.364 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.974 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.190

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا سَهَوْتَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَأَعِدْهُمَا حَتَّى ثُثُبِتَهُمَا)».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Harun bin Kharijah, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you are forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs,
then repeat them until you establish them firmly."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ قَالَ قَالَ لِي: «إِذَا لَمْ تَحْفَظِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ فَأَعِدْ
صَلاتَكَ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Hammad, from al-Fadl bin Abd al-Malik, who said:
Imam {a.s} said to me: "If you do not remember the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat your
prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.364 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.190

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ وَ عَلِيّ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ
عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ لاَ يَدْرِي أَوَاحِدَةَ صَلَّى أَمْ يِنْتَيْنِ قَالَ
«يُعِيدُ».
english_text:
Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Muhammad bin Isma‘il, from al-Fadl bin Shadhan, and Ali bin Ibrahim, from
his father, all from Hammad bin ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from one of them (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon
them both, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should repeat (the prayer)."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.364 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.972 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.189

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ
مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْوَشَّاءِ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «الْإِعَادَةُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوِّلَتَيْنِ وَ السَّهْوُ فِي
الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأَخِيرَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from al-Hasan bin Ali al-Washa’
and al-Husayn bin Muhammad, from Mu‘alla bin Muhammad, from al-Washa’, who said:
Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: "Repetition is for the first
two rak‘ahs, and forgetfulness is for the last two rak‘ahs."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.350 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.364 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.972 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.190

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ لا يَدْرِي أَرَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى أَمْ وَاحِدَةً قَالَ «يُتِمّ)».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Ali bin al-Hakam, from al-Husayn bin Abi
al-‘Ala’, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether
he prayed two rak‘ahs or one.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should complete (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.178 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.364 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.365 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.975 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.192 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.192

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ السِّنَدِيَّ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَاجِ
عَنْ أَبِي إبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: فِي الرَّجُلِ لا يَدْرِي رَكْعَةً صَلَّى أُمِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ «يَبْنِي عَلَى الرَّكْعَةِ».
english_text:
And what was narrated by Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from al-Sindi bin al-Rabi‘, from al-Hasan bin
Mahbub, from Abd al-Rahman bin al-Hajjaj:
Abu Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who does not know whether
he prayed one rak‘ah or two.
Imam {a.s} said: "He builds upon the one rak‘ah."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.177 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.365 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.976 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.192

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وما رواه سعد بن عبد اللّٰه عن محمد بن الحسين عن أحمد ابن محمد بن أبى نصر عن عبد الكريم بن عمرو عن
عبد الله بن أبي يعفور قال سألت أبا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : عن الرجل لا يدري أركعتين صلى ام واحدة فقال :
يتم بركعة.
english_text:
And what was narrated by Sa‘d bin Abdillah, from Muhammad bin al-Husayn, from Ahmad bin Muhammad
bin Abi Nasr, from Abd al-Karim bin ‘Amr, from Abdillah bin Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether
he prayed two rak‘ahs or one.
Imam {a.s} said: "He completes (the prayer) with one rak‘ah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ أَيْضاً عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ لا يَدْرِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى أَمْ وَاحِدَةً قَالَ «يُتِمُّ عَلَى صَلاتِهِ».
فاول ما في هذه الاخبار انها لا تعارض ما قدمناه من الاخبار لانها اضعاف هذه ولا يجوز العدول عن الاكثر الى الاقل إلا
الدليل، ولو كانت هذه الاخبار معارضة لها ومساوية لم يكن فيها ما ينقض ما قدمناه ، لانه ليس في شئ من هذه الاخبار
أن الشك إذا وقع في الاولة والثانية من صلاة الفرايض أو صلاة النوافل، وإذا لم يكن هذا في الخبر حملناها على النوافل
الان النوافل عندنا لا سهو فيها ويبني الانسان إن شاء على الاقل وإن شاء على الاكثر وإن كان البناء على الاقل افضل ،
ومتى حملنا هذه الاخبار على ما ذكرناه كنا قد جمعنا بينها اجمع ولم نكن قد اطرحنا منها شيئا .قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه :
(. سل فف يضة الغداة أه المغرب اعاد) بدا على. ذلك ما دماه :
english_text:
And what was narrated by Sa‘d also, from Abu Ja‘far, from al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Fadalah bin Ayyub,
from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (said) regarding a man who does not know
whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one.
Imam {a.s} said: "He completes according to his prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The first point regarding these reports is that they do not contradict the reports we
presented earlier, because those are far more numerous than these, and it is not
permissible to abandon the more numerous in favor of the fewer without a proof. Even
if these reports were contradictory and equal in number, they still would not invalidate
what we have previously presented, because none of these reports states that the
doubt occurred in the first or second rak‘ah of the obligatory prayers or the
recommended prayers.
And since this is not stated in the reports, we interpret them as referring to the
recommended prayers, because according to our view, there is no (legal)
forgetfulness in the recommended prayers. A person may build upon the lesser if he
wishes, or upon the greater if he wishes, though building upon the lesser is preferable.
And if we interpret these reports as we have mentioned, then we have reconciled all
of them together and have not discarded any of them.
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} support him, said: "Whoever is forgetful in the
obligatory (prayer of) Fajr or Maghrib must repeat (the prayer)."
This is supported by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.178

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي
عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بُنِ الْبَخْتَرِيَّ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي ٱلْمَغْرِبِ فَأَعِدْ وَ إِذَا
شَكَكْتَ فِي الْفَجْرِ فَأْعِدْ».
english_text:
Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, and from Muhammad bin Isma‘il, from al-Fadl
bin Shadhan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs bin al-Bakhtari and others:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat
(the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.350 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.178 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.179 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.180 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.365 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.366 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.366 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.971 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.972 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.193

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
- عَن آَلَّ حُا ئُصَلً . هَ لاَ يَذْهى أَوَاحدَةً صَلَّ . أَد اثنَتَنْ. قَال «يَسْتَقْأُ حَدَّ. تَسْتَنْقءَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَتَمَّ هَ ف الْحُمُعَة ةَ
english_text:
And from him, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad bin Muslim,
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is praying and does not
know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should start over until he is certain that he has completed (the
prayer), and this applies in Jumu‘ah, in Maghrib, and in prayer during travel."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.351 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.179 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.365 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.973 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.189 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.194

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ:
«ليْسَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْفَجْرِ سَهْوُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Yunus, from a man:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no forgetfulness in Maghrib and Fajr."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.351 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.179 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.366 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.973 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.194 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.197 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.113

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ السَّهْوِ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ قَالَ «يُعِيدُ حَتَّى يَحْفَظَ إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ مِثْلَ الشَّفْعِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Safwan and Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of
them (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about forgetfulness in Maghrib.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should repeat (the prayer) until he remembers, for it is not like the
Shaf‘ (even-numbered prayers)."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.179 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.370 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.975 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.194

Chapter Title: RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (SAHW) IN PRAYER AND WHAT REQUIRES REPEATING OF PRAYER
arabic_text:
