غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتُ سَمَّاهُنَّ وَ بَيَّنَهُنَّ وَ وَقْتَهُنَّ وَ غَسَقُ اللَّيْلِ اِنْتِصَافُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «وَ قُرْآنَ ٱلْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْآنَ ٱلْفَجْرِ
كانَ مَشهُوداً» فَهَذِهِ الْخَامِسَةُ وَ قَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ «وَ أَقِمِ الصْلاةَ طَرَقَي النَّهارِ» وَ طَرَفَاهُ ٱلْمَعْرِبُ وَ ٱلْغَدَاةُ «وَ زُلَفاً مِنَ
اللّيْلِ» وَ هِيَ صَلاَةُ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ قَالَ «حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَواتِ وَ الصَّلاةِ الْوُسْطى» وَ هِيَ صَلاَةُ الظُّهْرِ وَ هِيَ
أَوَّلُ صَلاَةٍ صَلاَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ هِيَ وَسَطْ النَّهَارِ وَ وَسَطْ صَلاَتَيْنِ بِالنَّهَارِ صَلاَةِ اَلْغَدَاةِ وَ
صَلاةِ الْعَصْرِ» وَ فِي بَعْضِ الْقِرَاءَةِ « «حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوْاتِ وَ الصَّلاةِ الْوُسْطى» صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ «وَ قُومُوا لِلَّهِ
قانِتِين» » قَالَ «فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ آلْآيَةُ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ وَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي سَفَرِ فَقَنَتَ فِيهَا وَ تَرَكَهَا
عَلَى حَالِهَا فِي السِّفَرِ وَ الْحَضَرِ وَ أَضَافَ لِلْمُقِيمِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ إِنَّمَا وُضِعَتِ الرَّكْعَتَانِ اللَّتَانِ أَضَافَهُمَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ لِلْمُقِيمِ لِمَكَانِ الْخُطْبَتَيْنِ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ فَمَنْ صَلَّى يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي غَيْرِ جَمَاعَةٍ فَلْيُصَلَّهَا أَرْبَعَ
رَكَّعَاتٍ كَصَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ فِي سَائِرِ الْأَيَّامِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon
him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about what Allah {SWT} has made obligatory in terms of prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "Five prayers during the night and day."
So I asked: "Has Allah {SWT} named them and clarified them in His Book?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes. Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, said to His Prophet {saws};
‘Establish the prayer from the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night (Surah
Al-Isra’ 17:78)’ - And its decline (duluk) is its zenith.
And between the decline of the sun and the darkness of the night are four prayers that
He {AZJ} named, clarified, and set their times. And the darkness of the night is its
midpoint.
Then Imam {a.s} said: “And ‘(establish) the recitation of the dawn; indeed, the recitation
of the dawn is ever witnessed’, this is (about) the fifth.”
And He {AZJ} said in that; ‘Establish prayer at the two ends of the day’, and its two ends
are Maghrib and Ghadah (fajr, morning).
And ‘in the early part of the night’, this is the night prayer (Isha).
And He {AZJ} said; ‘Guard strictly [five] the prayers, especially the middle prayer’, and
that is the Dhuhr prayer, and it was the first prayer that the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, prayed. It is the middle of the day and the
middle of the two daytime prayers: the morning and the ‘Asr prayers.”
And in some recitations it is; ‘Guard strictly the prayers and the middle prayer, the ‘Asr
prayer, and stand before Allah {SWT} devoutly.’"
Imam {a.s} said: "This verse was revealed on the day of Jumu‘ah while the Messenger of
Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, was on a journey, and he performed
qunut in it and left it as it was in travel and in residence.
And He {saws} added two rak‘ahs for the resident, and the two rak‘ahs that the Prophet
{saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, added on the day of Jumu‘ah for the
resident were because of the two sermons with the Imam (of prayer).
So whoever prays on the day of Jumu‘ah not in congregation, let him pray it four rak‘ahs
like the Dhuhr prayer on the other days."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.271 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.195 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.354 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.35 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.10 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.496 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.137

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ ٱلْفَرْضِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ «آَلْوَقْتُ وَ الطَّهُورُ وَ
اَلْقِبْلَةُ وَ التَّوَجُهُ وَ الرُّكُوعُ وَ السُّجُودُ وَ الدُّعَاء» قُلْتُ مَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «سُنَّةٌ فِي فَرِيضَةٍ».
english_text:
Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Ja‘far {a.s} about what is obligatory (fardh) in the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “The time, purification, the qiblah, facing the direction (of Qibla),
bowing, prostration, and supplication.”
I asked: “And what about everything else besides that?”
Imam {a.s} said: “It is Sunnah within the obligatory (prayer).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.272 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.41 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.109 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.295 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.264 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.311 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.67 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.160

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «لِلصَلاةِ أَرْبَعَةُ آلاَفِ حَدَّ».
english_text:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Prayer has four thousand boundaries (limits).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.272 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.195 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.827

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text: وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لِلصَّلاَةِ أَرْبَعَةُ آلآَفِ بَابٍ».
english_text:
And it was narrated from (Imam) al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, that Imam {a.s} said:
“Prayer has four thousand gates (aspects/rulings).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.272 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.195 • Al-Khisal, Vol.2 p.638 • Uyun Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.255 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.827 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.827 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 9 p.303

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اِبْنُ رِبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ ٱلْإِسْلَامِ أَصْلِهِ وَ
فَرْعِهِ وَ ذِرْوَتِهِ وَ سَنَامِهِ فَقَالَ «أَصْلُهُ الصَلاَةُ وَ فَرْعُهُ الزَّكَاةُ وَ ذِرْوَتُهُ وَ سَنَامُهُ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى» قَالَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ أَبْوَابِ الْخَيْرِ قَالَ «الصِّيَامُ جُنَّةٌ وَ الصَّدَقَةُ تُذْهِبُ ٱلْخَطِيئَةَ وَ قِيَامُ الرَّجُلِ فِي جَوْفٍ
اللّيْلِ يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ « «تَتَجَافِى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضْاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفاً وَ طَمَعاً وَ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ»
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah said: Ibn Ribat narrated to me from Ibn Miskan from Sulayman ibn
Khalid:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “A man came to the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless
him and his family,) and said;
“O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, inform me about Islam, its root, its branch, its peak, and
its summit.”
He {saws} said: “Its root is prayer, its branch is zakat, and its peak and summit is striving
in the way of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted.”
He (the man) asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, inform me about the gates of
goodness.”
He {saws} said: “Fasting is a shield, charity erases sin, and the standing of a man in the
depths of the night while he privately converses with his Lord {AZJ}.”
Then the Prophet {saws} recited: ‘Their sides forsake their beds, they call upon their Lord
{AZJ} in fear and hope, and from what We have provided them, they spend’ (Surah Al-
Sajdah 32:16).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.32 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.4 p.392

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيِى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَ قَالَ:
كُنَّا جُلُوساً عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ بِمِنَّى فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مَا تَقُولُ فِي النَّوَافِلِ فَقَالَ «فَرِيضَةٌ» قَالَ فَفَزِعْنَا
وَ فَزِعَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنَّمَا أَعْنِي صَلاَةَ اللّيْلِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِنَّ اللَهَ
يَقُولُ «وَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَدْ بِهِ نافِلَةً لَكَ» ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdillah from Ibn Faddal from Marwan from
‘Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
We were sitting with Abu Abdillah {a.s} at Mina when a man said to him:
“What do you say about the nawafil (supererogatory prayers)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “They are obligatory (faridah).”
We were alarmed, and the man was alarmed too.
Then Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “I only mean the night prayer upon the Messenger of Allah
{SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family. Indeed, Allah {SWT} says:
‘And in the night, keep vigil with it as a supererogatory act for you’” (Surah Al-Isra’
17:79).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.89 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.68 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.570 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 6 p.377 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.121 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.204 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.7 p.478

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ الْكُوفِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرِو
الْجَلابٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ تَفُوتُنِي أَفَأْصَلِّيهِمَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ لِمَ أَفَرِيضَةُ قَالَ
فَقَالَ « رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سَنَّهُمَا فَمَا سَنَّ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَهُوَ فَرْضٌ ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: قوله عليه السلام فما سن رسول اللّٰه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله فهو فرض معناه مقدر لان الفرض معناه
هو التقدير ، وليس يريد أنه فرض يستحق تاركه العقاب، يدل على ما قلناه ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl Al-Kufi
from Sa‘d ibn Abi ‘Amr al-Jallab, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “The two units of the Fajr prayer (the supererogatory rak‘ahs
before the obligatory Fajr), if I miss them, should I make them up?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
I said: “Why? Are they obligatory?”
Imam {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
established them as a Sunnah. And whatever the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah
{SWT} bless him and his family, establishes as a Sunnah is an obligation.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His statement (peace be upon him), ‘Whatever the
Messenger of Allah {SWT} (may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family) established as a
Sunnah is an obligation,’ means it is determined (muqaddar).
This is because the meaning of ‘fardh’ (obligation) is determination and fixing. He {a.s}
does not mean that it is an obligation whose abandonment would deserve
punishment. What proves what we have said is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.90 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.104

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيِي عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ «سُنَّةٌ لَيْسَتْ بِفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid from Abu Jamilah from Abu Usamah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} was asked about the witr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “It is a Sunnah, not an obligation (faridah).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.243 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.89 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.90

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «ٱلْوَثْرُ فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَاجِبٌ وَ هُوَ وَثْرُ ٱللّيْلِ وَ ٱلْمَغْرِبُ وَثْرُ النَّهَارِ».
فلا ينافي ما قدمناه من انه سنة لان المسنون إذا كان مؤكدا يسمى واجبا على ما بيناه في غير موضع.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ja‘far
ibn Bashir from ‘Ubayd from his father:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The witr prayer is recorded in the Book of
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, as obligatory (wajib); it is the witr of the night, and
the Maghrib prayer is the witr of the day.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, it does not contradict what we have previously stated, that it is a Sunnah,
because a Sunnah that is strongly emphasized is also referred to as wajib (obligatory),
as we have explained in other places.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.243 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.88 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.91

Chapter Title: THE MERIT OF PRAYER, AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED FROM IT
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ وَهْبٍ أَوْ عَنِ السَّكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى
اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «تَنَفّلُوا فِي سَاعَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ وَ لَوْ بِرَكْعَتَيْنٍ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُمَا يُورِثَانٍ دَارَ الْكَرَامَةِ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
وَ مَا سَاعَةُ الْغَفْلَةِ قَالَ «مَا بَيْنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْعِشَاءِ».
١٣ - باب المواقيت
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Wahb or from Al-Sakuni from Ja‘far from his father, peace be upon
them, who said:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
“Perform voluntary prayers during the hour of heedlessness, even if it is only two light
rak‘ahs, for they will bring about the abode of honor.”
It was said: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, what is the hour of heedlessness?”
He {saws} said: “It is the time between Maghrib and Isha.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.44 • Ma’ani Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.265 • Al-Amali (Lil-Saduq), Vol.1 p.554 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.243 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.317 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.245 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.80 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1397 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.95

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْرَةً عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنِ الصَّبَّاحِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah said: Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah narrated to me from Mu‘awiyah
ibn ‘Ammar from Al-Sabbah ibn Sayabah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When the sun passes its zenith, the time of the two prayers has
entered.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.276 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.243 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.245 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.246 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.239 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.242 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.127

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مَالِكِ ٱلْجُهَنِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ وَقْتِ
الظُّهْرِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاتَيْنِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Ibn Miskan from Malik al-Juhani, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the time of Dhuhr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “When the sun passes its zenith, the time of the two prayers has
entered.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.246 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.242 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.128

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عنه عن محمد بن زياد عن منصور بن يونس عن العبد الصالح عليه السلام قال سمعته يقول : إذا زالت الشمس
فقد دخل وقت الصلاتين.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Mansur ibn Yunus from the Righteous Servant (al Abd al Salih
{a.s}), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: “When the sun passes its zenith, the time of the two prayers has
entered.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عنه عن محمد بن أبي حمزة عن ابن مسكان عن مالك الجهني قال سألت أبا عبد اللّه عليه السلام : عن وقت
الظهر فقال: إذا زالت الشمس فقد دخل وقت الصلاتين.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Ibn Miskan from Malik al-Juhani, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the time of Dhuhr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “When the sun passes its zenith, the time of the two prayers has
entered.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْمِيثَمِيِّ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى الظَّهْرَ جِينَ زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ
بِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Mithami and others from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who prayed Dhuhr when the sun had just passed its
zenith.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in it.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.246 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.242 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.128

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ عَلاءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَاجَةَ أَوِ
النَّوْمَ جِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ فَجَعَلَ يُصَلِّي الْأُولَى جِينَيْذِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah from ‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two (Imams
{a.s}), peace be upon them:
(Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding a man who intends to tend to a need or to sleep when
the sun passes its zenith, so he begins to pray Dhuhr at that time.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in it.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.243 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.128

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ وَ اِبْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ وَقْتِ ٱلظُهْرِ أَ هُوَ إِذَا زَالَتِ ٱلشَمْسُ فَقَالَ « بَعْدَ ٱلزَّوَالِ بِقَدَمٍ أَوْ نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ فِي السَّفَرِ
أَوْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّ وَقْتَهَا إِذَا زَالَتْ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Ali ibn Al-Nu‘man and Ibn Ribat
from Sa‘id al-A‘raj from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the time of Dhuhr prayer, is it when the sun passes its zenith?
Imam {a.s} said: “After the zenith by the measure of a footstep (qadam) or so, except in
travel or on the day of Jumu‘ah, for its time is when the sun passes its zenith.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.236 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.145

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عنه عن صفوان عن ابن مسكان عن إسماعيل بن عبد الخالق قال سألت أبا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : عن وقت
الظهر قال: بعد الزوال بقدم أو نحو ذلك إلا في يوم الجمعة أو في السفر فان وقتها حين تزول الشمس.
english_text:
From him, from Safwan from Ibn Miskan from Isma‘il ibn Abd al-Khaliq, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the time of Dhuhr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “After the sun’s zenith by a footstep (qadam) or so, except on the day
of Jumu‘ah or while traveling, for its time is when the sun passes its zenith.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
وَعَثَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ وَ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ هَاشِمِ وَ إِبْنِ رِبَاطِ وَ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى كُلُهُمْ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبِ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ ٱلْفَيْءُ ذِرَاعاً».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn ibn Hashim and Ibn Ribat and Safwan ibn
Yahya, all from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the time of Dhuhr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “When the shadow is the length of one arm's span (dhira‘).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.230

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «وَقْتُ ٱلظُهرِ عَلَى ذِرَاعٍ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذه الاخبار هو ما قدمناه فيما مضى من الكتاب وهو أن ما تضمنت من لفظ القدم.
والذراع والقامة إنما ذكر لمكان النافلة، وقد دللنا على ذلك وأكثرنا فيه الاخبار، وليس ذلك وقت الاجزاء لانه إذا زالت
الشمس فهو وقت الاجزاء غير أن الافضل أن يقدم على الفرض النوافل الى أن يصير الفئ على ذراع، والذي يزيد ما
قدمناه وضوحا ما رواه :
english_text:
From him, from Husayn ibn Hashim from Ibn Miskan from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The time of Dhuhr is when the shadow reaches one arm's span
(dhira‘).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: ‘The interpretation of these reports is as we have
previously explained earlier in the book, that the mention of a footstep (qadam), an
arm's span (dhira‘), or a height (qamah) pertains to the time allocated for performing
the nafilah (supererogatory prayers). We have already provided evidence for this and
narrated numerous reports regarding it.
This is not the time for the validity (ijaz) of the obligatory prayer itself, because as soon
as the sun passes its zenith, the time of validity for the obligatory prayer begins.
However, it is preferable to first perform the nafilah until the shadow reaches an arm's
span.’ What further clarifies what we have previously stated is following narrations:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.245 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.229 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.145

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةً عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: أَتَدْرِي لِمَ جُعِلَ الذِّرَاعُ
وَ الذِّرَاعَانٍ قُلْتُ لِمَ قَالَ «لِمَكَانِ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ لَكَ أَنْ تَتَنَفَلَ مِنْ زَوَالِ الشَمْسِ إِلَى أَنْ يَبْلُغَ ذِرَاعاً فَإِذَا بَلَغَ ذِرَاعاً بَدَأْتَ
بِالْفَرِيضَةِ وَ تَرَكْتَ ٱلنَّافِلَةَ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Ibn Miskan from Zurarah:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do you know why the arm's span (dhira‘) and
two arm's spans were set?"
I asked: "Why?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Because of the obligatory prayer. You are allowed to perform
supererogatory (nafilah) prayers from the sun's zenith until the shadow reaches an
arm's span. When it reaches an arm's span, you must begin with the obligatory
(faridah) prayer and leave the supererogatory."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.288 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.245 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.361 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.229

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ ٱلْمِيثَمِيَّ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ الْجُعْفِيّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «أَتَدْرِي لِمَ جُعِلَ الذِّرَاعُ وَ
الذَّرَاعَانِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَ قَالَ «لِمَكَانِ الْفَرِيضَةِ لِثَلاَ يُوخَذَ مِنْ وَقْتِ هَذِهِ وَ يُدْخَلَ فِي وَقْتِ هَذِهِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Al-Mithami from Aban from Isma‘il Al-Ju‘fi:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do you know why the arm's span (dhira‘) and
the two arm's spans were set?"
I asked: "Why?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Because of the obligatory prayer, so that time would not be taken from
this (obligatory prayer) and entered into that (supererogatory prayer)."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.245 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.249 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.229 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.146

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُثَنَّى الْعَطَّارِ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ الرِّوَّاسِيّ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلِّ ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ صَلِّ الْفَرِيضَةَ أَرْبَعا فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْ سُبْحَتِكَ قَصَّرْتَ أَوْ
طَوَّلْتَ فَصَلِّ الْعَصْرَ».
english_text:
From him, from Ja‘far ibn Muthanna al-‘Attar from Husayn ibn Uthman al-Rawwasi from Sama‘ah ibn
Mihran, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said to me: “When the sun passes its zenith, pray eight rak‘ahs, then
pray the obligatory Dhuhr prayer, four rak‘ahs.
When you finish your ‘subhah’ (supererogatory prayer), whether you shortened or
prolonged it, then pray the ‘Asr prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.245 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.249 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.224 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.134

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ: كُنْتُ أَقِيسُ الشَّمْسَ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَقَالَ «يَا عُمَرُ ألاَ أُنَبَئُكَ بِأَبْيَنَ مِنْ هَذَا» قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَالَ «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ وَقَعَ
الظُّهْرُ إلاَّ أَنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا سُبْحَةً وَ ذَلِكَ إِلَيْكَ فَإِنْ أَنْتَ خَفَفْتَ فَجِينَ تَفُرُغُ مِنْ سُبْحَتِكَ وَ إِنْ طَوَّلْتَ فَحِينَ تَفْرُغُ
مِنْ سُبْحَتِكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Safwan ibn Yahya from Al-Harith ibn Mughirah from ‘Umar ibn Hanzalah, who said:
I was measuring the position of the sun before Abu Abdillah {a.s}.
Imam {a.s} said: “O ‘Umar, shall I inform you of something clearer than this?”
I said: “Yes, may I be ransomed for you.”
Imam {a.s} said: “When the sun passes its zenith, the time of Dhuhr has entered, except
that before it is the ‘subhah’ (supererogatory prayer), and that is up to you, if you
shorten it, then when you finish your ‘subhah’, and if you lengthen it, then when you
finish your ‘subhah’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.249 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.133

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ الْمُحَارِبِيّ عَنْ أُبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ
أُنَاس وَ أَنَا حَاضِرْ فَقَالَ «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَهُوَ وَقْتَ لا يَحْبِسُكَ مِنْهَا إِلَّ سُبْحَثُكَ تُطِيلُها أَوْ تَقْصُرُهَا» فَقَالَ بَعْضُ
الْقَوْمِ إِنَّا نُصَلِّي الْأُولَى إِذَا كَانَتْ عَلَى قَدَمَيْنِ وَ الْعَصْرَ عَلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «النَّصْفُ
مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ».
english_text:
From him, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah from Dhurayh al-Muharibi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
Some people asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} while I was present.
Imam {a.s} said: “When the sun passes its zenith, it is the time (for prayer); nothing holds
you back from it except your subhah (supererogatory prayer), whether you lengthen it
or shorten it.”
Then some of the people said: “We pray the Dhuhr when the shadow is two feet in
length and the ‘Asr when it is four feet.”
So Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “Half of that is more beloved to me.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.249 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.232

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
فَأَمَا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي صَلَّيْتُ الظُّهْرَ فِي يَوْمِ غَيْمٍ فَانْجَلَتْ فَوَجَدْتُنِي صَلَّيْتُ جِينَ زَالَ النَّهَارُ قَالَ فَقَالَ «لا تُعِذ
وَ لا تَعْدْ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر انه إنما نهاه عن المعاودة الى مثله لان ذلك فعل من لا يصلي النوافل ولا ينبغي الاستمرار على ترك
النوافل، وإنما يسوغ ذلك عند العوارض والعلل على ما بيناه، والذي يزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه:
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Abdullah ibn Jabalah from Ibn
Bukayr from his father from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “I prayed Dhuhr on a cloudy day, and then the sky cleared, and I
realized that I had prayed just as the day had started to decline.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Do not repeat it, (but) do not do it again.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, the interpretation of this report is that he only forbade him from returning to
doing the same again because that behaviour resembles the action of one who
neglects the supererogatory (nafilah) prayers, and it is not appropriate to persist in
abandoning the nafilah.
It is only permissible to do so in cases of necessity, obstacles, or illness, as we have
previously explained. What further clarifies this is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.252 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.243 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.129

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي بِشرٍ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا زَالَتِ
الشَّمْسُ فِي طُولِ النَّهَارِ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الظُهْرَ وَ الْعَصْرَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ مَا أُجِبُّ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ ذَلِكَ فِي كُلّ يَوْمِ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Abi Bishr from Ma‘bad ibn Maysarah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “When the sun passes its zenith during the length of the day,
is it permissible for a man to pray Dhuhr and ‘Asr (immediately)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, but I do not like that he should do so every day.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.247 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.252 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.288 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.128

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْكَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ أَصُومُ فَلا
أَقِيلُ حَتَّى تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ فَإِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ صَلَّيْتُ نَوَافِلِي ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ نَوَافِلِي ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ الْعَصْرَ
ثُمَّ نِمْتُ وَ ذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ النَّاسُ فَقَالَ «يَا زُرَارَةُ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ ٱلْوَقْتُ وَ لَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُ لَكَ أَنْ
تَتَّخِذَهُ وَقْتاً دَائِماً».
فإن قيل قد ذكرتم انه إذا زالت الشمس فقد دخل وقت الفرض ثم قلتم إن البداية بالنوافل أفضل وهذا ينافي ما روي في
الاخبار انه لا تطوع في وقت فريضة.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Abdullah ibn Yahya al-Kahili from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I fast, and I do not take a midday nap until the sun passes
its zenith. When it passes, I pray my supererogatory prayers, then I pray Dhuhr, then I
pray my supererogatory prayers, then I pray ‘Asr, and then I sleep, and this is before
the people pray.”
Imam {a.s} said: “O Zurarah, when the sun passes its zenith, the time has entered. But I
dislike for you to take that (early time) as a constant habit.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
If it is said: ‘You have mentioned that when the sun passes the meridian (zawal), the
time for the obligatory prayer has entered, then you said that beginning with the
supererogatory prayers is better’, yet this contradicts what is narrated in the reports
that there is no supererogatory prayer at the time of an obligatory prayer.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.247 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.252 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.289 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.134

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
روى ذلك الحسن بن محمد بن سماعة عن عبد اللّٰه بن جبلة عن علا عن محمد بن مسلم عن أبي جعفر
عليه السلام قال قال لي رجل من أهل المدينة : يا أبا جعفر مالي لا أراك تتطوع بين الاذان والاقامة كما يصنع
الناس؟ قال قلت : إنا إذا أردنا أن نتطوع كان تطوعنا في غير وقت فريضة ، فإذا دخلت الفريضة لا تطوع.
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah narrated from Abdullah ibn Jabalah from ‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn
Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: A man from the people of Madinah said to me:
“O Aba Ja‘far, why do I not see you performing voluntary prayers between the adhan
and the iqamah as the people do?”
I (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) said: “When we want to perform voluntary prayers, we perform
them at a time other than the time of an obligatory prayer. Once the time for an
obligatory prayer enters, there is no voluntary prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ نَجِيَّةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ تُدْرِكُنِي الصَّلاةُ فَأَبْدَأُ بِالنَّافِلَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ « لا
اِبْدَأْ بِالْفَرِيضَةٍ وَ اِقْضِ النَّافِلَةَ».
english_text:
Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar narrated from Najiyyah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The time for prayer comes upon me,
should I begin with the supererogatory prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, begin with the obligatory prayer and make up the supererogatory
prayer afterward.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.363

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَالِدِ وَ عُبَيْسِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي غِيَاتٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الْمَكْتُوبَةُ فَابْدَأُ بِهَا فَلا يَضُرُكَ أَنْ تَثْرُكَ مَا قَبْلَهَا مِنَ النَّافِلَةِ».
وما قدمتموه من الاخبار أيضا من ان اول الوقت أفضل يؤكد هذه الاخبار فكيف تجمعون بين هذه وتلك؟! قلنا : أما الذي
تضمنته الاخبار التي قدمناها من ان الصلاة في أول الوقت أفضل فهي محمولة على الوقت الذى يلي وقت النافلة ، لان
النوافل إنما يجوز تقديمها الى أن يمضي مقدار قدمين أو ذراع، فإذا مضى ذلك المقدار فلا يجوز الاشتغال بالنوافل ، بل
ينبغي أن يبدأ بالفرض ويكون ذلك الوقت أفضل من الوقت الذي بعده وهو وقت المضطر وصاحب الاعذار، وكل ذلك قد
أوردنا فيه الاخبار، ويزيده بيانا ما رواه :
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn Khalid and ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from Thabit from Ziyad ibn Abi
Ghiyath from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: “When the obligatory prayer is present, begin with it; it will not
harm you if you leave the supererogatory prayer that comes before it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And if it is said: ‘What you have presented from the reports, that performing the prayer
at the beginning of its time is better, also supports these narrations. So how do you
reconcile between these and those?’
We say: ‘As for the reports we presented earlier stating that prayer at the beginning of
its time is better, they are referring to the time immediately after the period allowed for
performing the supererogatory (nafilah) prayers. Because the nafilah prayers are only
permitted until the passing of the amount of two footsteps (qadamayn) or an arm’s
span (dhira‘). Once that measure has passed, it is not permitted to engage in
supererogatory prayers; rather, it is necessary to begin with the obligatory (faridah)
prayer. And that period is better than the time that follows it, which is the time for one
who is compelled or has an excuse. And we have cited reports regarding all of this.’
What further clarifies this is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.247 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.363 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.227

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ وُهَيْبِ بْنِ حَفْصِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الصَّلاةُ فِي
اَلْحَضَرِ ثَمَانِي رَكَعَاتٍ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ ثُلْثَا الْقَامَةِ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ثُلْثَا ٱلْقَامَةِ بَدَأْتَ
بِالْفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Wuhaib ibn Hafs from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “In residence (when not traveling), the prayer is eight rak‘ahs
after the sun has passed its zenith, during the time between you and when two-thirds
of a shadow’s length (qamah) passes. When two-thirds of the qamah have passed,
you must begin with the obligatory prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.248 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.248 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.253 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.233 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.146

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عنه عن ابن جبلة عن علي بن أبي حمزة عن أبي بصير عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام قال : الصلاة في الحضر
ثماني ركعات إذا زالت الشمس ما بينك وبين أن يذهب ثلثا القامة ، فإذا ذهب ثلثا القامة بدأت بالفريضة.
english_text:
From him, from Ibn Jabalah from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The prayer in residence (not while traveling) is eight rak‘ahs
after the sun has passed its zenith, during the time between you and when two-thirds
of a shadow’s length (qamah) passes. When two-thirds of the qamah have passed,
you must begin with the obligatory prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى
اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُصَلِّي الظُهَرَ عَلَى ذِرَاعٍ وَ الْعَصْرَ عَلَى نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ».
فإن قيل فالاخبار التي تضمنت ان أول الوقت أفضل عامة وليس فيها تخصيص الوقت الذي ذكرتموه فمن اين قلتم ذلك؟
وهلا حملتموها على العموم؟ قيل له: حملنا ذلك على ما قلناه لئلا تتناقض الاخبار، وقد ورد بشرحها أيضا آثار.
english_text:
From him, from Husayn ibn Hashim from Ibn Miskan from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, used to pray Dhuhr when the shadow reached an arm’s span (dhira‘) and ‘Asr
at about the same measure.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary:
If it is said: ‘The reports that state the beginning of the time is better are general and
do not specify the time you have mentioned, so how can you claim that? Why did you
not apply them to the general case?’
We say to them: ‘We have interpreted them as we said in order to avoid contradiction
among the reports, and indeed there have also come narrations that explain and
clarify this matter.’
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.248 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.230 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.147 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 9 p.338

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
رَوَى الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْمِيثَمِيِّ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلَاَمُ
عَنْ أَفْضَلِ وَقْتِ الظُهْرِ قَالَ «ذِرَاعٌ بَعدَ الزَّوَالِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فِي الشَّتَاءِ وَ الصَّيْفِ سَوَاءً قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Al-Mithami from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah,
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about the best time for Dhuhr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "An arm’s span (dhira‘) after the sun’s zenith."
I asked: "Is it the same in winter and summer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.249 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.254 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.230 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.147

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُحَمّدٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ رَوَى أَصْحَابُنَا عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالا «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ إِلا أَنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِمَا سُبْحَةً إِنْ شِئْتَ
طَوّلْتَ وَ إنْ شِئتَ قَصَّرْتَ» وَ رَوَى بَعْضُ مَوَالِيكَ عَنْهُمَا «أَنَّ وَقْتَ الظُّهْرِ عَلَى قَدَمَيْنِ مِنَ الزَّوَالِ وَ وَقْتَ الْعَصْرِ
عَلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ مِنَ الزَّوَالِ فَإِنْ صَلَّيْتَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لَمْ يُجْزِكَ وَ بَعْضُهُمْ يَقُولُ يُجْزِي وَ لَكِنَّ الْفَضْلَ فِي اِنْتِظَارٍ
الْقَدَمَيْنِ وَ الْأَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ» وَ قَدْ أَحْبَبْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ أَنْ أَعْرِفَ مَوْضِعَ الْفَضْلِ فِي الْوَقْتِ فَكَتَبَ «الْقَدَمَانِ وَ
الْأَرْبَعَةُ أَقْدَامٍ صَوَابٌ جَمِيعاً».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, who said:
I wrote to Imam {a.s}: “May I be your ransom. Our companions have narrated from Abu
Ja‘far {a.s} and Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon them, that they both said:
‘When the sun passes its zenith, the time of the two prayers has entered, except that
before them is a subhah (supererogatory prayer), which if you wish, you may lengthen,
and if you wish, you may shorten.’
And some of your followers have narrated from them (Imams {a.s}) that:
‘The time of Dhuhr is after two footsteps from the zenith, and the time of ‘Asr is after
four footsteps from the zenith. If you pray before that, it does not suffice; and some
say it does suffice, but the preference is in waiting for two or four footsteps.’
And I wished, may I be your ransom, to know the correct position regarding the virtue
of the timing.”
So Imam {a.s} wrote: “The two footsteps and the four footsteps are both correct.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary: And this report does not contradict what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.249 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.254 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.231 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.148

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى قَالَ: كَتَبَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ رُوِيَ عَنْ
آبَائِكَ «الْقَدَمِ وَ الْقَدَمَيْنِ وَ الْأَرْبَعِ وَ الْقَامَةِ وَ الْقَامَتَيْنِ وَ ظِلِّ مِثْلِكَ وَ الذَّرَاعِ وَ الذَّرَاعَيْنِ» فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لا
اَلْقَدَمِ وَ لا الْقَدَمَيْنِ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا سُبْحَةٌ وَ هِيَ ثَمَانُ رَكَعَاتٍ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ
طَوَّلْتَ وَ إِنْ شِنْتَ قَصَّرْتَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ صَلاَةَ ٱلظَهْرِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ كَانَ بَيْنَ ٱلظَهْرِ وَ الْعَصْرِ سُبْحَةٌ وَ هِيَ ثَمَانُ رَكَّعَاتٍ
إن شِئتَ طَوَّلْتَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ قَصّرْتَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ الْعَصْرَ».
لان الوجه في هذا الخبر انه إنما نفى القدم والقدمين حتى لا يظن ان ذلك وقت لا يجوز غيره، والذي روى ذلك رواه على
جهة الافضل يبين ما قلناه:
english_text:
Sa‘d ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, who said:
One of our companions wrote to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“It has been narrated from your forefathers regarding ‘one footstep, two footsteps,
four footsteps, one height (qamah), two heights, a shadow equal to yourself, one arm’s
span, and two arm’s spans.’”
So Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote in reply:
“Neither one footstep nor two footsteps (are required). When the sun passes its
zenith, the time of the two prayers has entered, and before them is a ‘subhah’
(supererogatory prayer) which is eight rak‘ahs. If you wish, you may lengthen it, and if
you wish, you may shorten it. Then pray the Dhuhr prayer.
When you finish, between Dhuhr and ‘Asr there is a ‘subhah’ as well, which is eight
rak‘ahs. If you wish, you may lengthen it, and if you wish, you may shorten it. Then pray
the ‘Asr prayer.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary:
Because the interpretation of this report is that he only negated the one footstep and
two footsteps so that it would not be assumed that this is the only permissible time
and no other, whereas the one who narrated it did so in the sense of it being the
preferable (afdhal) time.
What clarifies what we have said is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.249 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.254 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.224 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.134

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
سَغدٌ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ اَلنَّحَاسِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْفَرَجِ قَالَ:
كَتَبْتُ أَسأَلُ عَنْ أَوْقَاتِ الصَّلاةِ فَأَجَابَ «إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَ سُبْحَتَكَ وَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ فَرَاغُكَ مِنَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ
وَ الشَّمْسُ عَلَى قَدَمَيْنِ ثُمَّ صَلَّ سُبْحَتَكَ وَ أُجِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ فَرَاغُكَ مِنَ الْعَضْرِ وَ الشَّمْسُ عَلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ فَإِنْ
عَجَّلَ بِكَ أَمْرٌ فَابْدَأُ بِالْفَرِيضَتَيْنِ وَ اِقْضِ النَّافِلَةَ بَعْدَهُمَا فَإِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَصَلَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةَ ثُمَّ اِقْضِ بَعْدُ مَا شِئْتَ».
فاما ما تضمنته الاخبار التي قدمناها من أنه لا تطوع في وقت فريضة فمحمولة على انه لا تطوع في وقت فريضة قد
نضيق وقتها أو في وقت فريضة لم يشرع فعل النافلة فيه على ما بيناه من انه إذا مضى من الزوال قدمان أو قدم ونصف
فلا نافلة ، وينبغي ان يبدأ بالفريضة وعلى هذا لا تنافى بين الاخبار، ويزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه :
english_text:
Sa’d from Musa ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Maymun ibn Yusuf al-Nahhas from
Muhammad ibn al-Faraj, who said:
I wrote asking about the times of prayer, and he replied:
"When the sun passes its zenith, pray your ‘subhah’ (supererogatory prayer), and I
prefer that you complete your obligatory prayer while the sun is at two footsteps
(above the horizon). Then pray your ‘subhah’, and I prefer that you complete your ‘Asr
prayer while the sun is at four footsteps. But if some urgent matter hastens you, then
begin with the two obligatory prayers and make up the supererogatory afterward.
And when the dawn rises, pray the obligatory (Fajr) prayer first, then afterward make
up as much as you wish (of supererogatory prayers)."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
As for what was mentioned in the reports we have presented earlier, that there is no
voluntary (nafilah) prayer during the time of an obligatory (faridah) prayer, it is to be
understood as meaning that there is no voluntary prayer during the time when the
obligatory prayer’s period has become constricted, or during a time when the
performance of a voluntary prayer was not legislated, as we have explained:
when two footsteps or a footstep and a half have passed from the zenith, then no
nafilah is to be performed, and the obligatory prayer must be prioritized.
Thus, there is no contradiction between the reports.
And what further clarifies this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.250 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.255 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.231 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.148

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «كَانَ حَائِطُ
مَسْجِدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَامَةً فَإِذَا مَضَى مِنْ فَيْئِهِ ذِرَاعٌ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ إِذَا مَضَى مِنْ فَيْئِهِ ذِرَاعَانٍ
صَلّى العصْرَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَتَدْرِي لِمَ جُعِلَ الذَّرَاعُ وَ الذِّرَاعَانِ» قُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ »مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الذِّرَاعِ
وَ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ بَدَأْتَ بِالْفَرِيضَةِ وَ تَرَكْتَ النَّافِلَةَ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from Ibn Ribat from Ibn Miskan from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Ja‘far {a.s} say:
"The wall of the mosque of the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, was the height of one qamah (the height of a man). When a shadow the
length of one arm’s span (dhira‘) had passed, He {saws} would pray Dhuhr; when two
arm’s spans had passed, He {saws} would pray ‘Asr."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Do you know why one arm’s span and two arm’s spans were set?"
I said: "No."
Imam {a.s} said: "Because of the obligatory prayer: when the time of one arm’s span and
two arm’s spans arrives, you must begin with the obligatory prayer and leave the
supererogatory prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.250 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.255 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.228 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.147

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُدَيْسِ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ الْجُعْفِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ
رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلْى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا كَانَ اَلْفَيْءُ فِي الْجِدَارِ ذِرَاعاً صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَ إِذَا كَانَ ذِرَاعَيْنِ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ»
قُلْتُ الْجُدْرَانُ تَخْتَلِفُ مِنْهَا قَصِيرٌ وَ مِنْهَا طَوِيلْ قَالَ «إِنَّ جِدَارَ مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يَوْمَئِذٍ
قَامَةٌ وَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الذَّرَاعُ وَ الذَّرَاعَانِ لِثَلاَّ يَكُونَ تَطَوُّعْ فِي وَقْتِ فَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn ‘Udays from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from Isma‘il al-Ju‘fi:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
"The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, when the shadow
on the wall measured one arm’s span (dhira‘), would pray Dhuhr, and when it reached
two arm’s spans, He {saws} would pray ‘Asr."
I asked: "The walls differ; some are short and some are tall."
Imam {a.s} said: "The wall of the mosque of the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, at that time was the height of a man (qamah).
And the one arm’s span and two arm’s spans were set so that no supererogatory
prayer would be performed during the time of an obligatory prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.250 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.255 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.147

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عُبَيْسِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ٱلْعَبْدَ الصَّالِحَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ أَوّلَ وَقْتِ
الظُّهْرِ زَوَالُ الشَّمْسِ وَ آخِرَ وَقْتِهَا قَامَةً مِنَ الزَّوَالِ وَ أَوَّلَ وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ قَامَةٌ وَ آخِرَ وَقْتِهَا قَامَتَانِ» قُلْتُ فِي الشَّتَاءِ
وَ الصَّيْفِ سَوَاءُ قَالَ »نَعَمْ».
وقد بينا فيما مضى أن القامة والذراع عبارة عن شئ واحد، ويؤكد ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from ‘Ubays from Hammad from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:
I heard the Righteous Servant (Abd al Salih {a.s}), peace be upon him, saying:
"Indeed, the beginning of the time for Dhuhr is when the sun passes its zenith, and the
end of its time is one height (qamah) from the zenith.
The beginning of the time for ‘Asr is at one height, and the end of its time is two
heights."
I asked: "Is it the same in winter and summer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
And we have explained earlier that the qamah (height) and the dhira‘ (arm’s span) are
expressions referring to the same measure.
What further confirms this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.251 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.256 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.245 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.148

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ خَلِيلِ الْعَبْدِيِّ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «فِي كِتَابٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ «الْقَامَةُ ذِرَاعٌ وَ الْقَامَتَانِ ذِرَاعَانِ» ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Khalil al-Abdi from Ziyad ibn Isa from Ali ibn
Hanzalah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "In the Book of (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, it is stated:
'One qamah is one arm’s span (dhira‘), and two qamahs are two arm’s spans
(dhira‘ayn).'"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.251 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.220 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.147 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.38

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ وَ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ هَاشِمِ وَ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِبَاطِ وَ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شَعَيْبِ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاةِ الظُّهْرِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ الْفَيءُ ذِرَاعاً» قُلْتُ ذِرَاعاً مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ قَالَ
«ذِرَاعاً مِنْ فَيْئِكَ» قُلْتُ فَالْعَصْرُ قَالَ «الشَّطْرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ» قُلْتُ هَذَا شِبْرٌ قَالَ «شِبْرٌ أَ وَ لَيْسَ شِبْرٌ كَثِيراً».
فان قيل: نراكم قد رتبتم الاوقات بعضها على بعض وجعلتم لبعضها فضلا على بعض ، وقد روي ان ذلك كله سواء.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn ibn Hashim and Ali ibn Ribat and Safwan ibn Yahya
from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about the Dhuhr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "When the shadow is one arm’s span (dhira‘)."
I asked: "An arm’s span from what?"
Imam {a.s} said: "An arm’s span from your own shadow."
I asked: "And the ‘Asr prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Half of that."
I asked: "That is one hand-span (shibr)."
Imam {a.s} said: "A hand-span, and is a hand-span not considerable?"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
If it is said: ‘We see that you have arranged the times (of prayer) one over another and
made some times more virtuous than others,.
whereas it has been narrated that all of them are equal.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.251 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.232 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.145

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
رَوَى الْحَسَنْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ شَجَرَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
الَهُ يَكُونُ أَصْحَابُنَا فِي الْمَكَانِ مُجْتَمِعِينَ فَيَقُومُ بَعْضُهُمْ يُصَلِّي الظُهْرَ وَ بَعْضُهُمْ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ قَالَ «كُلُّ ذَلِكَ
وَاسِعٌ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Ali ibn Shajarah from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: "Our companions may be gathered in one place, and some of them
get up to pray Dhuhr while others get up to pray ‘Asr."
Imam {a.s} said: "All of that is permissible (wasi‘)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.251 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.256 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.287 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.139

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زُرَارَةُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ الرَّجْلاَنِ يُصَلِّيَانٍ فِي وَقْتِ وَاجِدٍ وَ أَحَدُهُمَا يُعَجّلُ الْعَصْرَ وَ الْآخَرُ يُوَخِّرُ الظُهْرَ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
From him, by Ahmad ibn Abi Bashir by Hammad ibn Abi Talhah, who said Zurarah ibn A‘yan narrated to me:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "Two men are praying at the same time, one of them hastens
the ‘Asr prayer while the other delays the Dhuhr prayer."
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with that."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.252 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.256 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.287

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: رُبَّمَا دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتُ
الظُّهْرَ وَ الْعَصْرَ فَيَقُولُ «صَلّيْتَ الظُّهرَ» فَأَقُولُ نَعَمْ وَ الْعَصْرَ فَيَقُولُ «مَا صَلَّيْتُ الظُّهرَ» فَيَقُومُ مُتَرَسِّلاً غَيْرَ
مُسْتَعْجِلٍ فَيَعْتَسِلُ أَوْ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي الظُّهرَ ثُمّ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَ رُبَّمَا دَخَلْتْ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ أُصَلّ الظُهرَ فَيَقُولُ «قَدْ
صَلَّيْتَ الظُّهرَ» فَأَقُولُ لا فَيَقُولُ «قَدْ صَلَّيْتُ الظُهْرَ وَ ٱلْعَصْرَ».
قيل له : ليس في هذه الاخبار ما ينافي ما قدمناه لان قوله عليه السلام كل ذلك واسع محمول على أن ذلك كله جائز قد
سوغته الشريعة وإن كان لبعضها فضل على بعض ، وليس في الخبر أن ذلك كله واسع متساو في الفضل ، ويجوز أن يكون
سوغ ذلك لهم لضرب من التقية والاستصلاح ، يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Ibn Ribat from Ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Sometimes I would enter upon Abu Ja‘far {a.s} after I had prayed Dhuhr and ‘Asr, and
Imam {a.s} would say: "Have you prayed Dhuhr?"
And I would say: "Yes, and (also) ‘Asr."
Then Imam {a.s} would say: "I have not yet prayed Dhuhr."
He {a.s} would then rise, calmly and without haste, perform ghusl (ritual bath) or perform
wudu’ (ablution), then pray Dhuhr and then pray ‘Asr.
And sometimes I would enter upon Him {a.s} while I had not yet prayed Dhuhr, and He
would say: "Have you prayed Dhuhr?" And I would say: "No"
Then Imam {a.s} would say: "I have already prayed Dhuhr and ‘Asr."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
It is said to him: ‘There is nothing in these reports that contradicts what we have
presented, because his statement (peace be upon him), " All of that is permissible," is
to be understood as meaning that all of it is permissible and has been allowed by the
sacred law, even though some times may be more virtuous than others.
The report does not state that all of it is equal in merit. It is also possible that this
permissibility was granted to them due to some circumstance of taqiyyah or for
considerations of reconciliation and benefit. What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.252 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.256 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.25 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.288 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.139

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمِ الْبَجَلِيّ عَنْ سَالِمِ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلَ إِنْسَانٌ وَ أَنَا حَاضِرٌ فَقَالَ رُبَّمَا دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَ
بَعْضُهُمْ يُصَلِّي الظُهرَ فَقَالَ «أَنَا أَمَرْتُهُمْ بِهَذَا لَوْ صَلَّوْا عَلَى وَقْتِ وَاحِدٍ لَعُرِفُوا فَأْخِذُوا بِرِقَابِهِمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Abdul-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim Al-Bajali, from
Salim Abu Khadijah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked (Imam {a.s}) while I was present, and he said: "Sometimes I enter the
mosque and some of our companions are praying Asr while others are praying Dhuhr."
Imam {a.s} said: "I am the one who ordered them to do this. If they were to pray at the
same time, they would be recognized and seized by their necks."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.276 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.252 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.257 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.287 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.137 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.2 p.251

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
فَأَمًّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«أَنَى جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِمَوَاقِيتِ الصَّلاةِ فَأَتَاهُ حِينَ زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَأَمَرَهُ
فَصَلَّى الظُّهرَ ثُمَّ أَنَاهُ حِينَ زَادَ الظَّلُ قَامَةً فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَّى ٱلْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ حِينَ غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَّى ٱلْمَغْرِبَ
ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ جِينَ سَقَطَ الشَّفَقُ فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ حِينَ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ مِنَ الْغَدِ
جينَ زَادَ فِي الظَّلِّ قَامَةً فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَى الظُهْرَ ثُمْ أَتَاهُ جِينَ زَادَ فِي الظَّلِّ قَامَتَانٍ فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلّى الْعَصْرَ ثُمّ أَتَاهُ جِينَ
غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ جِينَ ذَهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلّى ٱلْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ جِينَ نَوْرَ الصُّبْحُ
فَأَمَرَهُ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَقْتٌ».
english_text:
As for what Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "(Archangel) Jibrail, peace be upon him,
came to the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, with the
timings of the prayer.
He (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the sun had passed the meridian and (conveyed
the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Dhuhr.
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the shadow had increased by the length of a
span and ordered him, so he prayed Asr. Then he came to him when the sun had set
and (conveyed the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Maghrib.
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the twilight had disappeared and (conveyed
the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Isha.
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the dawn had risen and (conveyed the) order
(to) him, so He {saws} prayed Subh.
Then he {Jibrail) came to Him {saws} on the next day when the shadow had increased by
the length of a span and (conveyed the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Dhuhr.
Then he {Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the shadow had increased by the length of two
spans and (conveyed the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Asr.
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the sun had set and (conveyed the) order (to)
him, so He {saws} prayed Maghrib.
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when a third of the night had passed and (conveyed
the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Isha.
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} when the light of dawn had spread and (conveyed
the) order (to) him, so He {saws} prayed Subh."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "What is between these two times is (considered) time (for the
prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.252 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.257 • Al-Arba’un Hadithan (Lil-Shahid Al-Awwal), Vol.1 p.47 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.211 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.157 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 9 p.347 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.122

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي بَشِيرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «أَتَّى جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ » وَ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَدَلَ ٱلْقَامَةِ وَ ٱلْقَامَتَيْنِ «ذِرَاعِ وَ ذِرَاعَيْنِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Abi Bashir, from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
"Jibrail, peace be upon him, came", and he mentioned the narration similar to that of
Abu Khadijah, except that instead of saying "one span and two spans (qamah and
qamatayn)," he said "one forearm length and two forearm lengths (dhiraʿ and
dhira’ayn)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «نَزَلَ جَبْرَئِيلُ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ » وَ سَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ مِثْلَ الْأَوَّلِ وَ ذَكَرَ بَدَلَ الْقَامَةِ وَ الْقَامَتَيْنِ
«قَدَمَيْنِ وَ أَرْبَعَةَ أقْدَامٍ».
فليس لاحد أن يقول : ان هذه الاخبار تنبئ ان أول الوقت والآخر سواء لانه قال : ما بينهما وقت لانه لا يمتنع أن يجعل ما
بين الوقتين وقتا وان كان الاول أفضل منه، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Ribaat from Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Jibrail, peace be upon him, descended
upon the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,"
And he continued the narration similar to the first one, and he mentioned in place of
"one span and two spans" (qamah wa qamatayn), "two feet and four feet" (qadamayn
wa arbaʿat aqdam).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So no one has the right to say: ‘These narrations indicate that the beginning of the time
and its end are the same’.
This is because he said: "Between them is the time," for it is not impossible that what
is between the two times is made a time, even though the beginning is better than it.
What indicates this is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «أَتَى جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَأَعْلَمَهُ مَوَاقِيتَ الصَّلَاَةِ فَقَالَ صَلِّ الْفَجْرَ حِينَ يَنْشَقُّ الْفَجْرُ وَ صَلِّ الْأُولَى إِذَا
زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَ صَلِّ الْعَصْرَ بُعَيْدَهَا وَ صَلِّ الْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا سَقَطَ الْقُرْصُ وَ صَلِّ الْعَتَمَةَ إِذَا غَابَ الشَّفَقُ ثُمَّ أَنَاهُ مِنَ
اَلْغَدِ فَقَالَ أَسْفِرْ بِالْفَجْرِ فَأَسْفَرَ ثُمَّ أَخِّرَ الظُّهْرَ حَتَّى كَانَ الْوَقْتُ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ اَلْعَصْرَ وَ صَلَّى اَلْعَصْرَ بُعَيْدَهَا وَ
صَلَّى اَلْمَغْرِبَ قَبْلَ سُقُوطِ الشَّفَقِ وَ صَلَّى الْعَتَمَةَ جِينَ ذَهَبَ ثُلْثُ ٱللَّيْلِ ثُمّ قَالَ مَا بَيْنَ هَذَيْنِ الْوَقْتَيْنِ وَقْتُ وَ
أفْضَلُ الوَقْتِ أُوَّلُهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «قَالَ رَسُولُ ٱللّهِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «لَوْ لاَ أَنَّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُشَقَّ عَلَى
أَمَّتِي لَأَخْرْتُهَا إِلَى نِصْفِ اللِّيْلِ » » وَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ أَنَاساً مِنْ أَصْحَابٍ أَبِي الْخَطَابِ يُمَسُونَ بِالْمَغْرِبِ حَتَّى
تَشَتَبِكَ النُجُومُ قَالَ فَقَالَ «أَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِمَّنْ يَفْعَلُ هَذَا مُتَعَمِّداً ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Abdullah ibn Jabalah from Dharih:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Jibrail, peace be upon him, came to the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, and informed him of
the timings of the prayer.
He (Jibrail) said: “Pray Fajr when the dawn breaks, and pray the first prayer (Dhuhr)
when the sun passes the meridian, and pray Asr shortly after it, and pray Maghrib when
the disk (of the sun) sets, and pray the night prayer (Isha) when the twilight
disappears.”
Then he (Jibrail) came to Him {saws} on the next day and said: “Brighten the Fajr (delay it
until the light is widespread), so He {saws} delayed it until the light spread. Then He {saws}
delayed Dhuhr until the time when He {saws} had prayed Asr on the previous day, and He
{saws} prayed Asr shortly after it, and He {saws} prayed Maghrib before the twilight
disappeared, and He {saws} prayed the night prayer (Isha) when a third of the night had
passed.
Then he (Jibrail) said: “Between these two times there is time, and the best time is its
beginning."
Then He {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, said: ‘Were it not that I dislike to burden my nation, I would
have delayed it (Isha) until the middle of the night.’
And he (Dhurayh) said: "I said to Him {a.s};There are people among the companions of
Abu Al-Khattab who delay Maghrib until the stars become entangled."
He (Dhurayh) said: "He, (Imam al Sadiq {a.s}), said: ‘I disassociate myself before Allah
{SWT} from whoever does this intentionally.’"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.253

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الحسن بن محمد عن الميثمي عن معاوية بن وهب عن أبي بصير عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام قال : من صلى
في غير وقت فلا صلاة له.
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Al-Mitami from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever prays outside of the (prescribed)
time, his prayer is not considered a prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعَطَارِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَأَنْ أُصَلِّيَ الظُهْرَ فِي وَقْتِ ٱلْعَصْرِ
أَحَبّ إِلَيّ مِنْ أَنْ أَصَلِّيَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ فَإِنِّي إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَزُولَ الشَمْسُ لَمْ تُحْتَسَبْ لِي وَ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ
فِي وَقْتِ اَلْعَصْرِ حُسِبَثْ لِي».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Attar, from his father:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "For me to pray Dhuhr at the time of Asr is
more beloved to me than to pray before the sun passes the meridian, for if I pray before
the sun passes the meridian, it will not be counted for me, and if I pray at the time of
Asr, it will be counted for me."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.254 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.254 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.307 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.168

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عنه عن محمد بن الحسن العطار عن عبد اللّٰه بن سليمان عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام قال : لان أصلي الظهر
في وقت العصر أحب إلي من أن أصلي قبل أن تزول الشمس فاني إذا صليت قبل أن تزول الشمس لم تحسب
لي ، وإذا صليت في وقت العصر حسبت لي.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Attar, from Abdullah ibn Sulayman:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "For me to pray Dhuhr at the time of Asr is
more beloved to me than to pray before the sun passes the meridian, for if I pray before
the sun passes the meridian, it will not be counted for me, and if I pray at the time of
Asr, it will be counted for me."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
علي بن مهزيار عن فضالة عن أبان عن زرارة عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام في رجل صلى الغداة بليل غره من ذلك
القمر ونام حتى طلعت الشمس فاخبر انه صلى بليل قال : يعيد صلاته.
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated from Fadalah from Aban from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who prayed the morning
prayer during the night, being deceived by the moon, and then slept until the sun rose,
and was informed that he had prayed during the night.
Imam {a.s} said: “He must repeat his prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
محمد بن يحيى عن محمد بن الحسين عن عثمان بن عيسى عن سماعة قال : سألته عن الصلاة بالليل والنهار
إذا لم تر الشمس ولا القمر ولا النجوم قال : اجتهد رأيك وتعمد القبلة جهدك.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who
said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about praying during the night and day when neither the sun nor the
moon nor the stars are visible.
Imam {a.s} said: “Exert your judgment and face the qiblah as best as you can.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْفَرَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ
أَصْحَابِنَا رُبَّمَا اِشتَبَهَ الْوَقْتُ عَلَيْنَا فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْغَيْمِ فَقَالَ «تَعْرِفُ هَذِهِ الطُيُورَ الَّتِي عِنْدَكُمْ بِالْعِرَاقِ يُقَالُ لَهَا الدِّيَكَةُ»
قُلْثُ نَعَمْ قَالَ «إِذَا اِرْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاثُهَا وَ تَجَاوَبَتْ فَقَدْ زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ» أَوْ قَالَ «فَصَلِّهِ».
english_text:
Ali narrated from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Abdillah Al-Farra' from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
A man from among our companions said to Imam {a.s}: “Sometimes the time becomes
unclear to us on a cloudy day.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do you know those birds you have in Iraq that are called roosters?"
I said: “Yes”.
Imam {a.s} said: "When their voices rise and they call to each other, then the sun has
passed the meridian," or Imam {a.s} said: "then pray."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.284 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.255 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.171

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
سَهْلُ بَنْ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ إِنَّي رَجُلٌ مُؤَذِّنْ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْغَيْمِ لَمْ أَعْرِفِ الْوَقْتَ قَالَ «إِذَا صَاحَ الدِّيكُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَصْوَاتٍ وِلاءً فَقَدْ زَالَتِ
الشَّمْسُ وَ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاَةِ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim from Al-Nawfali from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar from
a man who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I am a man who gives the call to prayer,
and when it is a cloudy day, I do not know the time.”
Imam {a.s} said: "When the rooster crows three continuous times, then the sun has
passed the meridian and the time of prayer has entered."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.285 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.255

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ وَ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ وَ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ
مُسْلِمٍ وَ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْعِجْلِيَّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ وَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ : «وَقْتُ الظُهْرِ بَعْدَ ٱلزَّوَالِ
قَدَمَانٍ وَ وَقْتُ ٱلْعَصْرِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَدَمَانِ وَ هَذَا أَوْلُ وَقْتٍ إلَى أَنْ يَمْضِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَقْدَامٍ لِلْعَصْرِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Hariz ibn Abdullah from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar and Zurarah ibn A'yan and
Bukayr ibn A'yan and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah Al-Ijli who said:
Abu Ja'far {a.s} and Abu Abdullah {a.s}, peace be upon them, said:
"The time of Dhuhr is after the sun has passed the meridian by two feet, and the time
of Asr is after that by two feet, and this is the beginning of the time until four feet have
passed for Asr."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.255 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.248

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ بَيْنَ الظُهْرِ وَ اَلْعَصْرِ حَدَّ
مَعْرُوفٌ فَقَالَ «لا».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far {a.s}: “Is there a known limit between Dhuhr and Asr?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.255 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.240 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.126

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ قَالَ الْفَقِيهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «آخِرُ وَقْتِ ٱلْعَصْرِ
سِتَّةُ أقْدَامٍ وَ نِصفٌ».
وأما ما روي من الاخبار التي قدمناها من أن الوقت ممتد الى غروب الشمس فمحمول على صاحب الاعذار ومن به ضرورة
تمنعه من الصلاة على ما بيناه، وعلى مثل ذلك يحمل ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Ubaydi from Sulayman ibn Ja'far who said:
Al-Faqīh (the Jurist) said: "The end of the time for Asr is six and a half feet."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary:
As for what has been narrated from the reports we have mentioned earlier, that the
time extends until the setting of the sun, it is to be understood regarding the one who
has an excuse or one who has a necessity that prevents him from praying, as we have
explained. And similar to that is to be understood what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.256 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.259 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.246 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.153

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ ٱلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنٍ
مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا يَفُوتُ الصَّلاَةُ مَنْ أَرَادَ الصَلاَةَ لا يَفُوتُ صَلاَةُ
النَّهَارٍ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ وَ لَا صَلَاَةُ اللّيْلِ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ وَ لاَ صَلاَةُ الفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ».
والذي يزيد ما ذكرناه بيانا ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Ya'qub Al-
Hashimi from Marwan ibn Muslim from Ubayd ibn Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The prayer is not missed by one who
intends to pray. The prayer of the day is not missed until the sun sets, and the prayer
of the night is not missed until the dawn rises, and the prayer of Fajr is not missed until
the sun rises."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: And what further clarifies what we have mentioned is what has been narrated:
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.355 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.256 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.260 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.273 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.602 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.289 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 9 p.363

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْعَصْرُ
عَلَى ذِرَاعَيْنِ فَمَنْ تَرَكَهَا حَتَّى تَصِيرَ عَلَى سِنَّةِ أَقْدَامٍ فَذَلِكَ الْمُضَيِّعُ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah narrated from Ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Asr is at two arm's lengths, and whoever
delays it until it reaches six feet, then he is the one who has neglected it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.256 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.259 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.234 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.152

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُتَّنِّى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «صَلَّ الْعَصْرَ عَلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ
