الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ تَكُونُ عَلَيَّ الصَّلاةُ النَّافِلَةُ مَتَى أَقْضِيهَا فَكَتَبَ «فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn
Habib who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, asking: “The supererogatory
(nafila) prayers that are due upon me, when should I make them up?”
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "At any hour you wish, whether by night or by day."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.454 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.272 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.168 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.355 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.240

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ سَيْفٍ عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ قَضَاءِ النَّوَافِلِ
قَالَ «مَا بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَى غُرُوبِهَا».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Sayf from Hassan ibn Mihran who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about making up the supererogatory
(nafila) prayers.
Imam {a.s} said: "Anytime between the rising of the sun and its setting."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.272 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.356 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.242

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ تَفُوتُنِي صَلاةُ اللَّيْلِ فَأُصَلِّي الْفَجْرَ فَلِي أَنْ أَصَلِّيَ بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ مَا فَاتَنِي
مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللِّيْلِ وَ أَنَا فِي مُصَلاَيَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ لا تُعْلِمْ بِهِ أَهْلَكَ فَيَتَّخِذُونَهُ سُنَّةً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Zur'ah from
Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, the night prayer
sometimes escapes me, so I pray Fajr, is it permissible for me to pray after the Fajr
prayer what I missed of the night prayer while I am still in my prayer place before the
sun rises?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, but do not let your family know about it, lest they take it as a
regular practice."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.272 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.356 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.244 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.274

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى
السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ مَكْثُوبَةٍ لَهَا نَافِلَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِلاَّ ٱلْعَصْرَ فَإِنَّهُ تُقَدَّمُ نَافِلَتُهَا
فَيَصِيرَانٍ قَبْلَهَا وَ هِيَ الرّكْعَتَانِ اللّتَانِ تَمْثَ بِهِمَا الثَمَانِي بَعْدَ ٱلظُهْرِ فَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَقْضِيَ شَيْئاً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ مَكْتُوبَةً
أَوْ غَيْرَهَا فَلا تُصَلَّ شَيْئاً حَتَّى تَبْدَأَ فَتُصَلِّيَ قَبْلَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ آلَّتِي حَضَّرَتْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ نَافِلَةً لَهَا ثُمَّ اِقْضِ مَا سِئْتَ - وَ
اِبْدَأُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ بِالْآيَاتِ تَقْرَأ «إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ» إلَى «إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ» وَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
تَبْدَأُ بِالْآيَاتِ قَبْلَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الزَّوَالِ» - وَ قَالَ «وَقْتُ صَلاةِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ إِذَا زَالَتِ ٱلشَمْسُ شِرَاكْ أَوْ نِصْفٌ»
وَقَالَ «لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الزَّوَالَ مَا بَيْنَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَى أَنْ يَمْضِيَ قَدَمَانٍ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ بَقِيَ مِنَ الزَّوَالِ رَكْعَةٌ
وَاجِدَةً أَوْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْضِيَ قَدَمَانِ أَتَمّ الصَّلاةَ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ تَمَامَ الرَّكَعَاتِ وَ إِنْ مَضَى قَدَمَانِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَةً
بَدَأَ بِالْأُولَى وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ الزَّوَالَ إِلَّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ مِنْ نَوَافِلِ الْأُولَى مَا بَيْنَ الْأُولَى إِلَى أَنْ يَمْضِيَ
أَرْبَعَةُ أَقْدَامٍ فَإِنْ مَضَّتِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ أَقْدَامٍ وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ شَيْئاً فَلاَ يُصَلِّي النَّوَافِلَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ صَلَّى رَكْعَةً
فَلْيُتِمَّ النَّوَافِلَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ» وَ قَالَ «لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ إِنْ بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ صَلَاَةِ الزَّوَالِ
إِلَى أَنْ يَمْضِيَ بَعْدَ حُضُورِ الْأُولَى نِصْفُ قَدَمِ وَ لِلرَّجُلِ إِذَا كَانَ قَدْ صَلِّى مِنْ نَوَافِلِ الْأُولَى شَيْئاً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْضُرَ
الْعَضْرُ فَلَهُ أَنْ يُتِمَّ نَوَافِلَ الْأُولَى إِلَى أَنْ يَمْضِيَ بَعْدَ حُضُورِ الْعَصْرِ قَدَمْ» وَ قَالَ «ٱلْقَدَمُ بَعْدَ حُضُورِ الْعَصْرِ مِثْلُ
نِصْفِ قَدَمٍ بَعْدَ حُضُورِ الْأُولَى فِي الْوَقْتِ سَوَاءَ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةُ لَيَالٍ كَثِيرَةِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ
يَقْضِيَ صَلاةَ لَيَالٍ كَثِيرَةِ بِأَوْتَارِهَا يُثْبِعُ بَعْضُهَا بَعضاً قَالَ « نَعَمْ كَذَلِكَ لَهُ فِي أَوْلِ اللَّيْلِ وَ أَمْا إِذَا اِنْتَصَفَ إِلَى أَنْ
يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ فَلَيْسَ لِلرَّجُلِ وَ لا لِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ يُوتِرَ إِلاَّ وَثْرَ صَلاةِ تِلْكَ اللِّيْلَةِ فَإِنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ صَلاَةً عَلَيْهِ صَلَّى
ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنْ صَلاَةِ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ وَ أَخَرَ الْوَثْرَ ثُمَّ يَقْضِي مَا بَدَا لَهُ بِلاَ وَثْرِ ثُمَّ يُوتِرُ الْوَثْرَ الَّذِي لِتِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ خَاصَّةً»
وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً فِي الْحَضَرِ هَلْ يَقْضِيهَا وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ قَالَ «نَعَمْ يَقْضِيهَا بِاللَّيْلِ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَمًا
عَلَى الظَّهْرِ فَلَا وَ يُصَلِّي كَمَا يُصَلِّي فِي الْحَضَّرِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "For every obligatory prayer there are two
rak'ahs of supererogatory prayer except for Asr, for its supererogatory prayer is
performed beforehand, thus they become two rak'ahs before it, and they are the two
rak'ahs that complete the eight rak'ahs after Dhuhr. So if you want to make up any
prayer, obligatory or other than it, do not pray anything until you first perform two
rak'ahs of supererogatory prayer before the obligatory prayer that has arrived, then
make up whatever you wish.
And begin the night prayer with the verses: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and
the earth...’ until ‘Indeed, You do not fail in (Your) promise’ (Surah Aali Imran 3:190-
194). And on the day of Friday, you begin with the verses before the two rak'ahs before
the zenith (zawal).
And Imam {a.s} said: 'The time for the Friday prayer is when the sun has passed its zenith,
by the measure of a strap (shiraak) or half of it.'
And Imam {a.s} said: 'It is permissible for a man to pray at zawal from the time the sun
has passed its zenith until two footsteps (qadaman) have passed. So if there remains
time after the zenith for one rak‘ah or before two footsteps have passed, he should
complete the prayer until he finishes the full rak‘ahs. But if two footsteps have passed
before he prays one rak‘ah, then he should begin with the first (obligatory prayer) and
not pray the zawal supererogatory prayer except after that.
And it is permissible for a man to pray the supererogatory prayers of the first (part of
the day) from the beginning of the first until four footsteps have passed. If the four
footsteps pass and he has not prayed anything from the supererogatory prayers, then
he should not pray the supererogatory prayers. But if he has prayed one rak‘ah, then
he should complete the supererogatory prayers until he finishes them, then he should
pray the Asr prayer."
And Imam {a.s} said: "It is permissible for a man to pray if there remains something from
the prayer of the zenith (zawal) until half a foot has passed after the arrival of Dhuhr.
And if a man has already prayed something from the supererogatory prayers of Dhuhr
before Asr arrives, it is permissible for him to complete the supererogatory prayers of
Dhuhr until a foot has passed after the arrival of Asr."
And Imam {a.s} said: "A footstep after the arrival of Asr is like half a footstep after the
arrival of Dhuhr, they are the same in terms of time."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding a man upon whom are many missed night prayers;
is it permissible for him to make up the prayers of many nights along with their witr,
following one after the other?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it is permissible for him to do so at the beginning of the night. But
if half the night has passed until the rising of Fajr, then neither a man nor a woman is
to perform witr except the witr of that specific night. And if he wishes to make up a
missed prayer, then let him pray eight rak‘ahs from the prayer of that night and delay
the witr, then make up whatever he wishes without witr, then pray the witr of that
specific night alone."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding a man upon whom is a missed prayer from the
time of being present (hadar), is it permissible for him to make it up while traveling?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, he may make it up at night on the ground. As for on the back of a
mount, then no. And he should pray it as he would pray it in the state of presence
(hadar)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.273

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْكَ وَثْرَانٍ
أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٌ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَاقْضِ ذَلِكَ كَمَا فَاتَكَ تَفْصِلُ بَيْنَ كُلَّ وَتَرَيْنِ بِصَلاَةٍ لاَ تُقَدِّمَنَّ شَيْئا قَبْلَ أَوّلِهِ الْأَوَّلَ
فَالْأَوَّلَ تَبْدَأُ إِذَا أَنْتَ قَضَيْتَ صَلَاَةَ لَيْلَتِكَ ثُمَّ الْوَثْرَ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لاَ وَثْرَانٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ إِلاَّ وَ
أَحَدُهُمَا قَضَاء» وَ قَالَ «إِنْ أَوْتَرْتَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ وَ قُمْتَ فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ فَوَثْرُكَ الْأَوَّلُ قَضَاءُ وَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ مِنْ صَلاّةٍ
فِي لَيْلَتِكَ كُلَّهَا فَلْيَكُنْ قَضَاءَ إِلَى آخِرٍ صَلاَتِكَ فَإِنَّهَا لِلَيْلَتِكَ وَ لَيَكُنْ آخِرُ صَلاَتِكَ وَثْرَ لَيْلَتِكَ».
english_text:
Ali narrated from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "If two witr prayers, or three, or more than that
have accumulated upon you, then make them up in the same order in which you
missed them. Separate between each two witr prayers with a (supererogatory) prayer.
Do not perform anything before the first one. The first, then the first, you begin by
making up the prayer of your own night, then the witr."
He said, and Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him, also said: "There are not two Witrs in
one night except that one of them is a makeup."
And Imam {a.s} said: "If you performed Witr at the beginning of the night and then you
rise at the end of the night, then your first Witr is a makeup. And whatever you have
prayed from the prayers during your entire night, let them be considered as makeup
until the end of your prayers, for they are for your night. And let the last of your prayers
be the Witr of your night."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.453 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1036 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.166

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السْلاَمُ قَالَ:
«لا تَقْضٍ وَثْرَ لَيْلَتِكَ إنْ كَانَ فَاتَكَ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ الزَّوَالَ فِي يَوْمِ الْعِيدَيْنِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Abbas from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Do not make up the Witr of your night if you have
missed it until after you have prayed the prayer of the zenith (zawal) on the day of the
two Eids."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.509 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1299 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.428 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.430 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.271

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُمِّيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقْضِي عِشرِينَ وَثراً فِي لَيْلَةٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira, from Hariz, from Isa ibn Abdullah Al-Qummi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to
make up twenty Witrs in one night."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.453 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.274 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.166 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.271 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 9 p.216

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ
عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْوَثْرِ وَ
يَنْسَى الثَّالِئَةَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ قَالَ «يُوتِرُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ بِرَكْعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَتِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini,
from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays two rak'ahs of the Witr and forgets the third
until morning comes.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform the Witr when he wakes up with one rak'ah
immediately."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1026 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.271

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
سعد عن موسى بن جعفر بن أبي جعفر عن محمد بن عبد الجبار عن ميمون عن محمد بن الفرج قال : كتبت
الى العبد الصالح عليه السلام اسأله عن مسائل فكتب إلي : وصل بعد العصر من النوافل ما شئت وصل بعد
الغداة من النوافل ما شئت.
english_text:
Sa'd narrated from Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Abi Ja'far from Muhammad ibn Abdul-Jabbar from Maymun from
Muhammad ibn Al-Faraj who said:
I wrote to the Righteous servant (Abd al Salih {a.s}), peace be upon him, asking Imam {a.s}
about some matters.
Imam {a.s} wrote back to me: "Pray after Asr from the supererogatory prayers as much
as you wish, and pray after Fajr from the supererogatory prayers as much as you wish."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
فأما ما رواه أحمد بن محمد عن سعد بن إسماعيل عن أبيه اسماعيل بن عيسى قال سألت الرضا عليه السلام
عن الرجل يصلي الاولى ثم يتنفل فيدركه وقت العصر من قبل أن يفرغ من نافلته فيبطى بالعصر يقضي
نافلته أو يصليها بعد العصر أو يؤخرها حتى يصليها في وقت آخر؟ قال : يصلي العصر ويقضي نافلته في يوم
آخر
فالوجه في هذا الخبر انه إذا صلى في آخر وقت فيكون قد قارب غيبوبة الشمس وذلك وقت يكره فيه الصلاة على ما
بيناه في أكثر الروايات فالافضل أن يؤخرها فيقضيها في وقت آخر.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sa'd ibn Isma'il from his father Isma'il ibn Isa who
said:
I asked (Imam) Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, about a man who prays the Dhuhr prayer
and then engages in supererogatory prayers, but the time for Asr comes before he
completes his supererogatory prayers. Should he delay the Asr prayer in order to
complete his supererogatory prayers, or should he pray the Asr and then complete the
supererogatory prayers after Asr, or should he delay them until another time?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should pray the Asr and make up his supererogatory prayers on
another day."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
The explanation for this narration is that if he prayed at the end of the time (for Dhuhr),
he would be close to the setting of the sun, and that is a time in which prayer is disliked,
as we have explained in many narrations. Therefore, it is preferable for him to delay it
and make it up at another time.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ ٱلْعَابِدِ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ »وَ هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱللَّيْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرادَ أَنْ
يَذَّكَّرَ أوْ أَرادَ شُكُوراً» قَالَ «قَضَاءُ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ قَضَاءُ صَلاةِ ٱلنَّهَارِ بِاللّيْلِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Mansur
ibn Yunus from Anbasa Al-Abid who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the saying of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, "And He it is Who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever
desires to remember or desires gratitude." (Surah Furqan 25:62)
Imam {a.s} said: "Making up the prayer of the night during the day, and making up the
prayer of the day during the night."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1027 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.275 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.4 p.145 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.293

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ تَجْتَمِعُ عَلَيَّ قَالَ «تَحَرَّ وَ اقْضِهَا».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribaat, from
Isma'il ibn Jabir, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about (abundance of) prayers that have accumulated upon me.
Imam {a.s} said: "Make an effort and make them up."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1024 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.78

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ
يَجْتَمِعُ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ قَالَ «أَلْقِهَا وَ اِسْتَأْنِف».
قال محمد بن الحسن : لا تنافي بين الخبرين لانه يحتمل أن يكون الخبر الاول مخصوصا بالفرائض فيجب أن يتحرى
ويقضي ويكون الخبر الثاني مخصوصا بالنوافل فيجوز له تركها ، ولو حملناهما جميعا على النوافل لجاز أن يحمل الخبر
الاول على الاستحباب والثاني على الجواز.
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribaat, from Ibn Maskan who said:
Someone who asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, narrated to me about a man
upon whom prayers have accumulated.
Imam {a.s} said: "Abandon it and start anew."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “There is no contradiction between the two narrations
because it is possible that the first narration is specific to the obligatory prayers, thus
it is necessary to make an effort and make them up, and that the second narration is
specific to the supererogatory prayers, for which it is permissible to abandon them.
And if we were to apply both narrations to the supererogatory prayers, it would be
possible to interpret the first narration as indicating recommendation and the second
as indicating permissibility.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.276

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ حَزِيرَانَ عَلَى
بَصْفِ قَدَمٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ تَمُوزَ عَلَى قَدَمٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ آبَ عَلَى قَدَمَيْنِ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ
مِنْ أَيْلُولَ عَلَى ثَلاَثَةِ أَقْدَامٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ تِشْرِينَ الْأَوَّلِ عَلَى خَمْسَةٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ تِشْرِينَ
اَلْآخِرِ عَلَى سَبْعَةٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ كَانُونَ الْأَوَّلِ عَلَى تِسْعَةٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ كَانُونَ اَلْآخِرِ عَلَى
سَبْعَةٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ شُبَاطَ عَلَى خَمْسَةٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ آذَارَ عَلَى ثَلاَثَةٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي
النَّصْفِ مِنْ نَيْسَانَ عَلَى قَدَمَيْنٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ أيَّارَ عَلَى قَدَمٍ وَ نِصْفٍ وَ فِي النَّصْفِ مِنْ حَزِيرَانَ عَلَى
نِصْفٍ قَدَمٍ».
english_text:
Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The sun passes the zenith (zawal) in the
middle of Haziran (June) at half a foot, and in the middle of Tammuz (July) at one and a
half feet, and in the middle of Ab (August) at two and a half feet, and in the middle of
Aylul (September) at three and a half feet, and in the middle of Tishrin Al-Awwal
(October) at five and a half feet, and in the middle of Tishrin Al-Akhir (November) at
seven and a half feet, and in the middle of Kanun Al-Awwal (December) at nine and a
half feet, and in the middle of Kanun Al-Akhir (January) at seven and a half feet, and in
the middle of Shubat (February) at five and a half feet, and in the middle of Adhar
(March) at three and a half feet, and in the middle of Nisan (April) at two and a half feet,
and in the middle of Ayyar (May) at one and a half feet, and in the middle of Haziran
(June) at half a foot."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.223 • Al-Khisal, Vol.2 p.460 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.276 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.4 p.256 • Al-’Adad Al-Qawiyyah, Vol.1 p.154 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.250 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.163 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 9 p.365

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «مَنْ نَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الْعَتَمَةَ فَلَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ حَتَّى يَمْضِيَ نِصْفُ اللِّيْلِ فَلْيَقْضِ صَلاَتَهُ وَ لَيَسْتَغْفِرِ
الله».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahboub from Al-Abbas from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan, who raised
it to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever sleeps before performing the night prayer (al-’atama) and
does not wake up until half the night has passed, then he should make up his prayer
and seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT}."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.276 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1006 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.185 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.215

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER TIMES (MAWAQIT)
arabic_text:
عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَتَى مَا اِسْتَيْقَنْتَ
أَوْ شَكَكْتَ فِي وَقْتِ صَلاَةِ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلَّهَا أَوْ فِي وَقْتِ فَوْتِهَا صَلّيْتَهَا فَإِنْ شَكَكْتَ بَعْدَ مَا خَرَجَ وَقْتُ ٱلْفَوْتِ فَقَدْ
دَخَلَ حَائِلٌ فَلا إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَكّ حَتَّى تَسْتَيْقِنَ فَإِنِ اِسْتَيْقَئْتَ فَعَلَيْكَ إِعَادَةُ أَنْ تُصَلَّيَهَا فِي أَيِّ حَالٍ كُثْتَ».
١٤ - باب الاذان والاقامة
english_text:
Ali from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah and Al-Fudhayl:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Whenever you become certain or you doubt
within the time of the prayer that you have not prayed it, or within the time of its
expiration you pray it.
But if you doubt after the time of expiration has passed, then a barrier has entered, and
there is no re-praying upon you due to doubt unless you become certain. If you
become certain, then it is upon you to re-pray it, no matter what state you are in."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.276 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.282 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.71

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلامُ قَالَ: «لَمَا هَبَطَ
جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ بِالْأَذَانِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلِّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ رَأْسُهُ فِي حَجْرٍ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَأَذَّنَ
جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ أَقَامَ فَلَمَا اِنْتَبَهَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ «يَا عَلِيٌ سَمِعْتَ» قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ
«حَفِظُتَ» قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ «أدعُ بِلالا فَعَلَّمْهُ» فَدَعَا عَلِيٌ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ بِلاَلا فَعَلَّمَهُ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Mansur:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When Jibrail {a.s}, peace be upon him,
descended with the Adhan to the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family, the Messenger’s head was in the lap of (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him.
Jibrail, peace be upon him, made the call to prayer and established it.
When the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, awoke, He {saws}
said: 'O Ali, did you hear it?'
He (Imam Ali {a.s}) said: 'Yes.'
He {Prophet {saws} said: 'Did you memorize it?'
He (Imam Ali {a.s}) said: 'Yes.'
He {Prophet {saws} said: 'Call Bilal and teach him.'
So (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, called Bilal and taught him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.302 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.282 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.277 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.313 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.2 p.238 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.558 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.369 • Ithbat Al-Huda, Vol.1 p.186 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 0 p.62

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْتَهِي إِلَى
الْإِمَامٍ جِينَ يُسَلَّمُ فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ الْأَذَانَ فَلْيَدْخُلْ مَعَهُمْ فِي أَذَانِهِمْ فَإِنْ وَجَدَهُمْ قَدْ تَفَرَّقُوا أَعَادَ
اَلْأَذَانَ».
english_text:
Ali from his father, from Khalid ibn Sa'id, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who reaches the imam (of prayer) while he is giving the
salutation (at the end of prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not upon him to repeat the Adhan; rather, he should enter with
them with their Adhan. But if he finds that they have dispersed, he must repeat Adhan."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.304 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.277 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.606 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.429

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ
السَّابَاطِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنِ الْأَذَانِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عَارِفٍ قَالَ « لا يَسْتَقِيمُ
الْأَذَانُ وَلا يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ بِهِ إِلَّ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ عَارِفٌ فَإِنْ عَلِمَ الْأَذَانَ فَأَذِّنَّ بِهِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَارِفاً لَمْ يُجْزِ أَذَانُهُ وَ لا
إقَامَتُهُ وَ لاَ يُقْتَدَى بِهِ» وَ سُئِلَ عَنِ الرَجُلِ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ لِيُصَلِّيَ وَحْدَهُ فَيَجِيءُ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ تُصَلِّي جَمَاعَةً
هَلْ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَا بِذَلِكَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ قَالَ «لاَ وَ لَكِنْ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam {a.s} was asked about the Adhan, whether it is permissible for it to be performed
by someone who is not knowledgeable.
Imam {a.s} said: "The Adhan is not correct, and it is not permissible for anyone to
perform it except a Muslim man who is knowledgeable. So if he knows the Adhan and
performs it but is not knowledgeable, his Adhan and Iqamah are not sufficient, and he
is not to be followed."
And Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who gives the Adhan and the Iqamah to pray
alone, then another man comes and says to him, 'Will you pray in congregation?' Is it
permissible for them to pray with that Adhan and Iqamah?
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but he must give a new Adhan and Iqamah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.304 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.277

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى الْأذَانَ وَ الْإِقَامَةَ حَتَّى يَدْخلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ
فَلْيُصَلّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ لَيُقِمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ قَرَأَ فَلْيُتِمَ صَلاَتَهُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ismail from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan from Al-Ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn
Muslim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who forgets the Adhan and
the Iqamah until he enters into the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he remembers before he recites (the Qur'an), then he should send
blessings upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, and give the
Iqamah. But if he has already recited, then he should complete his prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.305 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.278 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.619 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.434

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِفْتَتَحْتَ الصَّلاةَ فَنَسِيتَ أَنْ تُؤَذِّنَ وَ تُقِيمَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ فَانْصَرِفَ فَأَذِّنْ وَ أَقِمْ
وَ اِسْتَفْتِحِ الصَّلاةَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ رَكَفْتَ فَأَتِمَ عَلَى صَلاتِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Nu'man from Sa'id Al-A'raj and Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-
Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you begin the prayer and forget to give
the Adhan and the Iqamah, then remember before you bow (for Ruku'), then break off,
give the Adhan and the Iqamah, and begin the prayer anew. But if you have already
bowed, then complete your prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.278 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.620 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.434

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ آدَمَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ الْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ حَسَانَ آلدَّ الآَنِيّ
عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ آدَمَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ كُنْتُ فِي صَلاَتِي فَذَكَرْتُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ
الثَّانِيَةِ وَ أَنَا فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ أَنَّي لَمْ أَقِمْ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ قَالَ «أسْكُتْ مَوْضِعَ قِرَاءَتِكَ وَ قُلْ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاةُ قَدْ قَامَتِ
الصَّلاَةُ ثُمَّ امْضٍ فِي قِرَاءَتِكَ وَ صَلاَتِكَ وَ قَدْ تَمَّثْ صَلاَتُكَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ishaq ibn Adam from Abu Al-Abbas
Al-Mufaddal ibn Hassan Al-Dallani from Zakariya ibn Adam who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, I was
in my prayer and during the second rak'ah while I was reciting, I remembered that I had
not given the Iqamah. What should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Fall silent in the place of your recitation and say, 'Qad qamati al-salah,
qad qamati al-salah' (The prayer has been established, the prayer has been
established), then continue in your recitation and your prayer, and your prayer will be
complete."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.278 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.619 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.435

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلتُهُ عَنِ
الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَفْتِحُ صَلَاةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُقِمْ قَالَ «فَإِنْ ذَكَرَ أَنْهُ لَمْ يُقِمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فَلْيُسَلَّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ
صَلِّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ثُمَّ يُقِيمُ وَ يُصَلِّي وَ إِنْ ذَكَرَ بَعْدَ مَا قَرَأَ بَعْضَ السُّورَةِ فَلْيُتِمَّ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الاخبار كلها محمولة على الاستحباب لانه إذا استفتح الصلاة فالاصل انه يجوز له المضي فيها
وليس عليه الانصراف ، والذي يبين ما ذكرناه ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Husayn ibn Abi Al-A'la, from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who begins the obligatory prayer and then remembers
that he did not give the Iqamah.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he remembers that he did not give the Iqamah before he recites, then
he should send blessings upon the Prophet (may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family),
then give the Iqamah and pray. But if he remembers after he has recited part of the
Surah, then he should complete his prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “All these narrations are to be understood as
recommending (the act) out of desirability, because once he begins the prayer, the
principle is that it is permissible for him to proceed in it and it is not obligatory upon
him to break it off.” What clarifies what we have mentioned is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.278 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.619 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.435

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْخَطَابِ عَنِ اِبْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَنْسَى الْأَذَانَ وَ الْإِقَامَةَ حَتَى يُكَبِّرَ قَالَ «يَمْضِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَ لاَ يُعِيدُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Salamah ibn Al-Khattab from Ibn Jabalah from Ibn Bukayr from Zurarah
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man forgets the Adhan and the Iqamah until he has said the
Takbir.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should proceed with his prayer and not repeat it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.279 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.302 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.620 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.436

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ نُعْمَانَ الرَّازِيِّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ وَ سَأَلَهُ
أُبُو عُبَيْدَةَ اَلْحَذَّاءُ عَنْ حَدِيثِ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ وَ يُقِيمَ حَتَّى كَبَّرَ وَ دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ دَخَلَ
الْمَسْجِدَ وَ مِنْ نِيَّتِهِ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ وَ يُقِيمَ فَليمْضِ فِي صَلاتِهِ وَلا يَنصرِف».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Nu'man Al-Razi who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and Abu Ubaydah Al-Hadhdha’ asked him
about the narration of a man who forgot to give the Adhan and the Iqamah until he said
the Takbir and entered into the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he entered the mosque with the intention to give the Adhan and the
Iqamah, then he should proceed with his prayer and not break it off."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.279 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.621 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.436

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي الصَّبَّاحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ
نَسِيَ الْأَذَانَ حَتَّى صَلَّى قَالَ «لا يُعِيدُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl from Abu Al-Sabbah from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who forgot the Adhan until he completed the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He does not repeat (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.279 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.621 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.433

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى اِنْصَرَفَ يُعِيدُ صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ «لاَ يُعِيدُهَا وَ لاَ يَعُودُ لِمِثلِهَا».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Shu'ayb ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Basir, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who forgot to give the Iqamah for the prayer until he
finished it. Should he repeat his prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "He does not repeat it, and he should not return to do the like of it
again."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.279 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.621 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.433

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يُقِيمَ الصَّلاةَ وَ قَدِ اِفْتَتَحَ الصِّلاةَ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ
فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَثُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ فَلْيُعِدْ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: وهذا الخبر أيضا محمول على الاستحباب بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-
Husayn from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who forgets to give the
Iqamah and has already begun the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he has completed his prayer, then his prayer is complete; but if he
has not completed his prayer, then he must repeat it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “And this narration as well is to be understood as
recommending (the act) out of desirability, based on the indication of the narrations
we have presented earlier.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.279 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.622 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.433

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «الْأَذَانُ وَ الْإِقَامَةُ مَثنَى
مَثْنَى» وَ قَالَ «إِذَا أَقَامَ مَثْنَى مَثنَّى وَ لَمْ يُؤَذِّنْ أَجْزَأَهُ فِي الصَّلاةِ ٱلْمَكْثُوبَةِ وَ مَنْ أَقَامَ الصَّلاَةَ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً وَ
لَمْ يُؤْذِّنْ لَمْ يُجْزِهِ إِلاَّ بِأَذَانِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ya'qub from Abu Hammam:
Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Adhan and the Iqamah are to be said
twice, twice."
And Imam {a.s} said: "If he gives the Iqamah twice, twice, and does not give the Adhan,
it suffices for him in the obligatory prayer. But whoever gives the Iqamah once, once,
and does not give the Adhan, it does not suffice for him except with an Adhan."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.582 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.423

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَذّنَ
مُؤَذِّنٍ فَنَقَصَ الْأَذَانَ وَ أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ بِأذَانِهِ فَأْتِمَ مَا نَقَصَ هُوَ مِنْ أَذَانِهِ وَ لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ ٱلْغُلاَمُ اَلَّذِي لَمْ
يَحْتَلِمْ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira, from Ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a Mu'adhdhin gives the Adhan and he
leaves something out of the Adhan, and you wish to pray with his Adhan, then
complete what he left out from his Adhan, and there is no problem if a boy who has
not yet reached puberty gives the Adhan."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.280

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ ٱلْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا
أَبُو جَغْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي قَمِيص بِلاَ إِزَارٍ وَ لا رِدَاءٍ وَ لا أَذَانٍ وَ لا إِقَامَةٍ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قُلْتُ لَهُ عَافَاكَ آَللَّهُ صَلَّيْتَ
بِنَا فِي قَمِيصٍ بِلا إِزَارٍ وَ لا رِدَاءٍ وَ لا أَذَانٍ وَ لا إِقَامَةٍ فَقَالَ «إنَّ قَمِيصِي كَثِيفَ فَهُوَ يُجْزِي أَنْ لا يَكُونَ عَلَيَّ إِذَارٌ
وَلَاَ رِدَاءُ وَ إِنِّي مَرَزْتُ بِجَعْفَرٍ وَ هُوَ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ فَلَمْ أَتَكَلَّمْ فَأَجْزَ أَنِي ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Abu
Maryam Al-Ansari who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, led us in prayer wearing only a shirt, without an izar
(lower garment) and without a Ridha' (upper garment), and without Adhan and without
Iqamah.
When Imam {a.s} finished, I said to Him {a.s}: “May Allah {SWT} grant you wellbeing, you
prayed with us in a shirt without an izar and without a Ridha', and without Adhan and
without Iqamah”.
Imam {a.s} said: "My shirt is thick, so it suffices that I do not have an izar or a Ridha', and
I passed by Ja'far while he was giving the Adhan and the Iqamah, and I did not speak,
so that sufficed for me."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.610 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 9 p.229

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَوْ سَمِغْتُهُ يَقُولُ «إِذَا نَسِيَ الرَّجُلُ حَرْفَاً مِنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ حَتَّى يَأْخَذَ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ فَلْيَمْضٍ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ فَلَيْسَ
عَلَيْهِ شَيْءً فَإنْ نَسِيَ حَرْفا مِنَ الْإِقَامَةِ عَادَ إِلَى الْحَرْفِ الَذِي نَسِيَهُ» ثُمَّ يَقُولُ «مِنْ ذَلِكَ ٱلْمَوْضِعِ إِلَى آخِرِ الإِقامَةِ»
وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَفْصِلَ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الإقَامَةِ بِشَيْءٍ حَتّى أَخَذَ فِي الصَّلاةِ أَوْ أَقَامَ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ
شَيء وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَدَعَ ذَلِكَ عَمْدا» ثُمَّ سُئِلَ مَا الَّذِي يُجْزِي مِنَ التَّسْبِيحِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الإِقَامَةِ قَالَ «يَقُولُ الْحَمْدُ
لِلَّهِ».
٧٥٥٥٣-٨١
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar Al-
Sabati who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, or I heard Him {a.s} say:
"If a man forgets a word from the Adhan until he begins the Iqamah, then he should
continue with the Iqamah and there is nothing upon him. But if he forgets a word from
the Iqamah, he must return to the word which he forgot,"
Then Imam {a.s} said, "from that place to the end of the Iqamah."
(Imam {a.s} was asked) about a man who forgets to separate between the Adhan and
the Iqamah with something until he begins the prayer or establishes the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is nothing upon him, but he should not intentionally abandon
Then Imam {a.s} was asked: “What suffices as Tasbih between the Adhan and the
Iqamah?”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should say: Alhamdulillah (All praise is due to Allah {SWT})."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.280

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَريزٍ عَنْ زرارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الله عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «مَنْ سَهَا فِي الْأَذَانِ فَقَدَّمَ أَوْ
أَخَرَ أَعَادَ عَلَى الْأَوِّلِ الَّذِي أَخْرَهُ حَتَّى يَمْضِيَ عَلَى آخِرِهِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever makes a mistake in the Adhan
and advances or delays (a part of it), he must return to the first part which he delayed
and then proceed to the end of it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.622 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.441

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلَ
الرَّجُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَ هُوَ لا يَأْتَمُ بِصَاحِبِهِ وَ قَدْ بَقِي عَلَى الْإِمَامِ آيَةٌ أَوْ آيَتَانٍ فَخَشِيَ إنْ هُوَ أَذَّنَ وَ أَقَامَ أَنْ يَزْكَعَ
فَلْيَقُلْ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَ لَيَدْخُلْ فِي الصَّلاةِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub from Mu'adh ibn Kathir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man enters the mosque and he is not
following the one leading the prayer, and only one or two verses remain for the Imam
(to complete the prayer), and he fears that if he gives the Adhan and the Iqamah, the
Imam will bow (for Ruku'), then he should say: 'Qad qamati al-salah, qad qamati al-
salah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah,' and then enter into the prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.306 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.582 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.443 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.110

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ بَعْضٍ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ : أَنَّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَانَ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ غَيْرُهُ وَ كَانَ يُقِيمُ
وَ قَدْ أَذَّنَ غَيْرُهُ.
english_text:
From him, from some of our companions, from Isma'il ibn Jabir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, would give the Adhan while someone else would
give the Iqamah, and Imam {a.s} would give the Iqamah after someone else had given
the Adhan.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.306 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.600 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.438 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.160

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ
النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَ بِلاَلْ يُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ جَلَسَ ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Barqi from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni from (Imam) Ja'far {a.s} from his father
{a.s} from his forefathers {a.s} from (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
"The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, when He {saws} would enter
the mosque and Bilal was giving the Iqamah for the prayer, He {saws} would sit down."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.600 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.438

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدِ
عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: دَخَلَ رَجْلانِ الْمَسْجِدَ وَ قَدْ صَلَّى النَّاسُ فَقَالَ لَهُمَا عَلِيَّ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنْ شِئْتُمَا فَلْيَوُمَّ أَحَدُكُمَا صَاحِبَهُ وَ لا يُؤَذِّنُ وَ لا يُقِيمُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Al-Husayn ibn
Alwan from Amr ibn Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali from his forefathers from (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Two men entered the mosque after the people had already prayed, so (Imam) Ali {a.s},
peace be upon him, said to them: "If you wish, let one of you lead the other in prayer,
and there is no need for Adhan or Iqamah."
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.281 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.56 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.80 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.607 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.430 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.415 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.46

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ الرَّجُلُ يَدْخُلُ
ٱلْمَسْجِدَ وَ قَدْ صَلَّى الْقَوْمُ أَيُوَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ دَخَلَ وَ لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقِ الصَّفُ صَلَّى بِأَذَانِهِمْ وَ إِقَامَتِهِمْ وَ إِنْ
كَانَ تَفَرَّقَ الصَّفُ أَذْنَ وَ أَقَامَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Aban from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
I asked: “A man enters the mosque and the people have already prayed; should he give
the Adhan and the Iqamah?”
Imam {a.s} said: "If he enters and the rows have not dispersed, he should pray with their
Adhan and Iqamah. But if the rows have dispersed, he must give the Adhan and the
Iqamah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.607 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.430 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.414

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدَّهِ
عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْمُؤَذَّنُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ وَ الإِمَامُ ضَامِنْ».
english_text:
Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah from Isa ibn
Abdullah Al-Hashimi from his father from his grandfather:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Mu'adhdhin is entrusted, and the Imam
is responsible."
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.282 • Shihab Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.74 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.617 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.378

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلسُنَّةُ فِي
الأَذَانٍ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ أَنْ يُوَذِّنَ وَ يُقِيمَ الظُهْرَ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّيَ ثُمَّ يَقُومَ فَيُقِيمَ لِلْعَصْرِ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ وَ كَذَلِكَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ وَ
الْعِشَاءِ بِمُزْدَلِفَةً ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira, from Ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Sunnah regarding the Adhan on the
Day of Arafah is that the Adhan and Iqamah should be given for Dhuhr, then he should
pray, then he should stand and give the Iqamah for Asr without a new Adhan, and
likewise for Maghrib and Isha at Muzdalifah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.610 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.445

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ
السَّابَاطِيّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ يَقُولُ: «لا بُدَ لِلْمَرِيضِ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ وَ يُقِيمَ إِذَا أَرَادَ الصَّلاةَ وَ لَوْ فِي
نَفْسِهِ إِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ بِهِ» سُئِلَ فَإِنْ كَانَ شَدِيدَ الْوَجَعِ قَالَ «لا بُدَّ مِنْ أَنْ يُؤَذِنَ وَ يُقِيمَ لِأَنَّهُ لاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاّا
بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَةٍ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "It is necessary for the sick person
to give the Adhan and the Iqamah when he wishes to pray, even if it is within himself if
he is not able to speak them."
Imam {a.s} was asked: “And if he is in intense pain?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It is still necessary for him to give the Adhan and the Iqamah, because
there is no prayer without Adhan and Iqamah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.282 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.300 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.609 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.444 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.130

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ تَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةُ الصَّلاةِ أَيُعِيدُهَا بِأَذَانِ
وَ إقَامَةٍ فَكَتَبَ «يُعِيدُهَا بِإِقَامَةٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Isa who said:
I wrote to Imam {a.s}: “A man upon whom it is obligatory to repeat the prayer, does he
repeat it with Adhan and Iqamah?”
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "He repeats it with Iqamah."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.446 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.166

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ الشَّيْبَانِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أُوَذِّنُ وَ أَنَا رَاكِبٌ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَأَقِيمُ وَ أَنَا رَاكِبٌ قَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ وَ أَقِيمُ وَ رِجْلِي فِي
الرِّكَابٍ قَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ فَأْقِيمُ وَ أَنَا قَاعِدٌ قَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ فَأَقِيمُ وَ أَنَا مَاشٍ قَالَ «نَعَمْ مَاشٍ إلَى الصَّلاَةِ» قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ
«إِذَا أَقَمْتَ الصَّلاةَ فَأَقِمْ مُتَرَسِّلاً فَإِنَّكَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ قَدْ سَأَلْثُكَ أَقِيمُ وَ أَنَا مَاشِ قُلْتَ لِي نَعَمْ فَيَجُوزُ أَنْ
أَمْشِيَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مِنْ بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَكَبَّرْتَ وَ أَنْتَ مَعَ إِمَامِ عَادِلٍ ثُمَّ مَشَيْتَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ
أَجْزَأَكَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِذَا كَانَ الْإِمَامُ كَبَّرَ لِلرُّكُوعِ كُنْتَ مَعَهُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ لِأَنَّهُ إِنْ أَدْرَكْتَهُ وَ هُوَ رَاكِعٌ لَمْ تُدْرِكِ التَّكْبِيرَ لَمْ تَكُنْ
مَعَهُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Yunus
Al-Shaybani, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “Should I give the Adhan while riding?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: “Then should I give the Iqamah while riding?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
I asked: “Should I give the Iqamah while my foot is in the stirrup?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
I asked: “Should I give the Iqamah while sitting?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
I asked: “Should I give the Iqamah while walking?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, while walking towards the prayer."
Imam {a.s} then said: "When you give the Iqamah for prayer, give it calmly, for you are in
the prayer."
I asked: “I had asked you if I could give the Iqamah while walking, and you said yes. So
is it permissible for me to walk during the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, if you enter through the door of the mosque and you say the Takbir
while following a just Imam, then walk to the prayer, that suffices for you. And if the
Imam (of prayer) has already said the Takbir for Ruku', you will catch up with him in the
rak'ah, because if you find him while he is bowing and you did not catch the Takbir with
him, then you would not have caught the Ruku' with him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.282 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.403

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مَنْ أَذَّنَ فِي مِصْرٍ مِنْ أَمْصَارِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ سَنَةً وَجَبَثْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, said: "Whoever gives the Adhan in a city among the cities of
the Muslims for one year, Paradise becomes obligatory for him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.285 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.31 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.283 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.567 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.371 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.146

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا صَاحِبِ السَّابِرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «ثَلاَثَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ عَلَى ٱلْمِسْكِ الْأَذْفَرِ مُؤَذِّنْ أَذَّنَ اِحْتِسَابا وَ إِمَامٌ أَمَّ قَوْما وَ هُمْ بِهِ رَاضُونَ وَ مَمْلُوكٌ يُطِيعُ
اللَّهَ وَ يُطِيعُ مَوَالِيَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Zakariya, the companion
of Al-Sabiri:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Three will be in Paradise surrounded by
the purest musk: a Mu'adhdhin who gave the Adhan seeking reward, an Imam (of
prayer) who led a people and they were pleased with him, and a servant who obeys
Allah {SWT} and obeys his masters."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.565 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.371 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.350

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سَعْدِ ٱلْإِسْكَافِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «مَنْ أَذَّنَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ اِحْتِسَاباً جَاءَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَ لا ذَنْبَ لَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira, from Bakr ibn Salim, from Sa'd Al-Iskafi who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "Whoever gives the Adhan for seven
years seeking reward will come on the Day of Judgment without any sin upon him."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.286 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.31 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.567 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.371 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.374 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.146 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.149

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيَّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «آخِرُ مَا فَارَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ
حَبِيبَ قَلْبِي أَنْ قَالَ «يَا عَلِيُّ إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ فَصَلَ صَلاةَ أَضْعَفٍ مَنْ خَلْفَكَ وَ لا تَتَخِذَنَّ مُؤَذّنا يَأْخُذْ عَلَى أَذَانِهِ أَجْراً».
english_text:
Ahmad from Al-Barqi from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni from (Imam) Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The last thing upon which I parted from the
beloved of my heart (Prophet {saws}), was that He {saws} said:
‘O Ali, when you pray, pray the prayer of the weakest among those behind you, and do
not appoint a Mu'adhdhin who takes a wage for his Adhan.'"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.283 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.283 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.592 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.371 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.447

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ
عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «لِلْمُؤَذِّنِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ٱلْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ مِثْلُ أَجْرٍ
الشَّصد المُتَشَحّط بدمه ف سَسا اللَّه»» قَال «قُلْتُ مَا دَسُواَ اللَّه انَّمُمْ يَحْتَلدُه: عَلَ. الْأَذَار قَالَ «كَلاَّ انَّهُ بَأْت
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Isa ibn
Abdullah from his father from his grandfather:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT} (may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family) said: ‘For the Mu'adhdhin, between the Adhan and the
Iqamah, there is the reward similar to that of a martyr who is covered in his blood in
the way of Allah {SWT}.’"
Imam {a.s} said: "I asked: ‘O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, they strive against one another for
the Adhan!’"
He {saws} said: "No, indeed a time will come upon the people when they will cast the
Adhan upon their weak ones, and those (Mu'adhdhins) will be bodies whose flesh
Allah {SWT} has made forbidden to the Fire."
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.283 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.283 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.32 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.565 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.372 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.147

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَلاَّمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَذِّنَ عَشَرَ سِنِينَ مُحْتَسِباً يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَدَّ بَصَرِهِ وَ صَوْتِهِ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَ يُصَدَّقُهُ كُلُّ رَطبٍ
وَ يَابِسِ سَمِعَهُ وَ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَنْ يُصَلِّي مَعَهُ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ سَهْمٌ وَ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَنْ يُصَلِّي بِصَوْتِهِ حَسَنَةٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Mus'ab ibn Salam Al-Tamimi,
from Sa'd ibn Tarif:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever gives the Adhan for ten years
seeking reward, Allah {SWT} will forgive him for the distance his sight and voice reach into
the sky, and every moist and dry thing that hears him will testify to his truthfulness,
and for every person who prays with him in his mosque, he will have a share, and for
every person who prays upon hearing his voice, he will receive a good deed."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.32 • Al-Khisal, Vol.2 p.448 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.567 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.372 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.86 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.104 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.23

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ الْعَرْزَمِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ مِنْ أَطْوَلِ
اَلنَّاسِ أَعْنَاقاً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Al-Arzami:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, among the people with the longest
necks on the Day of Resurrection will be the Mu'adhdhins."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.31 • Uyun Al-Akhbar, Vol.2 p.61 • Al-Majazat Al- Nabawiyyah, Vol.1 p.93 • Shihab Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.74 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.568 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.373 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.376 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.7 p.303

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَثَهُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلشَّامِ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السْلاَمُ فَقَالَ لَهُ «إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَبَقَ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ بِلالٌ » قَالَ وَ لِمَ قَالَ «لِأَنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ أَذّنَ».
english_text:
From him, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far, from his father who said:
A man from the people of Sham entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him,
and said to Imam {a.s}: "Indeed, the first to precede to Paradise was Bilal."
He asked: "And why is that?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Because he was the first to give the Adhan."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.568 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.373 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.2 2 p.142

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الْأَذَانِ
فِي الْمَنَارَةِ أَسُنَّةُ هُوَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يُؤَذَّنُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ لَمْ تَكُنْ يَوْمَيِذٍ مَنَارَةٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Ali ibn Ja'far who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about giving the Adhan from the minaret,
is it a Sunnah?
Imam {a.s} said: "The Adhan was given for the Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, on the ground, and at that time there was no minaret."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.233 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.600 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.230 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.410

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ السَّرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «السُّنَّةُ
أَنْ تَضَعَ إصْبَعَيْكَ فِي أُذُتَيْكَ فِي الْأَذَانِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Sarri:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Sunnah is to place your two fingers in
your ears during the Adhan."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.600 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.412

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ ٱلْمُحَارِبِيّ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «صَلّ
الْجُمُعَةً بِأَذَانِ هَؤلاءِ فَإِنَّهُمْ أَشَدُّ شَيْءٍ مُوَاظَبَةً عَلَى الْوَقْتِ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ja'far ibn Bashir from Dharih Al-Muharibi who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: "Pray the Friday prayer according to
the Adhan of these people, for they are the most diligent in observing the time."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.291 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.378

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ
بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْقَسْرِيَّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَخَافُ أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَزُولَ الشَمْسُ فَقَالَ
«إِنَّمَا ذَاكَ عَلَى الْمُؤَذَّنِينَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam and Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from
Hammad ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Khalid Al-Qasri who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I fear that we might pray on Friday
before the sun passes its zenith.”
Imam {a.s} said: "That responsibility is upon the Mu'adhdhins."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.616 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.379

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ أَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ آللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَذَّنَ وَ أَقَامَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَفْصِلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بِجُلُوسٍ.
english_text:
Sa'd from Al-Husayn ibn Umar ibn Yazid from Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman from Abdullah ibn Muskan who
said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, give the Adhan and the Iqamah without
separating between them by sitting.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.285 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.589 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.399

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ الْأَذَانَ وَ ٱلْإِقَامَةَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «فَلْيَمْضٍ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَإِنَّمَا الْأَذَانُ
سُنَّةٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubayd
ibn Zurarah, from his father who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who forgot the Adhan and the
Iqamah until he had entered into the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should continue with his prayer, for the Adhan is a Sunnah."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.285 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.622 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.434

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ سِرْحَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ :
فِي رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ الْأَذَانَ وَ الْإِقَامَةَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءْ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who forgot the
Adhan and the Iqamah until he had entered into the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is nothing upon him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.285 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.305 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.622 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.434

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَوْزَاءِ الْمُنَبِّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: كُنَّا مَعَهُ فَسَمِعَ إِقَامَةَ جَارٍ لَهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ «قُومُوا» فَقُمْنَا فَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ وَ لاَ إِقَامَةٍ قَالَ «يُجْزِيكُمْ
أَذَانُ جَارِكُمْ».
english_text:
From him, from Abu Al-Jawza' Munabbih ibn Abdullah, from Al-Husayn ibn Alwan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
We were with Imam {a.s} when He {a.s} heard the Iqamah of a neighbor for prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "Stand up."
We stood and prayed with Imam {a.s} without Adhan and without Iqamah.
Imam {a.s} said: "The Adhan of your neighbor suffices you."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.285 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.610 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.437

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ
الْأَذَانٍ فِي الْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُمَا فَقَالَ «إِذَا كُنْتَ إِمَاماً تَنْتَظِرُ جَمَاعَةً فَالْأَذَانُ قَبْلَهُمَا وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ وَحْدَكَ
فَلاَ يَضُرُّكَ أَ قَبْلَهُمَا أَذَنْتَ أَوْ بَعْدَهُمَا».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman from Imran Al-Halabi who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the Adhan at Fajr, whether it should
be before the two rak'ahs or after them.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are an Imam (of prayer) waiting for a congregation, then the
Adhan should be before them. But if you are alone, it does not harm you whether you
give the Adhan before them or after them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.285 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.616 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.448

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ حَفْصِ بْنِ سَالِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ إِذَا قَالَ
الْمُؤَذِّنُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصّلاَةُ أَ يَقُومُ ٱلْقَوْمُ عَلَى أَرْجُلِهِمْ أَوْ يَجْلِسُونَ حَتَّى يَجِيءَ إِمَامُهُمْ قَالَ «لا بَلْ يَقُومُونَ عَلَى
أَرْجُلِهِمْ فَإِنْ جَاءَ إِمَامُهُمْ وَ إِلاَّ فَلْيُوْخَذْ بِيَدِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَيُقَدَّمَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Abu Al-Walid Hafs ibn Salim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “When the Mu'adhdhin says ‘Qad qamati
al-salah’ (The prayer has been established), should the people stand on their feet or
should they remain seated until their Imam (of prayer) comes?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, rather they should stand on their feet. If their Imam (of prayer)
comes, they pray with him. And if he does not come, then a man from among the
people should be taken by the hand and brought forward (to lead the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.285 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1269 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.450 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.379

Chapter Title: THE ADHAN AND THE IQAMAH
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيَّ صَاحِبِ الْأَنْمَاطِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلَامُ أَوْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «يُؤَذِّنُ لِلظُهْرِ عَلَى سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ يُوَذَّنُ لِلْعَصْرِ عَلَى سِتَّ
رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ».
١٥ - باب كيفية الصلاة وصفتها والمفروض من ذلك والمسنون
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu
Ali, the companion of Al-Anmat:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, or Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
"The Adhan is to be given for Dhuhr after six rak'ahs, and the Adhan is to be given for
Asr after six rak'ahs following Dhuhr."
IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al- Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.286 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.151 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.588 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.449 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.152 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.52

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ إِذَا قَامَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ تَفَيَّرَ لَوْنُهُ فَإِذَا سَجَدَ لَمْ
يَرْفَعْ رَأْسَهُ حَتَّى يَرْفَضَّ عَرَقاً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Rib'i ibn Abdullah from Al-
Fudayl ibn Yasar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "(Imam) Ali ibn Al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be
upon them, when He {a.s} stood for prayer; his color would change, and when He {a.s}
would prostrate, He {a.s} would not lift his head until He {a.s} would pour with sweat."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.300 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.286 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.117 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.846 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.474 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 6 p.64 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 6 p.79 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.261 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 8 p.128

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT
arabic_text:
علي بن إبراهيم عن أبيه عن حماد عن حريز عن زرارة عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال : إذا استقبلت القبلة
بوجهك فلا تقلب وجهك عن القبلة لتفسد صلاتك فان اللّٰه تعالى قال لنبيه في الفريضة : (فول وجهك شطر
المسحد الحداد محثها كيته فولها محمهكم شطيهل وأخشه يصك ولاتفعه ال السماء مليك. حناء محمك
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “When you face the Qiblah with your face, do
not turn your face away from the Qiblah lest you corrupt your prayer, for Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, said to His Prophet {saws} regarding the obligatory prayer: "So turn your face
toward the Sacred Mosque; and wherever you are, turn your faces toward it" (Surah
Baqarah 2:144 & 2:150)
And lower your gaze and do not raise it toward the sky, and let it be directed in front of
your face at the place of your prostration.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ : «يَنْبَغِي لِمَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ إِذَا
مَرَّ بِآيَةٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فِيهَا مَسْأَلَةٌ أَوْ تَخْوِيفٌ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ خَيْرَ مَا يَرْجُو وَ يَسْأَلَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ مِنَ
الْعَذَابِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "It is proper for one who recites the Qur'an,
when he passes by a verse in the Qur'an that contains a supplication or a warning, that
he should ask at that moment for the best of what he hopes for, and seek safety from
the Fire and from punishment."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.301 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.286 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1743 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.69 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.171 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.3 p.312

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى عَنِ الْوَشَاءِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ بَيَّاعِ السَّابِرِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَيَتَبَاكَى الرَّجُلُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «بَخْ بَخْ وَ لَوْ مِثْلَ رَأْسِ الذُّبَابِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla from Al-Washsha' from Hammad ibn Uthman from Sa'id, the seller
of Al-Sabiri (a type of delicate cloth), who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Should a man force himself to weep
during the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Excellent, excellent (is such action); even if it is as little as the size of a
fly's head."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.301 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.287 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.407 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.879 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.248
