Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ وَ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالاَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : «إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى
الصَّلاةِ فَقُلٍ - اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَقَدَّمُ إِلَيْكَ مُحَمَداً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَاجَتِي وَ أَتَوَجَّهُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ فَاجْعَلْنِي بِهِ وَجِيها عِنْدَكَ «فِي
اَلدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ وَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ» اِجْعَلْ صَلاَتِي مَقْبُولَةً وَ ذَنْبِي مَغْفُوراً وَ دُعَائِي بِهِ مُسْتَجَاباً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ اَلْغَفُورُ
الرَّحيم».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban and Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When you stand for prayer, say: 'O Allah
{SWT}, indeed I present Muhammad {saws} before my need and I turn towards You {AZJ}
through Him {saws}, so make me, through Him {saws}, honorable in Your {AZJ} presence in
this world and the Hereafter, and among those brought near. Make my prayer
accepted, my sin forgiven, and my supplication through Him {saws} answered. Surely
You {AZJ} are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.'"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.309 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.302 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.635 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.509 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.370

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْإِمَامُ يُجْزِيهِ تَكْبِيرَةُ وَاجِدَةٌ وَ
يُجْزِيكَ ثَلاَثٌ مُتَرَسِّلاً إِذَا كُنْتَ وَحْدَكَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Imam (of prayer) suffices with one
Takbir, and it suffices for you to say it three times calmly if you are alone."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.640 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.10

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَخَفَّ مَا
يَكُونُ مِنَ التَّكْبِيرِ فِي الصَّلاةِ قَالَ «ثَلاثُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ قِرَاءَةٌ قَرَأْتَ بِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ «قُلْ يَا أَيْهَا
الْكَافِرُونَ» وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ إِمَاماً فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِيكَ أَنْ تُكَبِّرَ وَاحِدَةً تَجْهَرُ فِيهَا وَ تُسِرُّ سِتَّاً ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the lightest form of Takbir in the
prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "Three Takbirs; and if there is recitation, then you should recite ‘Surah
Al Ikhlas’ and ‘Surah Al Kafirun’. And if you are the Imam (of prayer), it suffices for you
to pronounce one Takbir aloud and to say six (Takbirs) quietly."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.640 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.33

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ أَوْ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ اِسْتَفْتَحَ الصَّلَاَةَ بِسَبْعِ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ وِلاءً.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Zurarah
who said:
I saw Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, or he said: “I heard Imam {a.s}, begin the prayer
with seven consecutive Takbirs.
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.641 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.21

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ الْبَجَلِيَّ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «عَلَى الإِمَامِ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ يَدَهُ فِي الصَّلاةِ لَيْسَ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ يَدَهُ فِي الصَّلاةِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: المعنى في هذا الخبر ان فعل الامام أكثر فضلا وأشد تأكيدا من فعل المأموم ، وإن كان فعل المأموم
أيضا فيه فضل على ما بيناه فيما مضى.
english_text:
Sa'd from Abu Ja'far from Musa ibn Al-Qasim Al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother
(Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "It is upon the Imam (of prayer) to raise his hand during the prayer; it
is not upon anyone else to raise his hand during the prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The meaning in this narration is that the action of the
Imam carries greater merit and is more strongly emphasized than the action of the
follower, although the action of the follower also carries merit, as we have explained
previously.”
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.257 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.208 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.645 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.27 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.362 • Mustadrak Al- Wasa’il, Vol.6 p.512

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مِسْمَعِ الْبَصْرِيِّ قَالَ:
صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَقَرَأً « «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ الرَّحِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ» » ثُمَّ قَرَأَ السُّورَةَ
اَلْتِي بَعْدَ الْحَمْدِ وَ لَمْ يَقْرَأُ «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ الرَّحِيمِ » ثُمَّ قَامَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ فَقَرَأَ الْحَمْدَ وَ لَمْ يَقْرَأ «بِسْمِ اللّهِ الرَّحْمْنِ
الرَّجِيمِ -» ثُمَّ قَرَأَ بِسُورَةٍ أَخْرَى.
قال محمد بن الحسن: لا ينافي هذا الخبر ما قدمناه من تأكيد الجهر ببسم اللّٰه الرحمن الرحيم لانه يتضمن حكاية فعل
ويجوز أن يكون مسمع لم يسمع أبا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام يقرأ ببسم اللّٰه الرحمن الرحيم لبعد كان بينه وبينه ، والذي يكشف
عما ذكرناه ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from
Misma‘ Al-Basri who said:
I prayed with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and Imam {a.s} recited "In the name
of Allah {SWT}, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate” and then ‘Surah Al Fatiha’.
Then Imam {a.s} recited the Surah after Al-Hamd and did not recite "Bismillah Hir
Rahman Nir Rahim."
Then Imam {a.s} stood in the second unit and recited Al-Hamd and did not recite
"Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim" and then recited another Surah.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration does not contradict what we have
previously presented regarding the emphasis on reciting Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir
Rahim aloud, because it merely reports an action, and it is possible that Misma‘ did
not hear Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, reciting Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim
due to the distance between him and Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him.” What
clarifies what we have mentioned is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.288 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.651 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.62

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْكَاهِلِيَّ
قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي مَسْجِدِ بَنِي كَاهِلٍ فَجَهَرَ مَرَّتَيْنِ - بِ «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ الرّحِيمِ -» وَ
قَنَتَ فِي اَلْفَجْرِ وَ سَلَّمَ وَاحِدَةً مِمَّا يَلِي الْقِبْلَةَ.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.288 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.649

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
فَأَمًا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ السِّنْدِيّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ إِمَاماً يَسْتَفْتِحُ بِالْحَمْدِ وَ لا يَقُولُ «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ الرَّحِيمِ -» قَالَ « لا
يَضُرُّهُ وَلا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر حال التقية على ما بيناه لان مع التقية يجوز اخفاته على ما قدمنا القول فيه، ويجوز أن يكون
الخبر تناول من لم يقل ذلك ناسيا دون أن يكون ذلك منه على جهة العمد.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Sindi from Hammad from Hariz
from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is an Imam (of prayer)
and begins with Al-Hamd without saying "Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim".
Imam {a.s} said: "It does not harm him, and there is no problem with that."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
The interpretation of this narration is that it pertains to the situation of taqiyya
(dissimulation), as we have explained, because under taqiyya it is permissible to recite
it quietly, as we have previously mentioned. It is also possible that the narration refers
to someone who omitted saying it out of forgetfulness, and not intentionally.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.288 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.312

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ السَّبْعِ الْمَثَانِي وَ الْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ هِيَ الْفَاتِحَةُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ: «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ
الرَّجِيمِ -» مِنَ السَّبْعِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ هِيَ أَفْضَلُهُنَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub from
Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about ‘the seven oft-repeated verses’ (al-
Sab‘ al-Mathani) and ‘the Great Qur'an’ (al-Qur’an al-‘Azim), is it Al-Fatiha?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: “Is ‘Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim’ among the seven (al-Sab‘ al-Mathani)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it is the best of them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.289 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.648 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.57 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.95 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.385 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.8 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.27 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 p.11 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.7 p.155

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ قَالَ: صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فَتَعَوِّذَ بِإِجْهَارٍ ثُمَّ
جَهَرَ - «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ الرَّحِيمِ -».
english_text:
From him, from Abdul-Samad ibn Muhammad, from Hanan ibn Sadir who said:
I prayed behind Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and Imam {a.s} sought refuge (with
Allah {SWT}) aloud, then Imam {a.s} recited aloud “Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.289 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.79

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْكَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: « «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمْنِ الرَّحِيمِ » أَقْرَبُ إِلَى اِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمِ مِنْ نَاظِرِ الْعَيْنِ إِلَى بَيَاضِهَا».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Hammad ibn Zayd, from Abdullah ibn
Yahya Al-Kahili:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his father {a.s}, said: “Bismillah Hir Rahman
Nir Rahim” is closer to the Greatest Name of Allah {SWT} (al-Ism al-A'zam) than the pupil
of the eye is to its white.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.289 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.648 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.1 p.82 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.57 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.95 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.8 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 p.17 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 p.27

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
هَلْ يَجْهَرُ بِقِرَاءَتِهِ فِي التَّطَوْعِ بِالنَّهَارِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الرواية رخصة والافضل أن لايقرأ شئ في صلوات النهار جهرا ولا يخفي شئ من صلوات الليل
، يدل على ذلك :
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Al-Sindi, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, should he recite aloud in his voluntary (nafl) prayers
during the day?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is a concession, and it is better that
nothing be recited aloud in the daytime prayers, and that nothing be concealed in the
nighttime prayers.” What indicates this is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.289 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.691 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.77

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِي بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَ بْنِ فَضَالٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «السُّنَّةُ فِي صَلاَةِ النَّهَارِ بِالْإِخْفَاتِ وَ السُّنَّةُ فِي صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ بِالْإِجْهَارِ».
english_text:
What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Hasan ibn
Ali ibn Faddal from some of our companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Sunnah in the daytime prayer is to
recite quietly, and the Sunnah in the nighttime prayer is to recite aloud."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.289 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.691 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.77

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَبَّاحِ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلامُ : «يَا ثُمَالِيْ إِنَّ الصَّلَةَ إِذَا أَقِيمَتْ جَاءَ الشَّيْطَانُ إِلَى قَرِينِ الْإِمَامِ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ ذَكَرَ رَبَّهُ فَإِنْ قَالَ نَعَمْ ذَهَبَ
وَ إن قَالَ لا رَكِبَ عَلَى كَتِفَيْهِ فَكَانَ إمَامَ ٱلْقَوْمِ حَتَّى يَنصَرِفُوا» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ أَ لَيْسَ يَقْرَءُونَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ
قالَ «بَلَى لَيْسَ حَيْثُ تَذْهَبُ يَا تُمَالِيّ إِنَّمَا هُوَ الْجَهْرُ «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمْنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ -» ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran from Sabbah Al-Hadhdha’ from a man from Abu Hamzah who
said:
(Imam) Ali ibn Al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon them, said: "O Thumali, when the prayer
is established, Satan comes to the companion of the Imam (of prayer) and says:
'Has he (Imam of Prayer) remembered his Lord {AZJ}?'
If he says, ‘Yes,’ he (Satan) departs.
But if he says, ‘No,’ he (Satan) mounts upon his shoulders and becomes the leader of
the people until they finish."
He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘May I be your ransom, do they not recite the Qur'an?’”
Imam {a.s] said: "Yes, but not in the way you think, O Thumali. What is meant is reciting
aloud ‘Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim’".
source: Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.649 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.75 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.6 0 p.202

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبْدُوسِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَادَوَيْهِ [زَادَوَيْهِ خ ل] عَنِ اِبْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّكَ كَتَبْتَ إِلَى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْفَرَجِ تُعْلِمُهُ أَنْ أَفْضَلَ مَا يُقْرَأْ فِي الْفَرَائِضِ - «إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ» وَ
«قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ إنَّ صَدْرِي لَيَضِيقُ بِقِرَاءَتِهِمَا فِي ٱلْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «لا يَضِيقَنَ صَدْرُك بِهِمَا فَإِنَّ
الْفَضْلَ وَ اللَّهِ فِيهِمَا».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Abdus from Muhammad ibn Zadawayh from Ibn Rashid who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, you wrote to
Muhammad ibn Al-Faraj informing him that the best of what is recited in the obligatory
prayers is ‘Surah Al-Qadr’ and ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’, but my chest feels tight when reciting
them at Fajr.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not let your chest be tight with them, for by Allah {SWT}, the virtue lies
within them."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.315 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.661 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.78 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.794 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.617 • Tafsir Kanz Al- Daqaiq, Vol.1 4 p.357

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «وَ لا تَجْهَزْ بِصَلاتِكَ وَ لا
تخافِتْ بِها» قَالَ «الْمُخَافَنَةُ مَا دُونَ سَمْعِكَ وَ الْجَهْرُ أَنْ تَرْفَعَ صَوْتَكَ شَدِيداً».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, "And do not
raise your voice in your prayer nor lower it too much" (Surah Al-Isra, 17:110).
Imam {a.s} said: "Lowering the voice (mukhafatah) is to recite below the level of your
own hearing, and raising the voice (jahr) is to raise your voice loudly and strongly."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.2 p.318 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.315 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.290 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.689 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.96 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.599 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.600 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.72 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.233 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.7 p.536

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ السِّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي فِي
مَوْضِعِ ثُمَّ يُرِيدُ أُنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ قَالَ «يَكُفُ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةٍ فِي مَشِبِهِ حَتَّى يَتَقَدَّمَ إِلَى الْمَوْضِعِ اَلَّذِي يُرِيدُ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who is praying in a place
and then wishes to move forward.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stop reciting while walking until he reaches the place he
intends, then he should resume his recitation."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.316 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.697 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.190 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.98

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الحسين بن محمد عن عبد الله بن عامر عن علي بن مهزيار عن فضالة بن أيوب عن الحسين بن عثمان عن
عمرو بن أبى نصر قال قلت لابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : الرجل يقوم في الصلاة فيريد أن يقرأ سورة فيقرأ قل
هو الله أحد وقل يا أيها الكافرون فقال : يرجع من كل سورة إلا من قل هو اللّٰه أحد وقل يا أيها الكافرون.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Aamir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-
Husayn ibn Uthman from Amr ibn Abi Nasr who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man stands in prayer and wants to
recite a Surah, but he recites ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’ and ‘Surah Al-Kafirun’.
Imam {a.s} said: "He may turn back from any Surah except from ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’ and
‘Surah Al-Kafirun’."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ
الرَّجْلٍ يَقْرَأْ بِالسَّجْدَةِ فِي آخِرِ السُّورَةِ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ وَ يَقْرَأْ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ ثُمَ يَرْكَعُ وَ يَسْجُدُ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, was asked about a man who recites a verse of
prostration (sajdah) at the end of a Surah.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should perform the prostration, then stand, recite the ‘Surah Al-
Fatiha’, then bow (for Ruku') and prostrate."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.318 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.291 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.685 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.102

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنْ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثِمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنْ صَلَّيْتَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ فَقَرَا الْإِمَامُ - اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ أَوْ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْعَزَائِمِ وَ فَرَغَ مِنْ قِرَاءَتِهِ
وَ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ فَأَوْمِ إِيمَاءً وَ الْحَائِضُ تَسْجُدُ إِذَا سَمِعَتِ السَّجْدَةَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Sama'ah from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you pray with a group and the Imam (of
prayer) recites ‘Surah Al-‘Alaq’ or something from the obligatory verses of prostration
(al-‘Aza’im), and he finishes his recitation without performing a prostration, then you
should gesture with an indication (for the prostration), and a woman in menstruation
should prostrate if she hears the verse of prostration."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.318 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.291 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.686 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.103

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجْلٍ سَمِعَ السَّجْدَةَ تُقْرَأْ قَالَ «لا يَسْجُدُ إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُنْصِتاً لِلْقِرَاءَةٍ مُسْتَمِعاً لَهَا أَوْ يُصَلِّي بِصَلاَتِهِ
فَأَمَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ يُصَلِّي فِي نَاجِيَةِ وَ أَنْتَ فِي نَاجِيَةِ أُخْرَى فَلا تَسْجُدْ لِمَا سَمِعْتَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who hears a verse of prostration being recited.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should not prostrate unless he is attentively listening to the
recitation or praying behind the one who is reciting. But if he is praying in one area and
you are in another, then do not prostrate for what you heard."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.318 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.291 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1749 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.242

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا قَرَأْتَ شَيْئاً مِنَ ٱلْعَزَائِمِ
الَّتِي يُسْجَدُ فِيهَا فَلَا تُكَبِّرْ قَبْلَ سُجُودِكَ وَلَكِنْ تُكَبِّرُ حِينَ تَرْفَعُ رَأْسَكَ وَ الْعَزَائِمُ أَرْبَعَةٌ حم السَّجَدَةُ وَ الم تَنْزِيلٌ
وَ اَلنَّجْمُ وَ اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When you recite something from the obligatory verses of
prostration (al-‘Aza’im) in which prostration is required, do not say the Takbir before
your prostration, but say Takbir when you lift your head. And obligatory prostrations
are four; Surah Fussilat, Surah As-Sajdah, Surah An-Najm, and Surah Al-‘Alaq."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.291 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.239

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ: «إِذَا قُرِئَ شَيْءُ مِنَ الْعَزَائِمِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ
فَسَمِعْتَهَا فَاسْجُدْ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءِ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ جُنُباً وَ إنْ كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ لا تُصَلِّي وَ سَائِرُ ٱلْقُرْآنِ أَنتَ فِيهِ
بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شِنْتَ سَجَدْتَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ لَمْ تَسْجُدْ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir who said:
He said: "When something from the four obligatory prostrations (al-‘Aza’im) is recited
and you hear it, then prostrate, even if you are without ablution, even if you are in a
state of major ritual impurity (junub), and even if it is a woman who is not praying. As
for the rest of the Qur'an, you have a choice: if you wish, you may prostrate, and if you
wish, you may not prostrate."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.318 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.291 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1749 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.2 p.341 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.240

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ هَلْ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَتَسْجُدُ سَجَدَةً إِذَا سَمِعَتِ السَّجْدَةَ قَالَ « تَقْرَأُ وَ لا تَسْجُدُ».
فلا ينافي الخبر الاول لان الخبر الاول محمول على الاستحباب وهذا الخبر محمول على جواز تركه ولا تنافي بينهما، واما
ما رواه :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdul-Rahman
ibn Abi Abdullah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a menstruating woman, does she recite the Qur'an and perform
the prostration if she hears a verse of prostration?
Imam {a.s} said: "She may recite but she does not prostrate."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, the first narration is not contradicted, because the first narration is to be
understood as recommending (the prostration) out of desirability, while this narration
is to be understood as permitting the omission of it, and there is no contradiction
between them. As for what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.292 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.320 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.34 • Al- Wafi, Vol.6 p.487 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.2 p.341

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ وَهْبِ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ
عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ آخِرُ السُّورَةِ السَّجْدَةَ أَجْزَأَكَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ بِهَا».
فلا ينافي خبر الحلبي المقدم ذكره لان هذا الخبر نحمله على من يصلي مع قوم لا يمكنه أن يسجد ويقوم ويقرأ الحمد
فانه لا بأس أن يركع معهم ، وخبر الحلبي وغيره ممن روى ذلك محمول على من تمكن من ذلك بأن يكون منفردا يدل على
ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Abu Al-Bakhtari Wahb ibn Wahb:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (narrated) from his father {a.s}, from (Imam) Ali {a.s},
peace be upon him, said: "If the prostration is at the end of the Surah, it suffices you
to bow (perform Ruku') for it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, this does not contradict the narration of Al-Halabi mentioned earlier, because
this narration is understood to refer to one who is praying with a group and cannot
perform the prostration, stand up, and then recite Al-Hamd; in that case, there is no
harm in him bowing (with them). As for the narration of Al-Halabi and others who
reported similarly, it is understood to refer to one who is able to do so, such as when
he is praying individually. What supports this interpretation is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.292 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.686 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.102

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: «مَنْ قَرَأَ اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِذَا خَتَمَهَا فَلْيَسْجُدْ فَإِذَا قَامَ
فَلْيَقْرَأُ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ وَ لَيَرْكَعْ» قَالَ «وَ إِنِ أبْثَلِيتَ بِهَا مَعَ إِمَامِ لا يَسْجُدُ فَيُجْزِيكَ الْإِيمَاءُ وَ الرُكُوعُ وَ لا تَقْرَأ فِي
اَلْفَرِيضَةِ اِقْرَأْ فِي التَّطَوْعِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah:
He said: "Whoever recites ‘Iqra' bismi Rabbik’ (Surah Al-‘Alaq), when he finishes it, he
should prostrate, and when he stands up, he should recite the ‘Opening of the Book’
(Surah Al-Fatiha) and then bow."
He said: "And if you are tested with this situation while praying behind an Imam who
does not perform the prostration, then gesturing and bowing suffices for you, and do
not recite it in an obligatory prayer; recite it in a voluntary prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.686

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «إِذَا قَرَأْتَ السِّجْدَةَ فَاسْجُدْ وَ لا تُكَبِّرْ
حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ رَأْسَكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When you recite a verse of prostration,
then prostrate, and do not say the Takbir until you lift your head."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1750 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.240

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يَقْرَأُ السَّجْدَةَ فَيَنْسَاهَا
حَتَّى يَركَعَ وَ يَسْجُدَ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُ إِذَا ذَكَرَ إِذَا كَانَتْ مِنَ الْعَزَائِمِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Safwan, from Al-Ala', from Muhammad, from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon
them, said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who recites a verse of prostration and forgets it until he
bows and prostrates.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should prostrate when he remembers, if it was from the obligatory
prostrations (al-‘Aza’im)."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.686 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.104 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.61

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَفَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى
اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجْلِ يَسْمَعُ السِّجْدَةَ فِي السَّاعَةِ اَلَّتِي لا يَسْتَقِيمُ الصَّلَاَةُ فِيهَا قَبْلَ
غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ وَ بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «لا يَسْجُدُ » وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَقْرَأْ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ سُورَةً فِيهَا سَجْدَةٌ مِنَ
الْعَزَائِمِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا بَلَغَ مَوْضِعَ السَّجْدَةِ فَلا يَقْرَأُهَا وَ إِنْ أَحَبَ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فَيَقْرَأَ سُورَةً غَيْرَهَا وَ يَدَعَ الَّتِي فِيهَا
السَّجْدَةُ فَيَرْجِعُ إِلَى غَيْرِهَا» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي مَعَ قَوْمٍ لا يَقْتَدِي بِهِمْ فَيُصَلِّي لِنَفْسِهِ وَ رُبَّمَا قَرَءُوا آيَةً مِنَ
الْعَزَائِم فَلا يَسْجُدُونَ فِيهَا فَكَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «لا يَسْجُدُ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from
Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who hears a verse of
prostration at a time when prayer is not valid, before the setting of the sun and after
the prayer of Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "He does not prostrate."
And (Imam {a.s} said) regarding a man who recites in an obligatory prayer a Surah that
contains a verse of prostration from the obligatory prostrations (al-‘Aza’im).
Imam {a.s} said: "When he reaches the place of the prostration, he should not recite it,
and if he wishes, he may go back and recite another Surah and leave the one that
contains the prostration, thus turning to another one."
And (Imam {a.s} said) regarding a man who prays among a group without following them
and prays for himself, and they might recite a verse from the obligatory prostrations
but they do not prostrate therein, what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He does not prostrate."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.293

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أحمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنْ إِمَام قَرَأَ السَّجْدَةَ فَأَحْدَثَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يُقَدِّمُ غَيْرَهُ فَيَتَشَهَدُ وَ يَسْجُدُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ هُوَ وَ قَدْ
تَمَّثْ صَلاَتُهُمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far
{a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about an imam (of prayer) who recites a verse of prostration and then
becomes impure (loses his ablution) before he performs the prostration, what should
he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should appoint another person to lead; that person should perform
the tashahhud, prostrate, and then they should all finish their prayer, and the Imam
(of prayer) who became impure should withdraw, and the prayer of the congregation
is complete."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.255 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.205 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.687 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.106 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.240 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.427 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.15

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ بْنِ رَزِينِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ
الرَّجْلٍ يُعَلَّمُ السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْعَزَائِمِ فَتُعَادُ عَلَيْهِ مِرَاراً فِي الْمَقْعَدِ الْوَاحِدِ قَالَ «عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ كُلَّمَا سَمِعَهَا وَ عَلَى
الَّذِي يُعَلَّمُهُ أَيْضا أَنْ يَسْجَدَ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who is being taught a Surah that contains an obligatory
prostration (from the 'Aza’im), and it is repeated to him several times in a single sitting.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is obligatory upon him to prostrate each time he hears it, and it is
also obligatory upon the one teaching him to prostrate."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1750 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.245 • Al- Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.3 p.320 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.179

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
: فِي الرَّجْلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ السُورَةَ فَيَقْرَأَ غَيْرَهَا فَقَالَ «لَهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ أَنْ يَقْرَأْ ثُلْثَيْهَا».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Ubayd ibn Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who intends to
recite a Surah but then recites another one instead.
Imam {a.s} said: "He is allowed to return (to the intended Surah) as long as he has not
recited two-thirds of it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.674 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.101 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.17

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ قَرَأَ سُورَةً فِي
رَكْعَةٍ فَغَلِطَ أَيَدَعُ الْمَكَانَ آلَّذِي غَلِطَ فِيهِ وَ يَمْضِي فِي قِرَاءَتِهِ أَوْ يَدَعُ تِلْكَ السُورَةَ وَ يَتَحَوَّلُ مِنْهَا إِلَى غَيْرِهَا
فَقَالَ «كُلُ ذَلِكَ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ وَ إِنْ قَرَأَ آيَةً وَاجِدَةً فَشَاءَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ بِهَا رَكَعَ».
محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على النافلة لانا قد بينا ان الفريضة لا يجوز فيها أقل من سورة مع الحمد :
english_text:
From him, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man recites a Surah in a rak'ah and
makes a mistake, should he leave the place where he made the mistake and continue
in his recitation, or should he leave that Surah and move to another Surah?”
Imam {a.s} said: "All of that is permissible; and if he recites even a single verse and then
wishes to bow with it, he may bow."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as referring to the
supererogatory (nafl) prayers, because we have already explained that in the
obligatory (fard) prayer, it is not permissible to recite less than a complete Surah along
with Al-Hamd.” As for what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.923 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.45 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.100

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يَاسِينَ الْبَصْرِيِّ عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلَاَمُ
: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ السُّورَةِ أَيُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ بِهَا فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَتْ سِنَّ آيَاتٍ قَرَأَ بِالنِّصْفِ
مِنْهَا فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى وَ النَّصْفِ الْآخَرِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ».
فهذا الخبر محمول على ضرب من التقية لانه موافق لمذهب العامة ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yasin Al-Basri from Hariz ibn Abdullah from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, was asked about a Surah, can a man pray with it
in the two rak'ahs of an obligatory prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, if it consists of six verses, he may recite half of it in the first rak'ah
and the other half in the second rak'ah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, this narration is to be understood as referring to a situation of taqiyya
(dissimulation), because it agrees with the view of the general public (al-‘amma). What
indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.294 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.676 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.46

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثَمَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فَقَرَأْ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ آخِرٍ سُورَةِ الْمَائِدَةِ فَلَمَا سَلَمَ اِلْتَفَتَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ
«أَمَا إِنَّي إِنَّمَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُعَلَّمَكُمْ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Aban ibn Uthman from Isma'il ibn Al-Fadl:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, prayed
with us, and they {a.s} recited the ‘Opening of the Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) and the end of
Surah Al-Ma'idah.
When they finished and gave the salam, they turned to us and said:
"Indeed, I only intended to teach you."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.294 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.677 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.46 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.28

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ
عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادِ الصِّيْقَلِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ هُوَ يَنْظُرُ فِي
الْمُصْحَفِ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِ يَضَعُ السِّرَاجَ قَرِيباً مِنْهُ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from
Aban ibn Uthman from Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad Al-Sayqal who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “What do you say about a man who is praying while looking
into the Mushaf, reading from it, and placing a lamp close to him?”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with that."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.699 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.107 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.298

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَجِيرَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «الإِمَامُ يَقْرَأُ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ وَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ يُسَبِّحُ فَإِذَا
كُنْتَ وَحْدَكَ فَاقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا وَ إنْ شِئْتَ فَسَبَّحْ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about reciting behind the Imam (of
prayer) in the last two rak'ahs.
Imam {a.s} said: "The Imam (of prayer) recites the ‘Opening of the Book’ (Surah Al-
Fatiha), and those behind him should glorify (say tasbih). If you are praying alone, then
you may either recite (Surah Al-Fatiha) in them or, if you wish, you may glorify."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.319 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.776 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.108

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيَّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ آللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَمَّا يَقْرَأُ ٱلْإِمَامُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي آخِرِ الصّلاةِ فَقَالَ » بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ لا يَقْرَأُ الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ وَ يَقْرَأْ
الرَّجُلُ فِيهِمَا إِذَا صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Sindi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about what the Imam (of prayer) recites
in the last two rak'ahs of the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He recites the ‘Opening of the Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha), and those
behind him do not recite. And a man who is praying alone recites Al-Fatiha in them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.777 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.108

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ غَلِطَ
فِي سُورَةٍ فَلْيَقْرَأُ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُمَّ ليَرْكَعِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever makes a mistake in a Surah, let
him recite ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’ and then bow."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.697 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.110

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَدْ
بَشتَدْ عَلَيَّ الْقِيَامُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تُذْرِكَ صَلاَةَ ٱلْقَائِمِ فَاقْرَأْ وَ أَنْتَ جَالِسُ فَإِذَا بَقِيَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ
آيَتَانِ فَقُمْ فَأْتِمَّ مَا بَقِيَ وَ اِرْكَعْ وَ اُسْجُدْ فَذَلِكَ صَلاَةُ ٱَلْقَائِمِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Hammad ibn Uthman who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Sometimes standing in prayer becomes
difficult for me.”
Imam {a.s} said: "If you want to attain the reward of the one who stands in prayer, then
recite while you are sitting, and when only two verses remain from the Surah, then
stand up, complete what remains, bow, and prostrate, that will be counted as the
prayer of one who stood."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.113 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.498

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَرَأْ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْحَوَامِيمِ فِي صَلَاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فَاتَهُ الْوَقْتُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Amir ibn Abdullah who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "Whoever recites something from
the Hawamim (the Surahs beginning with 'Ha Mim') in the Fajr prayer, for he will miss
the time (of the prayer due to length of the Surahs)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ
كَانَ يَقْرَأْ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَتَمَةِ بِالْوَاقِعَةِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Isma'il ibn Abd Al-Khaliq, from Muhammad ibn Abi Talhah, from Abd Al-Khaliq:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to recite in the two rak'ahs after the night
prayer (Al-Atamah) ‘Surah Al-Waqi'ah’ and ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.667 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.112

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ الْأَشعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ قَرَأَ فِي
رَكْعَةٍ الْحَمْدَ وَ نِصْفَ سُورَةِ هَلْ يُجْزِيهِ فِي الثَانِيَةِ أَنْ لاَ يَقْرَأ الْحَمْدَ وَ يَقْرَأْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ السُورَةِ فَقَالَ «يَقْرَأَ ٱلْحَمْدَ
ثُمَّ يَقْرَأْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على صلاة النوافل لانا قد بينا ان الفريضة لا يقرأ فيها بأقل من سورة مع الحمد.
english_text:
From him, from Al-Barqi, from Sa'd ibn Sa'd Al-Ash'ari, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who recited Al-Hamd and half of a Surah in one rak'ah,
would it suffice in the second rak'ah not to recite Al-Hamd and only recite what
remains of the Surah?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should recite Al-Hamd, then recite what remains of the Surah."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as referring to the
supererogatory (nafl) prayers, because we have already explained that in the
obligatory (fard) prayer, it is not permissible to recite less than a complete Surah along
with Al-Hamd.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.676 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.45

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الْقِرَانِ بَيْنَ السُّورَتَيْنِ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ النَّافِلَةِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» وَ عَنْ تَبْعِيضِ السُّورَةِ قَالَ «أَكْرَهُ
ذَلِكَ وَ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ فِي النَّافِلَةِ» وَ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ يَصْمُتُ فِيهِمَا الْإِمَامُ أَيُقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا بِالْحَمْدِ وَ هُوَ إِمَامٌ يُقْتَدَى
بِهِ قَالَ «إِنْ قَرَأْتَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ سَكَتَّ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: قوله عليه السلام لا بأس بالقران بين السورتين في المكتوبة محمول على انه إذا كان احدى
السورتين الحمد وليس في الظاهر انه لا بأس بقرائتهما بعد قراءة الحمد، وإذا لم يكن ذلك في ظاهره حملناه على ما قلناه
لئلا ينافي ما قدمناه من الاخبار.
english_text:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali, from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin
who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about combining two Surahs in the
obligatory and the supererogatory prayers.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about reciting part of a Surah.
Imam {a.s} said: "I dislike that, but there is no harm in it for the supererogatory prayers."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about the two rak'ahs in which the Imam (of prayer) remains
silent, should ‘Surah Al-Hamd’ be recited in them when one is following an Imam (of
prayer)?
Imam {a.s} said: "If you recite, there is no harm; and if you remain silent, there is no
harm."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His {a.s} statement, peace be upon him; "There is no
harm in combining two Surahs in the obligatory prayer," is to be understood as
meaning when one of the two Surahs is Al-Hamd.
And there is nothing apparent in the wording to suggest that it is permissible to recite
two Surahs after the recitation of Al-Hamd. And if it were not apparent in its wording,
we would interpret it according to what we have said, so as not to contradict the
previous narrations we have mentioned.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.296

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيّى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى ع قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَقْرَأْ فِي
الْفَرِيضَةِ - بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةِ أُخْرَى فِي النَّفَسِ الْوَاجِدِ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ قَرَأَ فِي نَفَسِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فِي غَيْرِهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-‘Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who recites in an obligatory prayer the ‘Opening of the
Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) and another Surah in one breath.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he wishes, he may recite them in one breath, and if he wishes, he
may recite them in separate breaths."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.236 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.296 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.699 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.113

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ
دُخُولِي مَعَ مَنْ أَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَيَرْكَعُ عِنْدَ فَرَاغِي مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ فَقَالَ « تَقْرَأُ فِي ٱلْأَخْرَاوَيْنِ
كَي تَكُونَ قَدْ قَرَأْتَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
From him, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Udhafir, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about joining the prayer behind someone while I am reciting behind
him in the second rak'ah, and he bows just as I finish reciting the ‘Opening of the Book’
(Surah Al-Fatiha).
Imam {a.s} said: "Recite in the last two rak'ahs so that you will have recited in two
rak'ahs."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.296 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1211 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.363 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.369 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.87

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجْلِ يَنْسَى حَرْفاً مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فَذَكَرَ وَ هُوَ رَاكِعْ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَهُ قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا سَجَدَ
فَلْيَقْرَأْهُ» - وَ قَالَ «اَلرَّجُلُ إِذَا قَرَأَ «وَ الشَّمْسِ وَ ضُحاها» فَيَخْتِمُهَا أَنْ يَقُولَ صَدَقَ اللَهُ وَ صَدَقَ رَسُولُهُ وَ الرَّجُلُ
إِذَا قَرَأَ «آللهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَا يُشرِكُونَ» أَنْ يَقُولَ اللّهُ خَيْرٌ اللّهُ خَيْرٌ اللّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَ إِذَا قَرَأَ «ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهمْ يَعْدِلُونَ»
أَنْ يَقُولَ كَذَبَ الْعَادِلُونَ بِاللَّه وَ الرَّجُلُ إذَا قَرَأَ «الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيْكٌ فِي اَلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ
يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِي مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَ كَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيراً» أَنْ يَقُولَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقُلِ الرَّجُلُ شَيْئاً مِنْ هَذَا
إِذَا قَرَأْ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Husayn, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn
Musa:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who forgets a letter from
the Qur'an and remembers it while he is bowing, is it permissible for him to recite it?
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but when he prostrates, let him recite it."
And Imam {a.s} said: "When a man recites ‘By the sun and its brightness’ (Surah Al-
Shams), upon completing it, he should say: 'Allah {SWT} and His Messenger {saws} have
spoken the truth.'
And when a man recites ‘Is Allah {SWT} better, or what they associate with Him?’ (Surah
An-Naml 27:59), he should say: 'Allah {SWT} is better, Allah {SWT} is better, Allah {SWT} is
greater.'
And when he recites ‘Then those who disbelieve set equals with their Lord’ (Surah Al-
An‘am 6:1), he should say: 'Those who set equals with Allah {SWT} have lied.'
And when he recites ‘Praise be to Allah {SWT}, who has not taken a son, and who has no
partner in His dominion, nor any protector out of weakness, and glorify Him with great
glorification’ (Surah Al-Isra’ 17:111), he should say: 'Allah {SWT} is the Greatest, Allah {SWT}
is the Greatest, Allah {SWT} is the Greatest.'"
I asked: “What if a man does not say anything of this when he recites?”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is nothing upon him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.674

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى الْخَشَابِ عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ كَلُوبِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَاَمُ
: «أَنّ رَجُلَيْنٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابٍ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اِخْتَلَفًا فِي صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
فَكَتَبَا إِلَى أَبَيَّ بْنِ كَعْبِ كَمْ كَانَتْ - لِرَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنْ سَكْتَةٍ قَالَ كَانَتْ لَهُ سَكْتَتَانِ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ
أَمِّ الْقُرْآنِ وَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa Al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from
(Imam) Ja'far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s} said) "Two men from among the companions of the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, differed regarding the prayer of the Messenger
of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
So they wrote to Ubayy ibn Ka'b asking: “How many pauses did the Messenger of Allah
{SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, have in his prayer?”
He said: “He had two pauses, one when he finished reciting the ‘Opening of the Book’
(Surah Al-Fatiha) and another when he finished the Surah."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.700 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.114 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.25 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 p.83

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ : «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ
أَنْ تَرْكَعَ وَ تَسْجُدَ فَارْفَع يَدَيْكَ ثُمَّ اِرْكَغْ وَ أُسْجُدْ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When you intend to bow and to prostrate,
raise your hands and then bow and prostrate."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.702 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.296

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارِ ٱلْمِنْقَرِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ
إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ الشَّعِيرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَنّ اَلنَّبِيَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
قَالَ: «ضَعُوا اَلْيَدَيْنِ حَيْثُ تَضَعُونَ ٱلْوَجْهَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَسْجُدَانٍ كَمَا يَسْجُدُ الْوَجْهُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Musa ibn Yasar Al-Minqari from Ali ibn
Ja'far Al-Sakuni from Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sha'iri from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his
forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them:
The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
"Place the two hands where you place the face, for indeed they both prostrate just as
the face prostrates."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.719 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.357

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ وَ تَعْلَبَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«الْجَبْهَةُ إِلَى الْأَنْفِ أَيّ ذَلِكَ أَصَبْتَ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ فِي السُجُودِ أَجْزَأَكَ وَ السُجُودُ عَلَيْهِ كُلَّهِ أَفْضَلُ».
english_text:
From him, from Musa ibn Umar, from Al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr and Tha'labah, from Burayd:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The forehead to the nose, whichever of them
you place upon the ground in prostration, it suffices you, and prostrating with all of it
(the entire forehead and nose) is better."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.716 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.356

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ مُصَادِفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «إِنَّمَا السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْجَبْهَةِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَنْفِ سُجُودٌ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah Al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn Musadif, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "Indeed, the prostration is upon the forehead, and there
is no prostration upon the nose."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.717 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.343

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ وَ عَمَّارٍ السَّابَاطِيَّ قَالَ: «مَا بَيْنَ قُصَاصِ الشَّعْرِ إِلَى طَرَفٍ
الْأَثْفٍ مَسْجِدٌ أَيُّ ذَلِكَ أَصَبْتَ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ أَجْزَأَكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim and Ammar Al-Sabati:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "The area between the hairline and the tip of the nose is a place of
prostration; whichever part of that you place on the ground suffices you."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.271 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.716 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.356

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ : «لا تُجْزِي صَلاَةُ لا يُصِيبُ الْأَنْفُ مَا يُصِيبُ الْجَبِينُ».
فهذه الرواية محمولة على ضرب من الكراهية دون الفرض لان الفرض هو السجود على الجبهة والارغام بالانف سنة على
ما بيناه، والذي يدل على كراهيته أيضا ما رواه :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ammar from (Imam)
Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: “(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: ‘The prayer is not sufficient
if the nose does not touch what the forehead touches’."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, this narration is to be understood as indicating a kind of disliked (action) and not
an obligation, because the obligation is the prostration upon the forehead, and
pressing the nose is a recommended act, as we have explained. What also indicates
its being disliked is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ كَرِهَ تَنْظِيمَ الْحَصَى فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى قُصَاص شَعْرِهِ حَتَّى يُرْسِلَهُ إِرْسَالاً».
وقد بينا في رواية محمد بن مصادف وغيره انه ليس على الانف سجود، ويدل على ذلك أيضا ما رواه :
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam)
Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "Indeed, (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, disliked arranging the
pebbles during the prayer, and He {a.s} used to dislike that one should pray upon the
hairline until he lets it fall naturally."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
And we have explained in the narration of Muhammad ibn Musadif and others that
there is no prostration upon the nose, and what also indicates this is what was
narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.363 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.344

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ
قَالَ أَبْو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «السُجُودُ عَلَى سَبْعَةٍ أَعْظُمِ ٱلْجَبْهَةِ وَ الْيَدَيْنِ وَ
الرُكْبَتَيْنِ وَ الْإنْهَامَيْنِ وَتُرْغِمُ بِأَنْفِكَ إِرْغَاما فَأَمَّا ٱلْفَرْضُ فَهَذِهِ السَّبْعَةُ وَ أَمَّا ٱلْإرْغَامُ بِالْأَنْفِ فَسُنّةٌ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى
اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad ibn Isa from
Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless
him and his family, said: ‘Prostration is upon seven bones: the forehead, the two
hands, the two knees, and the two big toes, and you press your nose firmly in humility.
As for the obligation, it is these seven, and as for pressing the nose, it is a Sunnah from
the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.718 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.343

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي .
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ هُوَ
يُصَلِّي فَعَدَدْتُ لَهُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ سِتَّينَ تَسْبِيحَةً.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Umar Al-Halabi from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, while He {a.s} was praying, and I counted for Him {a.s} in
the bowing and the prostration sixty tasbihat.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.329 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.93 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.708 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.304 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 7 p.50 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 0 p.138

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ
يَذْكُرُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ ٱلْمَكْثُوبَةِ إِمَّا رَاكِعاً وَ إمَّا سَاجِداً فَيُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ عَلَى تِلْكَ
الْحَالٍ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى نَبِيَّ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَهَيْئَةِ التَّكْبِيرِ وَ التَّسْبِيحِ وَ هِيَ عَشَرُ حَسَنَاتٍ
يَنْتَدِرُهَا ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مَلَكاً أَيُّهُمْ يُبَلِّغُهَا إِيَّاهُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who remembers the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, while he is in the obligatory prayer, whether bowing or
prostrating, and he sends blessings upon Him {saws} while in that state.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, indeed, sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah {SWT}, may
Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, is like the takbir and the tasbih, and it is ten good
deeds, and eighteen angels hasten to deliver it to him, each vying as to who will convey
it to him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.322 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.885 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.326

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَدْعُو اَللَّهَ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدْ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ فَادْعُ لِلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ فَإِنَّهُ رَبُّ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Fadalah from Aban from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Shall I supplicate to Allah {SWT} while I am in prostration?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, so supplicate for the world and the Hereafter, for indeed He {AZJ} is
the Lord {AZJ} of the world and the Hereafter."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.323 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.44 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.881 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.371

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو بَصِيرٍ فِي طَرِيقٍ
مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ وَ قَدْ كَانَتْ ضَاعَتْ نَاقَةٌ لَهُمْ اللَّهُمَّ رُدَّ عَلَى فُلاَنِ نَاقَتَهُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُبِي عَبْدِ
اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَأْخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ «وَ فَعَلَ » فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ قُلْتُ أَفَأْعِيدُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «لا».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Basir led us in prayer on the way to Mecca, and while he was in prostration, and
their camel had been lost, he said: “O Allah {SWT}, return so-and-so’s camel to him.”
Muhammad (ibn Muslim) said: “Then I entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and informed
him, and Imam {a.s} said: "And he did that?"
I said: “Yes”.
Imam {a.s} then remained silent.
I asked: “Should I repeat the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.300

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَرِيرِ الرَّوَّاسِيَّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ يَقُولُ : « اَللَّهُمَ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ
اَلرَّاحَةَ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَ الْعَفْوَ عِنْدَ الْحِسَابِ » يُرَدِّدُهَا.
english_text:
From him, from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Jarir Al-Rawasi, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, while He {a.s} was saying:
"O Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} for comfort at the time of death and pardon at the time of
the reckoning," and He {a.s} kept repeating it.
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.300 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1670 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.216

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ قَالاَ: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ عِنْدَهُ قَوْمٌ فَصَلَّى بِهِمُ الْعَصْرَ وَ قَدْ كُنَّا صَلَّيْنَا فَعَدَدْنَا لَهُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ « سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ» أَرْبَعاً
أَوْ ثَلاثاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً وَ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا فِي حَدِيثِهِ «وَ بِحَمْدِهِ» فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ.
قال محمد بن الحسن : الاصل في صلاة الجماعة التخفيف وهذه الرواية يمكن أن يكون الوجه فيها ان القوم الذين صلى
بهم كانوا مطيقين للاطالة واقوياء عليه فلاجل ذلك فعل عليه السلام ذلك.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Hamzah ibn Humran and Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad,
who said:
We entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and with Him {a.s} were a group of people.
He {a.s} led them in the Asr prayer, and we had already prayed, so we counted for Him
{a.s} in his bowing "Glory be to my Lord {AZJ}, the Great" either four or thirty-three times,
and one of them mentioned in his narration "and with His {AZJ} praise" in the bowing and
the prostration.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The basis in the congregational prayer is lightness,
and this narration can be understood in that the group with whom he prayed were
capable of enduring lengthiness and strong in bearing it, and for that reason, He {a.s},
peace be upon him, did so.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.300 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.708 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.304 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 7 p.50 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 0 p.138

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ آَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسِّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا رَكَعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ أَيَبْدَأُ فَيَضَعُ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ رُكْبَتَيْهِ قَالَ «لا يَضُرُهُ بِأَيِّ ذَلِكَ
بَدَأْ هُوَ مَقْبُولٌ مِنْهُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : قوله عليه السلام لا يضره ذلك بايهما بدأ معناه انه لا يبطل صلاته وان كان الافضل ما قدمناه من
انه ينبغي ان يتلقى الارض بيديه الا عند الضرورة.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man, when he bows and then raises his head, should he first
place his hands on the ground or his knees?
Imam {a.s} said: "It does not harm him whichever of them he begins with; it is accepted
from him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His {a.s}, peace be upon him, saying; "It does not harm
him whichever of them he begins with," means that his prayer is not invalidated,
although the preferable way is what we have previously mentioned, that he should
receive the ground with his hands, except in a case of necessity.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.300 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.714 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.337

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِالْإِقْعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الرواية رخصة والافضل ما قدمناه من انه لا يقعي بين السجدتين ، ويؤكد ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah
Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said: "There is no harm in sitting in the Iq'a' position during the
prayer between the two prostrations." (sitting back on the heels with the bottom of the
toes, and the knees, upon the ground)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is a concession, and the preferable way
is what we have previously mentioned, that he should not sit in the Iq'a' position
between the two prostrations”.
And what confirms this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.301 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.724 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.348

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تُقْع بَيْنَ السِّجْدَتَيْنِ إِقْعَاءَ».
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.301 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.723 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.348 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.198

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِبعِ عَنْ أَبِي إسْمَاعِيلَ السِّرَّاجِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ وَ قَدْ رَفَعَ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَ إِحْدَى قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى اَلْأُخْرَى.
قال محمد بن الحسن: يجوز أن يكون إنما فعل ذلك لضرورة لان الافضل ما قدمناه من وضع الابهامين على الارض.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Abu Isma'il Al-Sarraj from Harun ibn
Kharijah, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} while He {a.s} was in prostration, and He {a.s} had lifted his feet from
the ground, with one of his feet placed upon the other.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “It is possible that He, peace be upon him, only did
that out of necessity, because the preferable way is what we have previously
mentioned, which is placing the two big toes upon the ground.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.301 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.723

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُسَوِّي
اَلْحَصَى فِي مَوْضِعٍ سُجُودِهِ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} leveling the pebbles at the place of his prostration between the
two prostrations.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.271 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.908 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.373

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ أ
يَمْسَحُ الرَجُلُ جَبْهَتَهُ فِي الصَّلاةِ إِذَا لَصِقَ بِهَا تُرَابٌ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ قَدْ كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَمْسَحُ جَبْهَتَهُ فِي
الصَّلاَةٍ إِذَا لَصِقَ بِهَا التُرَابُ».
english_text:
