From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
who said:
I asked Imam {a.s}: “Should a man wipe his forehead during the prayer if dust sticks to
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, indeed Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, used to wipe his forehead
during the prayer if dust stuck to it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.301 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.908 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.373

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ يُجْزِي أَنْ
أَقُولَ مَكَانَ ٱلتَّسْبِيحِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ - لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ كُلُّ هَذَا ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “Is it sufficient that I say instead of the tasbih in bowing and
prostration, ‘There is no god but Allah {SWT}, and praise be to Allah {SWT}, and Allah {SWT} is
the Greatest?’
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, all of this is remembrance of Allah {SWT}."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.331 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.36 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.92 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.307

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : مِثْلَهُ.
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Ja'far ibn Bashir from
Hammad ibn Uthman from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}: similar to it.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.331 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.36 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.92 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.307

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكِ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَسْجُدُ فَتَقَعُ جَبْهَتِي عَلَى الْمَوْضِعِ الْمُرْتَفِعِ قَالَ «اِرْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ ثُمَّ ضَعْهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik Al-Hadrami from Al-Husayn ibn
Hammad, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I prostrate and my forehead falls upon a raised surface.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Raise your head and then place it (properly)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.720 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.354 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.129

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عِجْلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
عَنِ الْمَكَانِ يَكُونُ فِيهِ الْغُبَارُ فَأْتْفُخُهُ إِذَا أَرَدْتُ السُّجُودَ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn Ammar from a man from Banu Ijl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a place that has dust in it, so I blow on it when I want to
prostrate.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.907 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ: «إِذَا وَضَعْتَ جَبْهَتَكَ عَلَى نَبَكَةٍ فَلاَ تَرْفَعْهَا وَ لَكِنْ جُرَّهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who
said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When you place your forehead upon a clod of earth, do not lift
it, but rather drag it along the ground."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.333 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.720 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.353 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.129

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدٌ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ
الرَّجُلُ يَنْفُخُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مَوْضِعَ جَبْهَتِهِ فَقَالَ «لا».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الكراهية بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار.
english_text:
Muhammad from Al-Fadl from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man blows during the prayer upon the place of his forehead.”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as indicating dislike,
based on the evidence of the reports we have previously presented.”
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.334 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.907 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا سَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ ثُمَّ
أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْهَضَ فَلاَ يَعْجِنُ بِيَدَيْهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ لَكِنْ يَبْسُطُ كَفِّيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَضَعَ مَقْعَدَتَهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ».
english_text:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When a man prostrates and then wants to rise, he should not
knead the ground with his hands, but rather he should spread his palms without
placing his buttocks on the ground."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.726 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.374

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
فَأَمًا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَ ٱلْمُعَلِّى بْنُ
خُنَيْسِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ عَلَى الْقُفْرِ وَ عَلَى الْقِيرِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
فانه محمول على حال الضرورة أو التقية ولا يجوز ذلك مع الاختيار، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from
Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, while I was with Imam {a.s}, about
prostrating upon a barren land and upon tar.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
For it is to be understood as referring to a situation of necessity or dissimulation
(taqiyyah), and it is not permissible in the case of choice, and what indicates this is
what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.736 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.354

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ
اللّه عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «لَا تَسْجُدْ إِلَّ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَوْ مَا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ إِلَّ الْقُطْنَ وَ الْكَثَّانَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abu Al-Abbas Al-Fadl
ibn Abd Al-Malik, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate except upon the earth or what the earth grows,
except for cotton and linen."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.729 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.344 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.344 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.149

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْجُدُ عَلَى الزِّفْتِ
بَعنِي الْقِيرَ فَقَالَ «لا وَ لاَ عَلَى الثَّوْبِ الْكُرْسُفِ وَ لاَ عَلَى الصُّوفِ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنَ ٱلْحَيَوَانِ وَ لاَ عَلَى طَعَامٍ وَ لا
عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ ثِمَارِ الْأَرْضِ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنَ الرِّيَاشِ».
english_text:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “Shall I prostrate upon zift, meaning tar?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, and not upon a garment of cotton, nor upon wool, nor upon
anything from an animal, nor upon food, nor upon anything from the fruits of the earth,
nor upon anything from feathers."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.730 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.346 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.86

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنِ الْجِصِّ يُوقَدُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَذِرَةِ وَ
عِظَامِ ٱلْمَوْتَى وَ يُجَصْصُ بِهِ ٱلْمَسْجِدُ أَيُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ فَكَتَبَ إلَيْ بِخَطَّهِ «إِنّ ٱلْمَاءَ وَ ٱلنَّارَ قَدْ طَهْرَاهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and
the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to
prostrate upon it?
So Imam {a.s} wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have
purified it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al- Wafi, Vol.6 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.738 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.527 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.358

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تَسْجُدْ عَلَى
اَلْقُفْرِ وَلا عَلَى الْقِيرِ وَ لا عَلَى الصَّارُوجِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Isma'il from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa'id:
Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said: "Do not prostrate upon barren land,
nor upon tar, nor upon plaster."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.353

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَهَلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تَسْجُدْ عَلَى
الذَّهَب وَلاً عَلَى الْفِضَّةِ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate upon gold nor upon silver."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.736 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.361

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ
يُصَلِّي عَلَى الرَّطْبَةِ النَّابِتَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَلْصَقَ جَبْهَتَهُ بِالْأَرْضِ فَلا بَأْسَ» وَ عَلَى الْحَشِيشِ النَّابِتِ اَلثَّيِّلِ وَ هُوَ
يُصِيبُ أَرْضاً جَدَداً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s} said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man praying upon fresh grass that has grown.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he presses his forehead to the ground, then there is no harm."
And about praying upon thick grown grass (thayyil) that covers solid ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.734 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.361

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيّى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ : أَنَّ بَعْضَ أَصْحَابِنَا كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي عَ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ
عَلَى الزَّجَاجِ قَالَ فَلَمَا نَفَدَ كِتَابِي إِلَيْهِ تَفَكَّرْتُ وَ قُلْتُ هُوَ مِمَّا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَ مَا كَانَ لِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عَنْهُ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ
«لا تُصَلَّ عَلَى ٱلزُّجَاجِ وَ إِنْ حَدَّثَثْكَ نَفْسُكَ أَنَّهُ مِمَّا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمِلْحِ وَ الرَّمْلِ وَ هُمَا مَمْسُوخَانِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn:
Some of our companions wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, asking
him about praying upon glass.
He said: “When my letter reached Imam {a.s}, I reflected and said to myself: ‘it is from
what the earth has produced, and I should not have asked about it.’”
So Imam {a.s} wrote back to him: "Do not pray upon glass, even if your soul suggests to
you that it is from what the earth has produced, for it is from salt and sand, and both
are transformed (altered)."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.4 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.737 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.360 • Madinat Ma’ajiz Al-A’immah, Vol.6 p.345 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 8 p.37 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 1 p.78

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: «أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى قِرْطَاسِ عَلَيْهِ كِتَابَةٌ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj about Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
"Imam {a.s} disliked prostrating upon paper that has writing on it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.737 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.356

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا يَسْجُدُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر موافق لبعض العامة وليس عليه العمل لانه يجوز أن يقف الانسان على ما لم يسجد عليه
، والذي يدل على ذلك :
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far {a.s},
from his father {a.s}, from (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} said: "A man should not prostrate upon something that the rest of his body
is not upon."
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report agrees with the view of some of the general
public and is not acted upon, because it is permissible for a person to stand on what
he does not prostrate upon” And what indicates that is:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.739 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.357

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عُقْبَةَ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ
أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبِي يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ يَجْعَلُهَا عَلَى الطِّنْفِسَةِ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ
خُمْرَةٌ جَعَلَ حَصَّى عَلَى الطَّنْفِسَةِ حَيْثُ يَسْجُدُ».
english_text:
What was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj from Aban from Abdurrahman
ibn Abi Uqbah from Humran from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "My father {a.s} used to pray upon the khumrah (a small mat) placing it
upon the carpet and would prostrate upon it, and if there was no khumrah, He {a.s}
would place pebbles on the carpet where He {a.s} would prostrate."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.732 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.347

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : «دَعَا أَبِي
بِخُمْرَةٍ فَأَبْطَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ كَفّا مِنْ حَصَّى فَجَعَلَهُ عَلَى الْبِسَاطِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "My father {a.s} requested a khumrah (small prayer mat), but I
delayed in bringing it to Him {a.s}, so He {a.s} took a handful of pebbles and placed them
on the carpet, then prostrated upon them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.731 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.347

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِالْقِيَامِ عَلَى ٱلْمُصَلَّى مِنَ الشَّعْرِ وَ الصُّوفِ إِذَا كَانَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ
نَبَاتِ اَلْأَرْضِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالْقِيَامِ عَلَيْهِ وَ السُجُودِ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar and
Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah from one of them (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "There is no harm in standing upon a prayer mat made of hair or wool
if one prostrates upon the earth; but if it is from the plants of the earth, then there is
no harm in standing upon it and prostrating upon it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.731 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.344

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد عن الحسن بن محبوب قال سألت أبا الحسن عليه السلام : عن الجص يوقد عليه بالعذرة وعظام
الموتى ويجصص به المسجد يسجد عليه؟ فكتب إلي بخطه : إن الماء والنار قد طهراه.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and
the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to
prostrate upon it?
So He {a.s} wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have
purified it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا بِيَدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ إِلَيْهِ يَعْنِي أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ
يَسْأْلُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ الْمَدَنِيَّةِ فَكَتَبَ «صَلِّ فِيهَا مَا كَانَ مَعْمُولاً بِخُيُوطَةٍ وَ لاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى مَا كَانَ بِسُيُورَةِ»
قَالَ فَتَوَقَّفَ أَصْحَابُنَا فَأَنْشَدْتُهُمْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ لِتَأَبَّطَ شَرَا الْفَهْمِيِّ -) كَأَنَّهَا خُيُوطَةُ مَارِيٍّ ثُغَارُ وَ تُفْتَلُ) وَ مَارِيٌّ رَجُلْ
حَبَّالٌ يَفْتِلُ الخُيُوطَ.
english_text:
Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Rayan, who said:
Some of our companions wrote with the hand of Ibrahim ibn Uqbah to Imam {a.s},
meaning Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, asking Him {a.s} about prayer upon the
khumrah of Madinah.
So He {a.s} wrote: "Pray upon it as long as it is made with threadwork, and do not pray
upon that which is made with leather straps."
He said: Then our companions hesitated, so I recited to them a line of poetry by
Ta'abbata Sharran Al-Fihmi: "As if it were the threadwork of a Mari, twisted and spun,"
and Mari is a man who makes ropes and twists threads.
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.733 • Awalim Al- Uloom, Vol.2 3 p.394

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى الْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ عُيَيْنَةَ بَيَّاعِ الْقَصَبِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ فِي الْيَوْمِ الشَّدِيدِ الْحَرِّ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الْحَصَّى فَأَبْسُطُ ثَوْبِي فَأَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ
فَقَالَ « نَعَمْ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسِّ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Al-Muthanna Al-Hannat from
Uyaynah, the seller of reeds, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I enter the mosque on a day of extreme heat and dislike to
pray upon the pebbles, so I spread my garment and prostrate upon it.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.739 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
قُلْتُ لَهُ أَكُونُ فِي السَّفَرِ فَتَحْضُرُ الصَّلاَةُ وَ أَخَافُ الرَمْضَاءَ عَلَى وَجْهِي كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ قَالَ «تَسْجُدُ عَلَى بَعْضِ ثَوْبِكَ»
قُلْتُ لَيْسَ عَلَيَّ ثَوْبٌ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى طَرَفِهِ وَ لا ذَيْلِهِ قَالَ «أسْجُدْ عَلَى ظَهِرٍ كَفَّكَ فَإِنَّهَا إِحْدَى ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far,
peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I am on a journey and the time for prayer arrives, and I fear the
scorching ground for my face. What should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Prostrate upon part of your garment."
I asked: “I do not have a garment with me whose edge or hem I can prostrate upon.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Prostrate on back of your hand, for it is one of places of prostration."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.740 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.351

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْفُضَّيْلِ قَالَ: قَلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ
الرَّجُلُ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى كُمِّهِ مِنْ أَذَى الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abu Talib ibn Al-Salt from Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, a man
prostrates upon his sleeve due to the harm of heat or cold.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.740 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
الْحَسَنٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى كُمَّ قَمِيصِهِ مِنْ أَذَى الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ أَوْ عَلَى رِدَائِهِ إِذَا كَانَ تَحْتَهُ مِسْحٌ
أَوْ غَيْرُهُ مِمَّا لا يُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl from
Ahmad ibn Umar, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about a man who prostrates upon the sleeve of his shirt due
to the harm of heat or cold, or upon his cloak when there is beneath it a mat or
something else upon which prostration is not permitted.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.307 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.740 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ رَجُلُ إِلَى أَبِي
اَلْحَسَنٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَسْجُدُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى التَّوْبِ يَتَّقِي بِهِ وَجْهَهُ مِنَ الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ وَ مِنَ الشَّيْءِ يَكْرَهُ السُّجُودَ
عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ « نَعَمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl ibn
Yasar, who said:
A man wrote to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, asking: “Should a man prostrate upon a cloth to
protect his face from heat and cold, or from something he dislikes to prostrate upon?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.307 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.741 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ وُهَيْبِ بْنِ حَفْص عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْمِسْحِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ فِي تَقِيَّةٍ فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Wuhaib ibn Hafs from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prostrates upon a mat.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is out of dissimulation (taqiyyah), then there is no harm in it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.307 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.741 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.349

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْمِسْحِ وَ الْبِسَاطِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي حَالِ تَقِيَّةِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali from their father
Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, about a man who prostrates upon
a mat or a carpet.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if it is in a state of dissimulation (taqiyyah)."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.307 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.741 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.349

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ الصَرْمِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
فَقُلْتُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْكَتَّانِ وَ الْقُطْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَقِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ «جَائِزٌ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر انه يجوز السجود على هذين الشيئين وان لم يكن هناك تقية إذا كان هناك ضرورة اخرى من حر أو
برد وما يجري مجراهما، والذي يبين ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, and said: “Is it permissible to
prostrate upon linen and cotton without dissimulation (taqiyyah)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It is permissible."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary:
Thus, the interpretation of this report is that it is permissible to prostrate upon these
two materials even if there is no dissimulation (taqiyyah), provided there is another
necessity such as heat or cold or what is similar to them, and what clarifies this is what
was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.307

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ غَيْرٍ وَاجِدٍ
مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّا نَكُونُ بِأَرْضِ بَارِدَةِ يَكُونُ فِيهَا الثَّلْجُ أَفَنَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ « لا
وَ لَكِنِ اِجْعَلْ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَهُ شَيْئاً قُطْناً أَوْ كَثَاناً».
ولا ينافي هذا التأويل ما رواه:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Mansur
ibn Hazim from more than one of our companions, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “We are in a cold land where there is snow;
should we prostrate upon it?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but place something between you and it, such as cotton or linen."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary: And this interpretation is not contradicted by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.308 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.742 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.351

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَالِثِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ السّجُودِ عَلَى الْقُطْنِ وَ الْكَتَّانِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَقِيَّةِ وَ لا ضَرُورَةٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ «ذَلِكَ جَائِزٌ».
الانه يجوز أن يكون إنما اجاز مع نفي ضرورة تبلغ هلاك النفس ، وان كان هناك ضرورة دون ذلك من حر أو برد وما اشبه
ذلك على ما بيناه، فاما ما رواه :
english_text:
Sa'd from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Kaysan Al-San'ani, who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, asking Him {a.s} about
prostrating upon cotton and linen without dissimulation (taqiyyah) and without
necessity.
So Imam {a.s} wrote back to me: "That is permissible."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary:
Because it is possible that he only permitted it with the absence of a necessity that
would reach the level of danger to life, while there may still be a lesser necessity such
as heat or cold and what resembles that, as we have explained. As for what was
narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.308 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.742 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.348

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أحمد بن محمد عن أحمد بن اسحاق عن ياسر الخادم قال مربي أبو الحسن عليه السلام وانا اصلي على الطبري
وقد القيت عليه شيئا اسجد عليه فقال لي مالك لا تسجد عليه؟ أليس هو من نبات الارض؟
فهذا الخبر محمول على حال التقية.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Yasir the servant, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, passed by me while I was praying on the Tabari mat, and I had placed
something upon it to prostrate on, so Imam {a.s} said to me:
“Why do you not prostrate upon it? Is it not from what the earth has produced?”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary: This report is to be understood as referring to a situation of dissimulation (taqiyyah).
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ دَاوُدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْقَرَاطِيسِ وَ الْكَوَاعِذِ
الْمَكْتُوبَةِ عَلَيْهَا هَلْ يَجُوزُ السُّجُودُ عَلَيْهَا أَمْ لا فَكَتَبَ «يَجُوزُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : لا تنافي بين هذا الخبر وبين خبر جميل بن دراج عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام لان ذلك الخبر محمول
على الكراهية وهو صريح فيها وليس فيه شئ من الفاظ الحظر
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
Dawud ibn Yazid asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about papers and parchment that have
writing on them, is it permissible to prostrate upon them or not?
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "It is permissible."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “There is no contradiction between this report and the
report of Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, because that report is to be
understood as indicating dislike, and it is explicit in that, and it does not contain any
wording of prohibition.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.737

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ الْجَمَّالِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فِي
الْمَحْمِلٍ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى قِرْطَاسِ وَ أَكْثَرَ ذَلِكَ يُومِئُ إِيمَاءَ.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Najran from Safwan Al-Jammal, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, in the howdah prostrating upon paper, and most of the time
Imam {a.s} would gesture with a slight indication.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.373 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.738 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.355 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.91 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.154

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ
مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُضَارِبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ كُدْسِ جِنْطَةٍ مُطَيَّنِ أصَلِّي فَوْقَهُ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَّ
فَوْقَهُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ مِثلُ السَّطْحِ مُسْتَوِ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَ عَلَيْهِ».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn
Uthman from Ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Mudarib from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a mound of wheat covered with clay, may I pray upon it?
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray upon it."
I asked: “But it is like a leveled surface.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray upon it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.400 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.453 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.182

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ يَكُونُ الْكُدْسُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ مُطَيَّنا مِثلَ السَّطْحِ قَالَ «صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ».
لان الخبر الاول محمول على الكراهية دون الحظر.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha from Ahmad ibn A'id from Umar ibn Hanzalah,
who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “There is a mound of food covered with clay, levelled like a
surface, may I pray upon it?”
He said: "Pray upon it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: Because the first report is to be understood as indicating dislike, not prohibition.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.400 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.453 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.182

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ
تَسْجُدَ وَ بَيْنَ كَفِّيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ الْأَرْضِ ثَوْبُكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah, who said:
Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in prostrating while there is
your garment between your palms and the ground."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.719 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.353

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ : «أَنَّهُ كَانَ لا يَسْجُدُ عَلَى
الْكُمِّيْنٍ وَلا عَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam {a.s}) Ja'far {a.s}, from his father {a.s},
about (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
"That He (Imam Ali {a.s}) would not prostrate upon the sleeves nor upon the turban."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.743 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.363

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ الصَّرْمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّي أَخْرُجُ فِي هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَ رُبَّمَا
لَمْ يَكُنُ مَوْضِعْ أَصَلِّي فِيهِ مِنَ الثَّلْجِ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ أَمْكَنَكَ أَنْ لا تَسْجُدَ عَلَى الثَّلْجِ فَلا تَسْجُدْ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ
لَمْ يُمْكِنْكَ فَسَوِّهِ وَ أُسْجُدْ عَلَيْهِ».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, and said to Him {a.s}: “I go out on this journey, and sometimes
there is no place to pray except upon snow, what should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is possible for you not to prostrate upon the snow, then do not
prostrate upon it, but if it is not possible, then level it and prostrate upon it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
commentary: And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.390 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.261 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.452 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1051 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.164

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ عَلَى الثَّلْجِ فَقَالَ «لا تَسْجُدْ
فِي السَّبَخَةِ وَ لاَ عَلَى التَّلْجِ».
لان هذا الخبر محمول على حال الاختيار أو مع وجود شئ يستر به الثلج ويسجد عليه على ما بيناه في خبر منصور بن
حازم.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about prostrating upon snow.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate in the salt marsh nor upon snow."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
Because this report is to be understood as referring to the situation of choice, or when
there is something available to cover the snow and prostrate upon it, as we have
explained in the report of Mansur ibn Hazim.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.743 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.164 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.358

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بَن مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشيَمَ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحُضَيْنِي قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى
السَّرِيرٍ وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَتَبَ «لاَ بَأْسَ صَلَ فِيهِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim Al-Hudayni, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays upon a bed while he is able to pray on the
ground.
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "There is no harm; pray upon it."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.453 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.179

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي مَحْمُودِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الرَّجُلُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى سَرِيرٍ مِنْ سَاجٍ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى
اَلسَّاجٍ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man prays upon a bed made of
teakwood and prostrates upon the teakwood, is that permissible?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.261 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.178 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.364

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ صَالِحِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْحَصَى قَالَ
«يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَمْكِنَ».
english_text:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prostrates upon pebbles.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should raise his head until he becomes firmly settled."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.720 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.354

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: ذَكَرَ أَنَّ رَجْلاً
أَتَى أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ وَ سَأْلَهُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ عَلَى الْبُورِيَاءِ وَ الْخَصَفَةِ وَ النَّبَاتِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who
said:
It was mentioned that a man came to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, and asked Imam
{a.s} about prostrating upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and plants.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.346

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْبُورِيَاءِ وَ
اَلْخَصَفَةٍ وَ كُلِّ نَبَاتٍ إِلَّ الثَّمَرَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ibrahim Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon woven mats,
palm-leaf mats, and every plant except the fruit."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.261 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.345

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَدَيْنَةَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
عَنِ السَّجُودِ عَلَى الْحُصُرِ وَ الْبَوَارِي فَقَالَ « لا بَأْسَ وَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يُجِبُّ ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُمَكِّنَ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَنَا أَجِبُّ لَكَ مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
يُحِبُّهُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ishaq ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
He asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about prostrating upon mats and woven reed mats.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm, but that one prostrates upon the earth is more
beloved to me, for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
used to love that, to firmly place his forehead upon the earth, so I love for you what the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, used to love."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.368

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الْمَرِيضِ فَقَالَ «يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَوْ عَلَى الْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ يَرْفَعُهُ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ ٱلْإِيمَاءِ إِنَّمَا كَرِهَ مَنْ
كَرِهَ السُّجُودَ عَلَى ٱلْمِرْوَحَةِ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْأَوْثَانِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تُعْبَدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَ إِنَّا لَمْ نَعْبُدْ غَيْرَ اللَّهِ قَطٌ فَاسْجُدْ
عَلَى الْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى عُودٍ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far,
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the sick person.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should prostrate upon the earth or on a hand fan (mirwaha) or upon
a tooth-stick that he raises, this is better than gesturing.
The one who disliked prostrating on a hand fan only did so because of the idols that
were once worshipped besides Allah {SWT}, but we have never worshipped other than
Allah {SWT} at all. So prostrate on a hand fan, or on a stick, or on a tooth-stick (miswak)."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.177 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.745

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُومِن فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ النَّوَافِلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَوْضِعٌ يَسْجُدُ فِيهِ
قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ هَكَذَا فَلْيُومِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ كُلَّهَا».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati,
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who gestures during the obligatory and
supererogatory prayers when he does not find anything to prostrate upon and has no
place to prostrate.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is like that, then let him gesture throughout the entire prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1052 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.375

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى الثَّلْجِ قَالَ «لَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى
اَلْأَرْضِ بَسَطَ ثَوْبَهُ وَ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ مَطَرٌ وَ هُوَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ لا يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ فِيهِ مِنَ الطِّينِ وَ
لا يَجِدُ مَوْضِعاً جَافاً قَالَ «يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاةَ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ كَمَا رَكَعَ إِذَا صَلَّى فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَلْيُومِ
بِالسُّجُودِ إِيمَاءً وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَ يَتَشَهَدُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ يُسَلَّمُ».
english_text:
And from him with this same chain of transmission, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prays upon snow.
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but if he is unable to find earth, he should spread his garment and
pray upon it."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a man who is caught by rain and is in a place where
he cannot prostrate due to the mud and cannot find a dry place.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should begin the prayer, and when he bows, let him bow as usual
in prayer, and when he raises his head from bowing, he should gesture for the
prostration while standing. He should do that until he completes the prayer, and he
should recite the testimony (tashahhud) while standing, then he should conclude with
the taslim."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.603 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.101

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ حَدَّ ٱلطّينِ ٱَلَّذِي لا يُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ مَا هَوَ قَالَ «إِذَا
غَرِقَتِ الْجَبْهَةُ فِيهِ وَ لَمْ تَثُبُثْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ».
english_text:
And with this same chain of transmission from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the extent of mud upon which it is not permissible to prostrate,
what is it?
Imam {a.s} said: "When forehead sinks into it and does not remain stable on the ground."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.447 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.376 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.143 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.306

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السّلامُ قَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الْمِثَالِ إِذَا جَعَلْتَهُ تَحْتَكَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira by Alaa by Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon a patterned
cloth if you place it beneath you."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.464 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.439

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَضَعُ وَجْهِي لِلسُجُودِ فَيَقَعُ وَجْهِي عَلَى حَجَرٍ أَوْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مُرْتَفِعِ أُحَوِّلُ وَجْهِي إِلَى مَكَانٍ مُسْتَوٍ
قَالَ «نَعَمْ جُرَّ وَجْهَكَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَرْفَعَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan from Husayn ibn
Hammad from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I lower my face for prostration, and my face falls upon a stone or
something elevated, should I move my face to a level place?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, drag your face upon the ground without lifting it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.722 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.353

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْحَصَى وَ لا يُمَكِّنُ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالَ «يُحَرِّكُ جَبْهَتَهُ حَتَّى يَتَمَكِّنَ
فَيُنَحِّي الْحَصَى عَنْ جَبْهَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah together from Ali ibn Ja'far from his
brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prostrates upon pebbles but does not firmly place
his forehead upon the ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should move his forehead until he becomes firmly settled, pushing
the pebbles away from under his forehead without lifting his head."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.239 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.202 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.722 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.353 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.129

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّهْدِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ
عَلَى الْأَرْضِ الْمُرْتَفِعَةِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ مَوْضِعُ جَبْهَتِكَ مُرْتَفِعاً عَنْ مَوْضِعِ بَدَنِكَ قَدْرَ لَبِنَةٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Nahdi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about prostrating upon elevated ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the place of your forehead is elevated above the place of your body
by the height of a brick, then there is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحيّى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِالتَّشَهُدِ وَ الْقَوْلِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ وَ الْقُنُوتِ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ جَهَرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَجْهَزْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far
{a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, is it permissible for him to raise his voice in the
tashahhud, and in what is said during bowing, prostration, and qunoot?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he wishes, he may raise his voice, and if he wishes, he may not raise
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.237 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.198 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.694 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.290 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.332

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ٱلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَيُوبَ الْغَافِقِيِّ عَنْ عَمِّهِ إِيَاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ
الْغَافِقِيِّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرِ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ «فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ» قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «اِجْعَلُوهَا فِي رُكُوعِكُمْ» فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ «سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى» قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
«اجْعَلُوها فِي سُجُودِكُمْ».
english_text:
From him, from Yusuf ibn Al-Harith from Abdullah ibn Yazid Al-Minqari from Musa ibn Ayyub Al-Ghafiqi from
his uncle Iyas ibn Amir Al-Ghafiqi from Uqbah ibn Amir Al-Juhani, who said:
When the verse "So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great" (Surah Waqi'ah
56:96) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, said to us (companions): "Place it in your bowing."
Then when the verse "Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" (Surah A'la 87:1)
was revealed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said
to us (companions): "Place it in your prostration."
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.333 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.704 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.327 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.635 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.105

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عنه عن العباس بن معروف عن محمد بن يحيى الصير في عن حماد بن عثمان عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام قال
: سمعته يقول : السجود على ما انبتت الارض إلا ما أكل أو لبس.
english_text:
From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Sayrafi from Hammad ibn Uthman from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: "Prostration is upon what the earth has produced, except for
what is eaten or worn."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ ٱلرَّازِيِّ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ
لِي عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ أَرَى جَبْهَتَهُ جَلْحَاءَ لَيْسَ فِيهَا أَثَرُ السُّجُوبِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Abu Muhammad Al-Razi from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni from
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: "Indeed, I dislike that I see a man whose
forehead is bare and has no trace of prostration upon it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.376 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.160

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ تَطُولُ قُصَّتُهَا
فَإِذَا سَجَدَتْ وَقَعَ بَعْضُ جَبْهَتِهَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ بَعْضٌ يُغَطّيهِ الشَّعْرُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «لا حَتَّى تَضَعَ جَبْهَتَهَا
عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon them
both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a woman whose forelock grows long, so when she prostrates,
part of her forehead touches the ground while part of it is covered by her hair, is that
permissible?
Imam {a.s} said: "No, until she places her forehead fully upon the ground."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.239 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.224 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.717 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.363 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.130 • Mustadrak Al- Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.12

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَزَوَّرِ عَنِ ٱلْأَصْبَغِ
بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ قَعَدَ حَتَّى يَظْمَيِنَ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا
أَمِيرَ الْمُوْمِنِينَ كَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَ عُمَرُ إِذَا رَفَعُوا رُءُوسَهُمْ عَنِ السُّجُودِ نَهَضُوا عَلَى صُدُورِ أَقْدَامِهِمْ كَمَا
تَنْهَضُ الْإِبِلُ فَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنَّمَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَهْلُ الْجَفَاءِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْ تَوْقِيرِ الصَّلاةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah
from Ali ibn Al-Hazawwar from Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:
When the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, would raise his head from
prostration, He {a.s} would sit until He {a.s} became calm, then He {a.s} would stand.
So it was said to Imam {a.s}: “O Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, Abu Bakr and Umar
before you, when they raised their heads from prostration, they would rise on the balls
of their feet as camels rise.
Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, only the coarse people (Ahl al-Jafa) do that; rather, this calmness is part of
showing reverence for the prayer."
(‘coarse people - Ahl al-Jafa)’; harsh, rough, or lacking refinement in behavior and
indifferent to the deeper etiquettes of worship)
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.725 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.347

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ السُّورَةِ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ يَدْعُو بِهَا فِي الصَّلاةِ مِثْلِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» فَقَالَ «إِذَا كُنْتَ
تَدْعُو بِهَا فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd
ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about mentioning a chapter from the Book (the Qur'an) and
supplicating with it in prayer, like ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are supplicating with it, then there is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.302 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.882 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.53 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.703 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 4 p.502

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ إِسحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ أُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدٌ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ هُوَ مِثلُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Yahya Al-Halabi from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Basir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I send blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, while I am in prostration, is that permissible?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it is like saying SubhanAllah and Allahu Akbar."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.326

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ رَاشِدِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ مِسْمَعِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ نَهَى أَنْ يُغَمّضَ الرَّجُلُ عَيْنَيْهِ
فِي الصَّلاَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Rayan from Al-Husayn ibn Rashid from some of his
companions from Misma' from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon him:
"The Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, forbade a man from closing his
eyes during the prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.838 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.249 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.228 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.266

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ
وَ مَا يُقَالُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ »مَا قَضَى اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِكَ وَ لاَ أُعلَمُ فِيهِ شَيْئاً مُوَقَّتاً».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban from Isma'il ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the qunoot and what should be said in it.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whatever Allah {SWT} causes to flow from your tongue, and I do not know
of anything specifically fixed for it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.755 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.277 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.98

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَدْنَى
الْقُنُوتِ فَقَالَ «خَمْسُ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the minimum of the qunoot.
Imam {a.s} said: "Five tasbihat (saying SubhanAllah five times)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.756 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.273

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ رَجُلٌ نَسِيَ الْقُنُوتَ وَ هُوَ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ «يَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ ليَقُلْهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ
يَرْغَبَ عَنْ سُنَّةٍ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَوْ يَدَعَهَا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “A man forgets the qunoot while on his way
(after the prayer).”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should face the qiblah and then say it."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, I dislike for a man to turn away from the Sunnah of the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, or to abandon it
(Qunoot)."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.935 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.286

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْكُوفِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثِ
قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «قُلْ فِي الرَكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ التّشَهُمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْهَضَ - سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Husayn ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn Sufyan from
Amr ibn Hurayth, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, said to me: "Say in the first two rak‘ahs, after the tashahhud and
before you rise, Subhan Allah {SWT}, Subhan Allah {SWT} seven times."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.409

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِنْ نَسِيَ الرَّجْلُ الْقُنُوتَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ
أَنْ يَدَعَهُ مُتَعَمِّداً».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "If a man forgets the qunoot in any part of the prayer until he
bows, his prayer is still valid and there is nothing upon him, but it is not permissible for
him to deliberately abandon it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.936 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.286

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى الْفَقِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ ٱلْقُنُوتِ
فكَتَبَ إليَّ «إِذَا كَانَتْ ضَرُورَةْ شَدِيدَةْ فَلاَ تَرْفَعِ الْيَدَيْنِ وَ قُلْ ثَلاَثَ مَرّاتِ «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرّحْمْنِ الرّحِيمِ» ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, who said:
I wrote to the Al Faqih (Jurist), peace be upon him, asking Imam {a.s} about the qunoot.
He {a.s} wrote back to me: "If there is a severe necessity, then do not raise your hands,
and say three times: ‘Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim.’"
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.753 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.274 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.282

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَليدِ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَدْخُلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأَخِيرَةِ مِنَ الْغَدَاةِ مَعَ ٱلْإِمَامِ فَيَقْنُتُ ٱلْإِمَامُ أَيَقْنُتْ مَعَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ يُجْزِيهِ
مِنَ الْقُنُوتِ لِنَفْسِهِ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid Al-Khazzaz from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who joins the last rak'ah of the Fajr prayer
with the imam (of prayer), and the imam performs qunoot, should he perform qunoot
with him?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, and it suffices him for the qunoot for himself."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.753 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.287

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ
اَللَّه عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَخَافُ أَنْ أَقْنُتَ وَ خَلْفِي مُخَالِفُونَ فَقَالَ «رَفْعُكَ يَدَيْكَ يُجْزِي» يَعْنِي رَفْعَهُمَا كَأَنَّكَ تَرْكَعُ.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ali ibn Asbat from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ammar Al-
Sabati, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I fear to perform qunoot while there are opponents (non-
followers) behind me”.
Imam {a.s} said: "Raising your hands suffices," meaning raising them as if you are
bowing.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.753 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.282

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلتَّشَهْدُ
فِي النّافِلَةٍ بَعْضُ تَشَهُدِ الْفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "The tashahhud in the supererogatory prayer is part of the
tashahhud of the obligatory prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.772 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.394

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ تَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ عَنْ مُيَسِّرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «شَيْئَانِ يُفْسِدُ ٱَلنَّاسُ بِهِمَا
صَلاتَهُمْ قَوْلُ الرَّجُلِ تَبَارَكَ اِسْمُكَ وَ تَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ وَ إِنَّمَا هَوَ شَيْءُ قَالَتهُ الْجِنُ بِجَهَالَةٍ فَحَكَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ
وَ جَلَّ عَنْهُمْ وَ قَوْلُ الرَّجْلِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اللّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ ».
english_text:
From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr from Tha'labah ibn Maymun from Muyassar:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Two things by which people corrupt their prayer
are: a man saying ‘Tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruka’ (Blessed is
Your {AZJ} Name, exalted is Your {AZJ} Majesty, and there is no god besides You {AZJ}),
And this is something the jinn said out of ignorance, and Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, related it from them, and a man saying ‘As-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillah
as-salihin’ (Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT})."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Khisal, Vol.1 p.50 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.772 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.409 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.286 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.506 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.320 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.304 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.435

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مَا مَعْنَى قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ قَالَ «الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abu Shu'ayb by Abu Jamilah by Abdurrahman ibn Abdullah:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “What is the meaning of a man's saying At-tahiyyatu lillah
(greetings are for Allah {SWT})?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It means sovereignty belongs to Allah {SWT}."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.772 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.394

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ الْهَاشِمِيَّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي كَهْمَسِ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوّلَتَيْنِ إِذَا جَلَسْتُ فِيهِمَا لِلتَشَهُدِ فَقُلْتُ وَ أَنَا جَالِسْ
السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ اِنْصِرَافاً هُوَ قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا قُلْتَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ
الصَّالِحِينَ فَهُوَ الإِنْصِرَافُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Ya'qub Al-Hashimi from Marwan ibn
Muslim from Abu Kahmas from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the first two rak'ahs, when I sit for the tashahhud and while
sitting I say, ‘Peace be upon you, O Prophet {saws}, and the mercy of Allah {SWT} and His
blessings’, is that considered the dismissal (end of prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but when you say, ‘Peace be upon us and upon the righteous
servants of Allah {SWT}’, that is the dismissal (end of prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.348 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.604 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.41 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.773 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.426 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.309

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ:
«كُلْ مَا ذَكَرْتَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ بِهِ وَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ قُلْتَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ
اللّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ فَقَدِ اِنْصَرَفْتَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Everything by which you mention Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, and the Prophet {saws}, is part of the prayer, and if you say ‘Peace be upon us
and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT}’, then you have concluded (the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.42 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.766 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.426

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ عَنِ الصَلاةِ
فَانْصَرِفَ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When you conclude the prayer, then turn to your right side."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.338 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.375 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.782 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.421 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.422 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.500 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.500 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.303 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.326

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنِ النَّعْمَانِ بْنِ عَبْدِ
السّلاَمٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنِ اَلْبُكَاءِ فِي الصَّلاةِ أَيَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «إِنْ بَكَى
لِذِكْرٍ جَنَّةٍ أَوْ نَارٍ فَذَلِكَ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ ٱلْأَعْمَالِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ مَيّتاً لَهُ فَصَلاَتُهُ فَاسِدَةٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn
Dawud from Al-Nu'man ibn Abd Al-Salam from Abu Hanifah, who said:
