I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about crying during prayer, does it invalidate the prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he cries due to the remembrance of Paradise or Hellfire, then that is
the best of deeds in prayer, but if he cries because of remembering a deceased person
of his, then his prayer is invalid."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.408 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.880 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.247 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.313

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ التَّسْلِيمِ مَا هُوَ فَقَالَ «هُوَ إِذْنٌ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati, who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the taslim, what is it?
Imam {a.s} said: "It is permission (to end the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.782 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.416 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.311

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ إِخْوَتِي
مُوسَى وَ إسْحَاقَ وَ مُحَمَّداً بَنِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ يُسَلَّمُونَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَ ٱلشَمَالِ - « ٱلسَّلَاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ
وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far, peace be
upon him, who said:
I saw my brothers (Imam) Musa {a.s}, Ishaq, and Muhammad, the sons of Ja'far, peace
be upon him, giving taslim (salutation) in prayer to the right and to the left, saying:
"Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon you and the mercy of
Allah {SWT}."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.309 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.779 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.419

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ اِبْنِ أُذَيْئَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ وَ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَرَغَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ صَلاَثُهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً فِي أَمْرِ يَخَافُ أَنْ
يَفُوتَهُ فَسَلَّمَ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ أَجْزَأَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl, Zurarah, and
Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When a man completes the two testimonies
(shahadatayn), his prayer is complete. So if he is in a hurry for something he fears may
be missed, and he says the taslim and departs, it suffices him."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.774 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.397 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.416 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.301

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ خَلْفَ
الْإِمَامِ فَيْطِيلُ الْإِمَامُ النَّشَهُدَ قَالَ «يُسَلَّمُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ وَ يَمْضِي فِي حَاجَتِهِ إِنْ أَحَبّ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who is behind the imam (of prayer) and
the imam (of prayer) prolongs the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "Those behind him may say the taslim and proceed to their needs if they
wish."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.393 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.349 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1273 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.416 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.413

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ الرَّجُلُ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ الْأَخِيرِ فَقَالَ «تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنَّمَا التَّشَهْدُ
سُنَّةٌ فِي الصَّلاةٍ فَيَتَوَضَّأْ وَ يَجْلِسُ مَكَانَهُ أَوْ مَكَاناً نَظِيفاً فَيَتَشَهَّدُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : يحتمل أن يكون إنما سأل عمن أحدث بعد الشهادتين وإن لم يستوف باقي تشهده فلاجل ذلك قال:
تمت صلاته ، ولو كان قبل ذلك لكان يجب عليه اعادة الصلاة على ما بيناه، وأما قوله : وإنما التشهد سنة معناه ما زاد على
الشهادتين على ما بيناه فيما مضى ويكون ما أمره به من اعادته بعد أن يتوضأ محمولا على الاستحباب، فأما ما رواه:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from
Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man experiences a hadath (minor
ritual impurity) after he raises his head from the final prostration.”
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete, and indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah within
the prayer, so he should perform ablution and sit in his place or in a clean place and
then recite the tashahhud."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “It is possible that the question was regarding one who
experiences a hadath after the two testimonies, even if he did not complete the rest of
his tashahhud, and for that reason he said: His prayer is complete. And if it had been
before that, it would have been obligatory upon him to repeat the prayer, as we have
explained. As for his statement: "And indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah," its meaning
is what is beyond the two testimonies, as we have explained previously, and what he
commanded him to do, to repeat it after performing ablution, is to be understood as
recommended.” As for what he narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.318 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.342 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.402 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.866 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.411

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى وَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ
عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فِي السَّجْدَةِ الْأَخِيرَةِ وَ قَبْلَ أَنْ
يَتَشَهْدَ قَالَ «يَنْصَرِفُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ رَجَعَ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فَفِي بَيْتِهِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ حَيْثُ شَاءَ قَعَدَ فَتَشَهَدَ
ثُمَّ يُسَلَّمُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ الْحَدَثُ بَعْدَ الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ مَضَّتْ صَلَاَتُهُ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر ان نحمله على من دخل في صلاته بتيمم ثم أحدث ناسيا قبل الشهادتين فانه يتوضأ إذا كان قد
وجد الماء ويتمم الصلاة بالشهادتين وليس عليه اعادتها كما أن عليه اتمامها لو أحدث قبل ذلك على ما بيناه في كتاب
الطهارة.
english_text:
Sa'd from Abu Ja'far from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa and Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn
Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who experiences a hadath
after he raises his head from the final prostration and before he recites the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, perform ablution, and if he wishes, he may return to
the mosque, and if he wishes, then in his house, and if he wishes, wherever he wishes,
he may sit and recite the tashahhud and then offer the taslim. And if the hadath occurs
after the two testimonies, then his prayer has been completed."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
The interpretation of this narration is that we carry it upon the one who entered his
prayer with tayammum and then experienced a hadath forgetfully before the two
testimonies; in that case, he should perform ablution if he has found water and
complete the prayer with the two testimonies, and it is not obligatory upon him to
repeat it, just as it is obligatory upon him to complete it if he experiences a hadath
before that, as we have explained in the Book of Purity.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.347 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.318 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.343 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.402 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.866 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.410

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ السِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَأْخَذُهُ الرُّعَافُ أَوِ الْقَيِءُ فِي الصَّلاةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَنْقَتِلُ فَيَغْسِلُ
أَنْفَهُ وَ يَعُودُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَلْيُعِدِ الصَّلاَةَ».
english_text:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Musa ibn Al-Hasan from Al-Sindi ibn Muhammad from Al-Ala' ibn Razin from
Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is overtaken by nosebleed or vomiting during the
prayer; what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, wash his nose, and return to the prayer, and if he
speaks, then he must repeat the prayer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.318 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.403 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.240

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ
مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنْ نَسِيَ الرَّجُلُ التَّشَهُدَ فِي
الصَّلاَةِ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَقَطْ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ شَيْئاً مِنَ التَّشَهْدِ أَعَادَ الصَّلاَةَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذا الخبر انه إذا ذكر انه قال : بسم اللّٰه فقد تمت صلاته ويتمم الشهادتين على جهة
القضاء ولا يعيد الصلاة، وإذا لم يذكر شيئا من التشهد اعاد الصلاة إذا كان تركه له متعمدا ، وليس في الخبر أنه إذا لم
يذكره ناسيا أو متعمدا ، ولو تركه ناسيا ثم ذكر كان يجب عليه قضاء التشهد على ما بيناه.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn
Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets the tashahhud in the
prayer and remembers that he only said 'In the name of Allah {SWT},' then his prayer is
valid. But if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the
prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this narration is that if he
remembers that he said: " Bismillah," then his prayer is complete, and he should
complete the two testimonies in the manner of fulfillment and does not repeat the
prayer. And if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the
prayer if he left it intentionally. And there is nothing in the narration indicating whether
he left it forgetfully or intentionally. But if he left it forgetfully and then remembered, it
would be obligatory upon him to fulfill the tashahhud as we have explained.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.319 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.343 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.943 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.403 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.155

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْكُوفِيّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي الْمَكْثُوبَةَ فَتَنْقَضِي صَلاَتُهُ وَ يَتَشَهَّدُ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ
قَالَ «قَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ رُعَافاً غَسَلَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَسَلَمَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ghalib
ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who performs the obligatory prayer, and his prayer
concludes and he recites the tashahhud, then he falls asleep before offering the
taslim.
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete, and if it was a nosebleed, he should wash it
and then return and offer the taslim."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.868 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.425

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أحمد بن محمد عن ابن أبي عمير عن سعد بن بكر عن حبيب الخثعمي عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال سمعته
يقول : إذا جلس الرجل للتشهد فحمد اللّه أجزأه.
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذا الخبر التقية لانه مذهب العامة ونحن قد بينا وجوب الشهادتين والصلاة على محمد
واله،
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Sa'd ibn Bakr from Habib Al-Khath'ami from Abu Ja'far,
peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: “When a man sits for the tashahhud and praises Allah {SWT}, it
suffices him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this narration is that it is due to
taqiyyah, because it is the doctrine of the general public, and we have already
explained the obligation of the two testimonies and the sending of blessings upon
Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
يُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُحْدِثُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ قَالَ «قَدْ تَمَّثْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَ إِمَامٍ فَوَجَدَ فِي بَطْنِهِ أَذَّى فَسَلَّمَ فِي
نَفْسِهِ وَ قَامَ فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: هذا الخبر يدل على ان التسليم ليس بفرض لانه لو كان فرضا لكان يجب عليه اعادة الصلاة، فأما
مارواه :
مممسطن صمعلونوسلسلممسالمانممطل سلململواسهلهمممنسمميا
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is praying, then sits and experiences a hadath
before offering the taslim.
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete, and if he is praying with an imam (of prayer)
and he feels discomfort in his stomach and offers the taslim to himself and stands up,
then his prayer is complete."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration indicates that the taslim is not an
obligation, because if it were an obligation, it would be necessary for him to repeat the
prayer.” As for what he narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.867 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.424

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
فِي رَجُلٍ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فَلَمَّا جَلَسَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَشَهَدَ رَعَفَ قَالَ «فَلْيَخْرُجْ فَلْيَغْسِلْ أَنْفَهُ ثُمَّ ليَرْجِع
فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ فَإِنَّ آخِرَ الصَّلاَةِ التَّسْلِيمُ».
قوله عليه السلام : آخر الصلاة التسليم محمول على الافضل ، واما اتمام الصلاة فلا بد منه لان من اتمامها الاتيان
بالشهادتين على ما بيناه :
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah from Abu Basir who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say regarding a man who prayed the
morning prayer, and when he sat in the two units before reciting the tashahhud, he
experienced a nosebleed.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, wash his nose, then return and complete his prayer,
for the end of the prayer is the taslim."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
His statement, peace be upon him, "the end of the prayer is the taslim," is to be
understood as referring to what is preferable. As for the completion of the prayer, it is
necessary, because part of completing it is the recitation of the two testimonies, as
we have explained.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.320 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.345 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.416

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ الْمُسْتَرِقٌ عَنْ هِشَامٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ إِنّي أُخْرُجُ فِي الْحَاجَةِ وَ أُحِبْ أنْ أكُونَ مُعَقَّباً فَقَالَ «إنْ كُنْتَ عَلَى وُضُوءِ فَأَنْتَ مُعَقِّبٌ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Abbas from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Abu Dawud Al-Mustariq from Hisham who
said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I go out for a need, and I like to be among
those who perform ta'qib (post-prayer supplication).”
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are in a state of ablution, then you are among those who perform
ta'qib."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.786 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.457 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.316

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
فِي حَاجَةٍ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «اِنْصَرِف فَإِذَا كَانَ غَداً فَتَعَالَ وَ لا تَجِى إِلاَّ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَإِنَّي أَنَامُ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ
الفَجْرَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الرواية وردت رخصة والافضل ان لا ينام الانسان بعد الفجر الى طلوع الشمس ، ويجوز أن
يكون عليه السلام إنما نام لعذر كان به.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Musa ibn Umar from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad who said:
Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, sent for me regarding a need, so I entered
upon Imam {a.s}.
Imam {a.s} said: "Leave, and when tomorrow comes, then come, but do not come
except after the sun has risen, for I sleep after I have prayed the Fajr prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration has been reported as a concession,
and it is preferable that a person does not sleep after the Fajr prayer until the rising of
the sun, and it is permissible that Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, only slept due to an
excuse that He {a.s} had.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.320 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.350 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 6 p.544 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.497 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 2 p.176

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ ٱلسّكُونِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ
عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى فَجَلَسَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ كَانَ لَهُ سِثْراً
مِنَ النَّارِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Al-Sakuni
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his father {a.s}:
(Imam) Al-Hasan ibn Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever prays and sits in his
prayer place until the rising of the sun, there will be for him a covering from the Fire."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan Ibn Ali al- Mujtaba {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.332 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.117 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1553 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.458 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.315

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمِ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَقَالَ إِنَّي أَصَلِّي الْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ أَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ بِكُلَّ مَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذكُرَهُ مِمَّا يَجِبُ عَلَيّ فَأْرِيدُ أَنْ
أضَعَ جَنْبِي فَأَنَامَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَأَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «وَ لِمَ» قَالَ أَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَطْلَعِهَا قَالَ
«لَيْسَ بِذَلِكَ خَفَاءَ أُنْظُرْ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حَرَجِ أَنْ تَنَامَ إِذَا كُنْتَ قَدْ
ذَكَرْتَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim from Salim ibn Abi Khadijah
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked Imam {a.s} while I was listening, and said: “I pray the Fajr prayer, then I
engage in the remembrance of Allah {SWT} with all that I wish to remember of what is
obligatory upon me, then I desire to lay down my side and sleep before the rising of the
sun, but I dislike that.”
Imam {a.s} said: "And why?"
(the man) said: “I dislike that the sun should rise from other than its usual place.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no ambiguity in that. Look from where the Fajr rises, for from
there the sun rises, and there is no harm upon you to sleep if you have already engaged
in the remembrance of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.350 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 6 p.544 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.498 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.5 2 p.268

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
محمد بن علي بن محبوب عن محمد بن الحسين عن محمد ابن سنان عن عمار بن مروان عن المنخل بن جميل
عن جابر عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال : إذا انحرفت عن صلاة مكتوبة فلا تنحرف إلا بانصراف لعن بني امية.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar
ibn Marwan from Al-Munakhkhal ibn Jamil from Jabir:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “When you turn away from an obligatory prayer,
do not turn away except with a supplication for the curse upon the sons of Umayyah.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَخْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ثُوَيْرٍ وَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ
السَّرَّاجٍ قَالاَ: سَمِعْنَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ هُوَ يَلْعَنُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ مَكْتُوبَةِ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَ أَرْبَعاً مِنَ النَّسَاءِ
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Al-
Husayn ibn Thuwair and Abu Salamah Al-Sarraj who said:
We heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, while Imam {a.s} was cursing after every
obligatory prayer four men and four women; the Taymi, the Adawi, so-and-so, and
Mu'awiyah. And Imam {a.s} would name them, and so-and-so and so-and-so and Hind
and Umm Al-Hakam, the sister of Mu'awiyah.”
(The Four Men: al-Taymi; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa from Banu Taym of Quraysh, al-
Adawi; Umar ibn al-Khattab from the Banu ‘Adi clan, ‘so-and-so’; Uthman ibn ‘Affan &
Mu‘awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan of Banu Umayyah.
The Four Women: ‘so-and-so and so-and-so’; Aisha bint Abi Bakr and Hafsa bint Umar,
Hind bint ‘Utbah; mother of Mu’awiyah and wife of Abu Sufyan, Umm al-Hakam bint
Abi Sufyan; the sister of Mu’awiyah)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.803 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.3 0 p.397 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.58

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو
عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ الْإِمَامُ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَقَامِهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَنْحَرِفَ عَنْ مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim from
Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When the imam (of prayer) finishes the
prayer, he should not perform two units of prayer in his place until he moves away from
his position."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.382 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.186

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَدِّهِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ فَلْيَرْفَعْ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى
السّمَاءٍ وَلْيَنصَب فِي الدُّعَاءِ» فَقَالَ اِبْنُ سَبَا يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ أَلَيْسَ اللّهُ فِي كُلَّ مَكَانٍ فَقَالَ «بَلَى» قَالَ فَلِمَ يَرْفَعُ
يَدَيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ قَالَ «أَمَا تَقْرَأُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ «وَ فِي السِّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَ مَا تُوعَدُونَ» فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يُطْلَبُ الرِّزْقُ إلا مِنْ
مَوْضِعِهِ وَ مَوْضِعُ الرِّزْقِ وَ مَا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاءُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid from Abu Basir
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them:
The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon him, said:
"When one of you finishes the prayer, let him raise his hands toward the sky and devote
himself to supplication."
Ibn Saba said: “O Commander of the Faithful, is not Allah {SWT} in every place?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
He asked: “Then why does he raise his hands toward the sky?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do you not read in the Qur'an: 'And in the heaven is your sustenance
and that which you are promised'? (Surah Dhariyat 51:22)
So from where is sustenance sought except from its place? And the place of
sustenance and what Allah {SWT} has promised is the heaven."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.325 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.344 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.785 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.487 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.161 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.9 0 p.308 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.124 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 2 p.417 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.5 p.184

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ
اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَجْعَلُ الْعَنَزَةَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِذَا صَلَّى».
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.296 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.406 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.481 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.136 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 6 p.263 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.300

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «كَانَ طُولُ رَحْلِ رَسُولِ
اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ذِرَاعاً وَ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَسْتَتِرُ بِهِ مِمَّنْ يَمُرُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: هذه الاخبار محمولة على الاستحباب لا ان من لم يفعله فسدت صلاته ، والذي يدل على ذلك رواه:
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The length of the saddle of the Messenger
of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, was one cubit, and when He {saws}
prayed, He {saws} would place it in front of Him and shield himself with it from those who
would pass in front of Him {saws}."
source: Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “These narrations are to be understood as
recommending the act, not that whoever does not do it, his prayer is invalid.” What
indicates this is what has been narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.296 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.406 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.481 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.136 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 6 p.263

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ شَيْءُ مِمَا يَمُرْ بِهِ فَقَالَ «لا يَقْطَعُ صَلاَةَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَكِنِ اِدْرَءُوا مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Ibn Muskan from Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man, does anything that passes
in front of him break his prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing breaks the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are
able."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.406 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.483

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا يَقْطَعُ ٱلصَّلاةَ شَيْءَ كَلْبٌ وَ لاَ جِمَارٌ وَ لاَ
اِمْرَأَةً وَ لَكِنِ اِسْتَتِرُوا بِشَيْء فَإِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ قَدْرَ ذِرَاعِ رَافِعٌ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَدِ اِسْتَتَرْتَ».
english_text:
And Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Nothing breaks the prayer, neither a dog,
nor a donkey, nor a woman, but seek to shield yourselves with something. If there is in
front of you the measure of a cubit raised from the ground, then you have shielded
yourself."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.297 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.406 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.483 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.134 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.246 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.299

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ غِيَاتٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَضَعَ قَلَنْسُوَةً وَ صَلّى إِلَيْهَا».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ghiyath:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, placed a cap (qalansuwah) and prayed facing it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.379 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.406 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.482 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.137 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.301

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُصَلِّي ذَاتَ يَوْمِ إِذْ مَرَ رَجُلَ قُدَامَهُ وَ اِبْنُهُ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ جَالِسْ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قَالَ لَهُ اِبْنَهُ
«يَا أَبَتٍ مَا رَأَيْتَ الرِّجُلَ مَرّ قُدَّامَكَ» فَقَالَ «يَا بُنَيَ إنَّ ٱلَّذِي أُصَلِّي لَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَّ قُدَامِي».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Amr ibn Khalid from Sufyan ibn Khalid
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} was praying one day when a man passed in front of him while his son (Imam)
Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, was sitting.
When (Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}) finished, his son (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}) said:
"O my father, did you not see the man who passed in front of you?"
Imam {a.s} said: "O my son, the One {AZJ} for whom I was praying is closer to me than the
one who passed in front of me."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al- Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.407 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.485 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.133

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ
الرَّجُلِ أَيَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا يَمُرُّ بِهِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا يَقْطَعُ صَلاَةَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِ شَيْءُ وَ لَكِنِ إِدْرَأْ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتَ)
قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَعَفَ وَ لَمْ يَرْقَ رُعَافُهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصّلاَةِ قَالَ «يَحْشُو أَنْفَهُ بِشَيْءٍ ثُمّ يُصَلِّي وَ لا
يُطيلُ إنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَهُ الدَّمُ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ «إِذَا الْتَفَتَّ فِي صَلاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةِ مِنْ غَيْرِ فَرَاغٍ فَأَعِدِ الصَّلاَةَ إِذَا كَانَ
اَلالْتِفَاتُ فَاحِشا وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ تَشَهَدْتَ فَلاَ تُعِدْ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, does anything that passes in front of him cut off his
prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing cuts the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are
able." He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who experiences a
nosebleed and the bleeding does not stop until the time of prayer enters.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stuff his nose with something and then pray, and he should
not prolong the prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him."
He (al Halabi) said: “And Imam {a.s} said: ‘If you turn away during an obligatory prayer
without completing it, then repeat the prayer if the turning was excessive; but if you
have already recited the tashahhud, then do not repeat.’"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يَأْخُذُهُ الرُعَافُ وَ الْقَيْءُ فِي الصَّلاةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَنْقَتِلُ فَيَغْسِلُ أَنْفَهُ
وَ يَعُودُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ إِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَلْيُعِدْ صَلاَتَهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ وُضُوء».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Al-Ala' from
Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who experiences nosebleed and
vomiting during the prayer, what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should turn away, wash his nose, and return to his prayer. But if he
speaks, then he must repeat his prayer, and he is not required to perform ablution."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.264 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.238

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«اَلْقَهْقَهَةُ لا تَنْقُضُ الْوُضُوءَ وَ لَكِنْ تَنقُضُ الصَّلاَةَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Loud laughter does not invalidate the
ablution, but it does invalidate the prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.891 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.261 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.250

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَجِيهِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الضَّحِكِ هَلْ يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ
«أمّا التَّبَسُمُ فَلا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ وَ أَمّا الْقَهْقَهَةُ فَهيَ تَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan from his brother from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Him about laughter, does it break the prayer?
He said: "As for smiling, it does not break the prayer, but as for loud laughter, it does
break the prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.891 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.250

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفُوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْحَجَاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ الْغَمْزُ فِي بَطْنِهِ وَ هُوَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَصْبِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَيُصَلِّي عَلَى تِلْكَ اَلْحَالِ أَوْ لا يُصَلِّي قَالَ فَقَالَ
«إِنِ اِحْتَمَلَ الصِّبْرَ وَ لَمْ يَخَفْ إِعْجَالاً عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيُصَلِّ وَ لَيَصْبِرْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Al-Hajjaj who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about a man who experiences cramping in his stomach and
is able to endure it, should he pray in that condition or not?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he can bear the endurance and does not fear being rushed in his
prayer, then he should pray and be patient."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.863 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.251

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ : فِي
الرَّجُلٍ يَمَسُّ أَنْفَهُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَيَرَى دَما كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ أَ يَنْصَرِفُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ يَابِساً فَلْيَرْمِ بِهِ وَ لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of
them (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them:
Imam {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who touches his nose during the prayer and
sees blood, what should he do, should he leave?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is dry, then he should throw it away and there is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.871 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.437 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.239

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ
الْحَاجَةً وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «يُومِئ بِرَأْسِهِ وَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ وَ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَرَادَتِ ٱلْحَاجَةَ وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي تُصَفَّقُ
بِيَدِهَا» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْثُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَتَأَبُ فِي الصَّلاةِ وَ يَتَمَطَّى قَالَ «هُوَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ لَنْ يَمْلِكَهُ».
english_text:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who needs something while he is in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should gesture with his head and signal with his hand. And a
woman, if she needs something while she is praying, should clap with her hands."
He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who yawns and stretches
during the prayer”.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is from Shaytan, and he will not be able to control it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ قَالَ: كُنْتُ جَالِساً عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فَسَأَلَهُ نَاجِيَةُ
أَبُو حَبِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ إِنّ لِي رَحَى أَطَحَنْ فِيهَا فَرُبَّمَا قُمْتُ فِي سَاعَةٍ مِنَ اللِّيْلِ فَأَعْرِفُ مِنَ الرَّحَى
أَنَّ الْغُلامَ قَدْ نَامَ فَأَضْرِبُ الْحَائِطَ لِأُوقِظَهُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ أَنْتَ فِي طَاعَةِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ تَطْلُبُ رِزْقَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu Al-Walid who said:
I was sitting with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, when Najiyah Abu Habib asked
Imam {a.s} and said: “May I be your ransom, I have a mill in which I grind, and sometimes
I rise during a part of the night and know from the sound of the mill that the servant has
fallen asleep, so I strike the wall to wake him up.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, you are in obedience to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, seeking
His sustenance."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.301 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.896 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.256

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «كُلُّ مَا كَلَّمْتَ اللَّهَ
بِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ لَيْسَ بِكَلامِ».
english_text:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from some of his companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Everything with which you speak to Allah
{SWT} during the obligatory prayer, there is no harm in it, and it is not considered speech
(that invalidates the prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَفْص عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيَاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
كَانَ يَقُولُ: «لا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ الرُعَافُ وَ لاَ اَلدَّمْ وَ لاَ الْقَيْءُ فَمَنْ وَجَدَ أَذَى فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِيَدِ رَجْلٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنَ الصَّفِّ
فَلْيُقَدَّمْهُ يَعْنِي إِذَا كَانَ إِمَاما».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Aban from Salamah from Abu Hafs:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said that (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used
to say: "Nosebleed, blood, and vomiting do not cut off the prayer. So whoever
experiences discomfort should take the hand of a man from the people in the row and
bring him forward, meaning if he is the imam (of prayer)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.366 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.404 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1238 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.240

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ الْخَنْدَقِيِّ [الْخَنْدَقِيِّ خ ل] عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّكَ بَيْنَ يَدَي اللَّهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ لا تَرَاهُ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ يَرَاكَ فَأَقْبِلْ قِبَلَ صَلاَتِكَ وَ لاَ
نَمْتَخِط وَ لا تَبْزُقُ وَ لا تَنْقُضْ أَصَابِعَكَ وَ لاَ تَوَرَّك فَإِنَّ قَوْما قَدْ عُذَّبُوا بِنَقْضِ الْأَصَابِعِ وَ التَّوَرْكِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِذَا
رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ الرُكُوعِ فَأَقِمْ صُلْبَكَ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ مَفَاصِلُكَ وَ إِذَا سَجَدْتَ فَافْعَلْ مِثلَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ
الْأُولَى وَ الثَّانِيَةِ فَرَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ السُّجُودِ فَاسْتَتِمَ جَالِساً حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ مَفَاصِلُكَ فَإِذَا نَهَضْتَ فَقُلْ بِحَوْلِ اللّهِ وَ
قُوْتِهِ أَقُومُ وَ أَقْعُدُ فَإِنَّ عَلِياً عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Dawud Al-Khandaqi from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When you stand for prayer, know that you
are before Allah {SWT}; if you do not see Him {AZJ}, then know that He {AZJ} sees you. So turn
fully toward your prayer and do not blow your nose, nor spit, nor crack your fingers, nor
sit in a sprawling manner, for a people were punished for cracking their fingers and
sprawling during the prayer.
When you raise your head from bowing (ruku'), straighten your back until your joints
return to their places. And when you prostrate, do the same. And when you are in the
first and second rak'ahs and raise your head from prostration, sit properly until your
joints return to their places.
When you stand up, say: 'By the power and strength of Allah {SWT} I stand and sit,' for
indeed (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to do so."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.850 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.465

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ
إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلِّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ: «لا تُصَلِّ وَ أَنْتَ تَجِدُ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ».
english_text:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from his father from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
"Do not pray while you feel anything from the two impurities."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.864 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.252

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ - عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تُجَاوِزْ بِطَرَفِكَ
فِي الصَّلاةٍ مَوْضِعَ سُجُودِكَ» وَ قَالَ «لا يُصَلِّي الرَجُلُ مَحْلُولَ الْأَزْرَارِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ إِذَارٌ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not let your gaze go beyond the place of
your prostration during the prayer."
And Imam {a.s} said: "A man should not pray with his buttons undone if he is not wearing
an izar (waist wrap)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as recommending
the act”, and what indicates that is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ
إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَ أَزْرَارُهُ مَحْلُولَةٌ وَ يَدَاهُ دَاخِلَةٌ فِي ٱلْقَمِيصِ إِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي عُرْيَاناً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from a man who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The people say that if a man prays while
his buttons are undone and his hands are inside his shirt, it is as if he is praying naked.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.392 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.374 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.394 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.432

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْحَجَّاجِ يَقُولُ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُمِّيَّ يَسْأَلُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ إِذْخَالٍ يَدِهِ فِي التَّوْبِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فِي السُّجُودِ قَالَ «إِنْ شِئْتَ فَعَلْتَ لَيْسَ مِنْ هَذَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ».
english_text:
From him from Ibn Abi Umayr who said: I heard Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj say:
I saw Abu Abdul Malik Al-Qummi asking Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about
placing one's hand inside the garment during prayer in prostration.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you wish, you may do so; it is not from this that I fear for you."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَكَلِّمُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ بِكُلِّ
شَيْءٍ يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who speaks during the obligatory
prayer with anything by which he converses with his Lord {AZJ}.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.879 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.289 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.263 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 3 p.398

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عنه عن بكر بن محمد الازدي عن أبان بن عثمان عن الحلبي قال قلت : لابي عبد الله عليه السلام أسمي الائمة
عليهم السلام في الصلاة؟ قال : اجملهم.
english_text:
From him from Bakr ibn Muhammad Al-Azdi from Aban ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Should I name the Imams, peace be
upon them, individually in the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Mention them collectively."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَسْتَنِدَ إِلَى حَائِطِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي أَوْ يَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى الْحَائِطِ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ مِنْ غَيْرٍ
مَرَضٍ وَ لا عِلَّةٍ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَيَقُومُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ٱلْأُولَيَيْنِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ
أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ جَانِبَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَيَنْهَضَ يَسْتَعِينُ بِهِ عَلَى الْقِيَامِ مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَعْفٍ وَ لا عِلَّةٍ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far
{a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, is it permissible for him to lean against the wall of the
mosque while praying, or to place his hand on the wall while standing without illness
or weakness?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in the obligatory prayer and stands during
the first two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque
and use it to help himself rise without weakness or illness?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.899 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.499

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَغدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْجَهِمِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ سَعِيدِ
بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ التُكَأَةِ فِي الصَّلاةِ عَلَى ٱلْحَائِطِ يَمِيناً وَ شِمَالاً فَقَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali from his father from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jahm from Al-
Husayn ibn Musa from Sa'id ibn Yasar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about leaning during the prayer against
the wall, whether to the right or the left.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.900 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.500

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي مُتَوَكِّئا عَلَى عَصًا أَوْ عَلَى حَائِطِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِالتَّوَكَي عَلَى عَصًا وَ الإِتَّكَاءِ عَلَى
اَلْحَائِطِ».
english_text:
From him from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays leaning on a staff or on a wall.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in leaning on a staff or resting against a wall."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.900 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.500

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ أَخِي عَلِيَّ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ
قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُصَلِّي فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلٌ وَ هُوَ بَيْنَ السِّجْدَتَيْنِ فَرَمَاهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ
بِحَصَاةٍ فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ.
english_text:
From him from Ahmad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribbat from Muhammad ibn
Bajil, the brother of Ali ibn Bajil, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, praying, and a man passed in front of Him
{a.s} while He {a.s} was between the two prostrations, so Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon
him, threw a pebble at him, and the man turned toward him.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.371 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.897 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.258

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِنْ أَدْخَلْتَ يَدَكَ فِي أَثْفِكَ
وَأَنْتَ تُصَلِّي فَوَجَدْتَ دَماً سَائِلا لَيْسَ بِرُعَافٍ فَفُتَّهُ بِيَدِكَ».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "If you insert your hand into your nose while you
are praying and you find flowing blood that is not a nosebleed, then break your prayer
with your hand."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.242

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ الْبَجَلِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرُعَافِ أَيَنْقُضُ
الْوُضُوءَ قَالَ «لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً رَعَفَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مَاءً أَوْ مَنْ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْهِ بِمَاءٍ فَيُنَاوِلُهُ فَقَالَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَغَسَلَهُ
فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَقْطَعْهَا».
english_text:
From him from Ibn Abi Najran from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb Al-Bajali who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about nosebleed, does it invalidate the
ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: "If a man experiences a nosebleed during his prayer, and he has water
with him or someone nearby who can signal to him and hand him water, and he
gestures with his head and washes it, then let him continue his prayer and not cut it
off."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.241

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ يُصَلِّي
بِهِمُ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ فَيَعْرِضُ لَهُ رُعَافٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَخْرُجُ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ مَاءً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ فَلْيَغْسِلِ الرُّعَافَ ثُمَّ ليَعْذُ
فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ».
english_text:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Isma'il ibn Abd Al-Khaliq who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is among a group of people leading them in the
obligatory prayer, and he experiences a nosebleed, what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, and if he finds water before speaking, he should wash
the blood from the nosebleed, then return and continue with his prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.403 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.241

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا الْحَسَنٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرُّعَافِ وَ الْحِجَامَةِ وَ الْقَيءِ قَالَ «لَا يَنْقُضُ هَذَا شَيْئاً مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ وَ لَكِنْ يَنْقُضُ
الصَّلاَةَ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-
Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about nosebleed, cupping, and vomiting.
Imam {a.s} said: "None of these invalidate the ablution, but they do invalidate the
prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.403 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.262

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا
يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ رُعَافٌ وَ أَزْ فِي الْبَطْنِ فَبَادِرُوا بِهِنَّ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ».
فالوجه في هذين الخبرين ان نحملهما على رعاف يحتاج صاحبهما الى الانصراف عن القبلة أو الى الكلام ، فأما مع عدم
ذلك فلا يقطع الصلاة على ما قدمناه في الاخبار المتقدمة.
english_text:
And what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu
Hamzah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Nothing interrupts the prayer except a nosebleed
and severe discomfort in the stomach, so hasten to address them as much as you are
able."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
The interpretation of these two narrations is that we carry them upon the case where
the nosebleed requires its person to turn away from the qiblah or to speak. As for when
neither of these occurs, then it does not interrupt the prayer, as we have explained
previously in the earlier narrations.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ فِي
الصَّلاةٍ قَالَ «يَرُدّ يَقُولُ «سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ» وَ لاَ يَقُولُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمُ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ قَائِماً
يُصَلِّي قَمَرَّ بِهِ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ - أَلنَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ هَكَذَا».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is greeted with salam while he is in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should respond by saying, 'Salamun alaykum,' and he should not
say, 'Alaykumu as-salam,' for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, was once standing in prayer when Ammar ibn Yasir passed by Him {saws} and
greeted Him {saws} with salam, so the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, responded to him in this manner."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.366 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.887 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.267 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَ
هُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقُلْتُ ٱلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ فَقَالَ «السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ» قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ فَسَكَتَ فَلَمَا اِنْصَرَفَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ يَرُدْ
السَّلاَمَ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ مِثْلَ مَا قِيلَ لَهُ».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I entered upon Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, while He {a.s} was in prayer.
I said: "Peace be upon you,"
And Imam {a.s} replied: "Peace be upon you."
I asked: "How did you wake up?"
But Imam {a.s} remained silent, and when He {a.s} finished, I said to Imam {a.s}:
"Does one return the salam while in prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, in the manner it was said to him."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.887 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.267 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَقُلْتُ أَكُونُ أُصَلِّي فَتَمُرُ بِي
جَارِيَةٌ فَرُبَّمَا ضَمَمْتُهَا إِلَيَ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Misma’ who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}: “I might be praying and a slave-girl passes by me, and I might
draw her toward me.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.892 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.278

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَجَالِ عَنْ أَبِي إسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَصْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ
بالنَّفَخٍ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَوْضِعِ السُّجُودِ مَا لَمْ يُوْذِ أَحَداً».
english_text:
From him from Abu Muhammad Al-Hajjal from Abu Ishaq from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in blowing during the
prayer at the place of prostration as long as it does not harm anyone."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.908 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.350

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ: «إِنْ وَجَدْتَ قَمْلَةً وَ أَنْتَ فِي
الصَّلاَةٍ فَادفِتْها فِي
الْحَصَى».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said:
"If you find a louse while you are in prayer, then bury it in the pebbles."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.275

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ ٱلْحَكَمِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَقُومُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ
فَيَرَى الْقَمْلَةَ قَالَ «فَلْيَذْفِئْهَا فِي الْحَصَى فَإِنَّ عَلِيَاً عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «إِذَا رَأَيْتَهَا فَاذْفِئهَا فِي الْبَطْحَاءِ» ».
english_text:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who stands in prayer and
sees a louse.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him bury it in the gravel, for (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used
to say: 'If you see it, then bury it in the pebbles.'"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.906 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.276

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْهَيْتَمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَسْرُوقِ النِّهْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ هَيْتَمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِنَّي أَبِيتُ وَ أُرِيدُ الصَّوْمَ فَأَكُونُ فِي الْوَثْرِ فَأَعْطَشُ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ الدُعَاءَ فَأَشرَبَ وَ أَكْرَهُ
أَنْ أُصْبِحَ وَ أَنَا عَطْشَانُ وَ أَمَامِي قُلَّةٌ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهَا خُطْوَتَانِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٌ قَالَ «تَسْعَى إِلَيْهَا وَ تَشرَبُ مِنْهَا حَاجَتَكَ وَ
تَعودُ فِي الدُّعَاءِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq Al-Nahdi from Muhammad ibn Haytham Al-Tamimi
from Sa'id Al-A'raj who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I spend the night intending to fast, and
while I am in the witr prayer I become thirsty, but I dislike cutting off the supplication
to drink, and I also dislike reaching morning while I am thirsty. In front of me there is a
water container, two or three steps away.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Go to it, drink what you need from it, and then return to your
supplication."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.95 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.902 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.279 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.312

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ الْمَرْأَةُ صَبِيَّهَا وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي أَوْ تُرْضِعَهُ وَ هِيَ تَتَشَهَّدُ».
english_text:
From him from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah Al-Mada'ini from
Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no harm if a woman carries her child while she is
praying, or if she breastfeeds him while she is reciting the tashahhud."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.902 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.280

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ
أنَّ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَقَدْ تَكَلَّمَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Ja'far from his father:
(Imam) Ali {a.s} said: "Whoever groans during his prayer has indeed spoken."
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.876 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.281

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَرَى الْحَيَّةَ وَ
الْعَقْرَبَ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ قَالَ «يَقْتُلُهُمَا».
english_text:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who sees a snake or a
scorpion while he is praying the obligatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should kill them."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.905 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.273

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي
الصَّلاَةِ
فَيَرَى الْحَيَّةَ أَوِ الْعَقْرَبَ يَقْتُلُهُمَا إِنْ آذَيَاهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
From him from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a
snake or a scorpion, should he kill them if they harm him?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.905

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَقْثَلُ
اَلْبَقَّةً وَ الْبُرْغُوثَ وَ الْقَمْلَةَ وَ الذُّبَابَ فِي الصَّلَاَةِ أَيَنْقُضُ صَلَاَتَهُ وَ وُضُوءَهُ قَالَ «لا)).
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who kills a bug, a
flea, a louse, or a fly during prayer, does it invalidate his prayer or his ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.905 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.293

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ قَائِماً فِي الصَّلاةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَيَنْسَى
كِيسَهُ أَوْ مَتَاعاً لَهُ يَتَخَوَّفُ ضَيْعَتَهُ أَوْ هَلاكَهُ قَالَ «يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ وَ يُحْرِزُ مَتَاعَهُ ثُمَ يَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّلاَةَ» قُلْتُ فَيَكُونُ
فِي الصَّلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَتَفَلّتْ دَابَّثُهُ فَيَخَافُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ أَوْ يُصِيبَ مِنْهَا عَنَتاً فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَقْطَعَ صَلاَتَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is standing in obligatory prayer and remembers his
pouch or some of his belongings, fearing their loss or ruin.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should cut off his prayer, secure his belongings, and then start his
prayer anew."
I asked: “If he is in obligatory prayer and his animal breaks loose and he fears it might
be lost or cause harm”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if he cuts off his prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.903 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.277 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.289

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَرَأَيْتَ غُلاَماً لَكَ قَدْ أَبَقَ أَوْ غَرِيما لَكَ عَلَيْهِ مَالٌ أَوْ حَيَّةً تَخَافُهَا عَلَى نَفْسِكَ فَاقْطَعٍ
الصَّلاَةَ وَ اِتْبَعِ اَلْغُلاَمَ أَوْ غَرِيماً لَكَ وَ أُقْتُلِ الْحَيَّةَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il by Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan by Hammad by Hariz by someone from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "If you are in obligatory prayer and you see your servant running away,
or a debtor upon whom you have a debt, or a snake that you fear for yourself, then cut
off the prayer and pursue your servant or your debtor and kill the snake."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.369 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.903 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.276 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.289

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالا: «لا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلَاةَ إِلاَّ أَرْبَع الْخَلَاءُ وَ الْبَوْلُ وَ الرِّيحُ وَ الصَّوْتُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur ibn Yunus from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from
Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both:
The Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing invalidates the prayer except four things: relieving oneself,
urination, passing wind, and speaking."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.400

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرِّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي
صَلاَتِهِ فَيَسْتَأْذِنُ إِنْسَانٌ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَيُسَبَّحُ وَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَ يُسْمِعُ جَارِيَتَهُ فَتَأْتِيهِ فَيُرِيهَا بِيَدِهِ أَنّ عَلَى الْبَابِ
نُسَاناً هَلْ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ صَلاَتَهُ وَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ لاَ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ صَلاَتَهُ».
english_text:
From him from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in his prayer and someone seeks permission at
the door, so he glorifies (says tasbih) and raises his voice and lets his servant girl hear,
and she comes to him, and he gestures with his hand to show her that there is
someone at the door, does that action invalidate his prayer and what is required of
him?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm; that does not invalidate his prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.182 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.896 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.256

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَغدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَفَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَيَرَى حَيَّةً بِحِيَالِهِ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَيَقْتُلَهَا فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَ
بَيْنَهَا خُطْوَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَلْيَخْطُ وَ لْيَقْتُلْهَا وَ إِلاَّ فَلَا».
english_text:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a
snake nearby, is it permissible for him to reach out and kill it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If there is only one step between him and it, then he should step and
kill it; otherwise, he should not."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.904 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.273

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ «إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ
أَنْتَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ نَفْسِكَ وَ لا تَرْفَع صَوْتَكَ».
english_text:
And with this same chain of narration, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a person who is praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "If a man from among the Muslims greets you with salam while you are
in prayer, then return the greeting to him within yourself without raising your voice."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.888 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.268 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعدُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النّعْمَانِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ الرَّجُلُ وَ أَنْتَ تُصَلِّي قَالَ «تَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ خَفِيّاً كَمَا قَالَ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Ali ibn Al-Nu'man from
Mansur ibn Hazim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “If a man greets you with salam while you
are praying, he said: ‘You should return the greeting quietly, just as he said it.’"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.888 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.268 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143
