Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا عَطَسَ ٱلرَّجُلُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man sneezes during the prayer, he
should say, 'All praise is due to Allah {SWT}’ (Alhamdulillah)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.890 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.271

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
سَعَدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنِ الْمُعَلِّى أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْمَعُ
الْعَطْسَةَ فَأَحْمَدُ اللّهَ وَ أَصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ وَ أَنَا فِي الصَّلاةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ
صَاحِبِكَ اليَمّ».
english_text:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Al-Mu'alla Abu Uthman from Abu Basir
who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I hear someone sneeze, so I praise Allah {SWT} and send blessings
upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, while I am in prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, even if there is an ocean between you and your companion."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.272

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الرِّبَاطِيّ عَنْ زَكَرِيًّا الْأَعْوَرِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يُصَلِّي قَائِمَاً وَ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ رَجُلْ كَبِيرٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقُومَ وَ مَعَهُ عَصّا لَهُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَانْحَطَّ أَبُو
اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَنَاوَلَ اَلرَّجْلَ اَلْعَصَا ثُمَّ عَادَ إِلَى صَلاَتِهِ.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ribati from Zakariyya Al-A'war
who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, praying while standing, and next to Him {a.s} was an elderly man
who wanted to stand up and had a staff with him.
He wanted to reach for it, so Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, bent down while he was still standing
in his prayer and handed the man the staff, then returned to His {a.s} prayer.
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.371 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.901 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.503 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.304

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ أَكُونُ فِي
الصَّلاَةٍ فَأَجِدُ غَمْزاً فِي بَطْنِي أَوْ أَذَّى أَوْ ضَرَبَاناً فَقَالَ «اِنْصَرِفُ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأْ وَ اِبْنِ عَلَى مَا مَضَى مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ مَا لَمْ
تَنْقُضِ الصَّلاَةَ بِالْكَلاَمِ مُتَعَمَّدا فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمْتَ نَاسِياً فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْكَ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ تَكَلَّمَ فِي الصَّلاةِ نَاسِياً» قُلْتُ وَ
إنْ قَلَبَ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ ٱلْقِبْلَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ إنْ قَلَبَ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ الْقِبْلَةِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “I might be in prayer and experience cramping
in my stomach, or discomfort, or throbbing.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Leave, then perform ablution, and continue from where you left off in
your prayer, as long as you have not invalidated the prayer by speaking deliberately.
But if you spoke forgetfully, there is no harm upon you, for it is like one who speaks in
prayer forgetfully."
I asked: “Even if he turns his face away from the qiblah?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, even if he turns his face away from the qiblah."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.401 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.865 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.235

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثِمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَعَفَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ
يَرْعُفُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ صَلاَةٍ أُخْرَى قَالَ «يَحْشُو أَنْفَهُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي وَ لاَ يُطَوِّلُ إنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَهُ اَلدَّمُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who experiences a
nosebleed and it continues until the time of another prayer enters.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stuff his nose and then pray, and he should not prolong the
prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لاَ صَلاَةَ لِحَاقِنٍ وَ لا
لِحَاقِنَةٍ وَ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةٍ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ».
english_text:
From him from Al-Barqi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no prayer for one who is holding
in urine or one who is holding in feces, and he is in the position of someone who is
relieving himself in his garment."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.1 p.83 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.864 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.251 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.323

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أُبُو الْقَاسِمِ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ
عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يَعْبَثُ بِذَكَرِهِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ قَالَ «وَ مَا لَهُ فِعلٌ»
قُلْتُ عَبِثَ بِهِ حَتَّى مَسَّهُ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira who said: Abu Al-
Qasim Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated to me from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “A man plays with his private part during the obligatory prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: "And what action is that?"
I said: “He played with it until he touched it with his hand.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.892 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.283

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيَظُنُ أَنَّ ثَوْبَهُ قَدِ اِنْخَرَقَ أَوْ أَصَابَهُ شَيْءَ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَنظُرَ فِيهِ أَوْ يَمَسَّهُ قَالَ
«إِنْ كَانَ فِي مُقَدَّمِ ثَوْبِهِ أَوْ جَانِبَيْهِ فَلا بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي مُؤَخَّرِهِ فَلاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فَإِنَّهُ لا يَصْلُحُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah by Ali ibn Ja'far by (Imam) Musa {a.s} said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in his prayer and thinks that his garment might
have been torn or that something has soiled it, is it permissible for him to look at it or
touch it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is at the front of his garment or on its sides, there is no harm; but if
it is at the back, he should not turn around, for that is not appropriate."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.186 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.901 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.245

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ
عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي وَ يَرَى الصَّبِيَّ يَحْبُو إِلَى النَّارِ أَوِ الشَّاةَ تَدْخُلُ اَلْبَيْتَ
لِتُفْسِدَ الشَّيْءَ قَالَ «فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ وَ لَيُحْرِزْ مَا يَتَخَوَّفُ وَ يَبْنِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ مَا لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad
from Ja'far from his father:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who is praying and sees a
child crawling toward a fire or a sheep entering the house to cause damage.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, secure what he fears for, and continue with his prayer
as long as he has not spoken."
source: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.904 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.278

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَجُلِ
يَكُونُ فِي صَلاةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَيَقُومُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ٱلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ جَانِبَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَنْهَضَ يَسْتَعِينُ
بِهِ عَلَى اَلْقِيَامِ مِنْ غَيْرٍ ضَعْفٍ وَ لاَ عِلَّةٍ قَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in an obligatory prayer and rises during the first
two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque and use
it to help himself stand, without weakness or illness?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.164 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vl.1 p.206 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: وَذَكَرَ صَلاةَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ: «كَانَ يُوتَى بِطَهُورٍ فَيُخَمَّرُ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ وَ
يُوضَعُ سِوَاكُهُ تَحْتَ فِرَاشِهِ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اللّهُ فَإِذَا اِسْتَيْقَظَ جَلَسَ ثُمَّ قَلْبَ بَصَرَهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ تَلاَ آَلْآيَاتِ مِنْ
آلِ عِمْرَانَ « «إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ اِخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهارِ» » ٱلْآَيَةَ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنْ وَ يَتَطَهَرُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ إِلَى
الْمَسْجِدٍ فَيَرْكَعُ أُرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ قِرَاءَتِهِ رُكُوعُهُ وَ سُجُودُهُ عَلَى قَدْرٍ رُكُوعِهِ يَرْكَعُ حَتَى يُقَالَ مَتَى يَرْفَعُ
رَأْسَهُ وَ يَسْجُدُ حَتَّى يُقَالَ مَتَّى يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَيَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اللّهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَجْلِسُ فَيَثلُو
آَلايَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ وَ يُقَلّبُ بَصَرَهُ فِي السِّمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنّ وَ يَتَطَهَرُ وَ يَقُومُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَيُصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ كَمَا
رَكَعَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَيَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَجْلِسُ فَيَثلُو الْآيَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ وَ يُقَلِّبُ
بَصَرَهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنُ وَ يَتَطَهَرُ وَ يَقُومُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَيُوتِرُ وَ يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إلَى الصَّلاَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Mu'awiyah ibn
Wahb who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say, and He {a.s} mentioned the prayer of
the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
Imam {a.s} said: " A vessel of water for purification would be brought and placed covered
near His {saws} head, and His {saws} siwak (tooth-stick) would be placed under His {saws}
bed. Then He {saws} would sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed.
When He {saws} awoke, He {saws} would sit and turn his gaze toward the sky, then recite
the verses from (Surah Ale Imran) 'Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth
and the alternation of night and day' (Surah Al ‘Imran 3:190).
Then He {saws} would use the siwak and perform purification, then stand and go to the
mosque and pray four rak'ahs, with his bowing and prostration proportionate to his
recitation. He {saws} would bow so long that it would be said, 'When will He {saws} raise his
head?'
And He {saws} would prostrate so long that it would be said, 'When will he raise his head?'
Then He {saws} would return to his bed and sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed. Then He
{saws} would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His {saws} gaze
toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque and pray
four rak'ahs as He {saws} had prayed before.
Then He {saws} would return to His {saws} bed and sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed. Then
He {saws} would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His {saws} gaze
toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque to pray
the witr and the two rak'ahs, then go out to the (obligatory) prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.342 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.269 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 6 p.276 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.228 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.422 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.3 p.290

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ
أَنّهُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ مِنْ عَبْدِ إِلَّ يُوقَظُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ مِرَاراً فَإِنْ قَامَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِلاَّ فَحِّجَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَبَالَ
فِي أَذْنِهِ أَوَ لا يَرَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَنَّهُ إِذَا قَامَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ قَامَ وَ هُوَ مُتَخَثَرٌ تَقِيلٌ كَسْلاَنُ».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no servant except that he is
awakened every night once, or twice, or several times. If he gets up, then that is good;
otherwise, Shaytan snorts and urinates in his ear. Do you not see that if one of you gets
up without responding to this call, he gets up sluggish, heavy, and lazy?"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.334 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.290 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.6 0 p.262

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ كَامِلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا اِسْتَفْتَحْتَ صَلاةَ آللَّيْلِ وَ فَرَغْتَ مِنْ الإِسْتِفْتَاحِ فَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ ٱلْكُرْسِيَ وَ ٱلْمُعَوِّدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اِقْرَأ فَاتِحَةَ ٱلْكِتَابِ
وَ سُورَةً».
english_text:
From him by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn by Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Kamil:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When you begin the night prayer and finish the
opening supplication, then recite Ayat al-Kursi and the two surahs of seeking refuge
(Al-Falaq and Al-Nas), then recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and a surah."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.668 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.32

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مَنصُورٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى «قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إلا قَلِيلاً» قَالَ «أَمَرَهُ اللَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ كُلَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلا أَنْ يَأْتِيَ عَلَيْهِ
لَيْلَةٌ مِنَ اَللَّيَالِي لا يُصَلِّي فِيهَا شَيْئًا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur from Umar ibn Udhaynah from
Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Stand (in prayer) at night
except a little." (Surah Muzzammil 73:2)
Imam {a.s} said: "Allah {SWT} commanded Him {saws} to pray every night except that there
might come upon him a night among the nights in which he does not pray anything."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.99 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.147 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.516 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.126 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.127 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.446 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 3 p.496

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ ٱلزَّرَّادِ قَالَ: سَأَلَ أَبُو كَهْمَسِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ فَقَالَ يُصَلِّي
الرَّجُلُ نَوَافِلَهُ فِي مَوْضِعٍ أَوْ يُفَرَّقُهَا قَالَ «لا بَلْ هَاهُنَا وَ هَاهُنَا فَإِنَّهَا تَشَهَدُ لَهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ ».
english_text:
From him from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Abdullah ibn Ali Al-Zarrad who said:
Abu Kahmas asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, saying: “Should a man
perform his nawafil prayers (supererogatory prayers) in one place or should he
distribute them in different places?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, rather here and there, for indeed they will bear witness for him on
the Day of Resurrection."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.455 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.343 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.627 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 p.318 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.35

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ هَارُونَ عَنْ مُرَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَتَّى أُصَلَّي
صَلاةً اللّيْلٍ فَقَالَ «صَلَّهَا آخِرَ اللّيْلِ» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَنْبِهُ فَقَالَ «تَسْتَئْبِهُ مَرّةً فَتُصَلَّيهَا وَ تَنَامُ فَتَقْضِيهَا فَإِذَا
اِهْتَمَمْتَ بِقَضَائِهَا بِالنَّهَارِ اِسْتَنْبَهْتَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Harun from Murazim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “When should I pray the night prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Pray it at the end of the night."
I said: “But I do not wake up.”
Imam {a.s} said: "You will wake up once, so pray it, then if you sleep, you can make it up.
When you become concerned with making it up during the day, you will wake up (at
night)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.314 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.256

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ وَ إِسْحَاقَ اِبْنَيْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ أَنَّ إبْرَاهِيمَ
بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ أَخْبَرَهُمَا قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى الْفَقِيهِ يَا مَوْلايَ نَدَّرْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَتَى فَاتَثنِي صَلاَةُ اللِّيْلِ صُمْتُ فِي صَبِيحَتِهَا
فَفَاتَهُ ذَلِكَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَخْرَجْ وَ كَمْ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْكَفَّارَةِ فِي صَوْمِ كُلِّ يَوْمِ تَرَكَهُ إِنْ كَفَّرَ إِنْ
أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ «يُفَرِّقُ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمِ بِمُدَّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ كَفَّارَةً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa Al-Ubaydi from Ali and Ishaq, the two sons of
Sulayman ibn Dawud, that Ibrahim ibn Muhammad informed them, saying:
I wrote to the Faqih (jurist): "O my master, I made a vow that whenever I miss the night
prayer, I would fast the following morning. If he misses it, what should he do? Is there
a way out for him, and how much expiation is due upon him for each day he misses if
he chooses to offer expiation?"
So He wrote: "For each day, he should give a mudd of food as expiation."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.2 2 p.394

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: « «كَانُوا
قَلِيلاً مِنَ اللِّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ» » قَالَ «كَانَ ٱلْقَوْمُ يَنَامُونَ وَ لَكِنْ كُلِّمَا اِنْقَلَبَ أَحَدُهُمْ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَهِ وَ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
وَ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ » .
english_text:
From him from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Al-Abbas ibn Amir from Jabir from Abu Basir:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said regarding the verse: "They used to sleep but little
of the night" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:17)
Imam {a.s} said: "The people used to sleep, but whenever one of them turned over, he
would say, 'Praise be to Allah {SWT}, there is no god but Allah {SWT}, and Allah {SWT} is the
Greatest.'"
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1594 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.449 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.125 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.123 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 2 p.413

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «إِنَّ
تاشِئَةَ اللّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُ وَطْئاً وَ أَقْوَمُ قِيلاً» قَالَ «يَعْنِي بِقَوْلِهِ «وَ أَقْوَمُ قِيلاً» قِيَامَ ٱلرَّجُلِ عَنْ فِرَاشِهِ يُرِيدُ بِهِ اللَّهَ
عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لا يُرِيدُ بِهِ غَيْرَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic: "Indeed, the rising by night is the firmest way to tread and the best in
speech," (Surah Muzzammil 73:6).
Imam {a.s} said: "By His {AZJ} saying 'and the best in speech', He {AZJ} means the rising of a
man from his bed intending by it Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, and intending no
one other than Him {AZJ}."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.446 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.98 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.146 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.517 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.132 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.148 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.448 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.448

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ «كانُوا قَلِيلاً مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ» قَالَ «كَانُوا أَقَلَ اللَّيَالِي تَفُوتُهُمْ لا يَقُومُونَ
فِيهَا».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic: "They used to sleep but little of the night" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:17)
Imam {a.s} said: "The nights in which they missed getting up were very few; they would
stand in prayer in most of the nights."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
علي بن ابراهيم عن أبيه عن عبد اللّه بن المغيرة عن ابن مسكان عن الحسن الصيقل عن أبي عبد الله
عليه السلام قال قلت له: الرجل يصلي الركعتين من الوتر ثم يقوم فينسى التشهد حتى يركع فيذكر وهو راكع
قال: يجلس من ركوعه ويتشهد ثم يقوم فيتم ، قال قلت : أليس قلت في الفريضة إذا ذكره بعدما ركع مضى
ثم سجد سجدتي السهو بعدما ينصرف يتشهد فيهما؟ قال : ليس النافلة مثل الفريضة.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man prays the two rak'ahs of witr, then he stands and forgets the
tashahhud until he bows, and remembers while bowing.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should sit from his bowing, perform the tashahhud, then stand and
complete (his prayer)."
I asked: “Did you not say regarding the obligatory prayer that if he remembers after
bowing, he should continue, then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness after
he finishes and recite the tashahhud in them?”
Imam {a.s} said: "The supererogatory prayer (nafila) is not like the obligatory prayer
(faridah)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ عَنْ أَفْضَلِ
سَاعَاتِ الْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ »الْفَجْرُ أَوَّلُ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah and Hammad ibn Isa from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the best time for the witr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "The beginning of dawn is the best for that."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.448 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.314 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.271

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
علي عن أبيه عن ابن أبي عمير عن ابن اذينة عن زرارة قال قلت : لابي جعفر عليه السلام الركعتان اللتان قبل
الغداة أين موضعهما؟ فقال : قبل طلوع الفجر فإذا طلع الفجر فقد دخل وقت الغداة.
english_text:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “The two rak'ahs before the morning prayer
(Fajr), when is their time?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Before the rising of the dawn; and when the dawn rises, then the time
for the morning prayer has entered."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَارُودِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:
«كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُوتِرُ بِتِسْعِ سُوَرٍ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Al-Jarud from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I heard Him {a.s} say: "(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to perform the witr prayer
with nine surahs."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.670 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.52

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَقُولُ: «أَ مَا يَرْضَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ
يَقُومَ قَبْلَ الصُبْحِ فَيُوتِرَ وَ يُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَ يُكْتَبَ لَهُ بِصَلاَةِ ٱللَّيْلِ».
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "Is it not enough for one of you to
stand before dawn, perform the witr prayer, and pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr, and have
it written for him as the prayer of the night?"
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.337 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.258

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بِلاَلِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ فِي وَقْتٍ صَلاَةٍ
اللَّيل فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «عِنْدَ زَوَالِ اللَّيْلِ وَ هُوَ نِصْفُهُ أَفْضَلُ فَإِنْ فَاتَ فَأَوِّلَهُ وَ آخِرَهُ جَائِزْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Bilal who said:
I wrote to Him {a.s} regarding the time of the night prayer.
He {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote back: "At the decline of the night, which is its middle,
is best; but if that is missed, then its beginning and its end are both permissible."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.333 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.253 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.123

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إلَيْهِ أَسْأَلْهُ يَا سَيَّدِي رُوِيَ عَنْ جَدِّكَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُصَلِّيَ ٱلرَّجُلُ
صَلاةَ اللّيْلِ فِي أَوْلِ اللّيْلِ» فَكَتَبَ «فِي أَيّ وَقْتٍ صَلَّى فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ إنْ شَاءَ اللَهُ».
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Isa who said:
I wrote to Him asking: “O my master, it has been narrated from your grandfather that
he said, "There is no harm if a man prays the night prayer at the beginning of the night."
So He wrote: "At whatever time he prays, it is permissible, Allah {SWT} willing."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.334 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.253

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«لاً بَأْسَ بِصَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ أَفْضَلَ ذَلِكَ إِذَا اِنْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : قد بينا الوجه في امثال هذه الاخبار، وجملته ان صلاة الليل وقتها بعد نصف الليل الى طلوع الفجر
، فما روي من الرخصة في تقديمها في أول الليل فانما هو للمسافر والعليل ومن يعلم انه إن لم يصل في اول الليل شغل
عنه ولم يتمكن من قضائه ، فاما مع ارتفاع سائر الاعذار فلا يجوز على ما بيناه، والذي يؤكد ذلك ايضا ما رواه :
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Isa from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ja'far ibn Uthman from Sama'ah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in performing the night
prayer from the beginning of the night until its end, except that the best of that is when
the night has reached its midpoint."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “We have already explained the interpretation
regarding the likes of these narrations, and in summary, the time for the night prayer
is after midnight until the rising of the dawn. As for what has been narrated regarding
the concession to perform it at the beginning of the night, it is only for the traveler, the
sick person, and the one who knows that if he does not pray at the beginning of the
night, he will be preoccupied and will not be able to make it up. As for when all other
excuses are removed, it is not permissible, as we have explained.” What further
confirms this is also what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.334 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.252 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.120 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.122

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجْلُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ ٱلْقِيَامُ بِالَّيْلِ تَمْضِي عَلَيْهِ اللِّيْلَةُ وَ ٱلِّيِلَتَانِ وَ الثَّلاَثُ لاَ يَقُومُ فَيَقْضِي أَحَبُ إِلَيْكَ أَمْ
يُعَجّلُ الْوَثْرَ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ «لا بَلْ يَقْضِي وَ إِنْ كَانَ ثَلاَثِينَ لَيْلَةٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Al-Ala' from Muhammad
from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “A man who is accustomed to standing for the night prayer, a night,
two nights, or three pass and he does not stand; is it more beloved to you that he
performs the witr prayer early at the beginning of the night, or that he makes it up?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, rather he should make it up, even if it is for thirty nights."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.338 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.330 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.256

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ وَ أَظُنْهُ إِسحَاقَ بْنَ غَالِبِ قَالَ قَالَ: إِذَا قَامَ الرَّجُلُ فِي اللَّيْلِ فَظَنَّ أَنَّ الصُّبْحَ قَدْ أَضَاءَ فَأَوْتَرَ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ فَرَأَى
أَنَّ عَلَيْهِ لَيْلاً قَالَ «يُضِيفُ إِلَى الْوَثْرِ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ يَسْتَقْبِلُ صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ يُوتِرُ بَعْدَهُ».
english_text:
From him from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibrahim ibn Abd Al-Hamid from some of our
companions from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and I think it was Ishaq ibn Ghalib, who said:
He (ibn Ghalib) said: “When a man stands up during the night and thinks that dawn has
arrived, so he performs the witr prayer, then he looks and realizes that it is still night”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should add a rak'ah to the witr, then resume the night prayer, and
then perform the witr prayer after it."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.338 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.338 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.258 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.120

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ بُنَانِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ السِّنْدِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ
الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فَخَرَجْتَ وَ رَأَيْتَ الصُبْحَ فَزِدْ رَكْعَةً إِلَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللّتَيْنِ صَلِّيْتَهُمَا
قَبْلُ وَ اِجْعَلَهُ وَثْرا».
english_text:
From him by Bunan ibn Muhammad by Sa'd ibn Al-Sindi by Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Imran by Imam Al-Ridha {a.s}:
(Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s} said: "If you are in Fajr prayer and you went out and saw the dawn,
then add a rak'ah to the two rak'ahs you prayed before, and make it the witr prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.338 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.338 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.258 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.219

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِنْ خِفْتَ الشُّهْرَةَ فِي التُكَأَةِ فَقَدْ يُجْزِيكَ أَنْ تَضَعَ يَدَكَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ لا تَضْطَجِعَ وَ أَوْمَاً
بِأَطْرَافِ أَصَابِعِهِ مِنْ كَفِّهِ الْيُمْنَى فَوَضَعَهَا فِي الْأَرْضِ قَلِيلاً) وَ حَكَى أَبُو جَعْفَرِ ذَلِكَ.
english_text:
From him from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn
Udhafir from Umar ibn Yazid who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you fear being noticed (public attention)
when leaning (in prayer), it is sufficient for you to place your hand on the ground
without lying down."
Then He {a.s} gestured with the tips of his fingers from his right hand and placed them
lightly on the ground. And Abu Ja'far {a.s} also narrated that.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.338 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1598 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.493

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
نَسِيَ أَنْ يَضْطَجَعَ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ بَعْدَ رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ فَذَكَرَ حِينَ أَخَذَ فِي الْإِقَامَةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يُقِيمُ وَ يُصَلِّي وَ
يَدَعُ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Ahmad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who forgot to lie down on his right side after the two
rak'ahs of Fajr and remembered when the iqamah (call to prayer) had already begun,
what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should proceed with the iqamah and perform the prayer, and leave
that (lying on the right side); there is no harm."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.182 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.202 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.338 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1599 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.493

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أحمد بن محمد عن علي بن الحكم عن عبد اللّٰه بن بكير عن زرارة عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال : إنما على
أحدكم إذا انتصف الليل أن يقوم فيصلي صلاته جملة واحدة ثلاث عشرة ركعة ، ثم إن شاء جلس فدعا ، وإن
شاء نام ، وإن شاء ذهب حيث شاء.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “It is only required of one of you, when
midnight has passed, to rise and perform his prayer all at once, thirteen rak‘ahs in
total. Then, if he wishes, he may sit and supplicate, or if he wishes, he may sleep, or if
he wishes, he may go wherever he wants.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سَعْدِ الْأَشعَرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ سَاعَاتِ الْوَثْرِ قَالَ
«أَحَبُّهَا إِلَيَّ الْفَجْرُ الْأَوْلُ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَفْضَلِ سَاعَاتِ اللّيْلِ قَالَ «الثُلُثُ الْبَاقِي» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْوَثْرِ بَعْدَ فَجْرٍ
الصُّبح قَالَ «نَعَمْ قَدْ كَانَ أَبِي رُبَّمَا أَوْتَرَ بَعْدَ مَا اِنْفَجَرَ الصُّبْحُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Isma‘il ibn Sa‘d al-Ash‘ari, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the times for Witr.
Imam {a.s} said: "The most beloved of them to me is the first dawn."
And I asked Him {a.s} about the best hours of the night.
Imam {a.s} said: "The last third."
And I asked Him {a.s} about performing Witr after the dawn of morning has broken.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, my father would sometimes perform Witr after the dawn had
broken."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.339 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.313

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ ٱلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ أَقُومُ وَ أَنَا أَشُكْ فِي
الْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ «صَلِّ عَلَى شَكِّكَ فَإِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَأَوْتِرْ وَ صَلِّ الرّكْعَتَيْنِ وَ إِذَا أَنْتَ قُمْتَ وَ قَدْ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَابْدَأُ
بِالْفَرِيضَةِ وَ لا تُصَلِّ غَيْرَهَا فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَاقْضٍ مَا فَاتَكَ وَ لاَ تَكُونُ هَذِهِ عَادَةً وَ إِيَاكَ أَنْ تُطْلِعَ عَلَى هَذَا أهْلَكَ
فَيْصَلُونَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ لا يُصَلُّونَ بِاللَّيْلِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Zur‘ah, from al-Mufaddal ibn ‘Umar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I rise while I am uncertain about the
time of dawn.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Pray based on your uncertainty. Then, when dawn appears, perform
the Witr, and pray the two rak‘ahs. And if you rise and the dawn has already appeared,
then begin with the obligatory prayer and do not perform anything else.
Then, once you have finished, make up what you missed. And do not make this a habit.
And beware of letting your family become aware of this, so that they pray in this
manner and abandon the night prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.339 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.338 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.262

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ «رُبَّمَا
قُمْتُ وَ قَدْ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَأَصَلِّي صَلاةَ اللَّيْلِ وَ ٱلْوَثَرَ وَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أُصَلِّي الْفَجْرَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ أَفْعَلُ أَنَا ذَا
قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لاَ يَكُونُ مِنْكَ عَادَةً».
english_text:
From him, from al-Barqi, from Safwan, from Abu Ayyub, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: "It may happen that I rise and the
dawn has already appeared, so I perform the night prayer, and the Witr, and the two
rak‘ahs before Fajr, then I perform the Fajr prayer."
He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘May I do the same?’"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, but do not make it a habit."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.339 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.335 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.261

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي
وَ هُوَ يَرَى أَنَّ عَلَيْهِ لَيْلاً ثُمَّ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِ الْآخَرُ مِنَ الْبَابِ فَقَالَ قَدْ أَصْبَحْتَ هَلْ يُعِيدُ ٱلْوَثْرَ أَمْ لاَ أَوْ يُعِيدُ شَيْئا مِنْ
صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ «يُعِيدُ إِنْ صَلاَهَا مُصْبِحاً».
قال محمد بن الحسن : إنما ينبغي له الاعادة إذا صلاها مصبحا لانه إذا أصبح فيكون قد تضيق وقت الفرض فلا يجوز له
أن يصلي نافلة، فإذا صلاها كان عليه اعادتها لانه صلاها في غير وقتها ، والذي يبين ما قدمناه:
english_text:
And from him, from al-Barqi, from Sa‘d, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who is in his house, praying, while he believes it is still
night.
Then another person enters upon him from the door and says, "The morning has
come." Should he repeat the Witr or not, or should he repeat any part of his prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should repeat it if he prayed it after morning had arrived."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “It is only appropriate for him to repeat it if he prayed it
after morning had arrived, because when the morning has come, the time for the
obligatory prayer becomes constrained, and it is not permissible for him to perform a
supererogatory prayer. So if he performs it, he is required to repeat it because he has
prayed it outside of its proper time.” That which clarifies what we have presented is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.339 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.364 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.259 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.123

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
ما رواه أحمد بن محمد عن علي بن الحكم عن سيف بن عميرة عن أبي بكر عن جعفر بن محمد عليه السلام
قال: إذا دخل وقت صلاة مفروضة فلا تطوع.
english_text:
What was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr
from (Imam) Ja‘far ibn Muhammad {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} said: “When the time for an obligatory prayer enters, do not perform
supererogatory prayers.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَقُومُ وَ أَنَا
أَتَخَوَّفُ الْفَجْرَ قَالَ «فَأَوْتِز» قُلْتُ فَأَنظِرُ وَ إِذَا عَلَيَّ لَيْلْ قَالَ «فَصَلَّ صَلاةَ ٱللَّيْلِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn Abdul-Aziz, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I rise while I fear that dawn may have
arrived.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Then perform the Witr."
I asked: “Then I look and find that it is still night upon me.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Then perform the night prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.340 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.339 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.259 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.120

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ بِنْتِ إِلْيَاسَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: «إذَا
قُمْتَ وَ قَدْ طَلَعَ ٱلْفَجْرُ فَابْدَأُ بِالْوَثْرِ ثُمَّ صَلِّ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ صَلِّ الرَّكَعَاتِ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Bint Ilyas, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "If you rise and the dawn has already
appeared, then begin with the Witr, then pray the two rak‘ahs, then pray the rak‘ahs
when the morning has come."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.340 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.335 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.259

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلاّنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ عَنِ
الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ قَالَ «قُبَيْلَ الْفَجْرِ وَ مَعَهُ وَ بَعْدَهُ» قُلْتُ فَمَتَى أَدَعُهَا حَتَّى أَقْضِيَهَا قَالَ قَالَ «إِذَا قَالَ
الْمُؤذِّنُ قَدْ قَامَتٍ الصَّلاَةُ ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn ‘Allan, who said: Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar narrated to me, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the two rak‘ahs before Fajr.
Imam {a.s} said: "Just before Fajr, with it, and after it."
I asked: “When do I leave them in order to make them up later?”
Imam {a.s} said: "When the mu’adhdhin says: ‘Qad qamatis salah’ (The prayer has been
established)."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.340 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.269

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ لا يُصَلِّي الْغَدَاةَ حَتَّى تُسْفِرَ وَ تَظْهَرَ الْحُمْرَةُ وَ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ أَيَرْكَعُهُمَا أَوْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمَا قَالَ
«يُؤَخِّرُهُمَا».
english_text:
From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him. about a man who does not pray the
morning prayer until it becomes bright and the redness appears, and he has not yet
performed the two rak‘ahs of Fajr. Should he perform them or delay them?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should delay them."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.340 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.266

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحَجَّالِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ قَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا بِمِائَةٍ آيَةٍ وَ لا يَحْتَسِبُ بِهِمَا وَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ هُوَ جَالِسْ يَقْرَأْ فِيهِمَا ب «قُلْ هُوَ
اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ «قُلْ يا أَيُهَا الكَافِرُونَ» فَإِنِ اِسْتَيْقَظَ مِنَ اللِّيْلِ صَلَّى صَلاةَ اللِّيْلِ وَ أَوْتَرَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ
اَلْفَجْرُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَصَارَتْ شَفْعاً وَ اِحْتَسَبَ بِالرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللْتَيْنِ صَلاَّهُمَا بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ وَثْراً.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hajjal from Abu Abdullah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, would perform two rak‘ahs after the ‘Isha prayer,
in which He {a.s} would recite one hundred verses, and He {a.s} would not count them as
part of anything.
And He {a.s} would perform two rak‘ahs while sitting, in which He {a.s} would recite (Surah
Al Ikhlas) and (Surah Al Kafirun). Then if He {a.s} woke up during the night, He {a.s} would
perform the night prayer and the Witr.
And if He {a.s} did not wake up until the dawn had risen, He {a.s} would perform two
rak‘ahs, and they would count as the Shaf‘, and He {a.s} would count the two rak‘ahs He
{a.s} had prayed after ‘Isha as the Witr.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.340 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.253 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.121 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.120

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
عنه عن محمد بن الحسين عن ابن محبوب عن معاوية ابن وهب قال : سمعت أبا عبد اللّه عليه السلام يقول :
أما يرضى أحدكم أن يقوم قبيل الصبح ويوتر ويصلي ركعتي الفجر وتكتب له صلاة الليل.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Mahbub, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “Is it not sufficient for one of you to
rise shortly before dawn, perform the Witr, and pray the two rak‘ahs of Fajr, and it will
be recorded for him as the night prayer?”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : « «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَ
الْيَوْمِ اَلْآخِرِ» فَلاَ يَبِيتَنّ إِلاَّ بِوَثْرٍ».
١٦ - باب احكام السهو
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s} said: "Whoever believes in Allah {SWT} and the Last Day (Qiyama) should
not pass the night without performing Witr."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.200 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.98 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.94 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.95 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.95 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.145

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيُرْفَعُ لَهُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ نِصْفُهَا وَ ثُلْثُهَا وَ رُبُعُهَا وَ خُمُسُهَا فَمَا يُزْفَعُ إِلَّ مَا أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهَا بِقَلْبِهِ وَ إِنَّمَا أُمِرُوا
بِالنَّوَافِلِ لِيُتَمَّمَ لَهُمْ بِهَا مَا نَقَصُوا مِنَ الْفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, a servant’s prayer may be raised up
for him as half of it, or a third of it, or a fourth of it, or a fifth of it. Only that part of it is
raised up in which his heart is truly present.
And they were commanded to perform supererogatory prayers so that with them, what
was lacking from the obligatory prayers could be completed."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.363 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.328 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.847 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.71 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.66 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.238 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.28

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ : «يُرْفَعُ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رُبُعْهَا أَوْ
ثُمُنُهَا أَوْ نِصْفُهَا أَوْ أَكْثَرُ بِقَدْرٍ مَا سَهَا وَ لَكِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يُتِمُ ذَلِكَ بِالنَّوَافِلِ».
english_text:
From him, from Faddalah from someone who narrated it from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him said: "A man’s prayer may be raised up for him as
a fourth of it, or an eighth of it, or a half of it, or more, according to how much he was
heedless. But Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, completes that through the supererogatory
prayers."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.847 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.74 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.235

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ الثُمَالِيَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلامُ يُصَلَّي فَسَقَطَ رِدَاهُ عَنْ مَنكِبَيْهِ قَالَ فَلَمْ يُسَوِّهِ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «وَيُحَكَ
أَتَدْرِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْ مَنْ كُنْتُ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَلاَةٌ إلاَّ مَا أَقْبَلَ مِنْهَا» فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ هَلَكْنَا فَقَالَ «كَلاً إِنَّ
اللّهَ تَعَالَى يُتَمِّمُ ذَلِكَ بِالنَّوَافِلِ».
english_text:
From him, by Hammad ibn ‘Isa, said: One of our companions narrated to me from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali:
I (Abu Hamza) saw (Imam) Ali ibn al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon them both, praying,
and His {a.s} cloak fell from His {a.s} shoulders.
Imam {a.s} did not adjust it until He {a.s} had completed His {a.s} prayer.
I asked Imam {a.s} about that, and Imam {a.s} said:
"Woe to you! Do you know before whom I was standing? Indeed, a servant’s prayer is
not accepted from him except that part of it in which he was fully attentive."
I (Abu Hamza) asked: “May I be your ransom! Then we are doomed.”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, indeed Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, completes that with the
supererogatory prayers."
source: Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.847 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.478

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا
أَسْمَعُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّي كَثِيرُ السَّهْوِ فِي الصِّلاةِ فَقَالَ »وَ هَلْ يَسْلَمُ مِنْهُ أَحَدٌ» فَقُلْتُ مَا أَظْنُ أَحَداً أَكْثَرَ سَهْواً مِنِّي
فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّ ٱلْعَبْدَ يُرْفَعُ لَهُ ثُلُثُ صَلاَتِهِ وَ نِصْفُهَا وَ ثَلاَثَةُ أَرْبَاعِهَا وَ أَقَلُّ وَ أَكْثَرُ
عَلَى قَدْرٍ سَهْوِهِ فِيهِ وَ لَكِنَّهُ يُتَمُ لَهُ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ مَا أَرَى النَّوَافِلَ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تُثْرَكَ عَلَى حَالٍ فَقَالَ
أُبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «أُجَلْ لا».
english_text:
From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:
A man said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, while I was listening:
"May I be your ransom! I am very forgetful in prayer."
Imam {a.s} said: "And is there anyone who is safe from it?"
I said: "I do not think anyone is more forgetful than I am."
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "O Aba Muhammad, a servant’s prayer may
be raised for him as a third, or a half, or three-quarters, or less, or more, according to
the extent of his forgetfulness in it. But it is completed for him through the
supererogatory prayers."
Then Abu Basir said to Imam {a.s}: "I see that the supererogatory prayers should never
be abandoned under any circumstance."
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Yes, indeed."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.342 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.848

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ: «إِنَّمَا لَكَ مِنْ صَلاتِكَ مَا أَقْبَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهَا فَإِنْ أَوْهَمَهَا كُلَّهَا أَوْ غَفَلَ عَنْ
أَدَائِهَا لُفِّثْ فَضْرِبَ بِهَا وَجْهُ صَاحِبِهَا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar
from Abu Ja‘far {a.s} and Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "You are granted from your prayer only that portion of it to which you
give your attention. So if you are heedless of it entirely, or neglect its performance, it
is wrapped up and struck against the face of its performer."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.342 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.476 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.260

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ فِي كِتَابِ حَرِيزٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: إِنِّي نَسِيتُ أَنِّي فِي صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ
حَتَّى رَكَعْتُ وَ أَنَا أَنْوِيهَا تَطَوْعاً قَالَ فَقَالَ «هِيَ آَلَّتِي قُمْتَ فِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتَ قُمْتَ وَ أَنْتَ تَنْوِي فَرِيضَةً ثُمَّ دَخَلَكَ
الشَكّ فَأَنْتَ فِي الْفَرِيضَةِ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ دَخَلْتَ فِي نَافِلَةٍ فَتَنْوِيهَا فَرِيضَةً فَأَنْتَ فِي النَّافِلَةِ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ دَخَلْتَ فِي
فَرِيضَةِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتَ نَافِلَةً كَانَتْ عَلَيْكَ فَامْضٍ فِي الْفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, who said:
In the book of Hariz, he said: “I forgot that I was in an obligatory prayer until I had
already bowed, and I had intended it as a supererogatory prayer.”
He said: "It is according to what you stood for, if you stood with the intention of an
obligatory prayer and then doubt entered upon you, then you are in the obligatory
prayer. But if you began with the intention of a supererogatory prayer and then
intended it to be obligatory, then you are in the supererogatory prayer. And if you began
in an obligatory prayer and then remembered a supererogatory prayer that was due
upon you, then proceed with the obligatory prayer."
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.342 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.911 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.6

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
محمد بن مسعود العياشي عن جعفر بن أحمد عن علي بن الحسن عن محمد بن عيسى عن يونس عن معاوية
قال سألت أبا عبد اللّه عليه السلام : عن رجل قام في الصلاة المكتوبة فسها فظن انها نافلة ، أو كان في النافلة
فظن انها مكتوبة قال : هي ما أفتتح الصلاة عليه.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Mas‘ud al-‘Ayyashi from Ja‘far ibn Ahmad from Ali ibn al-Hasan from Muhammad ibn Isa
from Yunus from Mu‘awiyah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who stood for an obligatory
prayer but due to forgetfulness thought it was a supererogatory one, or was in a
supererogatory prayer and thought it was an obligatory one.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is according to what he began the prayer upon."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمْدَوَيْهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَامَ فِي صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَةً وَ هُوَ يَنْوِي أَنَّهَا نَافِلَةٌ قَالَ
«هِيَ الَّتِي قُمْتَ فِيهَا وَ لَهَا» وَ قَالَ «إِذَا قُمْتَ وَ أَنْتَ تَنْوِي الْفَرِيضَةَ فَدَخَلَكَ الشَّكْ بَعْدُ فَأَنْتَ فِي ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ عَلَى
اَلَّذِي قُمْتَ لَهُ وَ إنْ كُنْتَ دَخَلْتَ فِيهَا وَ أَنْتَ تَنوِي نَافِلَةً ثُمّ إِنَّكَ تَنوِيهَا بَعْدُ فَرِيضَةً فَأَنْتَ فِي النَّافِلَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا يُحْسَبُ
لِلْعَبْدٍ مِنْ صَلاتِهِ الَّتِي اِبْتَدَأْ فِي أَوْلِ صَلاَتِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Hamdawayh, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdul-Aziz,
from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya‘fur, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who stood for an obligatory prayer and prayed one rak‘ah
while intending it to be a supererogatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is according to what you stood for and intended."
And Imam {a.s} said: "If you stood while intending an obligatory prayer, and then doubt
entered upon you afterward, then you are in the obligatory prayer according to what
you stood for. But if you began it while intending it as a supererogatory prayer, and then
afterward you intend it as obligatory, then you are in the supererogatory prayer.
Indeed, what is counted for the servant from his prayer is what he began with at the
start of his prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.343 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.382 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.912 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.7

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى
السَّابَاطِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: فِي الرَّجْلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَيُصَلِّي عَشَرَ رَكَعَاتٍ أَيَخْتَسِبُ
بِالرَّكْعَنَيْنِ مِنْ صَلَاَةٍ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ «لا إِلَّ أَنْ يُصَلَّيَهَا عَمْداً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَنْوِ ذَلِكَ فَلا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah
from ‘Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who intends to pray
eight rak‘ahs but ends up praying ten rak‘ahs, are the two extra rak‘ahs counted as
part of another prayer upon him?
Imam {a.s} said: "No, unless he deliberately intends that. But if he did not intend it, then
no."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.343 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1010 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.7

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةً وَ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ السَّهْو فِي النَّافِلَةِ فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْء».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Faddalah and Safwan from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the
two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about forgetfulness in the supererogatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is nothing upon you."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.359 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.343 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1000 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.230

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَثْرَ عَلَيْكَ اَلسَّهْوُ فَامْضٍ فِي
صَلاتِكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Faddalah, from Ibn Sinan, from more than one person:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If forgetfulness becomes frequent for you,
then proceed with your prayer."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.343 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.999 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.228 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.272

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسْلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَثْرَ عَلَيْكَ السّهْوُ فَامْضٍ
عَلَى صَلاَتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَدَعَكَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ».
english_text:
From him, from Faddalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If forgetfulness becomes frequent for you,
then proceed with your prayer, for it is likely to leave you. Indeed, it is from Shaytan."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.359 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.343 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.998 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.227 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.272

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ السَّهْوِ فَإِنَّهُ يَكْثُرُ عَلَيَّ
فَقَالَ «أَذرِج صَلاَتَكَ إدرَاجاً» قُلْتُ وَ أَيّ شَيْءِ الْإِدْرَاجُ قَالَ «ثَلاَثُ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Bukayr from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about forgetfulness (in prayer), for it
occurs frequently with me.
Imam {a.s} said: "Merge your prayer with merging (idraj)."
I asked: “What is merging?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Three tasbihat (glorifications) in the bowing and prostration."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1001 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.236

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «كُلُّ مَا شَكَكْتَ
فِيهِ مِمَّا قَدْ مَضَى فَامْضِهِ كَمَا هُوَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Everything you doubt from what has already
passed, proceed with it as it is."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.949 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.237

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ وَ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي
السَّهو فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «تَبْنِي عَلَى الْيَقِينِ وَ تَأْخُذُ بِالْجَزْمِ وَ تَحْتَاطُ بِالصَّلاَةِ كُلَّهَا».
english_text:
From him, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abdur-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj and Ali:
Abu Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding forgetfulness in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "You build upon certainty, act upon what is firm, and apply precaution
to the entire prayer."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.987 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.213 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.237

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْإِمَامِ
سَهَوْ وَ لاَ عَلَى مَنْ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ سَهْوُ وَ لاَ عَلَى السَّهْوِ سَهْوُ وَ لاَ عَلَى الْإِعَادَةِ إِعَادَةٌ».
english_text:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no forgetfulness upon the Imam
(of prayer), nor upon the one who is behind the Imam (of prayer). There is no
forgetfulness upon forgetfulness, and there is no repetition upon repetition."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.359 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.999 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.239

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي الرَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الظُهْرِ أَوْ غَيْرِهِمَا وَ لَمْ تَتَشَهَذْ فِيهِمَا فَذَكَرْتَ ذَلِكَ فِي الرّكْعَةِ الثَّالِئَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ
فَاجْلِسْ فَتَشَهَدْ وَ قُمْ فَأَتِمّ صَلاَتَكَ وَ إِنْ أَنْتَ لَمْ تَذْكُرْ حَتَّى تَرْكَعَ فَامْضٍ فِي صَلاَتِكَ حَتَّى تَفْرُغَ فَإِذَا قَرَغْتَ
فَاسْجُذْ سَجْدَتَي السَّهْوِ بَعْدَ التَّسْلِيمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you stand up after the two rak‘ahs of
Dhuhr or any other prayer and did not recite the tashahhud in them, and you remember
that in the third rak‘ah before bowing, then sit and recite the tashahhud, then stand
and complete your prayer. But if you do not remember until after you have bowed, then
proceed with your prayer until you complete it. Once you have finished, perform the
two prostrations of forgetfulness after the taslim and before you speak."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.357 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.939 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.406

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ : «إِذَا قُمْتَ
فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوّلَتَيْنِ وَ لَمْ تَتَشَهَدْ فَذَكَزْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ فَاقْعُدْ فَتَشَهَدْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَذْكُرْ حَتَّى تَرْكَعَ فَامْضٍ فِي
صَلاَتِكَ كَمَا أَنْتَ فَإِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ سَجَدْتَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ لا رُكُوعَ فِيهِمَا ثُمَّ تَتَشَهَدُ التَّشَهُدَ الَّذِي فَاتَكَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If you stand up after the first two rak‘ahs
and did not recite the tashahhud, and you remember before you bow, then sit and
recite the tashahhud. But if you do not remember until after you have bowed, then
proceed with your prayer as you are. Then, when you have finished, perform two
prostrations in which there is no bowing, then recite the tashahhud that you missed."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.357 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.344 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.939 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.244

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَّيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ:
فِي الرَّجُلٍ يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ ثُمَّ يَنْسَى فَيَقُومُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ بَيْنَهُمَا قَالَ «فَلْيَجْلِسْ مَا لَمْ يَرْكَعْ وَ قَدْ
تَمْثَ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَلْيَمْضٍ فِي صَلَاَتِهِ فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ نَقَرَ ثِنْتَيْنٍ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar:
Abu Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who prays the first two
rak‘ahs of an obligatory prayer, then forgets and stands up before sitting between
them.
Imam {a.s} said: "Then let him sit down as long as he has not yet bowed, and his prayer
is complete. But if he does not remember until after he has bowed, then let him
continue in his prayer. When he finishes with the salam, he should peck out (quickly
perform) two (rak‘ahs) while sitting."
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.345

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ الْبَرْقِي عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ
اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَسَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ وَ حَالُهُ حَالُهُ
قَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَرَادَ اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يُفَقِّهَهُمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from al-Hasan ibn Sadaqah:
I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Did the Messenger of Allah
{SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, ever end his prayer with the taslīm after only
the first two rak‘ahs?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
I asked: “Even in his state, as he was?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, only intended to teach
them (people around Him {saws}) jurisprudence."
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.356 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.345 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.955 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 7 p.105

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُعْمَانِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
«صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنٍ فَسَأْلَهُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحَدَثَ فِي الصَّلاةِ
شَيْءٌ قَالَ «وَ مَا ذَاكَ» قَالُوا إِنَّمَا صَلّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «أ كَذَاكَ يَا ذَا الْيَدَيْنِ » وَ كَانَ يُدْعَى ذَا الشَمَالَيْنِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ
فَبَنَى عَلَى صَلاتِهِ فَأَتَمَّ الصَّلاةَ أَرْبَعاً وَ قَالَ «إنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ هَوَ ٱلّذِي أَنْسَاهُ رَحْمَةً لِلْأَمَةِ أَلاَ تَرَى لَوْ أَنَّ رَجْلاً
صَنَعَ هَذَا لَعَيِّرَ» » وَ قِيلَ مَا تُقْبَلُ صَلاَتُكَ فَمَنْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «قَدْ سَنْ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ وَ صَارَتْ أُسْوَةً وَ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ لِمَكَانِ الْكَلاَمِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from Sa‘id al-A‘raj, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family, once prayed and then performed the salam after two rak‘ahs.
Those behind Him {saws} said: 'O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, has something occurred in the
prayer?'
He {saws} said: 'What is that?'
They said: 'You only prayed two rak‘ahs.'
He {saws} said: 'Is that so, O Dhu al-Yadayn?', as he used to be called Dhu al-Shimalayn.
He (Dhu al-Shimalayn) replied: 'Yes.'
So the Prophet {saws} continued from where He {saws} had left off, completed the prayer
as four rak‘ahs, and said: 'Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, is the One {AZJ}
who made me forget, as a mercy to the ummah. Do you not see that if a man were to
do this, he would be reproached, and it would be said to him: ‘Your prayer is not
accepted?'
But whoever experiences this now, let him know that the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
peace be upon him and his family, has already established the precedent and it has
become a model to follow.'
And He {saws} performed two prostrations (sajdatayn) because of the speech that took
place."
source: Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.357 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.345 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.954 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 7 p.105 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.217 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.4 p.257

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ
قَامَ قَالَ «يَسْتَقْبِلُ» قُلْتُ فَمَا يَرْوِي النَّاسُ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ حَدِيثَ ذِي الشَّمَالَيْنِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ لَمْ يَبْرَحْ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ وَ لَوْ بَرِحَ اِسْتَقْبَلَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who had prayed two rak‘ahs
and then stood up.
Imam {a.s} said: "He must start over."
I asked: “What about what people narrate, then I mentioned to him the narration of
Dhu al-Shimalayn.”
Imam {a.s} said: "The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, did not
leave His {saws} place, and had He {saws} left it, He {saws} would have had to start over."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.345 • Nuzhat Al-Nazir, Vol.1 p.39 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.957 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.200

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ
صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنٍ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَذَهَبَ فِي حَاجَتِهِ قَالَ «يَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّلاَةَ» فَقُلْتُ مَا بَالُ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
لَمْ يَسْتَقْبِلْ حِينَ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لَمْ يَنْفَتِلْ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Faddalah, from al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Sama‘ah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who prayed two rak‘ahs and
then got up and went about his need.
Imam {a.s} said: "He must begin the prayer anew."
I asked: “Why is it that the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family,
did not restart the prayer when He {saws} had prayed two rak‘ahs?”
Imam {a.s} said: "The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, had not
left his place."
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.345 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.957 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.201 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 7 p.100

Chapter Title: THE RULINGS ON FORGETFULNESS (AHKAM AL-SAHW)
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلامُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ
